text.title: 风行者的命运
text.objectives: 搜索风行者号的残骸以及附近的海岸，寻找希尔瓦娜斯的踪迹。
text.description: 寻找希尔瓦娜斯是我们的唯一优先事项！$B$B分头找的话可以搜索更大的范围。我带一支队伍到敌人营地上方的山岭去找，你到坠毁的地方去搜索飞艇的残骸，寻找船员的踪迹。$B$B等我们搜完高地，就到海滩的另一头汇合。

english.title: The Windrunner's Fate
english.objectives: Search the wreckage of the Windrunner and the nearby coastline for signs of Sylvanas.
english.description: Finding Sylvanas is our only priority!$B$BWe will cover more ground if we split up. I will lead a team into the hills above the enemy's camp while you search the wreckage itself for any signs of the crew.$B$BOnce we've cleared the high ground, I will meet you at the far end of the beach.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到黑暗女王的登陆地点
寻找恐怖船长塔特赛尔
搜索风行者号以寻找线索

text.title: 凋零者之怒
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个第七军团伞兵或天火号狮鹫骑士。
text.description: 联盟的渣滓这次惹到不该惹的人了。他们对女妖之王的攻击点燃了我的怒火！$B$B就像我的长弓、利斧和猎犬一样，你也将成为复仇的象征。让敌人的尸体堆积成山吧，$c，别忘了我的动作不会比你慢。下次再会时，希望能看到你的双手沾满鲜血。

english.title: Wrath of the Blightcaller
english.objectives: Slay $1oa 7th Legion Paratroopers or Skyfire Gryphon-Riders.
english.description: The Alliance dogs have bitten off more than they can chew. They have attacked the Banshee Queen, and invoked the wrath of her champion!$B$BLike my bow, my axes, and my hounds, you will be an agent of vengeance. Pile the bodies high, $c, and know that I am doing the same. When next we meet, I expect to see blood upon your hands.

text.title: 残忍的战利品
text.objectives: 获取蛮天领主的徽记。
text.description: 看来希尔瓦娜斯不希望任何人跟随——不管是我们还是其他的人。$B$B她有自己的想法，我不该质疑，只需要服从。$B$B附近的山岭中有一位狮鹫骑士正在准备起飞，打算从空中搜寻我们的女王。我的游侠们已经就位，随时准备挟制住他。$B$B在这一切结束以后，我要拿到他的徽记。

english.title: A Grim Trophy
english.objectives: Take the Head of Thane Wildsky.
english.description: It would seem Sylvanas does not wish to be followed - by us or anyone else.$B$BHer will is her own, it is not my place to question. Only to obey.$B$BIn the hills nearby, a gryphon master is preparing to take flight, no doubt to pursue our queen from the sky. My rangers are lying in wait - we need only to close our jaws around him.$B$BI will have his head when this is over.

text.title: Azsuna - Treasure 016 - Cask of Special Reserve

english.title: Azsuna - Treasure 016 - Cask of Special Reserve

text.title: 搜寻大领主
text.objectives: 在破碎海滩搜寻提里奥·弗丁和灰烬使者。
text.description: 提里奥的生命正在地狱般的海滩上慢慢流逝……灰烬使者还在他手上！我们片刻也不能耽误。$B$B等你准备好了就告诉我，我们要立刻开始行动。
text.completion: I owe you my life, $n. We all do.

english.title: The Search for the Highlord
english.objectives: Recover Tirion Fordring and the Ashbringer from the Broken Shore.
english.description: Tirion is fading away on that infernal shore... and the Ashbringer with him! We must not waste another moment.$B$BGive the word and we'll set off. We're ready when you are.
english.completion: I owe you my life, $n. We all do.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵
玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵
玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

text.title: 翡翠女王
text.objectives: 准备好以后和玛法里奥谈一谈。
text.description: $n，你回来了。很好。$b$b与其他的大德鲁伊们商讨过后，我们一致认为，塞纳留斯的情况只是某个更为严重的问题的征兆。你在月爪谷的经历更加证实了这一点。$b$b我们需要帮助。$b$b有一个人可以为我们解读这些事情。现在绍恩走了，我们只能请求你来帮助我们与梦境女王取得联系。
text.completion: Behold, Ysera, the Emerald Queen.

english.title: The Emerald Queen
english.objectives: Speak to Malfurion when ready.
english.description: $n, you have returned. Good.$b$bI have counseled with the other archdruids and concluded that Cenarius' condition is merely a symptom of a much greater problem. Your experiences in Moonclaw Vale make that clear.$b$bWe need help.$b$bThere is one who can bring understanding to these events. With Thaon gone, we must ask that you aid us in reaching out to the Lady of Dreams.
english.completion: Behold, Ysera, the Emerald Queen.

text.title: 传承大德鲁伊
text.objectives: 前往萨斯塔拉寻找埃洛瑟尔。
text.description: 埃洛瑟尔居住在古老的萨斯塔拉林地，他在那里与自然进行交流，并将治疗之术与知识的传承教导给他的信徒。$b$b去找到他，并告诉他这里非常需要他的帮助。
text.completion: Welcome, traveler.

english.title: Archdruid of Lore
english.objectives: Seek out Elothir in Thas'talah.
english.description: Elothir resides in the ancient grove Thas'talah, where he communes with nature and instructs his acolytes in the ways of healing and the preservation of lore.$b$bSeek him out and tell him that he is desperately needed here.
english.completion: Welcome, traveler.

text.title: 谷地大德鲁伊
text.objectives: 与绍恩·月爪谈一谈。
text.description: 月爪谷位于森林深处。$b$b那里隐居着一群野性德鲁伊，他们保护着瓦尔莎拉的自然平衡。$b$b绍恩·月爪是这群德鲁伊的领袖，他是大德鲁伊中最勇猛的一位。$b$b去找他，告诉他塞纳留斯需要他的帮助。
text.completion: Cenarius will have my aid once my grove has been made safe.
text.completed: 在月爪谷与绍恩·月爪谈一谈。

english.title: Archdruid of the Vale
english.objectives: Speak with Thaon Moonclaw.
english.description: Deep within our forest lies Moonclaw Vale.$b$bThere you will find a reclusive group of feral druids charged with the protection of Val'sharah from any that would seek to disrupt the balance of nature.$b$bThese druids are led by Thaon Moonclaw, the most fierce of the Archdruids.$b$bSeek him out. Let him know that Cenarius is in need of his aid.
english.completion: Cenarius will have my aid once my grove has been made safe.
english.completed: Speak with Thaon Moonclaw in the Moonclaw Vale.

text.title: 自然的呼唤
text.objectives: 在洛拉希尔与阿兰妮勒谈一谈。
text.description: 这是什么样的邪恶力量？！$b$b连半神也受到这个诅咒的影响？简直难以想象！$b$b快点，$n，你必须召集森林里的大德鲁伊。有了他们的帮助，我们就可以召唤伊瑟拉。她一定知道是什么在控制我的导师。$b$b我会留在这里，尽可能地帮助塞纳留斯。$b$b回洛拉希尔去找阿兰妮勒，她知道大德鲁伊在哪里。$b$b朋友，事不宜迟……
text.completion: Cenarius is in need? Lord of the Forest, we shall not fail you...

english.title: Nature's Call
english.objectives: Speak to Aranelle in Lorlathil.
english.description: What vile power is this?!$b$bA curse with the strength to paralyze a demigod? Unimaginable!$b$bQuickly, $n, you must gather the archdruids of the forest. With their help, we can summon Ysera. She will surely know what horror has overtaken my mentor.$b$bI will remain here and lend Cenarius what aid I can.$b$bReturn to Lorlathil and speak with Aranelle. She will know the archdruids' whereabouts.$b$bAnd please, friend, make haste...
english.completion: Cenarius is in need? Lord of the Forest, we shall not fail you...

text.title: 7.0 Val'sharah - Treasure 012 - Grove of Cenarius - twh

english.title: 7.0 Val'sharah - Treasure 012 - Grove of Cenarius - twh

text.title: 一枚不落
text.objectives: 把德拉诺错币交给铁炉堡的克罗姆·粗臂。你可以通过完成每天的第一个《德拉诺之王》随机英雄地下城来获取德拉诺错币。
text.description: 有趣——你从要塞找来的那些硬币跟诺兰从外域收集到的稍有不同。看这儿，看到边缘的印记没？真是太有意思了！看来得做进一步研究才行，那意味着我们需要更多的硬币！帮我多带些来，我不会让你白忙的。
text.end: 把德拉诺错币交给铁炉堡的克罗姆·粗臂。

english.title: Completionism
english.objectives: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
english.description: Interesting - the coins you've brought back from your Garrison are slightly different than the ones Nolan collected in Outland. Y'see here, the markings along the edge? Very interesting stuff! This requires some more study an' that means more coins! Bring them to me and I'll see if I can scrounge up something for your trouble.
english.end: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge.

text.title: 一枚不落
text.objectives: 把德拉诺错币交给幽暗城的艾斯特蕾·根德瑞。你可以通过完成每天的第一个《德拉诺之王》随机英雄地下城来获取德拉诺错币。
text.description:
这简直无法容忍！你给我带回来的那些硬币，跟我之前收藏的那些根本不配套！这不会是你伪造的吧？真不是？哼。那看来我错怪你了，亲爱的。

弥补的办法只有一个，小家伙：我们得凑齐你新发现的这套硬币。给我带更多错币来！
text.end: 把德拉诺错币交给幽暗城的艾斯特蕾·根德瑞。

english.title: Completionism
english.objectives: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
english.description:
This is intolerable! The coins you brought me do not match the rest of the coins I already have! You aren't counterfeiting these are you? No? Hrumph. In that case I'm sorry we fought, dearie.

There's only one thing to do, buttercup: we need to complete the new set you've discovered. Bring me more misprinted coins!
english.end: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity.

text.title: 古里古怪
text.objectives: 把德拉诺错币交给铁炉堡的克罗姆·粗臂。你可以通过完成每天的第一个《德拉诺之王》随机英雄地下城来获取德拉诺错币。
text.description: 我一直在拿你带回来的硬币跟流通中的其它硬币做对比。有些是稍有错误……还有一些简直错得离谱。瞧这个，这枚硬币上居然印了两个脑袋。第二个脑袋还在盯着我笑，之前可没有啊。$b$b看来有更大的谜团需要破解，而这些错币就是揭晓答案的关键。快帮我多找一些来吧。
text.end: 把德拉诺错币交给铁炉堡的克罗姆·粗臂。

english.title: A Curious Oddity
english.objectives: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
english.description: I've been looking at some of the other coins in circulation plus the ones you've brought back. Some o' these are misprints... others are just plain wrong. Look 'ere. This one's got two heads. And the second one is smiling at me, where it wasn't before.$b$bThere's a bigger mystery in play here and these misprints are the key to figuring it out. I'm gonna need even more.
english.end: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge.

text.title: 古里古怪
text.objectives: 把德拉诺错币交给幽暗城的艾斯特蕾·根德瑞。你可以通过完成每天的第一个《德拉诺之王》随机英雄地下城来获取德拉诺错币。
text.description: 听着宝贝儿，我这儿有一个好消息和一个坏消息。好消息是，你已经给我带来了足够多的硬币来凑齐这套错币！坏消息是，这里面没有一枚能跟之前那套对得上。$b$b瞧这个——这枚硬币有两个脑袋。反面的那张脸还在朝我笑，他在一个小时前还是一脸严肃呢。这枚更绝，我用灯照它的时候，居然还眯缝起了眼。实在是太神秘了！给我多找些来！
text.end: 把德拉诺错币交给幽暗城的艾斯特蕾·根德瑞。

english.title: A Curious Oddity
english.objectives: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
english.description: Well sweet pea, I have good news and bad news for you. The good news is that you brought me enough coins to complete this new misprint set! The bad news is that not a single one of them has matched the original partial set.$b$bSee here - this coin has two heads. And the face on the reverse is grinning at me, where he was looking so dour only an hour ago. This one squints when I shine a light on it. Such a mystery! I must have more!
english.end: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity.

text.title: DEPRECATED
text.objectives: Collect a Bass Blaster, Laz-tron Disc Reader, Phonic Amplifier, S.P.R.K. Capacitor, and a Cord of Ancient Wood.
text.description:
You know what would boost morale around here?

Bass. Beats. Music!

Everyone loves a party! You go out and get me some hardware, and I'll make a system that will shatter Draenor itself.
text.completed: This is completion text.

english.title: DEPRECATED
english.objectives: Collect a Bass Blaster, Laz-tron Disc Reader, Phonic Amplifier, S.P.R.K. Capacitor, and a Cord of Ancient Wood.
english.description:
You know what would boost morale around here?

Bass. Beats. Music!

Everyone loves a party! You go out and get me some hardware, and I'll make a system that will shatter Draenor itself.
english.completed: This is completion text.

text.title: 同中有异
text.objectives: 把德拉诺错币交给铁炉堡的克罗姆·粗臂。你可以通过完成每天的第一个《德拉诺之王》随机英雄地下城来获取德拉诺错币。
text.description: 我开始怀疑这些硬币带有恶魔之力。瞧见没？这枚硬币的人头上有三只眼！这个则总是露出尾巴。再看看这里——还记得你之前给我带来的那些硬币吗？它们居然在圣水里溶解了。$b$b我得仔细确认一下，证明这一切不是偶然——再给我带一大堆硬币来，我得研究个明白，好让所有人都心服口服。
text.end: 把德拉诺错币交给铁炉堡的克罗姆·粗臂。

english.title: The Same, But Different
english.objectives: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
english.description: I'm beginning to suspect these here coins are demonic. See? This one's got three eyes! This one always comes up tails. And over here - the ones you brought me earlier? They dissolved in holy water.$b$bI need to make absolutely sure this isn't a fluke - bring me a huge pile of coins to sort through so nobody can refute m'theory.
english.end: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge.

text.title: 同中有异
text.objectives: 把德拉诺错币交给幽暗城的艾斯特蕾·根德瑞。你可以通过完成每天的第一个《德拉诺之王》随机英雄地下城来获取德拉诺错币。
text.description: 我的一位助手提出了极其有趣的理论，也许能够解释这些硬币究竟哪里不对劲。我们相信它们可能是出自恶魔之手。瞧见没？这枚上有三只眼睛，而这一枚则总是露出尾巴。还有这枚，居然会在半夜里跟我说悄悄话——噢，别嫉妒嘛，宝贝儿。你始终都是我的最爱。$b$b……前提是你得给我带更多硬币来，好让我验证我们的理论。快去吧！
text.end: 把德拉诺错币交给幽暗城的艾斯特蕾·根德瑞。

english.title: The Same, But Different
english.objectives: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
english.description: A most intriguing theory has been put forth by an associate of mine that may explain what's wrong with these coins. We believe they might be demonic in origin. See? This one's got three eyes. And this one always comes up tails. And THIS one whispers to me at night - on now, don't be jealous sweetheart. You're still my favorite.$b$b...Provided you bring me more coins so I can confirm our theory. Run along!
english.end: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity.

text.title: 抵御风暴
text.objectives: 在赫达沙尔找到登山鞋、浸油斗篷，以及魔化磁石。
text.description:
我四下打探之后，发现登山好像已经成为了维库人的例行习惯。他们有一些特别设计的登山装备，既然我们在这里，不如去拿些来用用看。

我建议你去找到登山鞋，这样在爬坡的时候可以防滑，再搞件可以遮雨的浸油斗篷。此外，他们好像还会带着魔化磁石来避免雷电，你最好也去弄一个。
text.completion: Excellent. These should do well to protect you from the storm.

english.title: To Weather the Storm
english.objectives: Collect Climbing Treads, an Oiled Cloak, and an Enchanted Lodestone from Hrydshal.
english.description:
I've been doing some nosing around, and it looks like these vrykul are making regular trips up the mountain themselves. They've got some specialized gear for it, so while we're here we should take some.

I'd recommend finding some climbing treads to keep your grip on the slopes, as well as an oiled cloak to keep the rain out. Also, it looks like they carry enchanted lodestones, which seem to keep the lightning at bay. You should probably grab one of those, too.
english.completion: Excellent. These should do well to protect you from the storm.

text.title: 漂流瓶
text.objectives: 把欧库纳的信带给艾瑞瑟夫人。
text.description:
<你在尸体上找到一个瓶子。里面有一封来自欧库纳·长牙的求救信。这个欧库纳声称自己和其他的船员都遭到了海巨人的俘虏。

你可以把求救信拿给倾颓王宫的艾瑞瑟夫人看看，或许她能给你指路。>
text.completion:
You say you found this message in a bottle? How quaint.

Yes, I can point you in the right direction, but are you sure you want to take on the sea giant prince and his skrogs? Just to free a bunch of unwashed sailors?

english.title: Bottled Up
english.objectives: Take Okuna's Message to Lady Irisse.
english.description:
<You've found a message in a bottle on the corpse. It's a request for aid from someone named Okuna Longtusk. Okuna claims that he and his fellow shipmates are being held prisoner by sea giants.

Maybe if you show the note to the ghost of Lady Irisse at the Crumbled Palace, she can point you in the right direction?>
english.completion:
You say you found this message in a bottle? How quaint.

Yes, I can point you in the right direction, but are you sure you want to take on the sea giant prince and his skrogs? Just to free a bunch of unwashed sailors?

text.title: 新商品
text.objectives: 与克劳勒中士谈一谈。
text.description: 克劳勒中士那又有新东西了。你不妨找时间尽快去看看他的新商品！
text.giverWindow: 在你的要塞里找到克劳勒中士。

english.title: New Goods
english.objectives: Talk with Sergeant Crowler.
english.description: New items are available from Sergeant Crowler.  I suggest you stop by and take a look at his new goods as soon as you can!
english.giverWindow: Find Sergeant Crowler in your Garrison.

text.title: 穿刺保险
text.objectives: 用爪钩枪爬上赫达沙尔城墙的顶端，然后拆除7座蔑潮鱼叉发射器。
text.description:
我有个坏消息。城墙上的那些鱼叉发射器可能会给我们带来一些麻烦。

我们在下面还算安全，但一旦我们开始登山，它们就会把你射成刺猬。

如果你用上爪钩枪，应该就能爬上城墙的顶端，然后拆掉它们。但是小心龙！
text.completion: Hah! I bet they never saw that coming!$B$BSeems like we've got no shortage of obstacles left, though.

english.title: Impalement Insurance
english.objectives: Grapple on top of the walls in Hrydshal and dismantle 7 Tideskorn Harpoon Launchers.
english.description:
I've got bad news. Those harpoon launchers up on the walls might cause us some problems. 

They can't get at us down here, but once you start climbing that path, they're likely going to try to skewer you.

If you use that grapple launcher, you should be able to get on top of the walls and dismantle them. Watch out for the drakes, though!
english.completion: Hah! I bet they never saw that coming!$B$BSeems like we've got no shortage of obstacles left, though.

text.title: 高处不胜寒
text.objectives: 从塔楼发射爪钩枪，然后顺着山路爬到顶端。
text.description:
塔楼上应该有合适的位置可以发射爪钩枪，让你前往山路。过去之后我就帮不上忙了，不过你应该可以一路爬到山顶。 

希望你能从上面的巨龙那里得到想要的东西。天知道神王对它们做了些什么。
text.completion: You are here for the trial? I'm afraid you might be too late.$B$BThis battle with these Felskorn has taken its toll. I am too weak to grant you the power you seek...$B$BBut perhaps you may be able to help...

english.title: Above the Winter Moonlight
english.objectives: Grapple across from the tower and climb to the top of the mountain path.
english.description:
You should have a good vantage from this tower to grapple over to the mountain path. I can't help you once you're across, but you should be able to take it all the way up to the top. 

I hope you're able to find what you need from the dragons up there. Who knows what the God-King has done to them.
english.completion: You are here for the trial? I'm afraid you might be too late.$B$BThis battle with these Felskorn has taken its toll. I am too weak to grant you the power you seek...$B$BBut perhaps you may be able to help...

text.title: 自由之翼
text.objectives: 在托里姆峰解救阿雷菲尔、哈拉夫瑟尔、埃瑞拉和赫里德莫格尔。
text.description:
蔑魔者袭击龙穴的时候，托林尼尔为了拯救族群而英勇奋战。不过敌人的恶魔盟友实在太过强大，我们很多人都惨遭俘虏。

现在，他们正在腐化我的兄弟姐妹来为他们效命。 

拜托你，外来者，去解救我的同胞脱离悲惨的命运！
text.completion: I am truly indebted to you for this act. My siblings were not able to defend themselves against the Felskorn, and would have ended up their slaves. $B$BYou are a true friend of the Thorignir.

english.title: Wings of Liberty
english.objectives: Free Aleifir, Hrafsir, Erilar and Hridmogir in Thorim's Peak.
english.description:
When the Felskorn assaulted the nest, the Thorignir fought bravely to save our brood. But their demonic allies proved too much, and many of us were captured.

Even now they work to corrupt my brothers and sisters to turn them to their side. 

Please, outsider, free them from this fate!
english.completion: I am truly indebted to you for this act. My siblings were not able to defend themselves against the Felskorn, and would have ended up their slaves. $B$BYou are a true friend of the Thorignir.

text.title: 巨龙之心
text.objectives: 寻找并解救托林尼尔一族的龙母。
text.description:
神王通过暴力和腐化夺走了你想要的力量，不过对于你和托林尼尔而言，或许还有一线希望，$C。

蔑魔者借助我前所未见的邪能，对幼龙进行腐化并试图奴役托林尼尔。他们的首领是一个威力强大的恶魔，他抓走了我们的龙母，想要她屈服于神王。

找到她，并帮她脱离魔掌——只有这样，托林尼尔才能重获力量，并给予你帮助。
text.completion: I am relieved to hear that our mother is safe. $B$BI am sure she will wish to thank you herself.

english.title: Heart of a Dragon
english.objectives: Find and rescue the mother of the Thorignir brood.
english.description:
Through brute force and corruption, the God-King has taken the power you seek, but there may be hope for you and the Thorignir, $C.

With the aid of fel powers such as I've never seen, the Felskorn are corrupting our young and seeking to enslave the Thorignir. Their leader, a demon of great power, has captured our mother and seeks to bend her to the God-King's will.

Find her and free her from the demon's grasp - only then might the Thorignir regain our power and grant you aid.
english.completion: I am relieved to hear that our mother is safe. $B$BI am sure she will wish to thank you herself.

text.title: 要塞战役：进击奥金顿
text.objectives: 在塔拉多的奥金顿与莉亚德琳会面。
text.description: 你的盟友莉亚德琳发来了一封公文，说奥金顿附近的局面需要我们提供帮助。萨格雷对那里发动了新的突袭，闯进了某些极为重要的地方。这种事情恰恰发生在古尔丹的力量不断增长期间，应该不是巧合。我们会在这里关注前线战况的指挥官。
text.completed: 在塔拉多的奥金顿和莉亚德琳谈谈。

english.title: Garrison Campaign: Onslaught at Auchindoun
english.objectives: Meet Liadrin at Auchindoun in Talador.
english.description: Your ally, Liadrin, has sent a missive requesting aid near Auchindoun. The Sargerei have made a new assault there and breached something important. It is no coincidence this happened after Gul'dan's ascendancy. We will watch the front here, commander.
english.completed: Speak with Liadrin at Auchindoun in Talador.

text.title: 萨格雷的秘密
text.objectives: 寻找并阻止奥金顿地下的腐化源头。
text.description:
奥金尼人近来一直在汇报说奥金顿……有些……不大对劲。他们也找不到原因。那些萨格雷突然而至，打开了一个洞口通往地下室。

那个洞口现在正渗透出腐化的力量，我们需要阻止它。

english.title: Secrets of the Sargerei
english.objectives: Locate and stop the source of corruption underneath Auchindoun.
english.description:
The Auchenai have been reporting for some time that something was... wrong... with Auchindoun. They were never able to find a reason. Suddenly the Sargerei attacked and blew open a hole into a subchamber.

Corruption leaks from that hole, we need to stop it.

objectiveDetails.description: 破坏西部邪能汲魂水晶
破坏东部邪能汲魂水晶

text.title: 萨格雷的威胁
text.objectives: 杀死$1oa名萨格雷。
text.description:
这样的袭击真是出乎意料。他们肯定已经重兵布防了，我需要一些时间集结军队将他们彻底扫清。

你每杀死一个萨格雷，都可以减轻我们夺回这一地区时面对的压力，指挥官。

english.title: The Sargerei Menace
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Sargerei.
english.description:
An attack such as this was unexpected. They have deployed heavily and it will take me some time to marshal enough forces to root them out.

Any Sargerei you can slay will make retaking this area much easier commander.

text.title: 要塞战役：进击奥金顿
text.objectives: 在塔拉多的奥金顿与伊瑞尔会面。
text.description: 奥金尼人送来了一份紧急公文——奥金顿又一次危在旦夕！萨格雷又一次发动了攻势，破坏了地下大厅。我能感觉到这一切之后的主使就是古尔丹。$b$b收拾好行装，尽快到奥金顿西边的英灵之庭和我会合。
text.completed: 到塔拉多的奥金顿和伊瑞尔谈谈。

english.title: Garrison Campaign: Onslaught at Auchindoun
english.objectives: Meet Yrel at Auchindoun in Talador.
english.description: The Auchenai have sent me an urgent missive - Auchindoun is in jeopardy again! The Sargerei have renewed their assault  and breached the underhalls. I sense the hand of Gul'dan is behind this.$b$bGather your things and meet me in the Court of Souls West of Auchindoun at once!
english.completed: Speak with Yrel at Auchindoun in Talador.

text.title: 新商品
text.objectives: 与格里姆加中士谈一谈。
text.description: 格里姆加中士那又有新东西了。你不妨找时间尽快去看看他的新商品！
text.giverWindow: 在你的要塞里找到格里姆加中士。

english.title: New Goods
english.objectives: Talk with Sergeant Grimjaw.
english.description: New items are available from Sergeant Grimjaw.  I suggest you stop by and take a look at his new goods as soon as you can!
english.giverWindow: Find Sergeant Grimjaw in your Garrison.

english.title: A Fel Puppy Of My Own

text.title: Tanaan Jungle - Tracking Quest - Lion's Watch Built - JMC

english.title: Tanaan Jungle - Tracking Quest - Lion's Watch Built - JMC

text.title: 进攻塔纳安
text.objectives: 在船坞与卡德加会面，然后同伊瑞尔谈话，开始进军。
text.description: 完成了！按照你的命令，我们已经建好了第一艘舰船，现在可以从这里发动海上攻势了。$b$b既然已经有了运输手段，也该去告诉伊瑞尔和大法师卡德加，我们已经准备好向塔纳安发动攻击了。到码头上和他们谈谈，然后开始登船吧。

english.title: The Invasion of Tanaan
english.objectives: Meet with Khadgar at your shipyard and then speak to Yrel to begin the invasion.
english.description: It is done! By your command we have built our first ship and can run our naval operations from here.$b$bNow that we have our transport, we can let Yrel and Archmage Khadgar know that we are ready to kick off an invasion of Tanaan. Speak with them at the docks to embark.

text.title: 妨碍进程
text.objectives: 收集这个地区部队部署的情报，并与后面的斥候会合。
text.description: 我们在登陆时没有遇到任何抵抗。这些港口为什么全部被抛弃了？$b$b前面的游侠斥候报告遇到了麻烦。血环氏族的拾荒者正在西北方那些被遗弃的建筑里大肆掠夺，另外有些术士邪教徒们正潜伏在黑暗之门附近安营扎寨。我们先尽可能查明情况，并与斥候会合。

english.title: Obstacle Course
english.objectives: Find any information on the forces deployed in the area and meet with the scouts afterwards.
english.description: Our landing was unopposed. Why are these docks all but abandoned?$b$bThe rangari scouts up ahead report trouble. Bleeding Hollow scavengers are looting some abandoned buildings to the northwest, and an encampment of warlock cultists lurk near the Dark Portal. Let's find out what we can and meet up with our scouts.

objectiveDetails.description: 在血环氏族成员那里找到情报
在邪教徒那里找到情报

text.title: Max-level Choice Tracker: Tanaan 6.2 - The Fel Forge

english.title: Max-level Choice Tracker: Tanaan 6.2 - The Fel Forge

text.title: Max-level Choice Tracker: Tanaan 6.2 - The Fel Forge

english.title: Max-level Choice Tracker: Tanaan 6.2 - The Fel Forge

text.title: 突袭邪能熔炉
text.objectives: 突袭塔纳安丛林铁城港的钢铁部落援军。
text.description:
钢铁部落仍在从德拉诺各地调派援军以增援地狱火堡垒的防御力量。假如无法切断他们的补给线，我们在塔纳安的计划就会失去控制。

对铁城港的补给线进行一次战略打击应能使钢铁部落疲于防守，让我们能够维持住目前的成果。

english.title: Assault on the Fel Forge
english.objectives: Assault the Iron Horde reinforcements at Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description:
The Iron Horde continue to bring in reinforcements from all over Draenor to reinforce their position at Hellfire Citadel. If we don't cut off the flow of supplies then we risk losing control of our plans in Tanaan.

A strategic attack to the supply lines at Ironhold Harbor is just the thing to keep the Iron Horde on the defensive and maintain our momentum.

text.title: 突袭邪能熔炉
text.objectives: 突袭塔纳安丛林邪能熔炉的钢铁部落军队。
text.description:
钢铁部落的战争机器受到了邪能魔法的强化，这使我们的敌人变得日益强大。我们甚至打探到消息说她们正在打造一台魔能机甲！

前往邪能熔炉摧毁他们的军队，否则我们将会被魔能机甲给碾碎！

english.title: Assault on The Fel Forge
english.objectives: Assault the Iron Horde forces at the Fel Forge in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description:
The Iron Horde is growing stronger each day as their war machines are empowered with fel magic. We have even obtained word that they are constructing a Fel Reaver!

Head to the Fel Forge and destroy their forces before we are overwhelmed.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭邪能熔炉的钢铁部落部队

text.title: 突袭邪能熔炉
text.objectives: 突袭塔纳安丛林邪能熔炉的钢铁部落军队。
text.description:
钢铁部落的战争机器受到了邪能魔法的强化，这使我们的敌人变得日益强大。我们甚至打探到消息说她们正在打造一台魔能机甲！

前往邪能熔炉摧毁他们的军队，否则我们将会被魔能机甲给碾碎！

english.title: Assault on The Fel Forge
english.objectives: Assault the Iron Horde forces at the Fel Forge in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description:
The Iron Horde is growing stronger each day as their war machines are empowered with fel magic. We have even obtained word that they are constructing a Fel Reaver!

Head to the Fel Forge and destroy their forces before we are overwhelmed.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭邪能熔炉的钢铁部落部队

text.title: 栖地之旅
text.objectives: 在蓝翼栖地与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
text.description:
伊利达雷暂时还能守住对抗燃烧军团的阵线。我们晚点再回来帮他们把恶魔赶出法罗纳尔的上层区域。想要重新封印萨格拉斯之墓，你跟我就必须把精力放在创世之柱的事情上面。

幸好你救了丝黛拉苟萨。如果有人知道创世之柱的下落，那必定就是她的祖父，塞纳苟斯。

蓝翼栖地就在东北边。我会在那里跟你会合，$n。
text.completion:
He is... he's dying! Senegos is possibly the oldest dragon alive. We cannot simply let him slip away.

There is something not quite right with the magic energy here, I can feel it.

english.title: Journey to the Repose
english.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at the Azurewing Repose.
english.description:
For now, the Illidari can hold the line against the Legion. We will return later to help them drive the Legion from the upper reaches of Faronaar. You and I must concentrate on the Pillars of Creation if the Tomb of Sargeras is to be resealed.

Your saving of Stellagosa is fortuitous. Surely if anyone knows where a Pillar of Creation is, it will be her grandfather, Senegos.

The Azurewing Repose is to the northeast. I will meet you there, $n.
english.completion:
He is... he's dying! Senegos is possibly the oldest dragon alive. We cannot simply let him slip away.

There is something not quite right with the magic energy here, I can feel it.

text.title: 前进、突破、深入！
text.objectives: 摧毁为大门提供火力掩护的邪能防御火炮。
text.description: 古尔丹似乎把他的防御力量都集中到这个隘口了。前面的那些火炮和我们之前所见过的完全不同——它们被恶魔的能量强化过了。$b$b我们的敌人一定认为这条通道是无法穿越的。证明他们的错误吧，指挥官！如果我们能突破这里，前面那片土地将是建造堡垒的好地方。摧毁那门大炮！

english.title: In, Through, and Beyond!
english.objectives: Destroy the Fel Defense Cannon covering the gate.
english.description: Gul'dan seems to have concentrated his defenses on this chokepoint. The guns up ahead are unlike anything we've seen before - they're empowered with fel energy.$b$bOur enemies think this pass is impregnable. Let's prove them wrong, commander! If we can break through, the terrain ahead will make an excellent stronghold. Destroy that cannon!

text.title: 突袭基地
text.objectives: 在塔纳安丛林建造你的突袭基地。
text.description:
在你对付那些邪能火炮的时候，我已经找到了一个建立突袭哨所的完美位置。

跟我来，开始建造基地！

english.title: The Assault Base
english.objectives: Establish your assault base in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description:
While you were playing with fel fire, I've located the perfect position for an assault outpost.

Follow me and we can get this base started!

text.title: 指挥官亲征！
text.objectives: 从塔纳安丛林的多名斥候那里听取报告。
text.description: 我们会赢得战斗，但需要经历一场苦战。我们的游侠已经成功将几名斥候派到了丛林各处。$b$b也许你最好亲自去收集一些情报，也可以看看丛林中有什么东西在等着我们。

english.title: Commander in the Field!
english.objectives: Get reports from various scouts in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: This battle will be won, but it will be hard fought. Our rangari did manage to get a few scouts out to the rest of the jungle though.$b$bPerhaps it is best you collect this intelligence yourself and see what this jungle holds for us all.

objectiveDetails.description: 与塔纳安丛林西南的斥候谈一谈
与塔纳安丛林西北的斥候谈一谈
与塔纳安丛林东北的斥候谈一谈

text.title: 突袭沙纳尔神殿
text.objectives: 突袭塔纳安丛林中沙纳尔神殿的萨格雷军队。
text.description:
在塔纳安丛林的丘陵上，萨格雷将一座曾经的神殿变成了召唤恶魔的大本营。

趁他们的仪式还没有完成，我们必须立刻发动攻击。我们耽误地越久，敌人就越强大。

english.title: Assault on the Temple of Sha'naar
english.objectives: Assault the Sargerei forces at the Temple of Sha'naar in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description:
Up in the hills of Tanaan Jungle, the Sargerei have converted a once-sacred temple into a den of demonic summoning.

We must attack them now, before their rituals complete. The longer we delay, the stronger our enemy grows.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭沙纳尔神殿的萨格雷部队

text.title: 要塞战役：血环氏族的克星
text.objectives: 收集追踪地图，找到杀手的位置。
text.description:
指挥官，我们最近派了斥候前往泽斯高附近的丛林侦察，并听说了一些新消息。

似乎有其他人在报复血环氏族，到处……追杀……他们。他们的猎人正在密切追踪那个杀手。

你一定听过那句话，“敌人的敌人……”什么的。所以我们最好找到他们的追踪地图，抢先一步找到那个杀手！

english.title: Garrison Campaign: The Bane of the Bleeding Hollow
english.objectives: Collect tracking maps to find the location of the killer.
english.description:
Commander, now that we've had time to get scouts all over the jungle we have heard some news near Zeth'Gol.

It appears that somebody else has a vendetta against the Bleeding Hollow and has been... hunting... them. Their hunters are closing in on the assassin.

You know what they say about "the enemy of my enemy..." We should collect their tracking maps and try to find the killer first!

objectiveDetails.description: 从血环氏族成员身上获取狩猎地图

text.title: 狂暴的熊怪
text.objectives: 消灭8只燃皮熊怪。
text.description: 我会带你觐见大德鲁伊，不过我们现在身陷困境。$B$B附近的熊怪陷入了狂乱。$B$B这些天来，光是防止它们侵入林地就耗尽了我们的力气。$B$B它们切断了我们通往兽穴的道路，大德鲁伊和我们的族人都在那里沉睡于翡翠梦境。$B$B我们必须先从熊怪中杀过去，才有办法唤醒他们。
text.completion: The conflict against the furbolgs is abated, for now.

english.title: Frenzied Furbolgs
english.objectives: Kill 8 Smolderhide furbolgs.
english.description: I would help you seek audience with the Archdruid, but we have a difficult situation on our hands.$B$BThe nearby furbolgs have gone into a frenzied rage.$B$BFor days, it has been all we can do to protect our grove from their aggression.$B$BThey have cut off our access to the barrow dens, where the Archdruid and our clan sleep in the Emerald Dream.$B$BIn order to awaken them, we must first get past the furbolg.
english.completion: The conflict against the furbolgs is abated, for now.

text.title: 要塞战役：术士
text.objectives: 在塔纳安丛林的沃玛尔和那名术士谈谈。
text.description:
指挥官，你有一位客人。一个古尔丹手下的术士刚刚来到要塞向我们投降。他说他带来了关于即将发生的重大事件的情报。

我建议你立刻去和他谈谈。

english.title: Garrison Campaign: The Warlock
english.objectives: Speak with the warlock at Vol'mar in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description:
Commander, you have a visitor. One of Gul'dan's warlocks just walked up to the base and surrendered. He says he has information of a terrible event that is about to occur.

I suggest you speak with him immediately.

text.title: 远古试炼
text.objectives: 到阿格拉玛的宝库附近寻找哈维。
text.description:
<渡鸦凝视你的双眼时，你的脑海中出现了奇怪的声音。>

我知道你是谁，勇士，我也知道你在寻找什么。

如果你认为自己可堪重任，那就跟我来吧。
text.completed: 在阿格拉玛的宝库附近与哈维谈一谈。
text.giverWindow: 不知为何，这个奇怪的维库老人好像很了解你……

english.title: The Ancient Trials
english.objectives: Find Havi near Aggramar's Vault.
english.description:
<As the raven stares into your eyes, an odd voice fills your mind.>

I know who you are, champion, and I know what you seek.

Come to me, if you think yourself truly worthy.
english.completed: Speak with Havi near Aggramar's Vault.
english.giverWindow: This strange old vrykul seems to know you somehow...

text.title: 各取所需
text.objectives: 签下达格洛普的契约。
text.description: 嘿，伙计！$b$b你看起来很好骗，呃……我是说很“聪明”。$b$b我有个提议。$b$b我需要一个仆从来跑腿，帮我搞一些仪式用的特殊……“材料”。$b$b而我会把我的前主人交给你，让你这个恶魔克星尽尽本分。$b$b有兴趣的话就在这里签个名。用血液来签，谢谢。
text.completion: At last! A minion of my very own!

english.title: Let's Make A Deal
english.objectives: Sign Daglop's contract.
english.description: Hey there!$b$bYou seem like a gullib- er... um... "intelligent" type.$b$bI propose a deal.$b$bI need a minion to be my muscle to help me acquire a few special... "ingredients" for a ritual.$b$bIn exchange, I'll give you my former master to do with whatever you demon-slaying types do with demons.$b$bIf you are interested, just sign here. In blood, please.
english.completion: At last! A minion of my very own!

text.title: 突破屏障
text.objectives: 在邪能熔炉收集黑烛，防御宝典和暗影之刃，并将它们带给欧鲁诺克。
text.description:
仪式的地址已经准备好了，还有屏障的保护……我创造的屏障。我可以摧毁那道屏障，但我需要三件物品，它们现在都在铸魔营地：复仇中被使用着。

如果你能得到那些仪式用品，我会在腐化的避难所那里和你会面，消除那道屏障。哪怕赔上我自己的性命。

english.title: Breaching the Barrier
english.objectives: Collect the Black Candle, the Tome of Protection, and the Shadowblade at the Fel Forge and bring them to Oronok.
english.description:
The ritual site is already prepared, and it is protected by a barrier... one that I created. I can destroy the barrier, but I will need three items currently in use at Forge Camp Vengeance.

If you can get those ritual items, I will meet you at the Corrupted Refuge and remove the barrier. Even if it kills me.

text.title: 诅咒密码
text.objectives: 让欧鲁诺克和你的盟友摧毁屏障，然后阻止古尔丹。
text.description:
你的盟友和我马上就会清除这些障碍，不过这会消耗我们很大一部分力量。不管前面是什么，都不是那么容易对付的。

古尔丹利用密码强化了一个元素领主，让它变得疯狂了。他想要用它来破坏元素与德拉诺之间的联系。如果你能摧毁那个元素，我们就能收回密码了。

english.title: The Cipher of Damnation
english.objectives: Get Oronok and your ally to destroy the barrier, then stop Gul'dan.
english.description:
Your ally and I will remove this barrier now, though it will take a greater part of our strength. What lies beyond will not be easy.

Gul'dan will have empowered an elemental lord with the Cipher, driving it insane. He will use it to destroy the link between the elements and Draenor. If you destroy that elemental, we could recover the Cipher.

objectiveDetails.description: 与你的盟友交谈并打破屏障

text.title: 托林尼尔的意志
text.objectives: 到赫达沙尔外面去见罗娜·克罗雷，然后开始托林尼尔的试炼。
text.description:
巨龙在风暴之顶等候。它们由众神所创，将会考验你的意志。 

它们栖息于赫达沙尔之上，而它们的子嗣正在下方遭受德克加尔的奴役。不过，巨龙并非我们或者维库人的盟友，所以你必须按照它们的方式才能赢得祝福。

有一位朋友正在赫达沙尔等你，你已经知晓她正在寻求的答案。找到她，和她一起接受风暴的考验！
text.completion: It's good to see you, $n. Greymane sent me away to scout this village for more information on the Aegis. $B$BI haven't gleaned much so far, other than that the locals here don't seem so friendly. Of course, when are they ever?$B$BI hope your search fares better.

english.title: Will of the Thorignir
english.objectives: Meet with Lorna Crowley outside of Hrydshal to begin the trial of the Thorignir.
english.description:
In the summit of storms the dragons await. Born of the gods, they will test your will. 

They roost above Hrydshal, where their children serve the Drekirjar. But they are no allies to man or vrykul, and so you must earn their blessing as they see fit.

A friend of yours awaits in Hrydshal, no doubt searching for the answers you now possess. Go to her, and together, you will test your might against the storm!
english.completion: It's good to see you, $n. Greymane sent me away to scout this village for more information on the Aegis. $B$BI haven't gleaned much so far, other than that the locals here don't seem so friendly. Of course, when are they ever?$B$BI hope your search fares better.

text.title: 7.0 Stormheim - Treasure 018 - Maw of Nashal - ZTO

english.title: 7.0 Stormheim - Treasure 018 - Maw of Nashal - ZTO

text.title: 新奇矿石
text.objectives: 获取10块魔石矿石。
text.description: 铁匠，你闻到了吗？啊哈……是机会的味道。$b$b达拉然把我们带到了新奇的地方，那里充满了神秘的金属。店里的事让我脱不开身，不过……你可以自由地去探索和采矿。$b$B去帮我找些有意思的东西回来，看看它们有什么用途。

english.title: Strange New Ores
english.objectives: Obtain 10 Leystone Ore.
english.description: You smell that, smith? Ahhhh... that there's the smell of opportunity.$b$bDalaran's taken us to some strange new shores, filled with mysterious metals. I'm tethered to my shop here, but you... you've got the freedom to explore and mine at will.$b$bBring me something interesting, and we'll see what we can make with it.

text.title: 掌握魔石铸造技术
text.objectives: 按照锻造配方清单里的奥拉尔德·施米尔的配方，制作一副手工魔石手甲。
text.description: 嗯，既然有了助熔剂，我们现在就动手，看看情况会怎么样。这次不如由你来锻造一副手套吧，我会看着你工作……还要站得远一点。

english.title: Leysmithing Mastery
english.objectives: Follow Alard Schmied's recipes in your Blacksmithing recipe list to build some Handcrafted Leystone Gauntlets.
english.description: Well, now that we have the flux we can put it to work and see how it goes. Why don't you take a crack at it this time and make some gauntlets for me. I'll observe your work... from a distance.

text.title: 积怨护甲锻造工艺
text.objectives: 获取一件精工积怨胸甲和一副精工积怨肩甲。
text.description: 我们也许有办法立刻开展魔石研究。$b$b我听说阿苏纳有纳迦的营地。如果他们在阿苏纳居住了很长一段时间，那么他们的铁匠肯定早就开始对魔石进行实验。$b$b取得一些纳迦的魔石护甲……最好是比护腕更费工的东西。

english.title: Hatecoil Hammerwork
english.objectives: Obtain a Masterwork Hatecoil Breastplate and a pair of Masterwork Hatecoil Pauldrons.
english.description: There may be a way to jump-start our research into leystone.$b$bI've heard reports of naga camps down in Azsuna. If they've been in Azsuna for long enough, their smiths have certainly started experimenting with leystone themselves.$b$bBe on the lookout for some leystone armor on the naga... ideally something more elaborate than a bracer.

text.title: 堕夜精灵锻造工艺
text.objectives: 取得一个上古哨兵构造体记忆核心。
text.description: 我有个想法，$n。$b$b你遇到过阿苏纳的堕夜精灵吗？他们是上层精灵的后裔，而上层精灵的匠人们造诣非凡。$b$b这些堕夜精灵掌握一些奥术工艺，在他们营地巡逻的哨兵就是他们制造出来的。$b$b帮我从他们的构造体里取出一个记忆核心，说不定我们可以从中学到什么锻造知识！

english.title: The Methods of the Nightfallen
english.objectives: Obtain an Ancient Sentry Construct Memory Core.
english.description: I have a theory, $n.$b$bHave you encountered the nightfallen elves of Azsuna? They descend from the Highborne, and the accomplishments of Highborne smiths are legendary.$b$bThese fallen elves do a bit of arcane tinkering, crafting sentries to patrol their camps.$b$bBring me a memory core from one of their constructs. Who knows what manner of smithlore might lie within!

text.title: 工程师：还有一点点用处
text.objectives: 把上古哨兵构造体记忆核心带给达拉然的迪墨菲·欧申克。
text.description: 很抱歉，我没办法从这个核心里获取任何信息。不过，我知道有一个人可以做到。$b$b到隔壁隔壁再隔壁的“精密仪器”工程学商店去一趟。迪墨菲·欧申克欠我一个人情，他应该可以提取这个核心的记忆。

english.title: Engineers: Not COMPLETELY Useless
english.objectives: Bring the Ancient Sentry Construct Memory Core to Timofey Oshenko in Dalaran.
english.description: Unfortunately, I have no idea how to access any information within this core. But I know someone who does.$b$bHead over to "Like Clockwork", the engineering shop three doors down from here. Timofey Oshenko owes me a favor. He should be able to extract the memory out of the core.

text.title: 鬼画符
text.objectives: 把古代上层精灵资料带给达拉然的帕林教授。
text.description: 我刚好有东西可以帮你提取这个核心里的信息。$b$b<迪墨菲把核心放进明显是地精制作的机器的漏斗里，然后捂住耳朵。>$b$b你最好不要盯着看，铁匠。

english.title: Chicken Scratch
english.objectives: Bring the Ancient Highborne Data Printout to Professor Pallin in Dalaran.
english.description: I think I have just the thing to extract the information from this core for you.$b$b<Timofey loads the core into the hopper of a clearly goblin-made machine, then covers his ears.>$b$bYou may wish to avert your eyes, blacksmith.

text.title: 魔石铸造的奥秘
text.objectives: 把魔石铸造指南带给达拉然的奥拉尔德·施米尔。
text.description: 其他人要花好几个小时钻研这张美妙手稿的内容！$b$b……但是对于像我这样的专家，这只是小事一桩。这不就是“魔石铸造”嘛，分分钟搞定。$b$b<侏儒在卷轴背面写下了翻译内容。>$b$b好了，一字不落。下次最好带些有意思的东西过来。

english.title: Secrets of Leysmithing
english.objectives: Bring the Leysmithing Guide to Alard Schmied in Dalaran.
english.description: I could spend hours poring over the details of this fascinating manuscript!$b$b...is what I would say if this weren't the simplest of tasks for someone of my skill level. It's about something called "Leysmithing". Here.$b$b<The gnome scribbles down a translation on the back of the scroll.>$b$bThere it is, word-for-word. Bring me something interesting next time.

text.title: Shrine of the Bear Twins - Reward

english.title: Shrine of the Bear Twins - Reward

text.title: 至高岭工匠
text.objectives: 在至高岭与巴姆·碎石谈一谈。
text.description: 我想，接下来的事情超出了我的知识范围，$n。$b$b至高岭的牛头人之中肯定有工匠。看看能不能从他们身上学到如何进一步提升你魔石铸造的手艺。

english.title: The Highmountain Smiths
english.objectives: Speak with Barm Stonebreaker in Highmountain.
english.description: I think we've gone as far as we can go with what I know, $n.$b$bThe tauren of Highmountain must have some smiths among their ranks. See if you can find out how to further progress our leysmithing abilities from them.

text.title: 有待进步
text.objectives: 发挥你的锻造技术为巴姆制作一副魔石手甲。
text.description: 想要我教你如何提升手艺？我们不可能听你说几句，就把商业机密分享给你。$b$b不过我们确实重视锻造工艺和技术磨练。$b$b让我看看你的手艺吧。那边有学徒用的小铁砧，去制作一副能够完全体现你技术的手套，让我看看你的实力。

english.title: You Are Not Worthy
english.objectives: Use your blacksmithing skill to craft a pair of Leystone Gauntlets for Barm.
english.description: You wish me to teach you how to strengthen your crafts? We do not simply share the secrets of our trade with outsiders who ask for them.$b$bWe do, however, respect craftsmanship and discipline.$b$bLet's see your hammerwork. Our greenhorn trainees use those small anvils over there. Craft your best pair of gauntlets so I may judge your work.

text.title: 天然原料
text.objectives: 获取10株狐尾花。$b$b如果你不是草药师，那么可以通过拍卖行或者其他玩家来获取材料。
text.description: 有意思，这表示杂质会使魔石产生剧烈的反应，难怪我们从外面带来的助熔剂会引起小规模爆炸。$b$b不过，当地的原料能够与魔石共存。至高岭上面生长着一种名为狐尾花的草药，可以做成合适的助熔剂。$b$b去采些狐尾花来，这样我们可以做一些可以使用的助熔剂。

english.title: Nature Provides
english.objectives: Obtain 10 Foxflower.$b$bIf you are not an herbalist, you can purchase Foxflower on the Auction House, or you can obtain it from another player.
english.description: This is interesting, it says that leystone reacts violently with anything it views as a contaminant. Our foreign-mined flux was enough to cause the small explosion.$b$bLocal ingredients, however, have learned to coexist with leystone. Up in Highmountain, an herb called foxflower grows that can be turned into a suitable flux.$b$bGo and gather some foxflower that we can turn into a usable flux.

text.title: 师从多人
text.objectives: 回达拉然去找奥拉尔德，并分享你从牛头人那里学到的知识。
text.description: 年轻人，回达拉然去找$b师傅吧，再接再厉。如果想多学一点东西，随时欢迎回来找我们。

english.title: From One Master to Another
english.objectives: Go back to Alard in Dalaran and share what you've learned from the Tauren.
english.description: Now young one, go back to your master$bin Dalaran and continue to practice your swing. We'll always be here if you wish to come back and learn more.

text.title: 格雷夫特
text.objectives: 前往深渊之路洞穴，从库布鲁手里夺回至高岭牛头人的祖传之锤，格雷夫特。
text.description: 我们部族擅用魔石打造腿甲。如果你能帮我做一件事……那我就和你分享我的图样。$b$b我的父亲在多年以前被卓格巴尔杀害，父亲的战锤成为了他们的战利品。那把战锤是我们家族世代相传下来的。现在，它落到了库布鲁这个邪恶的卓格巴尔手上。$b$b我很想把它拿回来。

english.title: Grayheft
english.objectives: Obtain Grayheft, Ancient Hammer of the Highmountain Tauren from Kubrul within the Deep Roads cavern.
english.description: Our tribe regularly crafts legplates out of leystone. I will share our pattern with you... if you do me a favor.$b$bMy father fell to the drogbar several years ago, and they took his hammer as a trophy. That hammer was in my family for countless generations. Now, it languishes in the hands of the vile drogbar, Kubrul.$b$bI would very much like to have it back.

text.title: 多才多艺
text.objectives: 制作4块硬化魔石锭和24根硬化魔石钉。
text.description: 你知道的，我们并不只会做护甲和武器。我常会帮铭文师制作凿子，帮炼金师制作坩埚，甚至帮裁缝制作顶针。$b$b如果裁缝们不想让自己的拇指被针刺到，就应该带着能够包住整只手的护手来缝纫。$b$b总之，我有一个特别的配方，肯定会让像你这样的冒险者感兴趣的，来试试吧。

english.title: Not Just Weapons and Armor
english.objectives: Craft 4 Hard Leystone Bars and 24 Hard Leystone Nails.
english.description: You know, we aren't just limited to armorsmithing and weaponsmithing. I regularly make chisels for the scribes, crucibles for the alchemists, and even thimbles for the tailors.$b$bThey should sew in full plate gauntlets if they're really all that worried about their poor little thumbs.$b$bAnyhow, I have a recipe I think an adventurer like you might be interested in. Let's try it out.

text.title: 魔石蹄铁
text.objectives: 骑上坐骑去找达拉然的梅尔·弗兰希斯，让她为坐骑装上魔石蹄铁。
text.description: 这些蹄铁你先拿着，到下面的坐骑和宠物商店去找梅尔·弗兰希斯，让她给你的坐骑装上。$b$b你回来之后我再给你看图样。

english.title: Leystone Hoofplates
english.objectives: Approach Mei Francis in Dalaran while mounted to have your Leystone Hoofplates fitted.
english.description: Here, bring these hoofplates to Mei Francis, down at the mounts and pets store, to get your mount properly shod.$b$bI'll share the pattern when you return.

objectiveDetails.description: 把坐骑带到梅尔·弗兰希斯处

text.title: 邪能工匠娜瑞莎
text.objectives: 前往苏拉玛，向邪能工匠娜瑞莎报到。
text.description: 据说有两位伊利达雷铁匠正在恶魔横行的苏拉玛前线，进行非常刺激的研究——这事在铁匠圈都传遍了。虽然我想亲自一探究竟，但是任何与“恶魔横行”有关的事情实在与我的品位不符。$b$b单是制作护甲就够了，我可不想穿上它们去打仗。$b$b不过，至于你嘛……到是可以去跟进一下。去找娜瑞莎吧，我听说她可是位卓越的铁匠。

english.title: Felsmith Nal'ryssa
english.objectives: Report to Felsmith Nal'ryssa in Suramar.
english.description: Word has been circulating in smithing circles about a pair of Illidari blacksmiths that have been doing exciting work out on the demon-infested front lines of Suramar. I'd follow up myself, but anything described as "demon-infested" is a little too exotic for my tastes.$b$bI just make the armor. I prefer not to wear it.$b$bYou, though... you could follow up on this tip. Be on the lookout for Nal'ryssa. From what I hear, she's a hell of a smith.

text.title: 结交盟友
text.objectives: 在邪魂堡垒消灭$1oa个恶魔。
text.description: 你是铁匠？$b$b<精灵看了看你的锤子。>$b$b还在学习魔石铸造？我或许可以帮你。$b$b想在这种地方结交盟友可不容易。虽然你长得挺好看，但谁也不能保证你不是恶魔的奸细。我现在没办法信任你。$b$b等你的双手沾满恶魔的鲜血之后再回来，到时候我们再讨论锻造的事。

english.title: Part of the Team
english.objectives: Slay $1oa demons within Felsoul Hold.
english.description: You're a blacksmith?$b$b<The elf looks down at your hammer.>$b$bStill working in leystone, are you? I might be able to help you out.$b$bAlliances out here are hard-won. You've got a pretty face, but that's no guarantee that you aren't working for the demons. I can't afford to trust you yet.$b$bDon't come back until you're caked in demon's blood. Then we'll talk smithing.

text.title: 战火中的铁匠
text.objectives: 按照邪能工匠娜瑞莎的指示制造魔石长靴。
text.description: 你没有靴子的配方？$b$b怎么回事，你是接受牛头人的训练吗？$b$b那就抓紧时间。恶魔可能不用多久就会再次来袭。这张图样你拿去，让我看看你的手艺。

english.title: Smith Under Fire
english.objectives: Follow Felsmith Nal'ryssa's instructions to craft Leystone Boots.
english.description: You lack recipes for boots?$b$bWhat, were you trained by a tauren or something?$b$bHurry up, then. We probably have a few minutes before the demons attack again. Here's a pattern - show me your work.

text.title: 娜瑞莎的手艺
text.objectives: 获取60块魔石矿石和60块邪能页岩。
text.description: 听着，$c。如果我们在对抗燃烧军团的战斗中牺牲，就需要像你这样的铁匠来继承伊利达雷的传统工艺。你就是个好苗子。$b$b去多找些材料，等你回来之后我们还有很多事情要讨论。

english.title: Nal'ryssa's Technique
english.objectives: Obtain 60 Leystone Ore and 60 Felslate.
english.description: Listen, $c. We need smiths like you to carry on the traditions of the Illidari, should we fail in our crusade against the Legion. You are ready to learn.$b$bBring me materials. Lots of them. When you return, we will have much to discuss.

text.title: 魔石的潜力
text.objectives: 使用邪能工匠娜瑞莎的技术制作一副精工魔石护臂。
text.description: 我相信你也明白了，你学到的所有魔石配方都有改进的空间。$b$b只要学会掌握魔石的真正潜力，你就可以减少耗材，并且获得相同的成果。来吧，我示范给你看。$b$b按照惯例，我们先从比较简单的护臂开始。硫磺石符文可以改良这个部位的护甲。自己亲眼见证吧。

english.title: Leystone's Potential
english.objectives: Use Felsmith Nal'ryssa's technique to craft a set of Masterwork Leystone Armguards.
english.description: As I'm sure you've deduced, all of the leystone recipes you know can be improved.$b$bBy learning to harness leystone's true potential, you can reduce the amount of material you use and still yield an equivalent result. Here, I'll show you.$b$bWe'll start, as one does, with the humble bracer. This particular piece of armor benefits from the addition of brimstone runes. See for yourself.

text.title: 苍穹石
text.objectives: 在至高岭与巴姆·碎石谈一谈。
text.description: 必须使用特殊的工具才能处理邪能页岩和邪钢，尤其是具有超强硬度的铁砧，才能在捶打邪能页岩时承受住材料散发的能量。$b$b我和乌拉尔已经没有这样的铁砧了，不过你的至高岭牛头人朋友们有这种好东西。$b$b想办法让他们允许你使用神圣的苍穹石，我们就可以继续处理邪钢了。

english.title: The Firmament Stone
english.objectives: Speak with Barm Stonebreaker in Highmountain.
english.description: When working with felslate and demonsteel, one must use special equipment. Specifically, an anvil hard enough to withstand the energy given off when felslate is hammered.$b$bUrael and I no longer possess such an anvil. But your friends, the Highmountain tauren, do.$b$bGain access to the Firmament Stone, their sacred anvil, and we can start working with demonsteel again.

text.title: 魔石精通
text.objectives: 找泰拉·钢铁图腾购买一个魔石护甲立架，然后把八件护甲都挂上去。
text.description: 想使用苍穹石的铁匠必须先证明自己完全掌握了魔石铸造。$b$b制作一整套魔石护甲，然后给我检查。泰拉可以给你提供一个护甲架。

english.title: Leystone Mastery
english.objectives: Speak with Thala Steeltotem to purchase a Leystone Armor Stand, then hang all eight pieces of Leystone Armor on it.
english.description: Smiths that seek access to the Firmament Stone must first prove complete mastery over leystone.$b$bCraft an entire set of Leystone Armor, then submit it to me for inspection. Thala can provide you with an armor stand.

text.title: 噬魂之喉：风暴铸就
text.objectives: 前往噬魂之喉，取得一把古代维库铁锤。
text.description: 你的锤子看起来脆弱不堪，敲打苍穹石的时候很容易损坏。$b$b古代的维库铁匠大师们以其强韧的铁锤而闻名。要得到那样的铁锤，唯一的办法就是到他们死后的去处寻找。那里叫做噬魂之喉。$b$b掌管那片领域的女神名叫海拉。她出于私欲收藏了亡者的饰品。$b$b打败她，或许你就可以得到那样的铁锤。

english.title: Maw of Souls: Hammered By The Storm
english.objectives: Go to the Maw of Souls and recover an Ancient Vrykul Hammer.
english.description: Your hammer looks weak, and would probably break upon striking the Firmament Stone.$b$bThe vrykul master blacksmiths of old were known for the strength of their hammers. The only way to get our hands on such a hammer would be to go where vrykul go when they die. To the Maw of Souls.$b$bThe goddess that resides over that realm is named Helya. She hoards the trinkets they bring for her own desires.$b$bDefeat her and you may be able to acquire such a hammer.

text.title: 部族知识
text.objectives: 返回苏拉玛，向邪能工匠娜瑞莎报告。
text.description: 首先，你需要适合的邪钢护甲图样。虽然你通过努力和坚持获得了铁砧的使用权，但是我们的配方只会教给值得信赖的部族成员。$b$b如果你想讨论邪钢图样，也许你应该去找另一位铁匠。

english.title: Tribal Knowledge
english.objectives: Report back to Felsmith Nal'ryssa in Suramar.
english.description: First, however, you'll need proper patterns for demonsteel armor. While access to the stone is earned through hard work and perseverance, access to our recipes is limited to the trusted members of our tribe.$b$bPerhaps you should seek another smith if you wish to discuss demonsteel patterns.

text.title: Lord Hal'shara's Tomb
text.objectives: Raid the tomb.
text.description: The tomb, I've found it.

english.title: Lord Hal'shara's Tomb
english.objectives: Raid the tomb.
english.description: The tomb, I've found it.

text.title: 振荡器，待会见
text.objectives: 找回水晶振荡器。
text.description: 那些没下巴的笨蛋真想从我们的飞艇上回收零件！他们根本不懂得欣赏高端的侏儒科技……可能他们只是痴迷于那些亮晶晶的东西。$B$B不管怎么说，我需要一个水晶振荡器来制作新的发报机。它是整个系统中最闪亮的零件，肯定被他们藏到哪里去了！
text.completion: <Overspark examines the crystal carefully.>$B$BYep, still shiny.

english.title: See Ya Later, Oscillator
english.objectives: Collect the Crystal Oscillator.
english.description: Those jawless mooks are actually trying to salvage parts from our ship! They can't possibly appreciate superior gnomish technology... Perhaps its shiny nature is appealing to their simple inclinations.$B$BIn any case, I need a crystal oscillator for our new transponder. It's the shiniest part of the whole system, they're bound to have it set aside somewhere!
english.completion: <Overspark examines the crystal carefully.>$B$BYep, still shiny.

text.title: 圣石配英雄
text.objectives: 与穆林·铁角谈一谈。
text.description: 你已经完全证明了自己的能力，$n。你的训练结束了。$b$b只有极少数铁匠能够使用苍穹石。你应该去找穆林·铁角，他一直是圣石的看守者，他会告诉你之后该做什么。

english.title: Worthy of the Stone
english.objectives: Speak with Muirn Ironhorn.
english.description: You have nothing more to prove to me, $n. Your training is complete.$b$bOnly a very small herd of smiths have earned the right to the Firmament Stone. You should speak with Muirn Ironhorn, who maintains vigil over our sacred stone. He will tell you what to do next.

text.title: 要塞战役：血环氏族的克星
text.objectives: 收集追踪地图，找到杀手的位置。
text.description:
指挥官，我们最近派了斥候前往泽斯高附近的丛林侦察，并听说了一些新消息。

似乎有其他人在报复血环氏族，到处……追杀……他们。他们的猎人正在密切追踪那个杀手。

你一定听过那句话，“敌人的敌人……”什么的。所以我们最好找到他们的追踪地图，抢先一步找到那个杀手！

english.title: Garrison Campaign: The Bane of the Bleeding Hollow
english.objectives: Collect tracking maps to find the location of the killer.
english.description:
Commander, now that we've had time to get scouts all over the jungle we have heard some news near Zeth'Gol.

It appears that somebody else has a vendetta against the Bleeding Hollow and has been... hunting... them. Their hunters are closing in on the assassin.

You know what they say about "the enemy of my enemy..." We should collect their tracking maps and try to find the killer first!

objectiveDetails.description: 从血环氏族成员身上获取狩猎地图

text.title: 要塞战役：术士
text.objectives: 在塔纳安丛林的雄狮岗哨和术士谈谈。
text.description:
指挥官，你有一位客人。一个古尔丹手下的术士刚刚来到要塞向我们投降。他说他带来了关于即将发生的重大事件的情报。

我建议你立刻去和他谈谈。

english.title: Garrison Campaign: The Warlock
english.objectives: Speak with the warlock at Lion's Watch in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description:
Commander, you have a visitor. One of Gul'dan's warlocks just walked up to the base and surrendered. He says he has information of a terrible event that is about to occur.

I suggest you speak with him immediately.

text.title: 萨格雷的秘密
text.objectives: 寻找并阻止奥金顿地下的腐化源头。
text.description:
奥金尼人近来一直在汇报，自从第一次被塔隆戈尔攻击以后，奥金顿就……有些……不大对劲。那些萨格雷突然而至，打开了一个洞口通往地下大厅。

那个洞口现在正渗透出腐化的力量，我们必须展开调查！

english.title: Secrets of the Sargerei
english.objectives: Locate and stop the source of corruption underneath Auchindoun.
english.description:
The Auchenai have been reporting for some time that something was... wrong... with Auchindoun since Teron'gor's original assault. Now suddenly the Sargerei attacked and blew open a hole into one of the underhalls.

Corruption leaks from that breach. We must investigate!

objectiveDetails.description: 破坏西部邪能汲魂水晶
破坏东部邪能汲魂水晶

text.title: 摘花制药外包工单
text.objectives: 与林奇·黑箭和奎茵·柔步商议，制定一份狐尾花熔剂的产品订单。
text.description: 既然知道狐尾花熔剂没有安全隐患，那我们就可以开始囤货了。话虽这么说，可惜我个人对摘花没什么兴趣。你喜欢摘花吗？不喜欢吧。$b$b去找对面的炼金师和草药师谈谈，我们肯定可以签订一些产品订单。

english.title: Flower-Pickers and Potion-Quaffers
english.objectives: Speak with Linzy Blackbolt and Kuhuine Tenderstride to secure a work order for Foxflower Flux.
english.description: Now that we know the foxflower flux is safe to use, we can start stocking it. That being said, I don't particularly feel like picking flowers. Do you feel like picking flowers? Didn't think so.$b$bGo talk to the alchemists and herbalists across the way. I'm sure we can set up some sort of work order arrangement.

text.title: 甜蜜的交易
text.objectives: 在达拉然找到一个冰霜法师来冷却你的淬火水槽。
text.description: 看过研究报告之后，我发现了一个有趣的方法，想让你试试。$b$b在预回火阶段，把金属的温度降到冰点以下。这是水淬法做不到的。$b$b好消息是，在这座城市里走两步就能遇到一个冰霜法师！去看看你能不能为店里招来一个，$n。

english.title: A Sweet Bargain
english.objectives: Find a frost mage in Dalaran to chill your quenching trough.
english.description: Reading over this research, I found an interesting method that I'd like you to try.$b$bThe method would require us to chill the metal to sub-freezing temperatures during the pre-tempering phase. Simple water quenching won't do.$b$bGood thing you can't walk two steps in this city without bumping into a frost mage! See if you can recruit one for the shop, $n.

objectiveDetails.description: 再次与格拉茜拉·白弹交谈

text.title: 萨格雷的威胁
text.objectives: 杀死$1oa个萨格雷。
text.description:
他们对我们的防御者发动了突然袭击。我们的大部队已经赶来扫荡他们，不过在部队到达之前还需要时间。

如果你能在这里杀死一些萨格雷，就可以让我们收复这个地区时面对的压力减轻一些，指挥官。

english.title: The Sargerei Menace
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Sargerei.
english.description:
This attack surprised our defenders. Forces are marshalling to push them out, but it will take some time for them to arrive.

Any Sargerei you can slay will make retaking this area much easier commander.

text.title: 团结的力量
text.objectives: 使用远古列王圣契，重建白银之手骑士团。
text.description: 必须有一位领袖将艾泽拉斯的圣骑士团结起来。提里奥过世以后，你是最有资格继承大领主之位的人。$B$B如果你愿意扛起重担，就把你的名字刻入远古列王圣契，然后我会代表你向众人致辞。$B$B你将成为白银之手的领袖，为组织带来新生！
text.completion: We've done it, Highlord $n.$B$BThe Order of the Silver Hand is reborn!

english.title: A United Force
english.objectives: Establish the Order of the Silver Hand using the Libram of Ancient Kings.
english.description: The paladins of Azeroth must stand united behind a single leader. With Tirion's passing, you are the one most worthy to wear the mantle of Highlord.$B$BIf you agree to accept this duty, inscribe your name into the Libram of Ancient Kings and I will address the masses on your behalf.$B$BThe Order of the Silver Hand is reborn, with you as its champion!
english.completion: We've done it, Highlord $n.$B$BThe Order of the Silver Hand is reborn!

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

objectiveDetails.description: 把你的名字刻入远古列王圣契
与玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵交谈

text.title: 要塞战役：战争议会
text.objectives: 与要塞议政厅中的沃金酋长谈一谈。
text.description: 沃金酋长亲临你的要塞，整个要塞都沸腾了。$b$b沃金已经在议政厅中等你了，他将与你一同探讨针对塔纳安丛林的进攻计划。让他等太久可不明智。
text.completed: 与要塞议政厅中的沃金酋长谈一谈。
text.giverWindow: 大酋长在等你。

english.title: Garrison Campaign: War Council
english.objectives: Speak with Warchief Vol'jin inside the Town Hall of your garrison.
english.description: Your garrison is in an uproar. Warchief Vol'jin himself is visiting your fortress to discuss your invasion plan for Tanaan Jungle.$b$bThe Warchief is ready for you inside your Town Hall. It would be wise not to keep him waiting...
english.completed: Speak with Warchief Vol'jin inside the Town Hall of your garrison.
english.giverWindow: The Warchief awaits.

text.title: 我们需要造船师
text.objectives: 前往钢铁码头与萨米·五指谈一谈。你的要塞飞行管理员可以送你去那里。
text.description: 钢铁部落的残余兵力已经全面撤回了塔纳安丛林，而古尔丹正试图将他们转化为更可怕的敌人。从正面进攻无异于自杀。$b$b还是海路比较安全。假如我们同时从海陆两路进攻，古尔丹就只能撤退了。$n，是时候建造一座船坞了！$b$b我们需要充分利用德拉诺的当地资源。前往钢铁码头，加兹鲁维的伙计们已经在那儿等你了。把你能弄到的设备都弄来，顺便看看能不能给部落找到一名合适的造船师。
text.completed: 前往钢铁码头与萨米·五指谈一谈。你的要塞飞行管理员可以送你去那里。

english.title: We Need a Shipwright
english.objectives: Travel to the Iron Docks and speak with Sammy Fivefingers. Your Garrison Flight Master can provide transport.
english.description: Whatever be left of da Iron Horde be fallin' back ta Tanaan Jungle, where Gul'dan is turnin' them into sumthun' even worse. A frontal assault be suicide.$b$bBut da seas be open. If we attack by both land an' sea, Gul'dan got ta fall back somewhere. $n, it be time ta build a shipyard!$b$bWe need local resources. Go to da Iron Docks. Gazlowe's boys are already there. Gather any equipment ya find, and see if ya can recruit us a proper Horde Shipwright!
english.completed: Travel to the Iron Docks and speak with Sammy Fivefingers. Your Garrison Flight Master can provide transport.

text.title: 清理码头
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个钢铁部落兽人和$2oa个独眼魔。
text.description: 我们需要控制一下局面。我们原以为这些码头已经被放弃了。但事实上，古尔丹命令钢铁部落的这些部队撤回塔纳安丛林，他们中很多人把这码头当作了通道。$b$b我们需要为你的搜救队清扫出一条道路来。把他们都干掉！我们在这里每杀死一个敌人，都会让古尔丹那支崇拜恶魔的军队减少一分力量。

english.title: Clearing the Docks
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Iron Horde orcs and $2oa ogron.
english.description: We need to get control of this situation. We thought these docks would be all but abandoned. Instead, Gul'dan has ordered the Iron Horde to retreat to Tanaan, and many are using this harbor to make their getaway.$b$bWe need to clear a path for your salvage team. Lay waste to them! Every foe we slay here is one less convert for Gul'dan's wretched demon-worshipping army.

text.title: 列车“事故”
text.objectives: 收集炸药和一个引爆器。
text.description: 有一些兽人站出来反对古尔丹，然后他们就被抓进了监狱。其中一位可称得上是工程天才：索洛格·拉克——“钢铁造船师”。这家伙真的很厉害。这里的码头和你在沙塔斯战斗过的那些巨大的无畏舰都是他设计的。假如我的情报没错，他眼下就在那列监狱列车里……我打赌他肯定会愿意投靠我们！$b$b收集一些爆炸品，然后去南边的列车那里跟杜隆坦碰头！

english.title: Derailment
english.objectives: Collect Explosive Charges and a Detonator.
english.description: Some orcs have spoken out against Gul'dan, and they've been taken prisoner. One of them is what you'd call an engineering prodigy: Solog Roark, "The Iron Shipwright." This guy's good. Designed all these docks, as well as the big dreadnaughts you fought around Shattrath.$b$bIf my scouts are right, he's in a prison train as we speak... And I betcha he'd be willing to defect!$b$bGather up some explosives and meet Durotan next to the train to the south.

text.title: 拦截囚车
text.objectives: 使用引爆器炸开监狱列车，说服拉克加入你们。
text.description: 我的战士们会包围住这列车厢。你负责用引爆器炸开厢门。$b$b我会试着和拉克谈一谈，看他是否有意加入我们。这里的东西都是他造的——他也是能帮我们造出码头的最好人选。$b$b假如不成功的话，我们就必须当场处决他。要是再弄出第二支钢铁舰队，我们就有好果子吃了……

english.title: The Train Gang
english.objectives: Use the detonator to blow open the prison train, and convince Roark to join your cause.
english.description: My warriors will surround and cover the train car. Hit the detonator to blow open the doors.$b$bI will speak to Roark and convince him to defect to our cause. He built all of this - he's our best hope for building a shipyard of our own.$b$bIf this doesn't work, execute him on the spot. The last thing we need is someone rebuilding the Iron Fleet.

text.title: 钩子，绳子，然后……干掉他！
text.objectives: 使用黑石爪钩抵达纳尔的碉堡。杀死他并夺取拉克的船坞图纸。
text.description: 我会帮你造一座船坞。而且造出来的不会是像这边这样大肆浪费资源的垃圾疙瘩。$b$b不过我需要图纸。古尔丹把这座港口转交给海军上将纳尔后，我的作品就都被他没收了。$b$b<拉克吐了口唾沫。>$b$b他现在已经喝下了古尔丹的绿色毒汁，坐在高处发号施令。我们要爬上去干掉他。

english.title: Hook, Line, and... Sink Him!
english.objectives: Use a Blackrock Grapple to reach Knar's bunker. Slay him to obtain Roark's Shipyard Blueprints.
english.description: I can build you a shipyard. And not some wasteful piece of over-engineering like this place.$b$bBut I'm going to need my blueprints. My work was confiscated when Gul'dan turned this harbor over to Admiral Knar.$b$b<Roark spits.>$b$bGul'dan's green poison courses through Knar's veins. He's calling the shots from on high. We'll need to grapple up there to take him out.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用爪钩抵达纳尔的碉堡

text.title: 无可留恋
text.objectives: 回要塞向沃金报告进展。
text.description: 这里没有任何可以让我留恋的东西了。昔日的氏族兄弟反目成仇，而古尔丹正在腐化我剩下的同胞。$b$b不过你和你的霜狼盟友还没有放弃抗争。如果你们保证会废黜古尔丹，我就会站在你们这边。我会到你的要塞去，与你一起建造一座伟大的船坞，它将统治德拉诺的红色海洋！$b$b告诉你的手下，我来了。
text.completed: 向要塞中的沃金报告进展。

english.title: Nothing Remains
english.objectives: Report back to Vol'jin at your garrison.
english.description: Nothing is left for me here. My old clanmates have turned into foes, and Gul'dan is desecrating what remains of my people.$b$bYou and your Frostwolf allies still have some fight left. If you pledge to depose Gul'dan, I will stand by your side. I will go to this garrison of yours and together we will build a shipyard that will rule the red seas of Draenor!$b$bLet your people know I am coming.
english.completed: Report to Vol'jin at your garrison.

text.title: 港口总动员
text.objectives: 为你的要塞建造一座等级1的船坞。
text.description: 快让这个“钢铁造船师”开工吧，指挥官。假如我们想要从海陆两路夹攻塔纳安，我们就需要船坞。你要和拉克合作，为部落建起船坞！$b$b他已经沿着要塞西侧的道路在勘查地形了。

english.title: All Hands on Deck
english.objectives: Construct a Level 1 Shipyard for your garrison.
english.description: Let's put dis "Iron Shipwright" ta work, commander. If we ta take Tanaan from both land an' sea, we gonna need a shipyard. Work wit' Roark an' make it happen!$b$bHe be surveyin' tha land along tha road west of Frostwall.

text.title: 圣光之愿会师
text.objectives: 前往东瘟疫之地，进入圣光之愿礼拜堂地下的圣光之愿大殿，和其他圣骑士会合。
text.description: 有你与我们并肩作战，燃烧军团必将灭亡！但是，在挺进破碎群岛之前，我们必须先安葬大领主提里奥。$B$B只有一个地方适合这位伟大圣骑士的安息之地……那就是我们礼拜堂地下的秘密堡垒，圣光之愿大殿。$B$B世界各地的圣骑士正在赶去那里参加葬礼。我知道，提里奥最希望能到场的人就是你。
text.completion: It is fitting that you are here.$b$bTime and again, you have fought to save our world. Now, I fear I must ask you to undertake an even greater act of service.

english.title: We Meet at Light's Hope
english.objectives: Join the other paladins at Light's Hope Sanctum beneath Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: With you on our side, I know the Legion will fall! But before we march on the Broken Isles, we must put Highlord Tirion to rest.$B$BThere is but one place suitable for a paladin of his caliber... Light's Hope Sanctum, a secret bastion of the Light hidden beneath our chapel.$B$BPaladins the world over are on their way to the ceremony. I know Tirion would want you there most of all.
english.completion: It is fitting that you are here.$b$bTime and again, you have fought to save our world. Now, I fear I must ask you to undertake an even greater act of service.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

objectiveDetails.description: （可选）使用达拉然的传送门前往达拉然巨坑

text.title: 西部战事
text.objectives: 到钢铁前线去和杜隆坦谈谈。
text.description: 我们的基地刚刚建好，钢铁部落就已经开始针对我们布防了。计划仍然有效，但我们需要面临两线作战的局面。$b$b我已经接到了消息，杜隆坦也已经突破了西边的大门，不过陷入了拉锯战。你应该亲自到那里去查看一下情况。

english.title: The Battle for the West
english.objectives: Go to the Iron Front and speak with Durotan.
english.description: Our base is barely built and already the Iron Horde sets up defenses against us. Still the plan worked and we fight on two fronts.$b$bI have received word that Durotan has finally breached the western gates as well, but is bogged down in a pitched battle. You should go see the situation for yourself.

objectiveDetails.description: 与加戈什交谈并飞往钢铁前线

text.title: 至关重要的消息
text.objectives: 到大地岩窟去，和智者拉戈谈谈。
text.description: 你的斥候……他把我救出了那个地狱一样的地方。邪兽人在丛林中突袭了我们，把我们抓到了山顶上。他们对我们严刑拷打……除了我以外其他人都被杀了。恐怕我们中有人在死前泄露了秘密。$b$b我必须请求你回去完成我们的任务。去和我的领袖拉戈谈谈，告诉他……告诉他古尔丹已经知道了。

english.title: A Message of Terrible Import
english.objectives: Go to the Vault of the Earth and speak with Lagar the Wise.
english.description: Your scout... he got me out of that hellish place. Fel orcs surprised us out in the jungle and dragged us up the mountain. They tortured us... killed all but me. I fear one of us may have given up our secret before the end.$b$bI must ask you to go to the home of our order. Speak with Lagar, my leader, tell him... tell him Gul'dan knows.

text.title: 西部战事
text.objectives: 到钢铁前线去和大主教玛拉达尔谈谈。
text.description: 我们的基地刚刚建好，钢铁部落就已经开始针对我们布防了。计划仍然有效，但我们需要面临两线作战的局面。$b$b我已经接到了消息，大主教玛拉达尔也已经突破了西边的大门，不过陷入了拉锯战。你应该亲自到那里去查看一下情况。

english.title: The Battle for the West
english.objectives: Go to the Iron Front and speak with Exarch Maladaar.
english.description: Our base is barely built and already the Iron Horde sets up defenses against us. Still the plan worked and we fight on two fronts.$b$bI have received word that Exarch Maladaar has finally breached the western gates as well, but is bogged down in a pitched battle. You should go see the situation for yourself.

objectiveDetails.description: 与塞安交谈并飞往钢铁前线

text.title: 致老友
text.objectives: 在眠月河滩杀死50个腐化生物。
text.description: 我感受到这里有股强大的黑暗力量，$n，但它并非来自萨维斯。这种感觉似曾相识。$B$B这股力量来自德鲁伊，一个被梦魇的阴影所扭曲的德鲁伊。$B$B如果要找到萨维斯，我们就必须解决这个威胁。我会从空中给你支援。$B$B去找到这个堕落的德鲁伊，并消灭被他腐化和扭曲的植物。
text.completion: Know this, $n. You did the only thing you could.$b$bWhen a mortal has become corrupted by the nightmare, there is no return. Only death will set them free.

english.title: To Old Friends
english.objectives: Kill 50 Corrupted Creatures in Moonrest.
english.description: I sense a powerful dark presence here, $n, but it is not of Xavius. This feels too familiar.$B$BI sense a druid's touch here, a druid twisted by the shadow of the Nightmare.$B$BWe must deal with this threat if we are to find Xavius. I will take to the skies and lend you my aid.$B$BFind this corrupted druid and cut down his tainted and twisted plants.
english.completion: Know this, $n. You did the only thing you could.$b$bWhen a mortal has become corrupted by the nightmare, there is no return. Only death will set them free.

text.title: 突袭基尔加丹王座
text.objectives: 击败塔纳安丛林基尔加丹王座的暗影议会军队。
text.description:
暗影议会正在被他们称为基尔加丹王座的高山顶上召唤他们的恶魔主子。别大意，那里可是整个塔纳安最危险的地方。

快去召集一支战斗小队突袭基尔加丹王座吧，别让燃烧军团在这里站稳了脚跟！

english.objectives: Defeat the Shadow Council at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description:
The Shadow Council are summoning their demonic masters upon a mountain they are calling the Throne of Kil'jaeden. Make no mistake; This is the most dangerous region in Tanaan.

Gather together a war party and assault the Throne of Kil'jaeden before the Legion gains a foothold here!

text.title: 玛法里奥的愤怒
text.objectives: 跟伊瑟拉谈一谈，开始搜寻玛法里奥。
text.description: 塞纳留斯输给了梦魇，这对我们所有人都是致命的打击。$b$b虽然玛法里奥的狂怒无可厚非，但他对萨维斯的仇恨已延续了几个世纪，我害怕他的怒火过于盲目，很容易被利用，最后引火烧身。$b$b愿月神指引我们找到他，让我们今日不必再为另一个朋友哀悼。
text.completion: Oh, $n...$b$bWhat is becoming of this precious land?

english.title: Malfurion's Fury
english.objectives: Speak with Ysera to search for Malfurion.
english.description: The loss of Cenarius to the nightmare is a devastating blow to us all.$b$bThough Malfurion's rage is justified, his hatred of Xavius has burned for centuries and I fear that his blind rage will be used as a weapon against him.$b$bMay Elune guide us in our search for him, lest we have yet another friend to mourn today.
english.completion: Oh, $n...$b$bWhat is becoming of this precious land?

objectiveDetails.description: 让伊瑟拉带你前往梦魇

(PH)
Darkgrove has run out of places to hide. Now it is time to finish him off.$B$BIf we stop him now, there may be hope for this valley yet.

text.title: 架构调整
text.objectives: 放置$1oa个G-X3遥测信标。
text.description:
$G 先生 : 女士;，我们修建了一台载具让你能直达基尔加丹王座！但每次我们试飞时导航系统总是失控！$b$b我的专业意见是，这是那边的钢铁部落在疯狂使用恶魔法术导致的。

假如你能去那跑一趟，把这几个遥测信标安置在那边，我们就能调整好这个飞行器，送你一趟稳定的航程。

你最好带几个朋友一起去，那边的恶魔看着可吓人啦。

english.title: Infrastructure Improvements
english.objectives: Place $1oa G-X3 Telemetry Beacons.
english.description:
$G Sir : Ma'am;, we built a vehicle to take ya up to the Throne of Kil'jaeden but whenever we try a test flight the navigation system goes crazy!$b$bIn my expert opinion it's 'cause of that crazy demon magic the Iron Horde is playing around with up there.

If you could travel up there and place these telemetry beacons we can program the vehicle and give you a stable flight all the way up.

Just be sure to have some friends with you, the demons up there look especially vicious!

text.title: 调试信号
text.objectives: 放置$1oa个五角电子分析器2000型。
text.description:
$G先生:女士;，我们修建了一台飞行器，可以帮你绕过部落营地直达基尔加丹王座！唯一的问题在于，那边的恶魔能量浓度太高，会让导航系统失控！

我需要你去基尔加丹王座，在山峰的边缘放一圈传感器，这样我们才能让航线控制稳定下来。

你最好带几个朋友一起去，那边的恶魔看着可吓人啦。

english.title: Setting the Signal
english.objectives: Place $1oa Pentangulate-o-tron 2000s.
english.description:
$G Sir : Ma'am;, we built a vehicle to bypass the Horde camp and take you to the Throne of Kil'jaeden! There's one problem, the concentrated fel energy up there is causing the navigation system to go haywire!

I'll need you to place some sensors along the edge of the summit. With them in place we can stabilize the flight controls.

Just be sure to have some friends with you, the demons up there look especially vicious!

text.title: Gates of Valhallas
text.objectives: Speak with Vedhir.
text.description:
Escaping the grasp of Helya is no small feat. You may prove to be a worthy warrior after all.

Skovald has entered Valhallas; you are running out of time. Legion has corrupted the minds of the Skovald's men. A battalion of unworthy vrykul is attempting to enter the portal to Valhallas.

The giants that protect the gates are fighting a losing battle. There is no end to Legion's onslaught.

Speak with the dragon, Vehdir, inside the gates near the portal. He will aid you on your next task.
