text.title: 托林尼尔的意志
text.objectives: 到赫达沙尔外面去见亡灵骑兵库伦，然后开始托林尼尔的试炼。
text.description:
巨龙在风暴之顶等候，他们是众神之子，将会考验你的意志。 

它们栖息于赫达沙尔之上，而它们的子嗣正在下方遭受德克加尔的奴役。不过，巨龙并非我们或者维库人的盟友，所以你必须按照它们的方式才能赢得祝福。

有一位朋友正在赫达沙尔等你，你已经知晓她正在寻求的答案。找到她，和她一起接受风暴的考验！

english.title: Will of the Thorignir
english.objectives: Meet with Dread-Rider Cullen outside of Hrydshal to begin the trial of the Thorignir.
english.description:
In the summit of storms the dragons await. Born of the gods, they will test your will. 

They roost above Hrydshal, where their children serve the Drekirjar. But they are no allies to man or vrykul, and so you must earn their blessing as they see fit.

A friend of yours awaits in Hrydshal, no doubt searching for the answers you now possess. Go to her, and together, you will test your might against the storm!

text.title: 钩深致远
text.objectives: 拿上一把雷铸爪钩枪，在赫达沙尔城墙外与亡灵骑兵库伦碰头。
text.description:
这么说，有个老维库人法师在帮我们？我猜这是件好事，但你这次的试炼可能会有点棘手。你瞧，要上山的话就得经过那些高大的城墙。

就是那些面目凶残的龙盘踞的城墙。

我之前打探了一下，但没能走太远，因为那些龙想把可怜的公爵夫人当做午餐吃掉。维库人驯服了那些龙，这可不是件好事儿。

我建议最好秘密潜入。之前我想办法搞到了几把爪钩枪。你拿上一把枪，和我在城墙外面碰头。

english.title: A Grapple a Day
english.objectives: Pick up a Stormforged Grapple Launcher and meet Dread-Rider Cullen outside the wall of Hrydshal.
english.description:
So some old magic vrykul is helping us out? I guess that's good, but this trial of yours might be tricky. You see, the only way up that mountain, is through those big walls.

You know, the ones with the mean-looking drakes on them.

I scouted a bit, but couldn't get too far without those drakes trying to make lunch out of poor Duchess. The vrykul have them trained, which can't be good.

I say we sneak in. I managed to snag a few grapple launchers earlier. Grab one and meet me outside the city walls.

text.title: 飞檐走壁
text.objectives: 用雷铸爪钩枪勾住赫达沙尔的城墙。
text.description:
那东西看起来有足够的射程，可以让我们越过城墙。那边有个不错的爪钩锚点，你从这里应该就可以看得到。

你进去以后看看能不能分散守卫的注意力，帮我制造溜过去的机会。我要看看还能不能打探到维库人的什么情报。

english.title: No Wings Required
english.objectives: Use the Stormforged Grapple Launcher to launch over the wall at Hrydshal.
english.description:
That thing looks like it's got the range to get us over the wall. There's a good spot to hook onto right past us - you should be able to spot it from here.

Once you're inside, do me a favor and see if you can distract the guards so I can slip through. I'll see what else I can find out about these vrykul.

text.title: 抵御风暴
text.objectives: 在赫达沙尔找到登山鞋、浸油斗篷，以及魔化磁石。
text.description:
我四下打探的时候，注意到这里的维库人对我们想要攀登的危险山路并不陌生。他们有一些特殊的登山装备。如果我是你的话，就会想办法弄些回来。

你需要找到登山鞋用以防滑，再找件可以遮雨的浸油斗篷。而且，他们还会携带一些特殊的石头来避免雷电，你最好也去弄一个。

english.title: To Weather the Storm
english.objectives: Collect Climbing Treads, an Oiled Cloak, and an Enchanted Lodestone from Hrydshal.
english.description:
When I was scouting this place out, I noticed the vrykul here are no strangers to the treacherous mountain path we're trying to get to. They've got some specialized equipment they're using, and if I were you I'd try to get my hands on some.

You'll want to find some climbing treads to keep your grip and an oiled cloak to keep you dry. They've also got these stones they carry to keep the lightning at bay, so you'll want to pick one of those up as well.

text.title: 防火防盗防鱼叉
text.objectives: 爬上赫达沙尔城墙顶端，然后拆除上面的7座蔑潮鱼叉发射器。
text.description:
看来元素并不是登山路上你唯一需要担心的问题。城墙上的那些鱼叉发射器看起来相当不妙，除非我们先把它们搞定，否则我们的登山之旅就要提早结束了。

它们在城墙顶端，所以你要用爪钩枪爬上去。记住不要把自己拿去喂龙！

english.title: Impalement Insurance
english.objectives: Grapple on top of the walls and dismantle 7 Tideskorn Harpoon Launchers atop in Hrydshal.
english.description:
It looks like the elements aren't the only thing you'll need to worry about going up that path. Those harpoon launchers on the wall look pretty nasty, and unless we take them out first, they're likely to make short work of anyone trying to scale that path.

They're up on top of the walls, so you'll need to use that grapple launcher to get to them. Just try not to end up drake food!

text.title: 龙鳞护甲
text.objectives: 从赫达沙尔的风暴之翼幼龙身上收集鳞片。
text.description: 看来这附近的维库人喜欢用龙鳞来装饰护甲。$B$B如果你能从这里的幼龙身上收集足够的材料，或许可以做出一些有用的东西。

english.title: Built to Scale
english.objectives: Collect Storm Drake Scales from the Stormwing drakes in Hrydhsal.
english.description: The vrykul around here seem to use scales from these drakes to fashion their armor. $B$BIf you were able to gather enough material from the local drakes, you may be able to make something useful out of it.

text.title: 另辟蹊径
text.objectives: 在赫达沙尔打败德克加尔勇士，然后爬上塔楼顶部。
text.description:
等等，那把爪钩枪还在你手上吧？我觉得如果你能够从那座塔顶发射爪钩枪，还是可以到达山路的。那里的空隙好像不大。

当然了，我们得先解决前面那个大家伙。他看起来很耐打。从侧面进攻的话比较有优势。

english.title: Another Way
english.objectives: Defeat the Drekirjar Champion in Hrydshal, then climb to the top of the tower.
english.description:
Wait, do you still have that grapple launcher? I think you can still get to the path if you can launch from the top of that tower. The gap doesn't seem too bad there.

Of course, we'll have to take out the big guy out front first. He looks tough, but I think we have a chance if we can flank him.

text.title: 高处不胜寒
text.objectives: 从塔楼使用爪钩枪到达山路，然后爬到山顶。
text.description:
那边好像有一个合适的锚点，就在对面。顺着这条路应该可以一直走到山顶。

根据我的情报，你要找的龙就在山顶。希望它们还有力气帮助你。

english.title: Above the Winter Moonlight
english.objectives: Grapple across from the tower and climb to the top of the mountain path.
english.description:
There, it looks like there's a good spot to launch to right across from here. This path should take you all the way to the top.

According to my  intel, your dragons should be up there. Let's just hope that they're still in a state to help you.

text.title: 雷霆怒吼！
text.objectives: 乘着维瑟尔飞行，在赫达沙尔消灭150名神王的部下。
text.description:
你已经证明了自己是托林尼尔的朋友，我们愿意给予你力量。不过，我们的新勇士，我想请你帮最后一个忙。 

指引你来找我的巨龙还在等待一个向维库人复仇的机会。我希望你能一起去惩治这些德克加尔，让他们看看惹怒托林尼尔的下场。不管他们是不是蔑魔者，他们的邪恶已经让我的同胞们受到伤害。他们必须血债血偿。

等你准备好之后就去找维瑟尔。
text.completion: <The raven squawks, and Havi's voice fills your head>$B$BYou are indeed mighty, as the trial shows. $B$BBut valor is a different animal - one you think to tame?

english.title: Cry Thunder!
english.objectives: Fly with Vethir and kill 150 of the God-King's allies in Hrydshal.
english.description:
You have proven yourself an ally of the Thorignir and we will lend you our strength. I would ask one last favor of our new champion, though. 

The dragon who guided you to me awaits his vengeance against the vrykul. Together I wish for you to show these Drekirjar what it means to cross the Thorignir. Be they Felskorn or not, their malice has caused suffering to my brood. Their toll must be paid in blood.

Speak to Vethir when you are ready.
english.completion: <The raven squawks, and Havi's voice fills your head>$B$BYou are indeed mighty, as the trial shows. $B$BBut valor is a different animal - one you think to tame?

text.title: Burning Importance
text.objectives: Save yourself by completing a Timewalking Dungeon.
text.description: Champion, you would not believe the horrors I have seen. The timeline is twisting and your fate is dire. Causality bends at its very knees, and in this dire future you kneel to the Betrayer himself, Illidan Stormrage. Venture into the past and save yourself, but beware - your powers are as they were then.

english.title: Burning Importance
english.objectives: Save yourself by completing a Timewalking Dungeon.
english.description: Champion, you would not believe the horrors I have seen. The timeline is twisting and your fate is dire. Causality bends at its very knees, and in this dire future you kneel to the Betrayer himself, Illidan Stormrage. Venture into the past and save yourself, but beware - your powers are as they were then.

text.title: 月神殿
text.objectives: 在月神殿与莱妮丝·坠月谈一谈。
text.description: 塞纳留斯的情况十分危急。$b$b如果不快点处理，他就会被威胁着翡翠梦境的梦魇所掌控。要救他脱离险境，我们就必须拿到艾露恩之泪——也就是你受命来这里索取的圣物。$b$b月神殿离这不远。到那里去找到莱妮丝，出示我的印记并让她把眼泪交由你保管。$b$b赶快，$n，时间有限。
text.completion: You - you bear the mark of The Dreamer. Elune be praised!$b$bYou've arrived just in time, visitor. Shaladrassil's roots are at our doorstep...
text.completed: 在月神殿与莱妮丝·坠月谈一谈。

english.title: The Temple of Elune
english.objectives: Speak with Lyanis Moonfall at the Temple of Elune.
english.description: Cenarius is in danger.$b$bIf his condition is not reversed soon, he will be lost to the Nightmare that threatens the Emerald Dream. To spare him that fate, we must have the Tears of Elune - the same relic you were sent here to retrieve.$b$bElune's temple is not far. Go there. Find Lyanis. Show her my seal and instruct her to release the tears into your custody.$b$bHurry, $n. Time is short.
english.completion: You - you bear the mark of The Dreamer. Elune be praised!$b$bYou've arrived just in time, visitor. Shaladrassil's roots are at our doorstep...
english.completed: Speak with Lyanis Moonfall at the Temple of Elune.

text.title: 村庄危机
text.objectives: 在鲑鱼溪与希斯罗镇长谈一谈。
text.description: 达西·希斯罗的尸体就躺在你面前，插满了箭矢，遍布刀伤。$b$b她的手中紧握着一张笔记，笔力虚弱：$b$b“亡者逼近鲑鱼溪。$b$b帮帮我们，拜托！”
text.completion: We don't need any help, and we don't like strangers wanderin' around on our land.

english.title: A Village in Peril
english.objectives: Speak to Mayor Heathrow at Bradensbrook.
english.description: The corpse of Darcy Heathrow lies before you pierced by several arrows and knife wounds.$b$bIn one hand she clutches a note, written with a feeble hand, that reads:$b$b"The dead march on Bradensbrook.$b$bHelp us, please!"
english.completion: We don't need any help, and we don't like strangers wanderin' around on our land.

text.title: 调查村庄
text.objectives: 调查希斯罗的宅邸、玛尔婆婆的农场以及德雷克里夫码头。
text.description: 请见谅，陌生人。希斯罗镇长最近承受了很多压力。$B$B这不能怪他：他的亲生女儿佩妮洛普已经失踪两天了。$B$B其实，我们应该去调查南边的几处场所：希斯罗镇长的宅邸、玛尔婆婆的农场以及雷德克里夫码头。你可以去打探一下情况吗？$B$B请帮帮我们，我相信镇长的态度会改变的。
text.completion: I'm sorry for my suspicion earlier. We're all on edge with the recent attacks.$B$BI couldn't be more grateful to you and your friend.$B$BThanks to you, our situation is under control now. We've got a lot of rebuilding to do, but we'll survive.

english.title: The Farmsteads
english.objectives: Check on the Heathrow house, Granny Marl's farm, and the Radcliffes' fishing dock.
english.description: Forgive us, stranger. Mayor Heathrow has been under a lot of stress recently.$B$BI can't blame him: his own daughter, Penelope, has been missing for two days.$B$BIn fact, we could use information on several farmsteads to the south: Mayor Heathrow's house, Granny Marl's farm, and the Radcliffes' dock. Can you go check on the situation out there?$B$BHelp us, and perhaps the mayor's heart will soften.
english.completion: I'm sorry for my suspicion earlier. We're all on edge with the recent attacks.$B$BI couldn't be more grateful to you and your friend.$B$BThanks to you, our situation is under control now. We've got a lot of rebuilding to do, but we'll survive.

text.title: 暗夜爪牙
text.objectives: 杀掉$1oa个复生的刺客、黑鸦猎隼或复生猎犬。
text.description: 我不是他们的敌人，但是我无法说服他们。$B$B他们的村庄被我的老朋友们袭击了，而且是……已经离世的朋友。$B$B他们在世时都是正直的士兵，决不会做出这种恶行。虽然不知道他们受到了什么人或者什么东西的控制，但是这个问题并非当务之急。$B$B现在，请帮我获得村民们的信任。打倒那些袭击村民的黑鸦堡垒士兵。
text.completion: Good. These innocent villagers have done nothing to deserve these attacks. You have done well to help them.

english.title: Children of the Night
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Risen Assassins, Black Rook Falcons, or Risen Hounds.
english.description: I am no enemy to these people, but there is no convincing them of that.$B$BTheir village has come under attack by some very old friends of mine. Friends who are no longer... living.$B$BThere's no telling who or what controls them, but in life these noble soldiers would never engage in such acts. That's a mystery for another time.$B$BFor now, help me earn the trust of these villagers. Strike down the Black Rook enemies who are terrorizing their citizens.
english.completion: Good. These innocent villagers have done nothing to deserve these attacks. You have done well to help them.

text.title: 你是我的眼
text.objectives: 用玛尔婆婆的信号枪为6只黑鸦猎隼做标记。
text.description: 你看到那些贪婪的乌鸦在我的农场上空乱飞了吗？这些邪恶的生物不仅把这里搞得乌烟瘴气，还偷吃我的庄稼。$B$B我想用火枪解决它们，但是我的眼神越来越不好使了。$B$B拿上这把信号枪去给它们做上标记。$B$B只要我能瞄准那些标记，它们就死定了。
text.completion: Well love, we sure did take care of them! Thank you, $c. Glad ta see I 'aven't lost my touch.

english.title: A Sight For Sore Eyes
english.objectives: Use Granny's Flare Gun to mark 6 Black Rook Falcons.
english.description: Do you see those ravenous birds flying above my farm? Vicious creatures are spreading their filth an' eatin' my crops.$B$BI'd get rid of them with my trusty gun, but my eyesight's gone downhill.$B$BTake this flare gun and mark them for me.$B$BOnce I get my sights on them, I'll make 'em scatter.
english.completion: Well love, we sure did take care of them! Thank you, $c. Glad ta see I 'aven't lost my touch.

text.title: 为了玉米！
text.objectives: 收集5桶玉米。
text.description: 地里的玉米硕果累累，等着收割。我需要壮实的人手帮忙，免得它们被暗夜精灵强盗给糟蹋了。$B$B到外面去收割庄稼，我会给你丰厚的报酬。$B$B镇上的乡亲们需要这些粮食，而且我宁愿死也不要再靠着吃老鼠来过冬。
text.completion: All right, I'll get those barrels loaded up and delivered to the village in no time.$B$BThank you, $n. There'll be a lot of full bellies because of you.

english.title: For the Corn!
english.objectives: Collect 5 Barrels of Corn.
english.description: I've got a full summer's corn harvest just sittin' out in the field. I need some muscle to bring it in before the night elf raiders can destroy it.$B$BGet out there and bring me those crops, and I'll reward you handsomely.$B$BThe folks back in town need this food, and I sure as heck ain't eating rats for another winter.
english.completion: All right, I'll get those barrels loaded up and delivered to the village in no time.$B$BThank you, $n. There'll be a lot of full bellies because of you.

text.title: Black Rook Orders
text.objectives: Return to Commander Jarod Shadowsong at Bradensbrook.
text.description: The letter is written in midnight ink:$B$B"A demon invasion is imminent, but as long as the fires of Black Rook Hold blaze, we shall protect kaldorei lands. Kill any intruders who stand in our way."$B$B- K.R."$B$BPerhaps Jarod Shadowsong will want to see this.

english.title: Black Rook Orders
english.objectives: Return to Commander Jarod Shadowsong at Bradensbrook.
english.description: The letter is written in midnight ink:$B$B"A demon invasion is imminent, but as long as the fires of Black Rook Hold blaze, we shall protect kaldorei lands. Kill any intruders who stand in our way."$B$B- K.R."$B$BPerhaps Jarod Shadowsong will want to see this.

text.title: 寂静之城
text.objectives: 与首席传送师欧库勒斯谈一谈。
text.description: 今天，苏拉玛城突然不再喧嚣，实在是让人担心。$b$b欧库勒斯刚才告诉我，残月酒馆的传送器没有响应了。他无法与凡瑟尔取得联系，我也一样。$b$b但愿没出什么大事，我觉得有必要调查一下。$b$b去跟欧库勒斯谈谈，看他能不能把你传送到残月酒馆。我们得查出真相。

english.title: Silence in the City
english.objectives: Speak to Chief Telemancer Oculeth.
english.description: There is a troubling silence from Suramar City this day.$b$bOculeth just informed me that the teleporter to the Waning Crescent has gone dark. He is not able to reach Vanthir, nor am I.$b$bWhile I am hesitant to believe something dire has happened, I do feel this warrants investigation.$b$bSpeak with Oculeth and see if he can transport you to the Waning Crescent. We need to find out what happened.

text.title: 腐化根茎
text.objectives: 收集$1oa个腐化根茎样本。
text.description: 莎拉达希尔的巨大根茎正在森林中传播恐怖的腐化。$b$b如果要拯救瓦尔莎拉，我们就必须设法阻止世界树的入侵。$b$b如果你能带给我足够的腐化根茎样本，我或许可以弄清楚它们的秘密。
text.completion: It is as I feared, $r. This corruption is... irreversable.$b$bOur only course of action is to somehow find a way to fight it at its source.

english.title: Root Cause
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Corrupted Root Samples.
english.description: The massive roots of Shaladrassil are spreading a horrible corruption throughout the forest.$b$bIf we are to save Val'sharah, we will need to find a way to stop the encroachment of the world tree.$b$bIf you bring me enough corrupted root samples, I may be able to discover their secrets.
english.completion: It is as I feared, $r. This corruption is... irreversable.$b$bOur only course of action is to somehow find a way to fight it at its source.

text.title: 恶魔印记
text.objectives: 将恶魔徽章送还给月神殿的伊索莱·夜星。
text.description: 恶魔符文在你的手中闪闪发光，散发出黑暗之力。上面用恶魔语刻着一个散发着冷光的单词……$b$b……加瓦克斯……

english.title: Mark of the Demon
english.objectives: Return the Demonic Emblem to Isoraen Nightstar at the Temple of Elune.
english.description: The demonic rune glows in your hand, emanating dark power. A single word, inscribed in demon tongue, glows coldly... $b$b...GRAVAX...

text.title: 惊惧之泪
text.objectives: 取得艾露恩之泪。
text.description: 艾露恩之泪是圣物，数千年来一直由神殿的祭司保管。我告诉你这些，是想让你了解这件事的严重性。$b$b不过，伊瑟拉既高尚又睿智，我相信她的指示。你可以在神殿最东边的密室找到艾露恩之泪。$b$b请务必保持警惕，那片区域已经被恶魔占据。
text.completion: Xavius has stolen our sacred artifact?$b$bElune, forgive me. I have failed you.

english.title: Tears for Fears
english.objectives: Retrieve the Tears of Elune.
english.description: The Tears of Elune are a sacred artifact, protected by my order for thousands of years. I tell you this so that you may understand the gravity of your request.$b$bThat said, Ysera is noble and wise and I trust in her guidance. You will find the tears in a vault at the eastern edge of the temple grounds.$b$bProceed with caution though, as that area has been overrun by demons.
english.completion: Xavius has stolen our sacred artifact?$b$bElune, forgive me. I have failed you.

text.title: 木已成舟
text.objectives: 在塞纳留斯林地与伊瑟拉谈一谈。
text.description: 多亏你的努力，神殿暂时安全了。$b$b但艾露恩之泪被偷走了，而一度守护着这片土地的世界之树莎拉达希尔，现在也已沦为敌人手中的工具。翡翠梦境本身正在被梦魇所吞噬。$b$b我们的人民心绪不稳，他们的信仰正受到前所未有的考验。尽管如此，还是请带着我的报告回到伊瑟拉身边，$n。$b$b我将用余下的时间向艾露恩祈祷。但愿我们能够设法取胜。
text.completion: This is dire news indeed, $n.$b$bDraw upon your courage now, friend, for Azeroth needs her heroes more than ever before.
text.completed: 在塞纳留斯林地与伊瑟拉谈一谈。

english.title: The Die is Cast
english.objectives: Speak with Ysera at the Grove of Cenarius.
english.description: Thanks to your efforts the temple is safe, for now.$b$bBut the Tears of Elune are stolen and Shaladrassil, the world tree that once protected this land, is now an instrument in the hands of our enemy. The Emerald Dream itself is being overrun by Nightmare.$b$bThe hearts of our people falter, their faith tested like never before. Return to Ysera with my report, $n, such as it is.$b$bI shall plead with Elune with what time I have left here. May we somehow yet prevail.
english.completion: This is dire news indeed, $n.$b$bDraw upon your courage now, friend, for Azeroth needs her heroes more than ever before.
english.completed: Speak with Ysera at the Grove of Cenarius.

text.title: Our Last Hope
text.objectives: Speak with Maiev Shadowsong in the Illidari Cellblock.
text.description:
Your jailor, Maiev Shadowsong, stands outside the open door to your cell. The leader of the Wardens has just finished removing your bonds.

In the distance, you can hear sounds of battle. The unmistakable stench of the Burning Legion wafts through the air.

english.title: Our Last Hope
english.objectives: Speak with Maiev Shadowsong in the Illidari Cellblock.
english.description:
Your jailor, Maiev Shadowsong, stands outside the open door to your cell. The leader of the Wardens has just finished removing your bonds.

In the distance, you can hear sounds of battle. The unmistakable stench of the Burning Legion wafts through the air.

text.title: Our Last Hope
text.objectives: Retrieve your new warglaives.
text.description:
The Vault has fallen to the Burning Legion.

It pains me to say it, but all is lost, but for one glimmer of hope... YOU. Believe me when I say, I did NOT want to have to do this. However, it would seem I have no choice.

Help me, demon hunter, and I will grant you your freedom.

english.title: Our Last Hope
english.objectives: Retrieve your new warglaives.
english.description:
The Vault has fallen to the Burning Legion.

It pains me to say it, but all is lost, but for one glimmer of hope... YOU. Believe me when I say, I did NOT want to have to do this. However, it would seem I have no choice.

Help me, demon hunter, and I will grant you your freedom.

text.title: 流离失物
text.objectives: 在暗影沼泽找回5个影沼传家宝。
text.description: 结束了吗？$b$b我们挚爱的玛法里奥,我看到他落入沉睡者的掌控，不过伊瑟拉已经……变了。她被扭曲了。$b$b我们强大的世界之树莎拉达希尔也遭到腐化，变得面目全非。$b$b我们被迫逃离家园，什么都来不及带出来。其中有一些祖传之物，对我们来说无比神圣。如果可以的话，请你把它们取回来，$c，求你了。
text.completion: It is not much, but it is better than I could have hoped for. You have our gratitude.

english.title: Lost in Retreat
english.objectives: Retrieve 5 Shadowfen Heirlooms in Shadowfen.
english.description: Is this the end?$b$bOur beloved Malfurion. I saw him in the Dreamer's clutches, but Ysera was... changed. Twisted.$b$bShaladrassil, our mighty world tree, is corrupted beyond recognition.$b$bWe were forced to flee our home without our belongings. Some were heirlooms, sacred to us. Return them to me if you can, $c, I beg you.
english.completion: It is not much, but it is better than I could have hoped for. You have our gratitude.

text.title: 生死逃亡
text.objectives: 释放受难者奥图里斯和凯恩·日怒。
text.description:
单凭我们的力量是没办法离开地窟的。

你的两个盟友，受难者奥图里斯和凯恩·日怒就被关在这个房间里。 

快去放他们出来，这样可以提高我们的战斗力。

english.title: Breaking Out
english.objectives: Free both Altruis the Sufferer and Kayn Sunfury.
english.description:
We cannot fight our way out of the Vault alone.

Two of your allies, Kayn Sunfury and Altruis the Sufferer, are imprisoned within this room. 

Free them with haste. Their strength will be of great use to us.

text.title: 梦魇之心
text.objectives: 穿越梦魇寻找玛法里奥的踪迹。
text.description: 我只知道我的丈夫在这片扭曲森林的深处。他还活着，但不知道他是否安然无恙。$b$b<泰兰德看着你，表情凝重。>$b$b如果玛法里奥有什么闪失，那么就算萨维斯向艾露恩祈求宽恕，我也不会放过他。

english.title: Heart of the Nightmare
english.objectives: Track Malfurion's path through the Nightmare.
english.description: I know only that my husband is somewhere deeper in this twisted forest.$b$bHe is still alive, but it remains to be seen if he is whole.$b$b<Tyrande's expression hardens into a scowl as she peers at you.>$b$bElune herself cannot protect Xavius if he is not.

text.title: Treasure: Jewel of the Fallen Star

english.title: Treasure: Jewel of the Fallen Star

text.title: 阅读树叶
text.objectives: 收集$1oa片腐化花瓣。
text.description: $n，我的朋友。你必须从我跌倒的地方爬起来。你必须找到我们敬爱的玛法里奥。$b$b梦魇正不断吞噬我的思维，我可以听到这些扭曲树木的声音。我必须尽力保持理智来帮助你。$b$b深入阿希瑟兰，从那里的堕落生物身上找到腐化花瓣带来给我。$b$b有了这些花瓣，我也许还能够趁着思绪清晰之时找到你们的大德鲁伊。
text.completion: The waking world is slipping further and further from my mind. But on the vestiges of this corruption consuming my mind, I sense Malfurion!

english.title: Reading the Leaves
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Corrupted Petals.
english.description: $n, my friend. You must succeed where I have failed. You must find our dear Malfurion.$b$bAs the Nightmare consumes my thoughts, I hear the voices of these twisted trees. I must cling to sanity long enough to aid you.$b$bVenture into Ash'theran and bring me Corrupted Petals from the fallen denizens there.$b$bWith them, I might find your Archdruid while my mind is still my own.
english.completion: The waking world is slipping further and further from my mind. But on the vestiges of this corruption consuming my mind, I sense Malfurion!

text.title: 触手可及
text.objectives: 在沙拉尼尔寻找玛法里奥。
text.description: 他就在附近，$n，我可以感觉到。$b$b我们必须彻底搜索这个地方，寻找我的丈夫。如果我们不尽快找到他，恐怕一切就都来不及了。$b$b你在我们的搜索行动中表现勇敢。我相信到如今你绝不会让我失望，$n。$b$b谢谢你，请赶快。
text.completion: This cannot be!

english.title: Close Enough to Touch
english.objectives: Search for Malfurion within Shala'nir.
english.description: He is near, $n, I can feel it.$b$bWe must scour this place in search of my husband. I fear if we do not find him soon it will be too late.$b$bYou have been courageous throughout our search. I know you will not fail me now, $n.$b$bThank you, and please hurry.
english.completion: This cannot be!

objectiveDetails.description: 在村庄里寻找玛法里奥
跟随泰兰德进入沙拉尼尔

text.title: 邪能灌注
text.objectives: 利用死去的恶魔为自己灌注100点能量。
text.description:
多年的监禁让我们变得虚弱不堪。

地窟里到处都是恶魔。消灭恶魔并收集它们的灵魂以恢复你的力量。

english.title: Fel Infusion
english.objectives: Infuse yourself with 100 energy from fallen demons.
english.description:
So many years of imprisonment has left us weak.

The Vault is overrun with demons.  Kill them and gather their souls to regain your strength.

text.title: 伊利达雷的崛起
text.objectives: 救出8名伊利达雷囚犯。
text.description:
看看下面，敌人的数量太多了。

想要逃出去的话，我们就需要更多的盟友。去释放囚禁在牢笼里的其他伊利达雷。

我们需要所有人的力量，才能活着离开这个地方。

english.title: Rise of the Illidari
english.objectives: Free 8 Illidari Prisoners.
english.description:
Look down there. We are vastly outnumbered.

We will need more allies on our side if we are to escape from here intact. Free the other Illidari imprisoned within the cells of this chamber.

We will need everyone to escape this place alive.

text.title: 加洛德的使命
text.objectives: 在拉文凯斯之墓与加洛德·影歌谈一谈。
text.description: 自从玛维追着古尔丹离开守望者地窟以后，她的守望者姐妹就一直到处寻找她的下落。$B$B剩余的守望者太少了，我自愿协助搜寻。希望我可以在黑鸦堡垒找到她的踪迹。$B$B堡垒肯定有重兵把守，我需要帮手来助我突破。帮我找到她，我会给你丰厚的奖励。
text.completion: What does the Legion want with Ravencrest? He was dead and buried ten millennia ago.

english.title: Jarod's Mission
english.objectives: Speak to Jarod Shadowsong at Ravencrest Mausoleum.
english.description: Since Maiev chased after Gul'dan at the Vault of the Wardens, her sisters among the Wardens have been searching far and wide for her whereabouts.$B$BWith so few Wardens remaining, I volunteered to join the search. I hope I will find sign of her within Black Rook Hold.$B$BThe fortress will be well guarded, and I will need help to break through. Help me find her, and I will reward you handsomely.
english.completion: What does the Legion want with Ravencrest? He was dead and buried ten millennia ago.

text.title: 正面回应
text.objectives: 在残月酒馆、唤星者小屋和海妖之祈消灭12个艾利桑德的部队成员。
text.description: 我要为今天丧命的夜之子哭泣。$b$b <希尔格林指指门外。>$b$b艾利桑德根本不在乎人民的死活。这么多鲜活的生命……就这样消逝了！$b$b而这只是为了传递一个信息：反抗她的人都得死。$b$b$n，我的朋友，我们必须回应她。我们一定要让她明白，屠杀自己的人民是要付出代价的。$b$b反击吧，$n。

english.title: Answering Aggression
english.objectives: Kill 12 of Elisande's Forces in the Waning Crescent, Starcaller Retreat, and Siren's Vigil.
english.description: I weep for the Nightborne this day.$b$b<Silgryn gestures out the door.>$b$bElisande demonstrates the ultimate disdain for her people. So many lives... wasted!$b$bAll to relay a message: This is what happens to those who defy her.$b$b$n, my friend, we must answer her. We must show her that she cannot slay her people without retribution.$b$bFight back, $n.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭艾利桑德的部队成员

text.title: 重整旗鼓
text.objectives: 逃出海妖之祈。
text.description: 这些人或许还能在这里死守一段时间，但我清楚我们坚持不了多久。$b$b我们在这里多耽误一分钟，他们的危险就会增加一分，艾利桑德的报复部队随时可能出现。$b$b我们要转移，要找个地方休养生息，重整旗鼓。$b$b跟我来，我知道怎么从这里出去。

english.title: Regroup
english.objectives: Escape Siren's Vigil.
english.description: These people may be able to hold out here, but I know for certain that we cannot.$b$bEvery moment we spend here places them in danger of Elisande's forces retaliating against us.$b$bWe need to move. We need to find a place to regroup and recover.$b$bFollow me. I think I know how we can get out of here.

text.title: 刨根究底
text.objectives: 调查残月酒馆发生的事件。
text.description: 塔莉萨的担心是有道理的！$b$b我想要重新与残月酒馆取得联络，可消息网络一直没反应。我不知道出什么事了，但是情况不妙，为了慎重起见，最好是找人实地调查一下。$b$b $n，你可以亲自去看看吗？我会尽自己所能，把你传送到离残月酒馆很近的地方。

english.title: Crackdown
english.objectives: Investigate the events of the Waning Crescent.
english.description: Thalyssra is right to be concerned!$b$bThe network has not responded to my attempts to re-establish connection with the Waning Crescent. I do not know what happened, but given the circumstances I believe it prudent to investigate in person.$b$b$n, would you do the honors? I will send you as close to the Waning Crescent as I can.

text.title: The Sword of Truth
text.objectives: Place Fal'shathil on the ground, then defeat Black Rook night elves within its holy light.
text.description: Lord Ravencrest's army rises from the dead, but I believe they are controlled by Gul'dan's will.$B$BTake this - Lord Ravencrest's blade, Fal'shathil. It was known for a unique, magical quality. Those who gazed upon its mirrored blade found themselves unable to deny the truth.$B$BTake the blade and plant it in the ground. Attack the night elven ghosts near its light. Once they are weakened in its presence, perhaps they will regain their senses.

english.title: The Sword of Truth
english.objectives: Place Fal'shathil on the ground, then defeat Black Rook night elves within its holy light.
english.description: Lord Ravencrest's army rises from the dead, but I believe they are controlled by Gul'dan's will.$B$BTake this - Lord Ravencrest's blade, Fal'shathil. It was known for a unique, magical quality. Those who gazed upon its mirrored blade found themselves unable to deny the truth.$B$BTake the blade and plant it in the ground. Attack the night elven ghosts near its light. Once they are weakened in its presence, perhaps they will regain their senses.

objectiveDetails.description: Black Rook soldiers defeated near Fal'shathil

text.title: Competitive Exorcise
text.objectives: Kill 15 Burning Legion invaders in 10 minutes or less.
text.description:
Think you're good at sending demons back to the hell from whence they came? Show me!

I once bagged 15 in under 10 minutes. Do better than that and there'll be brew money waitin' for ya.

english.title: Competitive Exorcise
english.objectives: Kill 15 Burning Legion invaders in 10 minutes or less.
english.description:
Think you're good at sending demons back to the hell from whence they came? Show me!

I once bagged 15 in under 10 minutes. Do better than that and there'll be brew money waitin' for ya.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭被污染的破水元素
消灭被污染的黑水元素

text.title: 紧急集结
text.objectives: 找到塔瓦德和欧瑞克·图哈特，然后在克拉苏斯平台与玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵碰头。
text.description: 我们必须做出一个关系重大的决定，$n。$B$B燃烧军团在破碎海滩把我们打得溃不成军。这个世界最强大的军队在转瞬之间化为灰烬。$B$B我们必须集结信念坚定的勇士，拯救我们的家园。欧瑞克·图哈特和提尔近卫塔瓦德各自制定了计划，我们必须鼎力相助。$B$B请你找到他们，并陪同他们前往克拉苏斯平台，共同商议并作出决定。
text.completion: Thank you for helping us gather together, $n. We must stand united.

english.title: An Urgent Gathering
english.objectives: Gather Travard and Orik Trueheart, then meet Lord Maxwell Tyrosus at Krasus' Landing.
english.description: A critical decision must be made, $n.$B$BThe Legion devastated our forces at the Broken Shore. The mightiest army this world has ever known was reduced to cinders in moments.$B$BWe must gather those with the conviction to save our home. Travard of Tyr's Guard and Orik Trueheart have each made plans to do just that, but we must not let them walk alone.$B$BI ask that you seek them out and guide them to Krasus' Landing so that we may make this decision together.
english.completion: Thank you for helping us gather together, $n. We must stand united.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

text.title: 守望者玺戒
text.objectives: 把守望者玺戒带给加洛德·影歌。
text.description: 暗夜精灵携带着一个刻有守望者纹章的玺戒。$B$B这枚戒指由一种坚不可摧的银质金属打造，但是由于主人常年佩戴，加上不经意的扭动和摩擦而留下了痕迹。

english.title: The Warden's Signet
english.objectives: Take the Warden's Signet to Jarod Shadowsong.
english.description: The night elf was carrying a signet engraved with the crest of the Wardens.$B$BThe band, made from a silvery, unbreakable metal, has been worn down by time, as if absently twisted and rubbed against its owner's finger.

text.title: 玛维的踪迹
text.objectives: 搜查熔炉、兽栏牢笼和守卫塔。
text.description: 前面就是堡垒的所在地。要搜查的范围很大，如果我们分头行事，就能搜查尽可能多的地方。$B$B你到熔炉、牢笼和守卫塔去寻找玛维的踪迹。我到上层区域进行搜查，然后我们在堡垒的另一面碰头。
text.completion: Good work, $n. There is no doubt that they have already moved Maiev into the prison cells beneath the tower.

english.title: Maiev's Trail
english.objectives: Search the forge, the saber pens, and the guard tower.
english.description: The fortress grounds are just up ahead. There is a large area to search, but if we split up, I believe we can cover a lot of ground.$B$BSearch the prison cages, the forge, and the guard tower for any signs of Maiev. I will check the upper ramparts and meet you on the other side of the keep.
english.completion: Good work, $n. There is no doubt that they have already moved Maiev into the prison cells beneath the tower.

text.title: 黑鸦守卫
text.objectives: 消灭卡斯特·远途、特兰·破盾以及斯塔丽丝·强弓。
text.description: 这已不是我记忆中的黑鸦堡垒。崩塌的高墙下回荡着往昔荣光的魅影。$B$B如果拉文凯斯领主复活了，那他以前的副官一定会追随左右。$B$B卡斯特·远途，守卫队长。$B$B特兰·破盾，举世无双的铸锤大师。$B$B还有蒙着双眼也能百步穿杨的斯塔丽丝·强弓。$B$B我们必须消灭他们，否则休想进入塔楼。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. May their spirits be at peace.

english.title: The Rook's Guard
english.objectives: Kill Kester Farseeker, Trelan Shieldbreaker, and Starlys Strongbow.
english.description: Black Rook Hold is not the same place I knew. Its walls have crumbled, a ghostly echo of its former glory.$B$BIf Lord Ravencrest has returned, then surely he will have his former officers at his side.$B$BKester Farseeker, captain of the guard.$B$BTrelan Shieldbreaker, peerless master of maces.$B$BStarlys Strongbow, who could split arrows while blindfolded.$B$BIf we stand any chance of entering the tower itself, they must be eliminated.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. May their spirits be at peace.

text.title: 黑鸦堡垒
text.objectives: 把守望者玺戒带给加洛德·影歌。
text.description: 箱子里有各种小玩意，里面藏着一枚刻有独特纹章的玺戒。$B$B这枚戒指由一种坚不可摧的银质金属打造，但是由于主人常年佩戴，加上不经意的扭动和摩擦而留下了痕迹。

english.title: Black Rook Hold
english.objectives: Take the Warden's Signet to Jarod Shadowsong.
english.description: Inside the chest, hidden amongst various knickknacks, is a signet engraved with a unique crest.$B$BThe band, made from a silvery, unbreakable metal, has been worn down by time, as if absently twisted and rubbed against its owner's finger.

text.title: 黑鸦监牢
text.objectives: 消灭阿拉扎斯并拿到监狱钥匙。
text.description: 我已历经千辛万苦，在这最后的关头，我决不会放弃。$B$B玛维肯定就在黑鸦堡垒下面的监牢里。$B$B我在上层侦察之后发现了监牢的入口，那里有一个恐怖的狱卒守卫。$B$B我潜进去干掉里面的守卫，你解决掉阿拉扎斯，拿到钥匙之后到里面来和我碰头。
text.completion: Good, these keys should open any of the cells within the prison.
text.giverWindow: 万能钥匙在他手上。

english.title: Black Rook Prison
english.objectives: Kill Araxxas and collect the Prison Keys.
english.description: I did not come this far to lose her in the final moments.$B$BMaiev must be in the cells beneath Black Rook Hold.$B$BI scouted above, and the entrance to the prison is guarded by a fearsome jailor.$B$BI will sneak past and take out the guards inside. Defeat Araxxas, take the keys, and then meet me within.
english.completion: Good, these keys should open any of the cells within the prison.
english.giverWindow: He holds the master key.

text.title: 库塔洛斯·拉文凯斯
text.objectives: 查看拉文凯斯的旗帜。
text.description: 拉文凯斯领主正直、高贵，他是无所畏惧的领袖，是经验丰富的指挥官和导师，更是人民的保卫者。$B$B玛法里奥、伊利丹、泰兰德和我……我们年轻时的命运之路上多亏有了他的提点。$B$B在他以前安息之地上面的是他们家族那具有传奇色彩的旗帜。好好观察一会，我再告诉你更多他的故事。
text.completion: The attacking spirits spoke of their lord and master. I fear the Legion has raised Lord Ravencrest to do their bidding. What price was paid for such a sinister revival, I do not know.

english.title: Kur'talos Ravencrest
english.objectives: Examine Ravencrest's Sigil.
english.description: Lord Ravencrest was a fearless leader, a seasoned commander, a man of integrity and honor, a teacher, and a protector of his people.$B$BMalfurion, Illidan, Tyrande, and I... we were still young when he helped shape our destinies.$B$BThe sigil of his house was legendary. Observe, for a moment, the sigil over his former resting place and I shall tell you more of his legacy.
english.completion: The attacking spirits spoke of their lord and master. I fear the Legion has raised Lord Ravencrest to do their bidding. What price was paid for such a sinister revival, I do not know.

text.title: 解救伊利达雷
text.objectives: 解救瑟留斯·黑翼、凯赛尔·夜棘和阿莎·鸦歌。
text.description: <这个伊利达雷恶魔猎手身上有几道可怕的伤口，血流不止。看来他被丢在这里等死。>$B$B牢房里还关着我的三个……<咳>……同伴。$B$B我们在这里侦察时遭到了突袭。$B$B我活不了多久了，不过，请你救救他们。
text.completion: The other Illidari did not make it, but I owe you my life. There is one thing I learned during my time in the prisons: the demons within Black Rook Hold must die.

english.title: Illidari Freedom
english.objectives: Free Sirius Ebonwing, Cassiel Nightthorn, and Asha Ravensong.
english.description: <The Illidari demon hunter is bleeding from several ghastly wounds. It appears he was left here to die.>$B$BWithin the prison are three of my... <cough>... comrades.$B$BWe were taken by surprise while scouting the area.$B$BI am not long for this world, but please, save them.
english.completion: The other Illidari did not make it, but I owe you my life. There is one thing I learned during my time in the prisons: the demons within Black Rook Hold must die.

text.title: 无可留恋
text.objectives: 疏散残月酒馆和海妖之祈的生还者。
text.description: 艾利桑德对残月酒馆的清洗行动太过突然，大家都措手不及。我的人大多死了，或者被抓了。$b$b有些人可能逃过了一劫，我们一定要找到他们。$b$b我要你去搜索一下附近的建筑，寻找生还者，确保他们能够及时逃跑。你一定要说服他们，不要继续留在城里。$b$b艾利桑德的统治如此疯狂，这里已经不能再呆了。

english.title: No Reason to Stay
english.objectives: Evacuate survivors in the Waning Crescent and Siren's Vigil.
english.description: Elisande's purge of the Waning Crescent came so swiftly that few could react. Many of my people are dead or taken.$b$bSome may have endured this atrocity. We need to make sure they are not left behind.$b$bI need you to search the houses nearby for any survivors. See that they flee before they are discovered. Reassure them that there is no reason to stay. $b$bNot here, not while Elisande's insanity reigns.

text.title: 残酷中尉
text.objectives: 消灭德斯德尔·星眼。
text.description: 你的直觉没有错。古尔丹使拉文凯斯领主及其军队从坟墓中复生。他们现在为燃烧军团效力，保护着塔楼里的秘密。$B$B虽然拉文凯斯是这里的最高首领，但是监牢的运作是德斯德尔·星眼中尉在负责。$B$B在过去的这些日子里，他不断对我严刑拷打，不过我没有放弃。$B$B<玛维用一根手指划过她的纹饰佩剑。>$B$B该结束他的生命了。
text.completion: Lord Stareye came from a noble house, but in war, he never came close to Ravencrest or my brother.$B$BNow that he is defeated, we can turn our attention to his commander.$B$BHowever, that will be no easy task. We must gather our strength before facing Lord Ravencrest himself.
text.giverWindow: 拉文凯斯领主的副官。

english.title: Lieutenant of the Tower
english.objectives: Kill Desdel Stareye.
english.description: All of your instincts were correct. Gul'dan raised Lord Ravencrest, and his ghostly army, from beyond the grave. Now, they serve the Legion, protecting secrets within the tower.$B$BAlthough Ravencrest commands from above, Lieutenant Desdel Stareye operates the prisons.$B$BHe tormented me these past few moons, but I did not yield.$B$B<Maiev runs a finger along her curved blade.>$B$BHis life must be ended.
english.completion: Lord Stareye came from a noble house, but in war, he never came close to Ravencrest or my brother.$B$BNow that he is defeated, we can turn our attention to his commander.$B$BHowever, that will be no easy task. We must gather our strength before facing Lord Ravencrest himself.
english.giverWindow: Second-in-command to Lord Ravencrest.

text.title: 阻止古尔丹！
text.objectives: 进入背叛者地窟，消灭库拉什和斯勒基，并夺取他们的邪能。
text.description:
伊利丹在黑暗神殿溃败之后，我们把他的遗体带到了这里，想将他永远埋葬在守望者地窟之中。

古尔丹突破了我们的防线，企图夺走背叛者的遗体。

就算失去了生命，伊利丹的躯体还能被燃烧军团所利用。绝不能让古尔丹得逞。
text.giverWindow: 尽力阻止他。

english.title: Stop Gul'dan!
english.objectives: Enter the Vault of the Betrayer, kill Crusher and Sledge, and take their fel power.
english.description:
After his defeat at the Black Temple, we brought Illidan's lifeless body here, to be interred forever within the Vault of the Wardens.

Gul'dan has found his way through our defenses and is trying to steal the Betrayer's corpse.

Even in death, Illidan's body can be used by the Burning Legion. Gul'dan CANNOT succeed.
english.giverWindow: Stop him if you can.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭库拉什和斯勒基并获取力量

text.title: 手足情深
text.objectives: 在黑鸦监牢寻找玛维·影歌。
text.description:
玛维应该在监狱的某个地方。我在来这里的路上发现了她抛弃的盔甲。

我们分头搜索牢房，这样速度更快。$B$B我们必须找到她。
text.completion: <Maiev's face is bruised, her lips cracked, and her body covered in scars. She looks thin and ragged, but she moves with purpose.>$B$BFor weeks they tried to break me. Amateurs!$B$BI kept my silence. I counted the minutes, measured their steps, and listened to the voices beyond my cell.$B$BI have been waiting for my chance to escape, and to strike back at my captors.$B$BNow, you bring my armor AND my blade. My salvation will be followed by bloodshed.$B$B<Maiev smiles.>

english.title: Brotherly Love
english.objectives: Find Maiev Shadowsong in Black Rook Prison.
english.description:
Maiev will be somewhere in the prison. I found her discarded armor on my way here.

Let's split up to search the cells more quickly.$B$BWe must find her.
english.completion: <Maiev's face is bruised, her lips cracked, and her body covered in scars. She looks thin and ragged, but she moves with purpose.>$B$BFor weeks they tried to break me. Amateurs!$B$BI kept my silence. I counted the minutes, measured their steps, and listened to the voices beyond my cell.$B$BI have been waiting for my chance to escape, and to strike back at my captors.$B$BNow, you bring my armor AND my blade. My salvation will be followed by bloodshed.$B$B<Maiev smiles.>

text.title: 深入邪污产床
text.objectives: 前往邪污产床与考瓦斯·血棘碰头。
text.description:
我审问的一个恶魔透露了非常有用的消息。显然，火山里有一个鬼母，她正在把燃烧军团的秘密记入魔典。

考瓦斯已经出发，试图找到那个恶魔并为我们带回那些秘密。

english.title: Into the Foul Creche
english.objectives: Meet up with Kor'vas Bloodthorn at the Foul Creche.
english.description:
One of the demons that I interrogated revealed a particularly juicy bit of information. Apparently, there's an imp mother in the volcano that scribes Legion secrets.

Kor'vas has gone out to find that demon and bring those secrets back for us.

text.title: 阻止轰炸
text.objectives: 除掉军团毁灭炮。
text.description:
杰斯的防御撑不了多久。必须有人到外面去消灭军团毁灭炮。

<凯恩以幽灵视觉意有所指地看着你。>

english.title: Stop the Bombardment
english.objectives: Destroy the Legion Devastators.
english.description:
Jace's wards are not going to hold out much longer. We need someone to go out there and make sure those Legion devastators are destroyed.

<Kayn pointedly looks at you with his spectrally-enhanced vision.>

text.title: 钥石
text.objectives: 消灭蛛后泰兰娜并拿到萨格里特钥石，然后到下方的传送室和其他人汇合。
text.description:
$n，蛛后泰兰娜就在前面的指挥室内，其他人已经先进去了。萨格里特钥石就在她的手上。

至此，我们所有做过的牺牲跟努力，都是为了最后这一战。
text.giverWindow: 从她的尸体上拿到萨格里特钥石！

english.title: The Keystone
english.objectives: Kill Brood Queen Tyranna and take the Sargerite Keystone. Then, join the others down-below in the portal chamber.
english.description:
$n, Brood Queen Tyranna is just ahead in the command chamber. The others already charged in. She has the Sargerite Keystone in her possession.

Finally, the object of all our sacrifice is at hand.
english.giverWindow: Take the Sargerite Keystone from her corpse!

text.title: 返回黑暗神殿
text.objectives: 使用萨格里特钥石激活邪能传送门，然后返回黑暗神殿。
text.description:
快点，$n，使用萨格里特钥石。

我们必须尽快赶回黑暗神殿，不然就太迟了！

english.title: Return to the Black Temple
english.objectives: Use the Sargerite Keystone to activate the Fel Portal and return to the Black Temple.
english.description:
Quickly, $n, use the Sargerite Keystone.

We must get back to the Black Temple before it is too late!

text.title: 瓦尔莎拉的命运
text.objectives: 保卫月神殿。
text.description: 玛法里奥，我的爱人……我为他心碎，但我们不能随他而去。$b$b我曾对我的女神艾露恩发誓，尽我一切所能保护她的殿堂和土地。当我的教派陷入危机时，我不能袖手旁观。$b$b愿月神眷顾你，玛法里奥。$b$b<泰兰德转过身，眼中闪烁着泪光。>
text.completion: This shall be remembered as one of the darkest days in the history of our world. But hope remains. Elune's light has strengthened our resolve.

english.title: The Fate of Val'sharah
english.objectives: Defend the Temple of Elune.
english.description: Malfurion, my love.... My heart breaks for him, but I cannot follow where he goes.$b$bI have sworn myself to Elune, my goddess, to defend her temples and lands with all that I am. I cannot stand by while my order is in danger.$b$bMay she keep you in her graces, Malfurion.$b$b<Tyrande turns away, eyes glistening with tears.>
english.completion: This shall be remembered as one of the darkest days in the history of our world. But hope remains. Elune's light has strengthened our resolve.

text.title: 恶魔行踪
text.objectives: 寻找玛法里奥·怒风。
text.description: 玛法里奥就在附近。我感受得到。$b$b你到安杜塔拉山顶找找，我会继续在森林里搜寻。$b$b赶快行动，$n。时间紧迫！
text.completion: My husband, Malfurion, what has become of him?!$b$bAnswer me!

english.title: The Demon's Trail
english.objectives: Find Malfurion Stormrage.
english.description: Malfurion is nearby. I can sense him..$b$bSearch the summit of Andu'talah while I continue to scour the forest.$b$bBe swift, $n. Time is of the essence!
english.completion: My husband, Malfurion, what has become of him?!$b$bAnswer me!

text.title: Treasure: Axe of the Weeping Wolf

english.title: Treasure: Axe of the Weeping Wolf

text.title: 解救同胞
text.objectives: 你的一些恶魔猎手有危险了，想办法拿魂铸之钥去解救他们。
text.description:
赛娅娜已经前往熔火之滨。她打算帮助那些先我们一步穿过传送门的恶魔猎手。不过，她已经自身难保。

据这个审判官透露，他们遭到了一种名为“狱卒”的恶魔的俘虏。这种新形态的恶魔会吸噬受害者的灵魂。我怕他们撑不了多久。

english.title: Set Them Free
english.objectives: Several of your demon hunters are in trouble. Get the Soulwrought Key to set them free.
english.description:
Cyana went down to the Molten Shore. She was going to help some of the demon hunters who came in through the gateway ahead of us. Instead, she got herself into trouble.

This inquisitor revealed they're being held prisoner by some new type of demon called a 'jailer'. The thing sucks the souls out of its victims. I doubt they can hold out much longer.

text.title: 加入伊利达雷：破坏魔
text.objectives: 将一位恶魔猎手的全部力量灌入军团传送门激活器内，然后用它召唤你的破坏魔部队。
text.description:
我们的破坏魔正在黑暗神殿等待着。把她们带来这里实在是一场赌博……毕竟她们以前为燃烧军团效力。但她们可以算是伊利丹大人麾下最强大的力量之一。

<杰斯意味深长地看着你。>

我有预感，为了召唤她们，我们必须做出最沉重的牺牲。

english.title: Enter the Illidari: Shivarra
english.objectives: Feed a powerful soul into the Legion Gateway Activator and then use it to summon in your Shivarra forces.
english.description:
Our Shivarra demonesses are waiting at the Black Temple. It's a gamble bringing them here... they used to be part of the Burning Legion after all. But, they are some of the most powerful in Lord Illidan's arsenal.

<Jace looks at you for a long moment.>

I have a feeling that the ultimate sacrifice is going to have to be made in order to summon them in.

objectiveDetails.description: 贝拉斯·黎明之刃击杀计数

text.title: 力挽狂澜
text.objectives: 消灭末日指挥官贝尔艾什，并将他的力量占为己有。
text.description:
必须解决末日守卫指挥官和那个蛛后。他手下的艾瑞达正在召唤大批援军。

我们必须赶在燃烧军团入侵火山上的新据点之前，把他解决掉。

而且还有个好处，你可以占有他的恶魔之力。
text.giverWindow: 燃烧军团的指挥官就在火山下方的低地里。将他的力量占为己有。

english.title: Before We're Overrun
english.objectives: Slay Doom Commander Beliash and take his power for your own.
english.description:
The doomguard commander and his queen must be dealt with. His eredar are summoning in a huge number of reinforcements.

We need to put an end to him before the Legion overruns our new foothold up in the volcano!

As an added benefit, you can steal his demonic power.
english.giverWindow: This is the Legion leader in the lowlands below the volcano. Take his power for youself.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭贝尔艾什并获取力量

text.title: 魔石矿脉样本
text.objectives: 把魔石矿脉样本带给达拉然的迪格丝大妈。
text.description: 这种矿石和你以前见过的完全不同。$b$b金属闪烁着神秘的光泽，形成了复杂又多变的纹路。达拉然的训练师一定想见识一下。
text.completion: It's so light. So pretty, too! Reminds me of elementium, a bit.$b$bIf you see any more ore like this, try and strike it with the grain. You'll waste much less of it.

english.title: Leystone Deposit Sample
english.objectives: Bring the Leystone Deposit Sample to Mama Diggs in Dalaran.
english.description: This ore looks like nothing you've seen before.$b$bA mystical sheen moves through the metal in complex, unpredictable patterns. Your trainer in Dalaran would certainly like to see this.
english.completion: It's so light. So pretty, too! Reminds me of elementium, a bit.$b$bIf you see any more ore like this, try and strike it with the grain. You'll waste much less of it.

text.title: 激活符文石
text.objectives: 在符文林地激活符文石。
text.description:
我的根茎枯萎……枝叶凋零……

骨语者，他们想让符文林地陷入死寂。符文石是阻止他们的关键……

激活符文石……解脱我的束缚……
text.completion: So it was your footsteps I felt upon my woods as the runestones released their grip? $B$BYou have my thanks, outsider.

english.title: Turn the Keys
english.objectives: Activate the Runestones within the Runewood.
english.description:
My roots wither... my branches die...

The Bonespeakers, they seek to silence the Runewood.  The runestones are the key...

Turn the stones... release my bonds...
english.completion: So it was your footsteps I felt upon my woods as the runestones released their grip? $B$BYou have my thanks, outsider.

text.title: 7.0 Val'sharah - River - Vignette: Thondrax - TRACKING - twh

english.title: 7.0 Val'sharah - River - Vignette: Thondrax - TRACKING - twh

text.title: 魔石矿层样本
text.objectives: 把魔石矿层样本带给达拉然的迪格丝大妈。
text.description: 这块矿石显然吸收了破碎群岛蕴含的魔网能量。它触感冰凉，古怪的棱角不规则地反射着光线。$b$b应该请达拉然的训练师分析一下。
text.completion: Look at that! She's a lovely one, isn't she?$b$bTreat this type of ore with care, $glad:lass;. No fat-muscle shoulder swings necessary - just a gentle tap on the right spot and you'll extract much more ore than a beginner.

english.title: Leystone Seam Sample
english.objectives: Bring the Leystone Seam Sample to Mama Diggs in Dalaran.
english.description: This ore has clearly absorbed some of the latent ley energies within the Broken Isles. It is cool to the touch, and reflects light in odd, playful angles.$b$bYour trainer in Dalaran should analyze this.
english.completion: Look at that! She's a lovely one, isn't she?$b$bTreat this type of ore with care, $glad:lass;. No fat-muscle shoulder swings necessary - just a gentle tap on the right spot and you'll extract much more ore than a beginner.

text.title: 活性魔石样本
text.objectives: 把活性魔石样本带给达拉然的迪格丝大妈。
text.description: 这不是普通的魔石。它更富有活性，复杂纹理闪烁着迷人的光芒。$b$b达拉然的训练师一定很想看看这个。
text.completion: Now isn't that somethin'? You got this offa one of those rocky creatures down there?$b$bLooks like ye only brought me a bit o' the torso, though. Next time, make sure to get the arms and head too. Lots o' good meat in there.

english.title: Living Leystone Sample
english.objectives: Bring the Living Leystone Sample to Mama Diggs in Dalaran.
english.description: This is no normal leystone. It is much livelier, shimmering in complex, enthralling patterns. It is easy to stare at.$b$bYour trainer in Dalaran would certainly like to have a look at this.
english.completion: Now isn't that somethin'? You got this offa one of those rocky creatures down there?$b$bLooks like ye only brought me a bit o' the torso, though. Next time, make sure to get the arms and head too. Lots o' good meat in there.

text.title: 谨慎对待
text.objectives: 使用罗诺斯的水晶矿锄对魔石进行$1oa次开采。
text.description: 魔石是一种敏感的矿石。铁匠可以慢慢提取其中的强大力量，但是身为矿工，我们更需要谨慎对待，否则力量就会潜藏到魔石内部。$b$b<牛头人递给你一把“水晶”矿锄。>$b$b下次开采魔石的时候就用这把矿锄。如果你用力过猛，它就会破碎。开采魔石就需要这么小心。
text.completion: You've learned much, $n.$b$bStay a while. I have a story for you.

english.title: Where Respect is Due
english.objectives: Mine for leystone $1oa times while using Ronos's Glass Pick.
english.description: Leystone is a sensitive ore. Our smiths can coax great power out of it, but as miners, we must treat it with respect, or else its power will retreat inward.$b$b<The tauren hands you what appears to be a GLASS mining pick.>$b$bThe next time you mine some leystone ore, use this pick. It will break if you strike too hard. THIS is the respect that leystone requires.
english.completion: You've learned much, $n.$b$bStay a while. I have a story for you.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用罗诺斯的矿锄开采魔石

text.title: 瑞苏·铁角的传奇
text.objectives: 与罗诺斯·铁角交谈，了解瑞苏·铁角的故事。
text.description: 很久很久以前，有个叫瑞苏的牛头人来到了这片土地上。他是所有矿工的先驱。$b$b如果你想学习更多关于采矿的知识，就必须先了解瑞苏的故事。
text.completion: Echoes of Rethu's time in this land still remain, $n. Be on the lookout for his influence when you are out in the field.

english.title: The Legend of Rethu Ironhorn
english.objectives: Speak with Ronos Ironhorn to learn the tale of Rethu Ironhorn.
english.description: A long, long time ago, a tauren by the name of Rethu entered this land. His exploits paved the road that all miners walk.$b$bIf you wish to learn more about mining, you must first learn about Rethu.
english.completion: Echoes of Rethu's time in this land still remain, $n. Be on the lookout for his influence when you are out in the field.

text.title: 瑞苏的日记
text.objectives: 把撕破的日记书页交给至高岭的罗诺斯·铁角。
text.description: 你注意到碎石之间夹着一张纸。$b$b小心移走碎石之后，你找出一个破旧卷轴的残骸。里面写着牛头人的古老文字，有两个字吸引了你的目光：$b$b“瑞苏”

english.title: Rethu's Journal
english.objectives: Bring the Torn Journal Page to Ronos Ironhorn in Highmountain.
english.description: Tucked in between a few pieces of rubble, a scrap of paper catches your eye.$b$bMining carefully, you uncover the tattered remains of an old scroll. The tauren handwriting is archaic, but one word catches your eye:$b$b"Rethu".

text.title: 瑞苏的矿锄
text.objectives: 把破旧的矿锄交给至高岭的罗诺斯·铁角。
text.description: 矿层上面有工具凿出来的斜线痕迹，这说明它曾被人开采过。$b$b往下一看，你发现地上有一把矿锄——由于过度使用加上年代久远，它的握柄已经破裂，锄头也已变钝。$b$b柄上刻着一个熟悉的名字：$b$b“瑞苏”

english.title: Rethu's Pick
english.objectives: Bring the Battered Mining Pick to Ronos Ironhorn in Highmountain.
english.description: This seam has been mined before - it bears the telltale diagonal ruts of a miner's pick.$b$bLooking down, that pick now lays on the ground - handle broken, pick-point dulled with use and years.$b$bCarved into the haft is a familiar name:$b$b"Rethu"

text.title: 瑞苏之角
text.objectives: 把大角交给至高岭的罗诺斯·铁角。
text.description: 你从岩石生物的尸体中发现了一件奇怪的东西：一根破损的牛头人的角。$b$b它看起来非常陈旧，但它的色泽和线条让你不由得想起了铁角飞地的罗诺斯·铁角。

english.title: Rethu's Horn
english.objectives: Bring the Chunk of Horn to Ronos Ironhorn in Highmountain.
english.description: The corpse of the rocky beast yielded an unusual treasure: a battered chunk of tauren's horn.$b$bIt is clearly very, very old, but something about its color and curve reminds you of Ronos Ironhorn at the Ironhorn Enclave.

text.title: 瑞苏的感悟
text.objectives: 向至高岭的罗诺斯·铁角报告你的遭遇。
text.description: 嘿……矿工……让我看看你的矿锄。$b$b<牛头人幽灵注视着你的矿锄。>$b$b你让我想起了过去，我也曾在这片土地上闯荡。好好珍惜吧，矿工，美好的日子总是稍纵即逝。$b$b<幽灵对你鞠了一躬，然后消失了。>

english.title: Rethu's Lesson
english.objectives: Report your encounter to Ronos Ironhorn in Highmountain.
english.description: You... miner... let me see your pick a moment.$b$b<The tauren spirit eyes your mining equipment.>$b$bYou remind me of myself, when I once walked this land. Savor these moments, miner. They cannot last forever.$b$b<With a bow, the spirit disappears.>

text.title: 瑞苏的经验
text.objectives: 向至高岭的罗诺斯·铁角报告你的遭遇。
text.description: 矿工……你……知道我是谁？$b$b我知道了。非常好。我的部族发扬了优良的传统。$b$b如果你回到铁角部族……告诉他们，我以他们为傲。

english.title: Rethu's Experience
english.objectives: Report your encounter to Ronos Ironhorn in Highmountain.
english.description: Miner... you... you know who I am?$b$bI see. That is good. My tribe continues to honor its roots.$b$bIf you return to the land of the Ironhorn tribe... let them know that they are looked upon with pride.

text.title: 瑞苏的牺牲
text.objectives: 向至高岭的罗诺斯·铁角报告你的遭遇。
text.description: 矿工……我们聊聊。我在这里的时间不多了。$b$b我看到你努力争取矿石，我认为这是最值得敬重的采矿之道。这给予了土地战斗的机会。$b$b但是，每个人都不该辜负自己的人生。挖得太深，就会被大地吞噬——这是我的教训，没有矿石值得你付出这样的代价。$b$b不过，那又是另一个故事了……

english.title: Rethu's Sacrifice
english.objectives: Report your encounter to Ronos Ironhorn in Highmountain.
english.description: Miner... speak with me a moment. I haven't much time in this place.$b$bI see you fight for your ore. I believe that is the most noble way to obtain your stone. It gives the land a fighting chance.$b$bStill, one mustn't be callous with their own life. Dig too deep, and the land will overcome you. No stone is worth the price I paid.$b$bBut that is a tale for another day...

text.title: 邪能页岩矿脉样本
text.objectives: 把邪能页岩矿脉样本带给达拉然的迪格丝大妈。
text.description: 这真是一块污秽不堪的矿石。$b$b应该让达拉然的训练师来看看。
text.completion: This is no natural stone, miner. It stinks of demon's blood. Where'd you find this?$b$bReminds me a bit of old fel iron. Come 'ere, lemme teach you a trick or two on how to properly gather this stuff.

english.title: Felslate Deposit Sample
english.objectives: Bring the Felslate Deposit Sample to Mama Diggs in Dalaran.
english.description: This is one nasty-looking stone.$b$bYour trainer in Dalaran should see this.
english.completion: This is no natural stone, miner. It stinks of demon's blood. Where'd you find this?$b$bReminds me a bit of old fel iron. Come 'ere, lemme teach you a trick or two on how to properly gather this stuff.

text.title: 邪能页岩矿层样本
text.objectives: 把邪能页岩矿层样本带给达拉然的迪格丝大妈。
text.description: 这块矿石异常沉重。更让人不安的是，你触碰它的时候，它的颜色似乎变得更深，还会发出嘶嘶声。$b$b或许达拉然的采矿训练师会有些见解。
text.completion: This came out of a cliffside seam? Remember, ye can't mine seams like ye mine deposits. Totally different thing. I'll show ye my trick.

english.title: Felslate Seam Sample
english.objectives: Bring the Felslate Seam Sample to Mama Diggs in Dalaran.
english.description: This ore is remarkably heavy. More disturbingly, it seems to darken and hiss at your touch.$b$bPerhaps your mining trainer in Dalaran has some insights.
english.completion: This came out of a cliffside seam? Remember, ye can't mine seams like ye mine deposits. Totally different thing. I'll show ye my trick.

text.title: 活性邪能页岩样本
text.objectives: 把活性邪能页岩样本带给达拉然的迪格丝大妈。
text.description: 你的矿工直觉告诉你，地狱火尸体的碎块好像有用。$b$b一定有办法可以从恶魔残骸中提取出更多的矿石。或许达拉然的采矿训练师能够帮忙。
text.completion: This came from a blasted infernal? Look out, we've got $gmister:little miss; COMBAT miner, here!$b$bSome o' this ore seems to 'ave lost its shine on the trip back, however. Next time, make sure to cut out the sword and spell wounds before ye mine it.

english.title: Living Felslate Sample
english.objectives: Bring the Living Felslate Sample to Mama Diggs in Dalaran.
english.description: Your miner's instinct is kicking in. Chunks of the infernal's corpse appear to be usable.$b$bStill, there must be a way to extract more ore from the demon's body. Perhaps your mining trainer in Dalaran will know how.
english.completion: This came from a blasted infernal? Look out, we've got $gmister:little miss; COMBAT miner, here!$b$bSome o' this ore seems to 'ave lost its shine on the trip back, however. Next time, make sure to cut out the sword and spell wounds before ye mine it.

text.title: 人性的牺牲
text.objectives: 让邪能工匠娜瑞莎将三块邪能页岩碎片嵌入你的身体。
text.description: 所谓开采邪能页岩，其实就是寻求恶魔之血。想要得到提升，就必须让自己部分恶魔化。$b$b为什么要变成这副模样？你自己说的：愿意做出牺牲。$b$b你很走运，我是这方面的专家。只要你相信我，我绝不会让你陷入危险。$b$b准备好了吗？

english.title: A Shred of Your Humanity
english.objectives: Allow Felsmith Nal'ryssa to place three shards of felslate in your body.
english.description: To mine for felslate is to seek the very blood of demons. To improve at it, you must become part demon yourself.$b$bWhy the dirty look? You said it yourself: you're willing to make sacrifices.$b$bLuckily for you, I'm an expert in this area. I won't put you in any danger, as long as you trust me.$b$bAre you ready?

objectiveDetails.description: 让邪能工匠娜瑞莎将邪能页岩嵌入你的身体

text.title: 黑心林地：娜瑞莎的姐姐
text.objectives: 前往黑心林地，找到莱瑞勒的玺戒。
text.description: 我不是家里唯一的矿工，我的三个姐姐曾经也是。$b$b我说“曾经”是因为她们都不在了。$b$b其中两位陷得太深，在身上嵌入了太多的邪能页岩，结果向萨格拉斯的意志所屈服。她们现在更像是恶魔，而不是精灵。$b$b至于三姐，我很久没有听到她的消息了。上一次听说她在调查黑心林地。$b$b我担心她可能以另一种方式走向了堕落。

english.title: Darkheart Thicket: Nal'ryssa's Sisters
english.objectives: Go to the Darkheart Thicket and find Lyrelle's Signet Ring.
english.description: I was not the only miner in my family. I was the youngest of four sisters.$b$bI say "was" because the other three are gone.$b$bTwo of them went too far. They overloaded their bodies with felslate and succumbed to the will of Sargeras. They are more demon than elf, now.$b$bThe third, I have not heard from in quite some time. The last I heard, she was investigating the Darkheart Thicket.$b$bI fear she may have fallen, too - one way or the other.

text.title: 琳蒂萨的眼球
text.objectives: 把埋在矿石里的眼球带给苏拉玛的邪能工匠娜瑞莎。
text.description: 邪能页岩矿脉里竟然有一颗人型生物的眼球。$b$b它不停地颤动，仿佛有生命一般。你有种感觉，如果它有眼睑的话，说不定会朝你眨眼。$b$b最好拿给采矿专家看看。

english.title: Rin'thissa's Eye
english.objectives: Bring the Ore-Bound Eye to Felsmith Nal'ryssa in Suramar.
english.description: Oddly enveloped within the felslate deposit is a humanoid eye.$b$bIt quivers with life. You get the sense that it would blink at you if it had an eyelid.$b$bA mining expert should take a look at this.

text.title: 莱瑞勒的右臂
text.objectives: 把断臂带给苏拉玛的邪能工匠娜瑞莎。
text.description: 你眨眨眼又揉揉眼，确定自己没有看错。这是一截女性的断臂，完全埋在了邪能页岩矿层里。$b$b它毫无血色，但是仍在抽搐，血管已经变成了绿色的脉络。$b$b邪能工匠娜瑞莎一定会想看看这个。

english.title: Lyrelle's Right Arm
english.objectives: Bring the Severed Arm to Felsmith Nal'ryssa in Suramar.
english.description: You blink and rub your eyes, but they do not deceive you. This is a woman's arm, completely enveloped within a felslate seam.$b$bThe arm is bloodless, but still twitches. Fel-colored streaks remain where veins once were.$b$bFelsmith Nal'ryssa will certainly want to see this.

text.title: 昂德里持续跳动的心
text.objectives: 把塞满矿石的心脏带给苏拉玛的邪能工匠娜瑞莎。
text.description: 这个乍看像是邪能页岩的东西其实是一个人型生物的心脏。它被岩石包裹着，里面的血液早已流干，被污秽的恶魔物质所取代。$b$b虽然是从恶魔体内挖出来的……但它好像不是恶魔的器官，反而更像是某种纪念品。幸好你的矿锄没有直接敲到它。$b$b邪能工匠娜瑞莎一定会想看看这个。

english.title: Ondri's Still-Beating Heart
english.objectives: Bring the Ore-Choked Heart to Felsmith Nal'ryssa in Suramar.
english.description: What at first looked like another chunk of felslate is, in fact, a humanoid heart, encrusted in rock and filled not with blood but a vile, demonic substance.$b$bIt does not appear to belong to the beast you carved it out of... it seems that the infernal was holding it like a keepsake. Luckily your mining pick didn't hit it straight on.$b$bFelsmith Nal'ryssa will want to see this.

text.title: 琳蒂萨
text.objectives: 召唤并打败琳蒂萨。
text.description: 你受到我妹妹娜瑞莎的影响了，对吗？$b$b那个懦弱的家伙连采矿的门都没摸着，她缺少追求进步的勇气。真理的来源只有一个，那就是伟大的邪能与烈焰之神。$b$b你想学习采矿的真理吗？那就前往苏拉玛的西北角，并呼唤我的名字：$b$b琳蒂萨。

english.title: Rin'thissa
english.objectives: Summon and defeat Rin'thissa.
english.description: My sister Nal'ryssa has her claws in you, doesn't she?$b$bThat weakling doesn't know the first thing about mining. She was always too afraid to take the leap. True knowledge comes only from the Great One, the God of Fel and Flame.$b$bYou want to truly learn how to mine? Come to Suramar's northwestern corner, and speak my name:$b$bRin'thissa.

text.title: 莱瑞勒
text.objectives: 召唤并打败莱瑞勒。
text.description: 看看你，矿工，还受限于逐渐腐朽的脆弱肉体。$b$b想要与这片土地的邪能矿石真正融合，就必须挣脱肉体的束缚，臣服于更黑暗的力量。$b$b加入我们，矿工。带着你弱不禁风的肉体前往邪魂堡垒，并呼唤我的名字：$b$b莱瑞勒。

english.title: Lyrelle
english.objectives: Summon and defeat Lyrelle.
english.description: Look at you, miner. Still held back by the limitations of your fragile, decaying flesh.$b$bTo truly become one with the demon-tinged rocks of these lands, you must shed your skin and submit to a darker power.$b$bJoin us, miner. Bring your feeble body to Felsoul Hold, and speak my name:$b$bLyrelle.

text.title: 昂德里
text.objectives: 召唤并打败昂德里。
text.description: 跟我比起来，你什么都不是。你以为自己内心坚定，经验丰富，甚至英勇果敢……真是可笑！$b$b你对我的经历一无所知。我所承受的折磨，付出的代价……一切都是为了实现我的心愿！$b$b没错，我跟你一样都是矿工。想知道我能教给你什么本事吗？那就前往苏拉玛的深红林地，并呼唤我的名字：$b$b昂德里。

english.title: Ondri
english.objectives: Summon and defeat Ondri.
english.description: You are nothing compared to me. You think yourself hardened, experienced... heroic, even. Hah!$b$bYou have no idea what I've been through. The tortures I've endured, the sacrifices I've made. All for the sake of my trade!$b$bYes, I'm a miner, just like you. Want to learn what I have to teach? Come to the Crimson Thicket in Suramar, and speak my name:$b$bOndri.

text.title: 地狱硫磺样本
text.objectives: 把地狱硫磺样本带给达拉然的迪格丝大妈。
text.description: 这块矿石简直臭气熏天——刺鼻的硫磺味中夹杂着糜烂尸体的腐臭味。$b$b这对某些人可能有用。$b$b或许达拉然的采矿训练师愿意接收它。

english.title: Infernal Brimstone Sample
english.objectives: Bring the Infernal Brimstone Sample to Mama Diggs in Dalaran.
english.description: This ore. Smells. Horrible. It combines the odor of sulfur with all the worst parts of a rotting corpse.$b$bSomeone will probably want it for something.$b$bMaybe your mining trainer in Dalaran will take it off of your hands.

text.title: 地狱硫磺分析
text.objectives: 前往冰冠堡垒、深岩之洲和暮光高地，从迪格丝大妈的学徒那里收集报告。
text.description: 想要开采地狱硫磺，我们得先了解这种矿石是怎么形成的。我有三位学徒正在世界各地研究不同的矿石。$b$b弗林·石心在深岩之洲，罗尔·兰德斯在暮光高地，库鲁尔·石角在冰冠冰川。去找他们，收集他们对当地矿石的研究报告。

english.title: Infernal Brimstone Analysis
english.objectives: Collect the reports from Mama Diggs' apprentices in Icecrown, Deepholm and Twilight Highlands.
english.description: In order to mine Infernal Brimstone, we first need to understand the way in which ore comes into being. I currently have three of my apprentices doing research on different ores around the world.$b$bFind Forinn Stoneheart in Deepholm, Rhol Landers in Twilight Highlands and Krul Rockhorn in Icecrown and collect any information they've gathered on the ore at those locations.

text.title: 巨熊肉
text.objectives: 在符文林地里狩猎贪吃的熊，并收集4块巨熊肉。
text.description:
亡者对生前能够享用的美食充满了渴望。对于维库国王来说，没有什么祭品比得上布卓恩哈塔——肥美的熊肉盛宴。 

符文林地的巨熊生养得很好，它们鲜嫩的肉质一直倍受好评。猎杀巨熊，并找到合适的肉来献给古代统治者。他们肯定抵挡不了这种美味的诱惑。
text.completion: These hearts are fat and bloody. $B$BThe slumbering rulers will not refuse an offering of Bjornharta.

english.title: Bjornharta
english.objectives: Collect 4 Engorged Bear Hearts from Voracious Bears in the Runewood.
english.description:
The afterlife leaves the dead hungry for the delicacies of their former lives. For the vrykul kings, none such offering is prized more than Bjornharta - a celebratory feast of an engorged bear heart. 

The bears of the Runewood eat well, and have long been prized for their tender meat. Hunt them and find a suitable heart of offer to the ancient rulers. They will not be able to resist such an offering.
english.completion: These hearts are fat and bloody. $B$BThe slumbering rulers will not refuse an offering of Bjornharta.

text.title: 美梦香薰
text.objectives: 在符文林地收集8个幽魂菇。
text.description:
一位外来者想寻求古代维库统治者的审判？这很有趣。我得提醒你：他们可不会对你笑脸相迎，陌生人。

如果你急着要面对审判，那么可以通过一个唤醒仪式来召唤他们。要完成这场仪式，你需要焚香并献上祭品。

符文林地里有一种合适的焚香植物，去找些回来，然后我会告诉你下一步怎么做。
text.completion: Yes, these Soulcaps should be adequate for your ritual. $B$BSpeak with me once you are ready to proceed and I will guide you further.

english.title: The Dreaming Fungus
english.objectives: Collect 8 Soulcaps in the Runewood.
english.description:
So an outsider would seek to be judged by the ancient rulers of the vrykul? Curious, this. Know that they will not take to your presence kindly, stranger.

If you are so hasty to meet judgment, you can call them forth with a ritual of wakening. To complete this ritual, you will require an aromatic to burn and an offering to present.

A plant grows in the Runewood that will make a suitable incense. Gather it, and I will instruct you further.
english.completion: Yes, these Soulcaps should be adequate for your ritual. $B$BSpeak with me once you are ready to proceed and I will guide you further.

text.title: 审判日
text.objectives: 获取古老维库统治者的审判。
text.description:
你目前为止的表现都相当出色，陌生人。我会兑现承诺，指导你进行唤醒仪式。

首先，你必须把祭品放在想要唤醒的统治者的坟墓上。然后焚香，让香气飘到坟墓周围。如果你献上了合适的祭品，统治者就会起身并宣布审判结果。

要小心，外来者。那些已故的维库国王们可不喜欢在安息之后还被打扰。
text.completion: Ashildir's grave has been disturbed, outsider. $B$BDo you know something of this?

english.title: Judgment Day
english.objectives: Receive judgment from the ancient vrykul rulers.
english.description:
You have proven resourceful thus far, stranger. As promised, I will instruct you on the ritual of wakening.

First, you must place the offering directly atop the grave of the ruler you wish to awaken. Burn the incense so that its aroma wafts over the grave. If your offering is adequate, the ruler will rise, and you may ask your judgment.

Take care, outsider. The dead vrykul kings will not enjoy being awakened from their slumber.
english.completion: Ashildir's grave has been disturbed, outsider. $B$BDo you know something of this?

objectiveDetails.description: 接受奥克泰尔·龙血的审判
接受神谕者莱萨斯的审判
接受“黑拳”海默尔的审判

text.title: 战前动员
text.objectives: 向你的伊利达雷队长们做简述，说明攻打火山内的燃烧军团的战略部署。
text.description:
就等着你向伊利达雷队长们下令了。燃烧军团最强力的部队就驻扎在火山里，蠢蠢欲动。

我们必须先发制人，迎头痛击。

消灭他们以后，我们就可以飞到指挥舰上去干掉蛛后泰兰娜并取得钥石。伊利丹大人一定会非常高兴。

english.title: Orders for Your Captains
english.objectives: Brief your Illidari captains on where to attack the Burning Legion within the volcano.
english.description:
All that is left is to deliver your orders to our Illidari captains. The mightiest of the Legion's forces have arrayed themselves within the volcano. But, they will not remain on the defensive for long.

We must strike first and we must strike hard.

Once we destroy them, we can fly up to the command ship, defeat Brood Queen Tyranna, and take the keystone for our own. Lord Illidan will be pleased.

objectiveDetails.description: 向主母玛沃伦丝做简述
向战争领主加尔顿做简述

text.title: 唤醒女武神
text.objectives: 使用重组符文让艾希迪尔的灵魂回到遗骨之中。
text.description:
我们打断仪式并找回了女王的遗骨，这下或许能够让艾希迪尔脱离骨语者的掌控。

这些秘法师在霍斯瓦尔德深处有一个特殊的祭坛，可以使死去战士的灵魂和肉体重新结合。我们或许可以用它让艾希迪尔的灵魂和遗骨合体，让女王脱离邪恶秘法师的束缚。

去吧，外来者。我会集结她的守卫。
text.completion: Where... where am I now? $B$BI... know you...

english.title: Waking the Shieldmaiden
english.objectives: Use the Rune of Reformation to return Ashildir's spirit to her bones.
english.description:
With the rituals disrupted and her bones returned, we may be able to wrest Ashildir from the grasp of these Bonespeakers.

Deeper within Haustvald, the mystics possess a special altar that can reunite the body and spirit of a fallen warrior. With this, we may be able to return Ashildir's spirit into her bones, and out of the grasp of these foul mystics.

Go outsider, I will rally her guard.
english.completion: Where... where am I now? $B$BI... know you...

text.title: 惩治骨语
text.objectives: 在霍斯瓦尔德击败15名维库人骨语者或他们的盟友。
text.description:
这些仪式执行者的罪行绝不能轻饶，但是他们所用的符文魔法对亡者有着难以言喻的力量，我们无法亲自惩治这些恶徒。

不过，你并非亡者，而且我能感受到你身上的强大力量。惩处这些异教徒，向艾希迪尔展现你的能力，赢得女王的恩典！
text.completion: Your glorious battle honors the Valkyra queen.

english.title: Breaking the Bonespeakers
english.objectives: Defeat 15 Bonespeaker vrykul or their allies in Haustvald.
english.description:
The crimes of these ritualists must not go unpunished, but we cannot be their executioners. The rune magic they practice grants them untold power over the dead.

You, however, are not dead, and I can sense great power from you. Take the fight to these heretics, and show Ashildir that you are truly worthy of her judgment!
english.completion: Your glorious battle honors the Valkyra queen.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭骨语者或者他们的盟友

text.title: 女王遗骨
text.objectives: 在霍斯瓦尔德找回8块艾希迪尔之骨。
text.description:
原来你想要寻求瓦尔基拉女王的审判？这肯定是你的错！

霍斯瓦尔德的骨语者犯下了暴行，并盗走了艾希迪尔之骨。他们一定是想利用遗骨阻止外来者完成试练！你绝不能让这种事发生！

到霍斯瓦尔德去找回她的遗骨吧。希望艾希迪尔心情不错，愿意饶过你的小命。
text.completion: The treachery of the Bonespeakers knows no limit. $B$BTheir rituals seek to sunder the very essence of our queen, but we will use their own magic to return her to us!

english.title: Regal Remains
english.objectives: Collect 8 Ashildir's Bones in Haustvald.
english.description:
So you seek the judgment of the queen of the Valkyra? This must be your fault!

The Bonespeakers of Haustvald have committed an atrocity and stolen Ashildir's bones. They must have done this to keep an outsider from completing the trials. You must not let this stand!

Enter Haustvald and retrieve her remains. I hope, for your sake, that Ashildir is in a forgiving mood.
english.completion: The treachery of the Bonespeakers knows no limit. $B$BTheir rituals seek to sunder the very essence of our queen, but we will use their own magic to return her to us!

text.title: 最后的审判
text.objectives: 在霍斯瓦尔德消灭符文先知法尔加。
text.description:
在灵魂分裂时，我看到一位英雄对斯瓦尔德的腐化秘法师施以正义的惩戒。我现在明白了，那位英雄就是你，$c。 

我知道你在寻求我的审判，但我的灵魂仍然处于分裂状态。此时此刻，符文先知法尔加正在召唤黑暗的禁忌魔法，企图将我的灵魂逐出风暴峡湾。如果让他得逞，你的试炼就会失败。

我和此地的连结正在消失。去吧，时间不多了！
text.completion: A cannot believe this fate... $B$BI am sorry, outsider, for I had underestimated Faljar's power.$B$BThat he could banish us here... is unthinkable.

english.title: The Final Judgment
english.objectives: Defeat Runeseer Faljar in Haustvald.
english.description:
In my fragmented state, I captured glimpses of a hero meting out justice to the corrupted mystics of Haustvald. I see now, this hero was you, $c. 

I know you seek my judgment, but my spirit is still fragmented. As we speak,  Runeseer Faljar is calling upon dark, forbidden magics in an attempt to banish my spirit to Helheim. If he succeeds, your trial will be lost.

My connection here is fading. Go, there is little time!
english.completion: A cannot believe this fate... $B$BI am sorry, outsider, for I had underestimated Faljar's power.$B$BThat he could banish us here... is unthinkable.

text.title: 大军压境
text.objectives: 在炼狱峰地区对蛛后之廷以及燃烧军团发起攻击。
text.description:
没错，必须消灭那些灭绝者，而且我们要做的事情还有很多。

现在处境困难，我们全靠你了。蛛后的一些主要首领控制着火山，所以必须消灭他们。我们必须铲除燃烧军团，并且尽一切努力去获得最终的胜利。

english.title: Their Numbers Are Legion
english.objectives: Wage war upon the Brood Queen's Court and the Burning Legion within the greater Inferno Peak area.
english.description:
Yes, those devastators must be silenced, but there's also a great deal more to be done.

Despite the odds, we're counting on you. The Brood Queen's primary leaders are in control of the volcano. They must be killed. We must smash the Legion and do anything else necessary to achieve absolute victory.

objectiveDetails.description: 摧毁第一个堡垒稳定器
摧毁第一个灵魂收割器

text.title: 缚魂符文
text.objectives: 在霍斯瓦尔德摧毁仪式石，阻止束缚艾希迪尔灵魂的仪式。
text.description:
这块石板上记载着一个仪式，可以把强大的灵魂分裂成碎片并束缚在特殊的符文石中。看来骨语者会用这个仪式来削弱艾希迪尔的灵魂。

如果她的灵魂被削弱了，可能就无法将她召唤出来。必须阻止仪式。
text.completion: These mystics have gone to great lengths to weaken Ashildir. $B$BWe must hope that her spirit is strong enough for the wakening.

english.title: The Runes that Bind
english.objectives: Destroy the Ritual Stones to stop the rituals binding Ashildir's spirit in Haustvald.
english.description:
The stone tablet here describes a ritual where a powerful spirit can be broken into weaker pieces by binding them to special runestones. It looks like the Bonespeakers may be using this very ritual to weaken the spirit of Ashildir.

It may be impossible to summon her with her spirit so weakened. The rituals must be stopped.
english.completion: These mystics have gone to great lengths to weaken Ashildir. $B$BWe must hope that her spirit is strong enough for the wakening.

text.title: 邪钢的艺术
text.objectives: 在穆林·铁角的帮助下锻造一块邪钢锭。
text.description: 普天之下，只有像苍穹石这样的少数铁砧才能承受邪钢锻造的捶打强压。$b$b过来，我教你怎么做。$b$b两份魔石，一份邪能页岩。不加热，不回火，全靠力量和技巧。$b$b试试吧，我会为你指导。

english.title: The Art of Demonsteel
english.objectives: Work with Muirn Ironhorn to craft a Demonsteel Bar.
english.description: The Firmament Stone is one of the few anvils beneath the sky that can tolerate the hammer strikes necessary to craft demonsteel.$b$bHere, I will show you.$b$bTwo parts leystone, one part felslate. No heat, no tempering, just pure strength and finesse.$b$bTry it. I will coach you.

text.title: 投身战场
text.objectives: 在伊利达雷哨所与恶魔猎手的首领谈一谈。
text.description:
燃烧军团在这里打败了我们，还有伊利达雷。看来恶魔猎手们正在独力坚守阵线，但是只能勉强支撑。

来吧，让你的武器发挥作用。在你痛击燃烧军团的时候，我会想出下一步行动。
text.completion:
The two of you are a welcome sight. We pushed the demons out of these ruins, but they are stronger than any we have encountered before.

Your help is appreciated. If we do not crush this Legion invasion now, they will overrun Azsuna and then the rest of the Broken Isles.

english.title: Into the Fray
english.objectives: Speak with the lead demon hunter at Illidari Stand.
english.description:
The Burning Legion has beaten us here, but so too have the Illidari. It looks like the demon hunters are holding their own, but just barely.

Come, let's put that weapon of yours to use. I'll figure out our next move while you crush the Legion.
english.completion:
The two of you are a welcome sight. We pushed the demons out of these ruins, but they are stronger than any we have encountered before.

Your help is appreciated. If we do not crush this Legion invasion now, they will overrun Azsuna and then the rest of the Broken Isles.

text.title: Done with Waiting
text.objectives: Travel to the southern cliffs of Val'sharah and speak to Makra Knifewhisper.
text.description: Mom got a message and said blood called for blood. She told me to wait here while she went out, but it's been two weeks since then. I'm tired of waiting.$B$BI'll stay home if you go find her. She said she was going to the cliffs far to the south.

english.title: Done with Waiting
english.objectives: Travel to the southern cliffs of Val'sharah and speak to Makra Knifewhisper.
english.description: Mom got a message and said blood called for blood. She told me to wait here while she went out, but it's been two weeks since then. I'm tired of waiting.$B$BI'll stay home if you go find her. She said she was going to the cliffs far to the south.

text.title: Fishy Business
text.objectives: Kill 3 Murktide Wavecallers on the southern coast of Val'sharah.

text.title: 帮沙考尔先生办件事
text.objectives: 救出克里夫·雷山、文雅的洛什和绿皮格蕾丝。
text.description:
你好，$c。我叫瑟斯卡。我是一个……贸易公司的代表。如你所见，我被海巨人和他们的纳迦盟友俘虏了。

我有三个同事也在考察洞窟的时候遭到了俘虏。我敢肯定，如果你能救出他们，我的雇主沙考尔先生会非常感激的。
text.completion:
Excellent, my good $g sir:lady;. I cannot thank you enough for the freedom of my people. Rosh is especially appreciative.

<Gentle Rosh grunts.>

Perhaps you and I can do some more business together.

english.title: A Favor for Mr. Shackle
english.objectives: Free Cleave Thunderhill, Gentle Rosh, and Grace the Green.
english.description:
Throm'ka, $c. My name is Seska. I represent a... trading company. As you can see, I've fallen victim to these giants and their naga allies.

Three of my associates were also captured while surveying this cove. I'm certain that my employer, Mr. Shackle, would be most grateful if you could procure their release.
english.completion:
Excellent, my good $g sir:lady;. I cannot thank you enough for the freedom of my people. Rosh is especially appreciative.

<Gentle Rosh grunts.>

Perhaps you and I can do some more business together.

text.title: 行窃蓟叶
text.objectives: 在月翼浅滩收集$1oa枚失窃的月翼龙蛋。
text.description: 虽然不清楚蓟叶为什么会收集月翼龙蛋，但绝对不会是想给小龙一个温暖的家。$b$b赛兰娜·河风知道该怎么处理这些龙蛋。

english.title: Thieving Thistleleaf
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Stolen Lunarwing Eggs in the Lunarwing Shallows.
english.description: Why the Thistleleaf are collecting the Lunarwing eggs is anyone's guess, but you can be sure it's not to give them a loving home.$b$bSaylanna Riverbreeze will know what to do with these.

english.title: Assault on the Ruins of Kra'nak
Assault on the Ruins of Kra'nak

text.title: 黑暗女王的密令
text.objectives: 到惊魂港去见纳萨诺斯·凋零者。
text.description:
呃，这些家伙是友军吗？他们不想吃掉公爵夫人，我想这应该是个好现象……暂时。

不管如何，我带来了命令。希尔瓦娜斯曾派遣黑暗游侠登上湮灭号执行秘密任务，纳萨诺斯赶上他们了。不幸的是，联盟听到了风声。现在，格雷迈恩正在攻打我们的岗哨！

我们非常需要你的帮助，$n。公爵夫人可以带你过去，准备好就告诉我。

english.title: The Dark Lady's Bidding
english.objectives: Meet with Nathanos Blightcaller in Dreadwake's Landing.
english.description:
Uh, are these guys friendlies? I guess it's a good sign they haven't tried to eat Duchess... yet.

Anyway, I have orders. Nathanos caught up with the dark rangers, who were sent forward aboard the Oblivion on a secret mission from Lady Sylvanas herself! Unfortunately the Alliance caught wind of our plan, and now Greymane is attacking the outpost!

We could really use you over there, $n. Duchess can take you there, just give me the word.

text.title: 横扫甲板！
text.objectives: 使用被遗忘者投石车进行4次发射，攻击格雷迈恩先遣营地。
text.description:
我们在斯考德-艾希尔的任务必须往后推了，$c。现在我们有更紧迫的事情要处理。

我才跟突击增援部队一块抵达，格雷迈恩的军舰就驶入了港口，开始轰炸城墙。我们部署了战斗器械，但是他们的地面部队很快就控制住了战局。

如果你能到投石车那里去，用它们消灭操作大炮的敌人，就可以为我们争取到足够的空隙，让我们推进战线！

english.title: Clear the Deck!
english.objectives: Fire 4 Forsaken Catapults in Greymane's Offensive.
english.description:
Our mission in Skold-Ashil will have to wait, $c - for now, we have more pressing matters to attend to.

I had just recently arrived with reinforcements for our assault when Greymane's ship sailed in and began barraging our walls. We deployed our siege weapons, but their ground forces quickly overwhelmed us.

If you can get to those catapults and take out the dogs manning the cannons, it may give us the window we need to push the attack!

text.title: 突袭邪能熔炉
text.objectives: 突袭塔纳安丛林铁城港的钢铁部落援军。
text.description:
钢铁部落仍在从德拉诺各地调派援军以增援地狱火堡垒的防御力量。假如无法切断他们的补给线，我们在塔纳安的计划就会失去控制。

对铁城港的补给线进行一次战略打击应能使钢铁部落疲于防守，让我们能够维持住目前的成果。

english.title: Assault on the Fel Forge
english.objectives: Assault the Iron Horde reinforcements at Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description:
The Iron Horde continue to bring in reinforcements from all over Draenor to reinforce their position at Hellfire Citadel. If we don't cut off the flow of supplies then we risk losing control of our plans in Tanaan.

A strategic attack to the supply lines at Ironhold Harbor is just the thing to keep the Iron Horde on the defensive and maintain our momentum.

text.title: 突袭邪能熔炉
text.objectives: 突袭塔纳安丛林铁城港的钢铁部落援军。
text.description:
钢铁部落仍在从德拉诺各地调派援军以增援地狱火堡垒的防御力量。假如无法切断他们的补给线，我们在塔纳安的计划就会失去控制。
