text.title: 盾牌的秘密
text.objectives: 在斯考德-艾希尔检查6面雕饰维库盾牌。
text.description:
我们的目标就在宝库里，$c。我没时间解释清楚，你只要知道，我们的成功对于被遗忘者来说至关重要。

虽然女武神们对此处展开了严密的防守，但是我觉得应该会有其他的进入办法。她们当中有少数被选上的人能被允许进入宝库，我要你去查明那是怎么办到的。

我在城里看过一些雕刻着复杂纹饰的盾牌，应该是那些被选中的人流传下来的。它们所描绘的内容可能是我们进入宝库的关键。

english.title: Shielded Secrets
english.objectives: Examine 6 Engraved Vrykul Shields in Skold-Ashil.
english.description:
Our goal lies within that vault, $c. I don't have time to explain in detail - just know that it is vital to the Forsaken that we succeed.

The shieldmaidens have proven tenacious in their defense, but I believe there may be another way in. A chosen few of their order are allowed entrance, and I need you to find out how.

In the town I have seen intricately engraved shields which I believe are passed down from these champions. The scenes they depict may be the key to passing into the vault.

text.title: 亡灵新生
text.objectives: 跟随希尔瓦娜斯进入艾尔的宝库。
text.description:
你总能带来惊喜，$n。有了瓦尔基拉女王的祝福，你开启了一条能够重塑艾泽拉斯命运的道路。

我邀请你来见证——今天，被遗忘者迎来了崭新的黎明！

english.title: A New Life for Undeath
english.objectives: Follow Sylvanas into the Vault of Eyir.
english.description:
It seems that you are full of surprises, $n. With the blessing of the Valkyra queen, you have opened a path that will shape the destiny of Azeroth.

I invite you to bear witness, for today a new day dawns on the Forsaken!

text.title: 至高岭牛头人
text.objectives: 到至高岭去找罗诺斯·铁角。
text.description: 你为我带来了一些值得一见的岩石，$n。如果你有兴趣的话，我有一个特别的任务要交给你。$b$b听说至高岭上的牛头人精通采矿技术。虽然我不知道他们有没有我们这样的才能，不过他们开采魔石的时间比我们更久。$b$b去拜访他们，学习他们的长处。
text.completion: You are indeed a miner. You have the look of it. There is ore in your blood.

english.title: The Highmountain Tauren
english.objectives: Report to Ronos Ironhorn in Highmountain.
english.description: Ye've brought me a bit of interesting rocks to look at, $n. I've got a special assignment for ye, if ye're up for it.$b$bI hear stories about these tauren, up in Highmountain, who claim mastery over minin'. I don't know if they're as talented as you or me, but they've been minin' leystone longer.$b$bPay 'em a visit. See what they have to say.
english.completion: You are indeed a miner. You have the look of it. There is ore in your blood.

text.title: 收养小可爱
text.completion: You kneel down and hold out a hand. The baby bear sniffs at your fingers, looking up at you trustingly.$b$bThis bear cub is too little to fend for itself. Will you take it with you on your travels?

english.completion: You kneel down and hold out a hand. The baby bear sniffs at your fingers, looking up at you trustingly.$b$bThis bear cub is too little to fend for itself. Will you take it with you on your travels?

text.title: Not Dead Yet!
text.objectives: Use the Nitro-Electric Jumpstarter to resurrect 5 Gadgetzan Bruisers.
text.description: They're not dead yet! A little nitro here, a jolt of electricity there... we can bring 'em back! And then, they can pay me! Whaddya say, $n? Wanna go into business with me?

english.title: Not Dead Yet!
english.objectives: Use the Nitro-Electric Jumpstarter to resurrect 5 Gadgetzan Bruisers.
english.description: They're not dead yet! A little nitro here, a jolt of electricity there... we can bring 'em back! And then, they can pay me! Whaddya say, $n? Wanna go into business with me?

text.title: Scouting Report
text.objectives: Find Goblin Intel from any Steamwheedle Scout in Tanaris.
text.description:
We were supposed to meet back here, and then sneak back to Gatgetzan. That was hours ago, $n! The others fanned out across all of Tanaris to gather intel.

Anything you can find will help in the defense of Gadgetzan. Keep your eyes open, $n!

text.objectives: Kill 15 Legion Invaders while piloting a vehicle during a Tanaris invasion.
text.description:
A piece of paper is tacked to the controls. On it is a tally of demons slain by the previous pilot.

Your ego demands satisfaciton.

text.title: 邪能工匠
text.objectives: 前往苏拉玛，向邪能工匠娜瑞莎报到。
text.description: 你处理邪能页岩的本事挺不错，$g小伙子:小姑娘;。你最好去找比我更了解这些东西的师傅进修。$b$b伊利达雷一向是恶魔方面的专家，我听说他们有些矿工已经前往苏拉玛，在恶魔出没的地区开了店。$b$b去拜访他们，学习他们的长处。

english.title: The Felsmiths
english.objectives: Report to Felsmith Nal'ryssa in Suramar.
english.description: Ye have a knack with this felslate, $glad:lass;. Best ship ye off to someone who knows the stuff better than I.$b$bThe Illidari have a knack with all things demonic, really, and I've heard about a few miners who've set up shop out near the demons in Suramar.$b$bPay 'em a visit. See what they have to teach ye.

text.title: 7.0 Val'sharah - Bluffs - Vignette: Nightcaller - Interaction - TRACKING - twh

english.title: 7.0 Val'sharah - Bluffs - Vignette: Nightcaller - Interaction - TRACKING - twh

text.title: 重返破碎海滩
text.objectives: 搭乘萨鲁法尔的备用坐骑前往破碎海滩，与他并肩作战以重获荣耀。
text.description: 别害怕，$n。我虽然满腔愤恨，不过我不会让自己白白送命。$b$b我们要飞过去找到一个理想的进攻地点。恶魔们还沉浸在胜利当中，让我们以迅雷不及掩耳之势结束他们的狂欢！$b$b搭乘我的备用坐骑，跟我一起飞往破碎海滩。我们将在那里为战死的同胞找回荣耀。

english.title: Return to the Broken Shore
english.objectives: Take Saurfang's spare mount to the Broken Shore and fight alongside him to restore your honor.
english.description: Fear not, $n. I'm angry, but I don't chase my own death.$b$bWe will fly in and scout the ideal point of attack. The demons are still drunk on their victory, but we will put a swift end to their revelry!$b$bTake my spare mount and we will fly to the Broken Shore. There we will bring honor to our dead.

objectiveDetails.description: 在破碎海滩证明你的勇气

text.title: 圣锤守护者
text.objectives: 前往至高岭的雷霆图腾找梅拉·高岭。
text.description: 高岭诸族本来是准备与你们结盟的。我们知道燃烧军团已经将战火燃烧到了这里。$b$b但是，我们遭到了自己人的背叛，所以现在只能向你求助。$b$b我们的圣物，卡兹格罗斯之锤，被邪恶的卓格巴尔偷走了。$b$b我们需要你帮忙夺回圣锤。
text.completion: I know you seek the Pillar of Creation but I am sad to say it was one of many things we lost today.

english.title: Keepers of the Hammer
english.objectives: Meet Mayla Highmountain at Thunder Totem in Highmountain.
english.description: The Highmountain Tribes had intended to pledge our allegiance to your forces. We know war has come with the Burning Legion.$b$bHowever, we have been betrayed from within and must now ask for your aid.$b$bA great relic, the Hammer of Khaz'goroth, was stolen from our people by the vile drogbar.$b$bWe need your help in recovering it.
english.completion: I know you seek the Pillar of Creation but I am sad to say it was one of many things we lost today.

objectiveDetails.description: 在雷霆图腾与武士奥罗见面
飞往至高岭的雷霆图腾

text.title: 前往高地
text.objectives: 把洁儿·河鬃带到雷霆图腾。
text.description: 达古尔大肆袭击河鬃是有原因的。这片地区的补给来自他们的牧场和农庄。$b$b麻烦你帮助洁儿前往雷霆图腾。运气好的话，梅拉会派增援到这里。$b$b我们会在这里集结幸存者，然后尽快赶上。
text.completion: Riverbend was... destroyed? That disgusting beast Dargrul! I will not stop until I see him dead.$b$bBut we cannot do that with the army we have.$b$bWe need help from the other tribes.

english.title: Get to High Ground
english.objectives: Bring Jale Rivermane to Thunder Totem.
english.description: It is no accident that Dargrul attacked the Rivermane in force. It is their farms and their pastures that supply food for the region.$b$bPlease, get Jale to Thunder Totem. With luck, Mayla will have reinforcements to send to the area.$b$bWe will rally the survivors here and follow as quickly as we can.
english.completion: Riverbend was... destroyed? That disgusting beast Dargrul! I will not stop until I see him dead.$b$bBut we cannot do that with the army we have.$b$bWe need help from the other tribes.

objectiveDetails.description: 跟着洁儿去见梅拉·高岭
把洁儿·河鬃带到雷霆图腾

text.title: 恶鹏对雄鹰
text.objectives: 解救$1oa只被捕获的巨鹰。
text.description: 紫喉女王教会她的女巫们如何诅咒我们挚爱的巨鹰，让它们变成不断袭击山谷的邪恶大鹏。$b$b诅咒一旦被成功施展，就无法被破除。$b$b我们将在空中对抗这些大鹏，但是地面上的问题还需要你的帮忙。$b$b往北穿过黑羽谷，解救你能找到的任何巨鹰。$b$b多解救一只巨鹰，就少一只变成非杀不可的大鹏。
text.completion: Your bravery has returned to us some of our fine feathered friends. Well done.$b$bNow how do you feel about a frontal assault?

english.title: Rocs vs Eagles
english.objectives: Save $1oa Captive Great Eagles.
english.description: High Crawliac has taught her witches how to curse our beloved eagles into the vile rocs you see assaulting the valley.$b$bThere is no way to break this curse once it has taken hold.$b$bWe will take to the skies and do battle with the rocs, but we need your help on the ground.$b$bHead north through Darkfeather Valley and release any eagles that you find.$b$bEvery eagle you save is one less roc we must kill later.
english.completion: Your bravery has returned to us some of our fine feathered friends. Well done.$b$bNow how do you feel about a frontal assault?

text.title: 河鬃部族
text.objectives: 前往大地母亲之赐，与洁儿·河鬃见面。
text.description:
我没有时间详细说明这里的情况。简单来说，野蛮的卓格巴尔发动了袭击，他们夺走了卡兹格罗斯之锤，我们的部族四散奔逃。

现在，卓格巴尔正在洗劫河鬃部族，但是我们残存的力量完全不足以提供增援。

我们需要一位英雄。拜托你，前往大地母亲之赐，尽可能提供帮助。
text.completion: Mayla was still able to send help? I could hug that child.$b$bWelcome, outsider. I am Jale Rivermane, Chieftain of the Rivermane tribe. And we could really use your help.

english.title: The Rivermane Tribe
english.objectives: Meet Jale Rivermane at Earthmother's Bounty.
english.description:
What has happened here requires more time than I have to explain. In short, our tribes have scattered in the wake of the attack that left the Hammer of Khaz'goroth in the hands of the barbaric drogbar.

Even now the drogbar are raiding the Rivermane tribe, and I have too few braves left to send to their aid. 

We need a hero. Please, go to Earthmother's Bounty and lend what aid you can.
english.completion: Mayla was still able to send help? I could hug that child.$b$bWelcome, outsider. I am Jale Rivermane, Chieftain of the Rivermane tribe. And we could really use your help.

text.title: 鲜血图腾部族
text.objectives: 到末路崖去找奥金·铁牛。
text.description:
鲜血图腾由图鲁克所领导，虽然这位脾气火爆的牛头人酋长一向提防外来者，但是他对我们非常有用。相信你已经见过他们部族的使者——奥金·铁牛——你在河湾救过他。

你也许能利用这段关系重新拉拢鲜血图腾。如果想打败卓格巴尔并夺回卡兹格罗斯之锤，那么至高岭就少不了他们。请多加小心，$n。
text.completion: Outsider, you are one of few from beyond Highmountain who has made it into these woods alive. With me vouching for you, the Bloodtotem have been given a no-kill order by Torok.

english.title: The Bloodtotem Tribe
english.objectives: Meet Oakin Ironbull at Cliff's Edge.
english.description:
The Bloodtotem are led by Torok, a volatile but useful tauren chieftain. He is wary of outsiders, but I believe you have already met an emissary to their tribe--Oakin Ironbull--whom you rescued at Riverbend.

Use that small thread and you may be able to bring the Bloodtotem back into the fold. Highmountain needs them if we are to defeat the drogbar and reclaim the Hammer of Khaz'goroth. Be on your guard, $n.
english.completion: Outsider, you are one of few from beyond Highmountain who has made it into these woods alive. With me vouching for you, the Bloodtotem have been given a no-kill order by Torok.

text.title: 天角部族
text.objectives: 在苍穹之角与拉善·天角见面。
text.description: 天角牛头人是举世闻名的探路者和猎手。$b$b他们是一个骄傲的部族，但应该听得进道理。$b$b如果觉得路途危险的话，至高岭任何一个飞行管理员都能带你飞去那儿。$b$b$p，请你去找到他们的领袖拉善，告诉他我们应该是团结一致的高岭部族。
text.completion: Ha ha! And what are you, tiny creature? Have you come to battle us or join us in battle?

english.title: The Skyhorn Tribe
english.objectives: Meet Lasan Skyhorn at Skyhorn.
english.description: The Skyhorn people are some of the greatest pathfinders and hunters this world has ever known.$b$bThey are a proud people, but should be willing to listen to reason.$b$bIf the roads feel unsafe, you may ask any flight master in Highmountain to fly you there.$b$bPlease, $p, go to their leader Lasan and remind him that only together, we are Highmountain.
english.completion: Ha ha! And what are you, tiny creature? Have you come to battle us or join us in battle?

text.title: 雪盲台地之战
text.objectives: 前往雪盲台地。
text.description: 你来得正好。根据我们在雪盲台地的部队报告，地底之王已经开始在地面上活动。$b$b据说他的护卫并不多，而且他还携带着圣锤。多亏了你的努力，我们终于可以和他们交战。$b$b跟我们在雪盲台地会合，共同对抗地底之王。
text.completion: That... is a lot of drogbar.
text.completed: 在雪盲台地与梅拉·高岭谈一谈。

english.title: Battle of Snowblind Mesa
english.objectives: Journey to Snowblind Mesa.
english.description: Your timing is fortunate. Our forces at Snowblind Mesa report seeing the Underking above ground.$b$bWhat is more, he is lightly guarded, and has the hammer with him. Thanks to your efforts, we can meet them in battle.$b$bMeet us at Snowblind Mesa and let us take the fight to Dargrul together.
english.completion: That... is a lot of drogbar.
english.completed: Speak with Mayla Highmountain at Snowblind Mesa.

text.title: 至高岭的秘密
text.objectives: 在雷霆图腾南边的峭壁与灵魂行者黑角见面。
text.description: 梅拉的父亲乌兰是我们的上一任大酋长。他为了阻止地底之王抢走卡兹格罗斯之锤而惨遭杀害。$b$b我看着梅拉长大，我可以告诉你，她具备足够的勇气和力量，可以接下大酋长的重任。$b$b她只需要我们帮助她认识自己。$b$b你可以到南边峭壁的城市入口处和我们碰头吗？有一个仪式可以起到帮助，不过我们需要你帮忙完成。
text.completion: Ah, thank you for coming. Mayla is as stubborn as her father if not more so.
text.completed: 在雷霆图腾南边的峭壁与灵魂行者黑角见面。

english.title: Secrets of Highmountain
english.objectives: Meet Spiritwalker Ebonhorn at the southern bluff of Thunder Totem.
english.description: Mayla's father, Ulan, was our last high chieftain. He was slain trying to stop the Underking from seizing the Hammer of Khaz'goroth.$b$bI have watched Mayla all her life and can tell you she has both the courage and the strength to wear the mantle of High Chieftain.$b$bShe needs only our help to realize it herself.$b$bWill you meet us at the city entrance along the southern bluff? There is a ritual that might help, but we will need your aid to survive it.
english.completion: Ah, thank you for coming. Mayla is as stubborn as her father if not more so.
english.completed: Meet Spiritwalker Ebonhorn at the southern bluff of Thunder Totem.

text.title: 小毛
text.objectives: 在燃皮林地与小毛谈一谈。
text.description: 陌生人，我恳求你！我那些原本爱好和平的兄弟们受到了诅咒，充斥着永无止尽的愤怒。$B$B我和侄子试图离开，这违抗了酋长的意愿。氏族的人们从我手中抓走了他。如果我没逃出来，肯定早被他们撕成了碎片。$B$B他被困在村子里，只怕他的情况比我想象的更糟。$B$B伟大的$c，请你救救他吧。我年老体衰，实在无能为力。
text.completion: Uncle?

english.title: Littlefur
english.objectives: Speak to Littlefur at Smolderhide Thicket.
english.description: Stranger, I beseech you! My once peaceful brethren are now cursed with insatiable wrath.$B$BMy nephew and I tried to leave against the Chieftain's wishes. The clan wrested him from me, and would have torn me apart if I did not flee.$B$BHe is trapped in the village, and I fear the worst.$B$BGreat $c, please save him. I am too old and too weak to do it myself.
english.completion: Uncle?

text.title: 称霸阿什兰
text.objectives: 在阿什兰的事件地点击败敌方阵营，并在其基地内击杀对方首领。
text.description: 联盟拒绝从阿什兰撤退。告诉他们，部落绝不会袖手旁观，眼看他们掠夺古代食人魔帝国的力量为他们所用的。
text.giverWindow: 大元帅泰布雷德是联盟在阿什兰部队的领袖。

english.title: Ashran Dominance
english.objectives: Defeat the enemy faction at the event locations in Ashran and slay their leader within their base.
english.description: The Alliance refuse to back down in Ashran. Teach them that the Horde will not stand aside while they plunder the power of the ancient ogre empire to use for their own schemes.
english.giverWindow: Grand Marshal Tremblade leads the Alliance forces in Ashran.

text.title: 维护霸权
text.objectives: 在阿什兰的事件地点击败联盟，并击杀大元帅泰布雷德。
text.description: 联盟拒绝从阿什兰撤退。告诉他们，部落绝不会袖手旁观，眼看他们掠夺古代食人魔帝国的力量为他们所用的。
text.giverWindow: 大元帅泰布雷德是联盟在阿什兰部队的领袖。

english.title: Continue the Domination
english.objectives: Defeat the Alliance at the event locations in Ashran and kill Grand Marshal Tremblade.
english.description: The Alliance refuse to back down in Ashran. Teach them that the Horde will not stand aside while they plunder the power of the ancient ogre empire to use for their own schemes.
english.giverWindow: Grand Marshal Tremblade leads the Alliance forces in Ashran.

text.title: 称霸阿什兰
text.objectives: 在阿什兰的事件地点击败敌方阵营，并在其基地内击杀对方首领。
text.description: 正像我们担心的一样，部落打算通过在这座岛上烧杀抢掠巩固他们的位置，和我们担心的一样。去给他们点颜色看看，让他们知道联盟绝不会姑息他们的侵略！
text.giverWindow: 沃拉斯是部落在阿什兰部队的领袖。

english.title: Ashran Dominance
english.objectives: Defeat the enemy faction at the event locations in Ashran and slay their leader within their base.
english.description: As we feared the Horde are trying to consolidate their position here on the island by looting it, just like we feared. Get out there and show them the Alliance won't put up with their aggression.
english.giverWindow: Volrath leads the Horde forces in Ashran.

text.title: Continue the Domination
text.objectives: Defeat the Horde at all event locations in Ashran and kill High Warlord Volrath.
text.description: As we feared the Horde are trying to consolidate their position here on the island by looting it, just like we feared. Get out there and show them the Alliance won't put up with their aggression.
text.giverWindow: Volrath leads the Horde forces in Ashran.

english.objectives: Defeat the Horde at all event locations in Ashran and kill High Warlord Volrath.
english.description: As we feared the Horde are trying to consolidate their position here on the island by looting it, just like we feared. Get out there and show them the Alliance won't put up with their aggression.
english.giverWindow: Volrath leads the Horde forces in Ashran.

text.title: 坚韧不拔
text.objectives: 赢得3场评级战场的比赛。
text.description: 在战场上击败你的对手，你会得到嘉奖的。

english.title: Battle Hardened
english.objectives: Win 3 Rated Battleground matches.
english.description: Defeat your opponents on the battlefield and you will be rewarded.

text.description: 在战场上击败你的对手，你会得到嘉奖的。

english.title: Battle Hardened
english.objectives: Win 3 Rated Battleground matches.
english.description: Defeat your opponents on the battlefield and you will be rewarded.

text.title: 装备图纸：舱底水泵
text.objectives: 把图纸交给你要塞船坞中的海军装备专家。
text.description: 这些图纸上画的似乎是某种海军装备。我们应该把它带回到船坞去，看有没有人能够读懂。

english.title: Equipment Blueprint: Bilge Pump
english.objectives: Return the blueprints to a Naval Equipment Specialist at your garrison shipyard.
english.description: This appears to be a blueprint for some sort of naval equipment.  We should take it back to our Shipyard and see if someone can decipher it.

text.title: 运筹帷幄
text.objectives: 与格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵谈一谈。
text.description: 我认为，我们已经准备好……重新让破碎群岛的燃烧军团见识我们的力量。$B$B格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵自愿协调部队在岛上的部署工作。我建议你立刻跟他谈谈，大领主。
text.completion: Now is the time to strike back against the Legion.

english.title: Logistical Matters
english.objectives: Speak to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker.
english.description: I think we are ready to... reintroduce ourselves to the Legion on the Broken Isles.$B$BLord Grayson Shadowbreaker has volunteered to help coordinate our forces on the ground. You should speak with him immediately, Highlord.
english.completion: Now is the time to strike back against the Legion.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 希拉斯的秘密宝箱
text.objectives: 找到希拉斯的秘密宝箱。
text.description:
暗月大奖等你拿，小心对手耍犴猾。

传单不是开玩笑，要寻线索背面找。

english.title: Silas' Secret Stash
english.objectives: Find Silas' Secret Stash.
english.description:
A great Darkmoon prize do you now seek, but be ye warned, it is not for the meek.

Your very first clue to send you on this caper, you will find printed on the back of this paper.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到希拉斯的秘密宝箱

text.title: 他姓……风暴烈酒
text.objectives: 去四风谷的雷脚农场和陈·风暴烈酒谈一谈。
text.description: 这附近有个传说，有一位非同寻常的熊猫人武僧，他的力量无人能敌，只有他的酒量能与之相媲美。$b$b他正和他年轻的侄女一起旅行，但这位晚辈口无遮拦给他惹了不少麻烦。$b$b当地人传言他正前往四风谷。你应该去见见他！不过……要小心他的右钩拳。

english.title: His Name Was... Stormstout
english.objectives: Speak with Chen Stormstout at the Thunderfoot Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: The land is ripe with rumors of an unusual pandaren monk whose power was matched only for his appetite for brew.$b$bHe was traveling with his young niece who's mouth seems to get them into a lot of trouble.$b$bThe locals say these two were headed to the Valley of the Four Winds. You should meet him! Just... watch out for that right hook.

text.title: 昆莱之路
text.objectives: 穿过雾纱栈道并抵达滨岸村。
text.description: 游学者周卓送来了消息，你的几位伙伴在翡翠林的冲突中活了下来，已经到达了昆莱山寻求治疗。$b$b他们需要你的帮助！$b$b要想到昆莱山去，你必须前往四风谷，在西北方边境的雾纱栈道找到高地之路的土地精。$b$b他们会领你走完剩下的路的。

english.title: The Road to Kun-Lai
english.objectives: Travel through the Veiled Stair to Binan Village.
english.description: Lorewalker Cho has sent word that several of your companions survived the conflict in the Jade Forest and have been moved to Kun-Lai Summit to seek healing.$b$bThey need your help if they are to survive!$b$bTo reach Kun-Lai Summit, travel to the Valley of Four Winds and look for the High Road Grummle that can be found at the base of the Veiled Stair along the North-western border.$b$bThey can guide you the rest of the way.

text.title: Unused - Wraith Zapper
text.objectives: Zap 7 Wraiths near the haunted manor on the hill in western Bradensbrook.
text.description: I came here to exorcise the manor. Unfortunately it's haunted by a wizard, and he's summoned quite a few wraiths to bolster his power.$B$BI'm no match for them, but perhaps you are. My gun can harvest the wraiths' ectoplasmic energy. Then we can turn it against him.$B$BBy my estimates, you'll need to zap 7 wraiths before the gun is fully charged. Here, take it.
text.completed: Return to Wilhelmina Eckrdige in Bradensbrook.

english.objectives: Zap 7 Wraiths near the haunted manor on the hill in western Bradensbrook.

Unfortunately it's haunted by a wizard, and he's summoned quite a few wraiths to bolster his power.$B$BI'm no match for them, but perhaps you are. My gun can harvest the wraiths' ectoplasmic energy. Then we can turn it against him.$B$BBy my estimates, you'll need to zap 7 wraiths before the gun is fully charged. Here, take it.
english.completed: Return to Wilhelmina Eckrdige in Bradensbrook.

text.objectives: Investigate the Shivering Ashmaw Cub in southern Val'sharah.
text.description: Not far away, a bear cub looks to be in some distress. Perhaps you should investigate?

text.title: 穿针引线
text.objectives: 获取$1oa块夏多雷丝绸。你可以通过其他冒险者、拍卖行，或者破碎群岛的人形生物获取夏多雷丝绸。
text.description: 每当达拉然到达一个新地方，我就迫不及待想知道那里可以找到什么样的织物和布料。$b$b是灌注了魔法的丝线？还是跟恶魔有关的东西？$b$b唉，但愿不会又是毛皮。$b$b你是一位冒险者……也是一位如假包换的裁缝。到下面去看看你能找到什么好东西吧！

english.title: Sew It Begins
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Shal'dorei Silk. You can find Shal'dorei Silk on humanoids within the Broken Isles, obtain some from a fellow adventurer, or you may visit the Auction House and buy some.
english.description: Every time Dalaran takes us to a new shore, I get anxious over what types of fabric and cloth we might find below.$b$bThreads imbued with magic? Something demonically-tinged?$b$bUgh, I hope it's not FURS again.$b$bYou're an adventurer... and tailor to boot. Head on down there and see what you can scrounge up!

text.title: 挺简单……的吧？
text.objectives: 在坦妮瑟娅的精加工台上制作一件手工丝纹长袍。你可以在你的裁缝图样清单里找到图样，并在她的店里找到材料。
text.description: 我有好多丝绸图样可以用上这种布料。$b$b请帮我准备材料吧，$n。我们要好好处理这块料子，给你做件新袍子。

english.title: This Should Be Simple... Right?
english.objectives: Craft a Handcrafted Silkweave Robe on Tanithria's Finishing Bench. You can find the pattern in your tailoring pattern list. You can find the materials for the pattern in her shop.
english.description: I have plenty of silk patterns that we can put this cloth to work on.$b$bHelp me to prepare the materials, $n. We're going to put this cloth to good use and make you a new robe.

objectiveDetails.description: 在坦妮瑟娅的精加工台上制作一件丝纹长袍

text.title: 求助本地人
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳寻找裁缝。
text.description: 不管这块料子是谁编织的，肯定不会只用来制作护肩和腰带。一定有办法用这种材料进行缝纫。$b$b到下面的阿苏纳找个裁缝问问。要做好缝纫的话，一定少不了针线活。

english.title: Consult the Locals
english.objectives: Find a tailor in Azsuna.
english.description: Whoever wove this fabric CAN'T have intended it only for belts and shoulderpads. There must be some way to sew thread into this material.$b$bHead on down to Azsuna and try to find a tailor. We need to sew if we're going to do any real tailoring.

text.title: 符文肠线
text.objectives: 获取$1oa条符文肠线。
text.description: 让我猜猜……遇到针线活上的麻烦了？嗯。$b我大概也猜到了。我们族人编织的丝绸非常华丽，每种丝绸所用的缝线类型各有不同。$b$b在编织夏多雷丝绸时，会混入一点魔网能量。你需要找到能够与这片土地的魔网能量共存的东西。$b$b我指的就是鹰头猫，我的好朋友！它们身上有你需要的东西。你可以在洛希恩废墟里找到它们。

english.title: Runic Catgut
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa pieces of Runic Catgut.
english.description: Let me guess... thread troubles? Mm-hm.$bI suspected as much. My people weave sumptuous silks, but those silks can be fickle about the types of thread they'll accept.$b$bShal'dorei silk has a bit of ley energy woven right into it. You need something that's learned to coexist with the ley energies of this land.$b$bI'm talking about owlcats, my good friend! They have what you need. You'll find them amongst the ruins of Llothien.

text.title: 艰难的日子
text.objectives: 获取一件脏兮兮的丝绸长袍和一副积怨裹腕。
text.description: 我还在苏拉玛的裁缝行会时，常常会研究图样。我从中得到了很多的启发。$b$b可惜我后来遭遇了一连串的不幸，图样都遗失了，真是一大憾事。$b$b西面礁湖里的纳迦女巫拥有精工制作的裹腕，而且北边的堕夜精灵也穿着一些丝绸长袍，这些东西对我们都有用……你能从他们贪婪的手里抢来几件吗？

english.title: Hard Times
english.objectives: Obtain a Stained Silken Robe and a set of Hatecoil Wristwraps.
english.description: When I worked at the tailoring guild in Suramar, I would usually work off of a pattern. Something that inspired me.$b$bUnfortunately, I've run into streak of bad luck, and I'm ashamed to say that I no longer have my patterns.$b$bThe naga sorceresses in the lagoon to the west, however, have expertly-sewn wristwraps. And the nightfallen to the north wear robes that we can use... if you can pry one from their greedy clutches.

text.title: 缝纫好手
text.objectives: 在林达斯的精加工台上制作一件符纹丝纹长袍和一副符纹丝纹护腕。你可以在你的裁缝图样清单里找到图样。
text.description: 很好，我想我们可以开始了。$b$b<林达斯偷偷看了一下你强大的武器，脸上浮现出渴望的表情。他很快收起情绪继续说话。>$b$b我们来把材料准备好，然后制作你应得的长袍和护腕！

english.title: So You Think You Can Sew
english.objectives: Craft a Rune-Threaded Silkweave Robe and a set of Rune-Threaded Silkweave Bracers at Lyndras' Finishing Table. You can find the patterns in your tailoring pattern list.
english.description: Very good, I think we're ready to begin.$b$b<Lyndras steals a glance at your powerful weapon. A look of hunger washes over his face before he shakes it off and continues.>$b$bLet's prepare our materials and make the robe and bracers that you so rightfully deserve!

text.title: 任性的裁缝
text.objectives: 请求达拉然的兰尔拉·亮纹召唤林达斯。
text.description: 可以帮我个忙吗，$n？$b$b我现在既名下无产又无家可归，更没有半个亲朋好友，请问你可以带我去你们的漂浮城市吗？我必须承认自己对那里非常好奇，而且也听说那里有很好的裁缝店。$b$b我自己虽然没办法上去，但是那座魔法城市里肯定有人可以召唤我吧。$b$b<林达斯渴望地看着你。>

english.title: The Wayward Tailor
english.objectives: Speak to Lalla Brightweave in Dalaran, and ask her to summon Lyndras.
english.description: Might I ask a favor, $n?$b$bAs I am recently without a home, shop, family, or friends, I was wondering if you might show me your floating city? I must admit, I am VERY curious about the place. I've also heard good things about their tailoring shop.$b$bI have no way of getting there myself, but certainly such a magical city has SOMEONE who can summon me.$b$b<Lyndras looks at you with hopeful apprehension.>

text.title: 称手缝衣针
text.objectives: 获取$1oa份林精棘针。
text.description: 这个店铺几乎应有尽有。美中不足的是，你们的缝衣针质量欠佳。$b$b我知道能在哪里搞到优质的针。瓦尔莎拉的幽灵植物长满了尖刺，可以做成称手的缝衣针。$b$b我虽然也不想这么挑剔，但是那些针绝对会带来焕然一新的效果。

english.title: A Needle Need
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Spritethorns.
english.description: This shop has almost everything we need. Unfortunately, the quality of your sewing needles is lacking.$b$bI do know where you can get better needles. The sprites of Val'sharah are covered with spines which, fortuitously, are perfect for the type of sewing we need.$b$bI hate to be such a prickler stickler, but these needles really will make a difference.

text.title: 极致精准
text.objectives: 把林精棘针交给达拉然的蒂凡妮·卡蒂亚。
text.description: 虽然这些针非常锐利，不过近看的话就会发现一些瑕疵。有些比较弯曲，有些甚至长着毛刺。看这根……都拧成直角了！我可不想用弯弯曲曲的针来缝纫。$b$b珠宝加工店的蒂凡妮·卡蒂亚对这种东西很在行。把这些针交给她，让她帮忙弄直。

english.title: Meticulous Precision
english.objectives: Bring the Spritethorns to Tiffany Cartier in Dalaran.
english.description: The needles are sharp, but look at them closely. Some have a curve to them, others have a spur hanging off the side. Look at this one... it's got a ninety-degree crook in it! I have no desire to sew around a corner.$b$bTiffany Cartier in the jewelcrafting shop has a good eye for this sort of thing. Bring these needles to her, and she'll straighten them out.

text.title: 缝纫进阶
text.objectives: 在坦妮瑟娅的精加工台上制作一件绣花丝纹长袍。你得在她的店铺里找到需要的材料。
text.description: 你已经学会护腕、腰带、肩饰和长袍的图样。可惜的是，你的工艺非常费料……需要改进一下。$b$b我们的缝衣针正好可以派上用场。$b$b来吧，我教你怎么改进这些图样的工艺。

english.title: Advanced Needlework
english.objectives: Make an Embroidered Silkweave Robe on Tanithria's Finishing Bench. You will need to gather the materials in her shop.
english.description: You've already learned the patterns for bracers, belts, epaulets, and of course, robes. Unfortunately, your technique was wasteful... you need a better method.$b$bThat's where our needles come in.$b$bHere, I'll show you how to improve the process of these patterns.

text.title: 林达斯在哪？
text.objectives: 寻找林达斯。
text.description: 真是奇怪，林达斯怎么神出鬼没的，他的表情也很不对劲。$b$b我们应该跟踪他。

english.title: Where's Lyndras?
english.objectives: Find Lyndras.
english.description: That's strange. Lyndras was here one moment, and then he ran off the next. He had such a strange look on his face.$b$bPerhaps we should track him down.

text.title: 目前为止，一切顺利
text.objectives: 制作一个丝纹包。你得在达拉然的裁缝店里找到需要的材料。
text.description: 你的缝纫技术很不错。虽然我没有实物图样了，但是我还有记忆。我记得一个简易背包的图样。$b$b好好学吧，$n。

english.title: Sew Far, Sew Good
english.objectives: Craft a Silkweave Bag. You will need to gather materials inside the Dalaran tailoring shop.
english.description: Your tailoring skill really is impressive and, although I don't have my patterns with me, I do have some patterns memorized. One of those patterns is for a simple bag.$b$bFollow my lead, $n.

text.title: 林达斯又跑到哪里去了？
text.objectives: 在达拉然寻找林达斯。
text.description: 天啊。$b$b他才答应不再乱跑，一会人又不见了！$b$b我开始觉得，这个叫林达斯的有点太过鲁莽，跟我合不来。$b$b请你快去找他，免得又惹出什么麻烦。

english.title: Where's Lyndras Again?
english.objectives: Find Lyndras in Dalaran.
english.description: Oh dear.$b$bHe had just promised you that he wouldn't wander off, and then he did it again!$b$bI'm starting to think that this Lyndras character might be a bit too impetuous for my tastes.$b$bPlease, go find him, before he gets into any more trouble.

text.title: 借鉴的灵感
text.objectives: 获取$1oa条符文马裤。
text.description: 真希望我有更多的图样能和你分享，但是我失去了自己的笔记本和店铺。我们必须再想些图样出来。$b$b我一直在想风暴峡湾那些维库人身上所穿的皮质马裤。虽然它们比我们缝制的衣物还要厚重，但是马裤上的装饰符文确实相当引人注目。$b$b如果你能找来几条，或许可以将符文用在更精致的服装上。

english.title: Taking Inspiration
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Runed Breeches.
english.description: I wish I had more patterns to share, but my notebook was lost along with my shop. We'll need to come up with some patterns on our own.$b$bI've been thinking about the leather breeches that the Stormheim vrykul wear. They're certainly much thicker and heavier than anything we could sew, but their embellishing runework is quite impressive.$b$bIf I had a few pairs, perhaps I could re-imagine this runework on a more... refined garment.

text.title: 合适的颜色
text.objectives: 获得$1oa份冥界鱿鱼墨汁。
text.description: 如果你有时间的话，我想请你帮个忙，$n。$b$b我一直在尝试重现以前见过的一双鞋子的图样，但是我在染料颜色方面遇到了麻烦。因为我们黑色染料的颜色太深，而蓝色染料的颜色又太亮，所以它们的混合色跟我想要的颜色相差甚远。$b$b我想找一种近似墨汁蓝的颜色。如果你在旅途中遇到这种颜色的颜料，劳烦你给我带些回来，可以吗？

english.title: The Right Color
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Helsquid Ink.
english.description: Your assistance, $n, if you have a moment.$b$bI've been attempting to reproduce a pattern for footwear that I spotted a while back, but I'm having trouble getting the right color for my dye. Our black dye is too dark, our blue dye is too bright, and mixing the two doesn't look right.$b$bThe color I'm looking for is more of a squid-ink blue. If, in your travels, you come across any dyes of this color, would you do me the favor of bringing some to me?

text.title: 丢三落四
text.objectives: 前往你和林达斯在苏拉玛初次见面的地方，寻找林达斯的裁缝剪、测量工具盒和穿线针。
text.description: 我真的想帮你提升缝纫技术，不过现在既没图样又没补给品，所以除了把我能够记住的有限知识教给你以外，我帮不了你更多。$b$b如果我没记错的话，你正好缺少手套和兜帽的优质图样。$b$b我要你做的第一件事，就是在我们初次见面的地方取回一些东西。我需要的东西有……

english.title: Left Behind
english.objectives: Gather Lyndras' Pinking Shears, his Box of Measuring Tools and his Threading Needles from where you first met him in Azsuna.
english.description: I do truly want to help you work on your tailoring, but without my patterns or my supplies, there isn't much more I can do save for teaching you what little I remember.$b$bIf my memory still serves true, you're just missing a good pattern for some gloves and a hood.$b$bThe first thing I need you to do is grab a few things from where you first met me. Here's what I need...

text.title: 熊皮内衬
text.objectives: 收集$1oa张熊皮。
text.description: 既然你要去阿苏纳，不如顺便为我们的纺织品找些内衬。$b$b阿苏纳的熊皮是出了名的柔软、有韧性。$b$b到洛希恩周围的林地里猎杀巨熊，然后把它们的皮带回来。

english.title: Lining Them Up
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Bear Furs.
english.description: Since you're heading to Azsuna, you may as well gather some lining for our projects.$b$bThe bears of Azsuna are known for how soft, yet durable their fur is.$b$bHunt them in the woods around Llothien and bring their fur back with you.

text.title: 艾萨拉之眼：卑鄙的堕夜精灵
text.objectives: 前往艾萨拉之眼，打败艾萨拉之怒并取得风暴之心。
text.description: 要制作手套的话，我们就需要一个特殊的物品。要取得这个东西会很麻烦，$n。$b$b据说，阿苏纳的纳迦一直在尝试召唤一个可怕的生物进入这个世界。$b$b那个生物的心脏拥有巨大的能量，我们可以把它导入手套里，让手套变得无比强大。$b$b我需要……我是说，我们需要那颗心脏，才能制作出配得上你这样的勇士的手套。

english.title: Eye of Azshara: The Depraved Nightfallen
english.objectives: Go to the Eye of Azshara, defeat the Wrath of Azshara and recover the Heart of the Storm.
english.description: In order to craft the gloves, we'll require a special item. This will be no easy task to recover it, $n.$b$bThe naga of Azsuna are said to be hard at work trying to summon a terrible creature into this world.$b$bThe creature's heart holds immense energy that we can use to channel into the gloves, making them incredibly powerful.$b$bI need... I mean, we need that heart if we are to produce a suitable pair of gloves for someone of your presence.

text.title: 进城的路
text.objectives: 帮助苏拉玛的堕夜精灵，令你找到安全地混入苏拉玛城精灵之中的方法。
text.description: 我记得林达斯提到过苏拉玛城里有一个裁缝行会。或许他们可以帮我们进一步了解如何利用这种新的织物。$b$b不幸的是，我听说他们和恶魔结了盟，反对他们的人都会被格杀勿论。$b$b如果我们要深入研究的话，你就必须在他们的城里找到一条安全的路线。

english.title: The Path to Suramar City
english.objectives: Assist the nightfallen of Suramar until you discover a way to move safely amongst the elves of Suramar City.
english.description: I recall Lyndras mentioning a guild of tailors within Suramar City. Perhaps they could further our understanding of how to utilize this new cloth.$b$bUnfortunately from what I've heard, they've sided with the demons and anyone opposed to them is to be killed on sight.$b$bYou must find a way to move safely within the confines of their city if we're to continue our research.

objectiveDetails.description: 在苏拉玛城找到一条安全的路线

text.title: 最后一课？
text.objectives: 在坦妮瑟娅的精加工台上制作一个手工丝纹兜帽。你得在她的店铺里找到或购买需要的材料。
text.description: 现在万事俱备，我们来制作兜帽吧。$b$b完成以后，我们就可以考虑手套的事情了。

english.title: The Final Lesson?
english.objectives: Create a Handcrafted Silkweave Hood on Tanithria's Finishing Bench. You will need to gather the materials in her shop.
english.description: Now that we have everything we need, let's work on the hood.$b$bAfter we're finished, we'll move onto the gloves.

text.title: 林达斯现在在哪？
text.objectives: 到对面的炼金店去看看情况。
text.description: 林达斯走不了多远。我的意思是，我们正飘在大海上空一千尺高的地方呢。$b$b今天早上，我在炼金店附近听到马路对面有一些骚动。希望那跟林达斯无关。$b$b你可以到那里去确认一下吗？

english.title: Where's Lyndras Now?
english.objectives: Go the alchemy shop across the street.
english.description: Lyndras couldn't have gone very far. I mean, we're floating a thousand feet over the sea. $b$bI heard some commotion across the way this morning near the alchemy shop. I pray that wasn't Lyndras.$b$bCould you please go over there and make sure?

text.title: 突袭紫罗兰监狱：探监
text.objectives: 进入紫罗兰监狱，了解林达斯的状况。
text.description: 林达斯被关进紫罗兰监狱了，你觉得自己应该对他负责，并查出他所作所为的背后真相。$b$b如果能够跟他谈谈，说不定可以设法把他弄出来，以后好好看着他。进入紫罗兰监狱，了解林达斯的状况。

english.title: Assault on Violet Hold: Into the Hold
english.objectives: Go into Violet Hold and find out what happened to Lyndras.
english.description: With Lyndras being locked up in Violet Hold, you feel responsible for him and must discover the truth behind his actions.$b$bPerhaps if you were able to speak with him, you could find a way to have him released from the hold and put back into your custody.$b$bGo into Violet Hold and find out what happened to Lyndras.

text.title: 隐藏的丝纹缝纫法
text.objectives: 制作精工丝纹护腕。$b$b你得在达拉然的裁缝店和铁匠铺里找到需要的材料。
text.description: 好了，我已经收起悲伤！我们来检查一下他的物品吧。$b$b<坦妮瑟娅迅速翻阅林达斯的日记。她睁大了眼睛。>$b$b这位朋友隐藏得很深啊。看这个！他教给我们的每个配方都可以得到改进。$b$b我们先从简单的护腕开始吧。大部分的材料我都有，你只需要到铁匠铺去找奥拉尔德·施米尔拿些硫磺屑就行。

english.title: Secret Silkweaving Methods
english.objectives: Craft some Masterwork Silkweave Bracers.$b$bYou will need to gather materials from the Dalaran tailoring shop and blacksmithing shop.
english.description: Okay, done mourning! Let's look through his stuff.$b$b<Tanithria takes a moment to leaf through Lyndras' journal. Her eyes open wide.>$b$bOur friend has been keeping secrets from us. Look at this! Every single one of the recipes he's taught us can be improved.$b$bLet's start simple, with some bracers. I can supply most of the materials, but you'll have to talk to Alard Schmied in the blacksmithing shop to get this powdered brimstone.

text.title: 夜之子的关系
text.objectives: 在苏拉玛与织魔者泰塔洛谈一谈。
text.description: 现在你可以伪装自己了，你应该在苏拉玛城里寻找这个裁缝行会。$b$b祝你好运，$n，小心别被抓住了。

english.title: The Nightborne Connection
english.objectives: Speak with Leyweaver Tytallo in Suramar.
english.description: Now that you're able to disguise yourself, you should go to Suramar City and try to find this guild of tailors.$b$bGood luck, $n, and try not to get caught.

text.title: 忠心的证明
text.objectives: 在苏拉玛消灭$1oa个枯法者。
text.description: <泰塔洛倾听你讲诉林达斯的故事。>$b$b我知道了。听起来……你似乎很同情那个可怜人。$b$b堕夜精灵都是骗子和小偷。全部都是。林达斯也不例外。$b$b我不能容忍学生对那些……东西有半点尊敬或者同情。你见过他们堕落以后会变成什么样吗？$b$b如果你想跟我学好的话，就让你的全身沾满枯法者的鲜血，否则就不要回来。

english.title: Proof of Loyalty
english.objectives: Slay $1oa withered within Suramar.
english.description: <Tytallo listens as you recount what happened with Lyndras.>$b$bI see. You sound almost... sympathetic to the wretch.$b$bThe nightfallen are liars and thieves. ALL of them. Lyndras included.$b$bI will not tolerate a student that has any respect or sympathy for those... things. And have you witnessed what they turn into at the depths of their depravity?$b$bIf you want to get on my good side, do not return until you are covered in the blood of the withered.

text.title: 丝纹大师
text.objectives: 找织魔者米索贾尼购买一个夏多雷人体模型，然后制作一整套丝纹护甲并把你的作品穿到模型身上。
text.description: 泰塔洛忙着对枯法者赶尽杀绝的时候，就由我来负责训练中比较乏味的部分。$b$b我们得看看你的能力如何。$b$b帮我制作一整套丝纹护甲。织魔者米索贾尼可以为你提供一个合适的人体模型，方便你展示作品。

english.title: Master of Silkweave
english.objectives: Purchase a Shal'dorei Mannequin from Leyweaver Mithrogane, then craft an entire set of silkweave armor and place them on the mannequin.
english.description: While Tytallo is busy exacting withered genocide, it falls on me to take care of the more mundane aspects of training.$b$bWe're going to need to see how talented you are.$b$bCraft an entire set of silkweave armor for me. Leyweaver Mithrogane can provide you with a proper mannequin for displaying it.

text.title: 女王的优雅织布机
text.objectives: 使用织魔者大厅里的传送水晶，然后与织魔者阿扎娜谈一谈。
text.description: 想要获得强大的力量，就必须付出代价。再出色的裁缝在丝纹造诣上也会有瓶颈。想要进一步改进你的图样，就必须有所取舍。$b$b$n，你已经准备好学习如何处理灌魔丝纹布。$b$b使用我身后的传送水晶，去找我们行会的领袖阿扎娜谈谈。

english.title: The Queen's Grace Loom
english.objectives: Use the Teleportation Crystal in the Leyweavers' Hall, then speak with Leyweaver Azayna.
english.description: Great power comes only with sacrifice. Even the most masterful tailor can only do so much with silkweave. To improve your patterns any further, bargains must be made.$b$bYou are prepared, $n, to learn about working with Imbued Silkweave.$b$bUse the teleportation crystal behind me, and speak with Azayna, the leader of our order.

objectiveDetails.description: 了解女王的优雅织布机

text.title: 特异织物
text.objectives: 取得邪能铭文裹布。
text.description: 我赌上了自己的生命和事业来到这里，裁缝。$b$b我对恶魔织物充满了好奇，但是我通过常规手段来获取织物的尝试遇到了阻碍。$b$b我只是想亲眼看看这种织物。$b$b我并不想破坏阿扎娜与恶魔的契约。但是，如果你去攻击恶魔的话，就不会为我的行会引起不必要的注意。$b$b我对一件特别的恶魔长袍非常感兴趣。去帮我找来那种料子吧，我会把我的知识传授给你的。

english.title: Exotic Textiles
english.objectives: Obtain the Fel Inscribed Shroud.
english.description: I'm risking my life and career to be here, tailor.$b$bI've been curious about demonic cloth, and my attempts to obtain some through approved means have been met with resistance.$b$bI simply must see this cloth for myself.$b$bI don't wish to disrupt Azayna's pact with the demons, but you - you can attack the demons without drawing attention to our guild.$b$bI'm particularly interested in a particular demon's set of robes. Bring me a scrap, and I'll teach you what I know.

text.title: 英灵殿：正确的问题
text.objectives: 在英灵殿打败海姆达尔并取得他的腰布。
text.description: 有人可能会问，织魔者站在维库人尸体上做什么？然而，这种问题只会招惹麻烦。$b$b反过来，我们应该问，我们可以从死人身上学到什么？这样的问题才可以使人进步。$b$b我猜你来这里是为了跟我学习灌魔丝纹马裤的图样，对吗？$b$b如果是这样的话，我就需要你从死人身上取来一样东西。伟大的守护者海姆达尔就在英灵殿里。$b$b把他的腰布拿给我，我就会教你学习我的图样。

english.title: Halls of Valor: The Right Question
english.objectives: Defeat Hymdall in the Halls of Valor and recover his loincloth.
english.description: One might ask what a leyweaver is doing standing over a dead vrykul's body. But such questions only stir up trouble.$b$bInstead let us ask what can be learned from those who have passed on. A question like that promotes progress.$b$bI assume you're here to learn from me, the pattern for Imbued Silkweave pants, yes?$b$bIf that's true, then I'll need something from one who has passed on. In the Halls of Valor the great guardian, Hymdall resides.$b$bBring me his loincloth and I will teach you my pattern.

text.title: 给我启发！
text.objectives: 在织魔者米索贾尼旁边制作一件棕色亚麻长袍、一条白色毛绒裙、一条简易的黑裙子、一件霜纹长袍，以及一件愈心长袍。$b$b如果有你不知道的图样，可以到各大主城找裁缝训练师学习。
text.description: 我现在会，以后也会不断钻研如何制作长袍和裙子。你当然可以制作手套、腰带和斗篷，但是对我来说，什么都比不过一件优质的长袍。$b$b你在缝纫生涯中肯定学会了很多长袍和裙子的图样，如果你能教我一些的话，我就跟你分享灌魔丝纹长袍图样。

english.title: Inspire Me!
english.objectives: Craft a Brown Linen Robe, a White Woolen Dress, a Simple Black Dress, a Frostwoven Robe, and a Spiritmend Robe while standing near Leyweaver Mithrogane.$b$bIf you do not know a pattern, you can learn it from tailoring trainers in major cities.
english.description: I am, and always will be, a student of robemaking and dressmaking. You can keep your gloves, belts, and cloaks. Nothing beats a good robe.$b$bI'll share my pattern for an imbued silkweave robe with you if you can teach me some of the robe and dress patterns you've learned along your tailoring journey.

objectiveDetails.description: 在织魔者米索贾尼旁边制作一件愈心长袍
在织魔者米索贾尼旁边制作一件霜纹长袍
在织魔者米索贾尼旁边制作一条简易的黑裙子
在织魔者米索贾尼旁边制作一条白色毛绒裙
在织魔者米索贾尼旁边制作一件棕色亚麻长袍

text.title: 有何指示，将军？
text.objectives: 前往塔纳安丛林的塔纳安计划图。
text.description: 将军，你的部队已集结在塔纳安丛林，正等候你的指示。到塔纳安计划图跟前去，下达你的指令。$b$b为了部落！
text.completed: 前往塔纳安丛林的塔纳安计划图。

english.title: Your Orders, General?
english.objectives: Go to the Tanaan Planning Map in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: General, your forces in Tanaan Jungle await your orders. Travel to the Planning Map there to issue your commands.$b$bFor the Horde!
english.completed: Go to the Tanaan Planning Map in Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 冰冠的召唤
text.objectives: 使用你的黑锋之门技能前往冰冠堡垒，取得堕落王子之剑。
text.description: <一个强大的存在再次进入你的思绪。>$b$b我已经命令你的同胞前往冰冠堡垒为即将到来的冲突做准备，然而对你而言，我还有更重要的安排。你，$n，将成为我们复仇的利器！$b$b使用黑锋之门返回阿彻鲁斯，我将为你揭示命运。

english.title: The Call of Icecrown
english.objectives: Use your Death Gate ability to travel to Icecrown and obtain the Blades of the Fallen Prince.
english.description: <A powerful presence again touches your thoughts.>$b$bI have ordered your brethren to Icecrown to prepare for the coming conflict, but I have a more important fate in mind for you. You, $n, will be the hand of our vengeance!$b$bUse the Death Gate to return to Acherus and I shall reveal your role in this.

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼
大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: TRACKING Encounter Botanist
text.objectives: Defeat Botanist Darkgrove
text.description:
(PH)
Darkgrove has run out of places to hide. Now it is time to finish him off.$B$BIf we stop him now, there may be hope for this valley yet.
text.completed: Return to Ysera

text.title: 有何指示，将军？
text.objectives: 与塔纳安丛林雄狮岗哨的伊瑞尔谈一谈。
text.description: 塔纳安丛林雄狮岗哨的大主教伊瑞尔传话来说，你的部队已准备就绪，正等候你的新指示。$b$b为了联盟！
text.completed: 与塔纳安丛林雄狮岗哨的伊瑞尔谈一谈。

english.title: Your Orders, General?
english.objectives: Speak with Yrel at Lion's Stand in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: Exarch Yrel has sent word from Lion's Watch in Tanaan Jungle that your forces stand ready for their new orders.$b$bFor the Alliance!
english.completed: Speak with Yrel at Lion's Stand in Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 我们借书不用卡
text.objectives: 从地狱火堡垒的首领身上收集$oa本混沌魔典。
text.description: 从我们已知的历史来看，古尔丹正在训练新一代术士，打算向我们发动攻击。如果我们能尽快采取行动，就能够遏制这股浪潮，也可以缓解我们将要面临的压力。$b$b在你和其他英雄向地狱火堡垒深处进军的过程中，注意从古尔丹的军士们身上搜集混沌魔典。$b$b那些魔典非常危险，千万不要看里面的内容，连图画都不要看。$b$b<卡德加打了个寒颤。>$b$b尤其是图画。

english.title: We Don't Need No Library Card
english.objectives: Collect $oa Tomes of Chaos from bosses in Hellfire Citadel.
english.description: If history is any indication, Gul'dan is training a whole generation of warlocks to marshal against us. If we act fast, we can stem the tide and make things easier on ourselves.$b$bAs you and your fellow heroes venture into the depths of the Hellfire Citadel, seek out Tomes of Chaos from Gul'dan's lieutenants.$b$bThey're dangerous, so don't read any of them. Not even the pictures.$b$b<Khadgar shudders.>$b$bESPECIALLY the pictures.

text.title: To Farahlon!
text.objectives: Use your shipyard to complete the "To Farahlon!" Naval Mission and retrieve the Pearl of Farahlon.
text.description: $n, have you ever heard of Farahlon? Archmage Vargoth would never stop talking about it - beautiful fields and forests dotted with natural crystalline formations that make it the magical nexus of Draenor. It's nearly impossible to get to. The magical storms in the seas around it are frequent and unpredictable.$b$bFor your ring, we'll need a magical artifact from Farahlon. You will need an absolutely top-notch crew to sail safely to the region and get back alive. Choose carefully and get me that artifact!
text.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar at your garrison's shipyard.

english.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar at your garrison's shipyard.

text.title: Ogres of the Deep
text.objectives: Use your shipyard to complete the "Ogres of the Deep" Naval Mission and retrieve the Soaked Ogre Decoder.
text.description: It might surprise you to know that at its peak the Gorian ogre empire had a small but powerful navy. It probably wouldn't surprise you to learn that many of its largest warships sunk. They were built out of stone.$b$bI've found an old chart indicating the last-known position of "The Emperor's Foot," lost at sea with a valuable artifact I need. An ogre decoder.$b$bRight! To salvage it you'll need a submarine and a crack crew. This is an extremely dangerous mission which is why I'm giving it to you.

text.title: Cooking the Books
text.objectives: Deliver Gul'dan's Library of Chaos to Cordana at Zangarra and ensure they are destroyed.
text.description: $n, we've got to destroy these tomes. Many of them have actual tortured souls bound into the pages, so we can't just burn them. Cordana will know what to do.$b$bTake these books to my tower in Zangarra and give them to Cordana. Let me know when the deed is done.

english.objectives: Deliver Gul'dan's Library of Chaos to Cordana at Zangarra and ensure they are destroyed.

text.title: Darkness Incarnate
text.objectives: Hunt down and engage Gul'dan within the Hellfire Citadel.
text.description: We have one final task before us, $n. We must defeat Gul'dan and unravel his plans for this world.$b$bI have no reward to offer you - I have given you everything I can.$b$bCome. When you and your allies are ready, we march on Hellfire Citadel... and end this.

text.title: Black Rook Invasion
text.objectives: Kill 7 Black Rook Assassins in Bradensbrook.
text.description: Once, this area was peaceful and prosperous. Then we saw the first bad omens: strange ailments, spoiled crops, and the like. Now ghosts attack us from that castle across the river, and undead assassins slay our fishers so as to cut off the village's food supply.$B$BWe're the last family living this close to the castle, but we daren't retreat: this river is the best route for fishers to bring their hauls in to town. Please, will you take the fight to these undead?

Please, will you take the fight to these undead?

text.title: Unused - The Fish Must Flow
text.objectives: Collect 6 Stolen Fish from the Black Rook Assassins and Black Rook Lieutenants in Bradensbrook.
text.description: Our village is running low on food, and undead spies from Black Rook Hold have started targeting our fishers.$B$BIt's a surgical move, hitting our people and our food supply all at once.$B$BHelp us out and send those ghosts a message. Pare down their forces and bring back the food they've stolen.

text.title: Rise to the Occasion
text.objectives: Speak with Highlord Darion Mograine within Acherus.
text.description: The Lich King made a wise choice in giving you that weapon, $n.$b$bYou've proven your strength and cunning on countless occasions and it is time that you have a position fitting for your accomplishments.

english.description: The Lich King made a wise choice in giving you that weapon, $n.$b$bYou've proven your strength and cunning on countless occasions and it is time that you have a position fitting for your accomplishments.

text.title: 卡德加的召唤
text.objectives: 在赞加拉的卡德加的法师塔与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
text.description: 大法师卡德加有非常紧急的事物要与你详谈。他非常担心这个世界对艾泽拉斯造成的威胁，并想要你帮他彻查这些威胁。 请前往塔拉多东面的赞加拉沼泽，在卡德加的法师塔和他见面。这不会耽误你很长时间的。
text.completed: 在赞加拉的卡德加的法师塔与大法师卡德加谈一谈。

english.title: Call of the Archmage
english.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.
english.description: Archmage Khadgar has a very urgent favor to ask. He is gravely concerned about additional threats this world may hold for Azeroth, and he will need your assistance pursuing them. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp.
english.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.title: Call of the Archmage
text.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.
text.description: Archmage Khadgar has devised the next course of action against the Shadow Council. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp.
text.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

english.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.title: 燃烧的时光之路
text.objectives: 完成5个时空漫游地下城。
text.description: 燃烧的星星照耀着大地，使土地布满焦痕，四处都是干枯的景象。那是一颗残忍而恶毒的星星。在它的影响持续期间，新的道路将被打开，通往遥远的空间与时间。没有哪位贤者真正了解这一预兆的涵义，但英勇的行为总会得到幸运的眷顾。

english.title: A Burning Path Through Time
english.objectives: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.
english.description: The blazing star shines upon the land, searing the earth and parching the landscape. This star is relentless, malevolent almost. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

text.title: A Frozen Path Through Time
text.objectives: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.
text.description: The chill star shines upon the land with its cold light as even the spirits retreat to the shadows. This star is unlike any other in the skies, sapping warmth and life. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

text.title: 地底之王的魔掌
text.objectives: 营救洁儿·河鬃、武士奥罗和奥金·铁牛。
text.description: 达古尔不知道怎么使用圣锤的力量，这只能算我们运气好。$b$b他一直认为那只是一把武器，并不知道那是创世的工具。$b$b即便如此，他还是把我们的族人关在从地面召唤出来的石拳里。我们发现我们的武器没办法对付那种魔法。$b$b你或许有足够的力量可以打开石拳。可以帮帮忙吗？
text.completion: It has been an age or more since the drogbar last walked the surface in such numbers.$b$bThey became the dark stories we tell children.

english.title: Grasp of the Underking
english.objectives: Rescue Jale Rivermane, Warbrave Oro, and Oakin Ironbull.
english.description: If we have one good fortune in this it is that Dargrul has no knowledge of how to use the hammer.$b$bHe keeps thinking of the hammer as a weapon instead of a tool of creation.$b$bEven so, he has imprisoned our tribesman in fists of stone summoned from the earth. Our weapons have proven useless against this magic.$b$bYou might have power enough to break these fists. Can you help?
english.completion: It has been an age or more since the drogbar last walked the surface in such numbers.$b$bThey became the dark stories we tell children.

text.title: 卓格巴尔
text.objectives: 在河湾消灭$1oa个卓格巴尔。
text.description: 对于达古尔来说，光是摧毁这座村庄还不够。他还派出掠石者，要毁掉剩下的一切。$b$b勇士，请向我的人民证明你就是预言中的英雄。$b$b消灭足够多的掠石者，瓦解他们的力量。
text.completion: Your battle skills are impressive.

english.title: The Drogbar
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Drogbar in Riverbend.
english.description: It wasn't enough for Dargrul to just destroy this village. He has also sent his Stoneraiders to take what is left.$b$bPlease champion, prove to my people that you are the hero I foresaw.$b$bSlay enough of these Stoneraiders that it breaks their resolve.
english.completion: Your battle skills are impressive.

text.title: 达古尔与圣锤
text.objectives: 对战地底之王达古尔。
text.description: 我们正打算追踪卓格巴尔进入洞穴，情况非常凶险，我们告诫孩子们千万不要参与这样的事情。$b$b我们的几位武士已经跟着达古尔进去了。$b$b加入战斗吧，让我们一起夺回卡兹格罗斯之锤。
text.completion: Oro and the others? Did they make it out as well?$b$bSuch destruction. So many good warbraves have fallen today.$b$bIt is clear now, we will need the full might of the Highmountain tribes if we are to recover the hammer.

english.title: Dargrul and the Hammer
english.objectives: Confront Dargrul the Underking.
english.description: We are about to follow a drogbar into a cave, something we warn our children never to do.$b$bEven so, several of our warbraves have already followed Dargrul inside.$b$bCome, join us in battle and let us reclaim the Hammer of Khaz'goroth.
english.completion: Oro and the others? Did they make it out as well?$b$bSuch destruction. So many good warbraves have fallen today.$b$bIt is clear now, we will need the full might of the Highmountain tribes if we are to recover the hammer.

text.title: Arauk Nashal 70:JP3 - Aggramar's Vault - Tracking Quest Cleared - God-King Intro

english.title: Arauk Nashal 70:JP3 - Aggramar's Vault - Tracking Quest Cleared - God-King Intro

text.title: A Summons from Saylanna
text.objectives: Seek out Saylanna Riverbreeze in the Lunarwing Shallows.
text.description: Sprites have always been mischievous creatures, but lately their mischief has turned to violence.$B$BOne of the druids I call friend, Saylanna Riverbreeze, reports that they are assaulting the faerie dragon nesting grounds.$B$BThe Lunarwing Shallows lie to the south. You will find Saylanna there.
