english.objectives: Seek out Saylanna Riverbreeze in the Lunarwing Shallows.
english.description: Sprites have always been mischievous creatures, but lately their mischief has turned to violence.$B$BOne of the druids I call friend, Saylanna Riverbreeze, reports that they are assaulting the faerie dragon nesting grounds.$B$BThe Lunarwing Shallows lie to the south. You will find Saylanna there.

text.title: 突袭时刻
text.objectives: 在盛产埃匹希斯的地区完成5项目标。
text.description: 星辰的方位使散布在德拉诺各处的远古文物——埃匹希斯水晶——产生了非同寻常的振动。有人发誓说，这些水晶会在无人观察的时候在夜空下自行增殖，但没有人亲眼目睹过这样的现象。不管原因到底是什么，如果你现在去寻找水晶的话，收获一定会比之前更多。

english.title: The Time to Strike
english.objectives: Complete 5 Objectives in Apexis-yielding areas.
english.description: This configuration of the stars causes an unusual vibration in the crystals strewn across Draenor, relics of the ancient Apexis. Some swear that the crystals will multiply when left unattended beneath the night sky, but none have seen the phenomenon firsthand. Regardless of the true cause, these crystals should be far more plentiful should you seek them out.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成埃匹希斯地区目标

text.title: Emissary of War
text.objectives: Complete 4 dungeons on Mythic difficulty.
text.description: When the sign of the emissary shines in the night sky, the stars strengthen existing bonds and forge new ones. Friendship is still not cheaply won, and deeds will prove loyalty, but trust comes more readily during these days. Venture deep into caverns and strongholds to prove your worth.

english.title: Emissary of War
english.objectives: Complete 4 dungeons on Mythic difficulty.
english.description: When the sign of the emissary shines in the night sky, the stars strengthen existing bonds and forge new ones. Friendship is still not cheaply won, and deeds will prove loyalty, but trust comes more readily during these days. Venture deep into caverns and strongholds to prove your worth.

text.title: 战斗的呼唤
text.objectives: 在战场中获得4场胜利。
text.description: 将军与战争领主的幸运星主宰了天空，护佑着各地的战术家们。有人说战争之星可以强化指挥官们的本能，让他们拥有接近先知的能力。如果你曾经打算在战场上检验自己的水平，现在就是最好的时机了。

english.title: A Call to Battle
english.objectives: Win 4 Battleground matches.
english.description: The favorite star of warlords and generals dominates the sky, offering good fortune to tacticians everywhere. Some say that the battle star hones the instincts of commanders to the point of near-prophecy. If ever you were going to test yourself on the field of battle, now is the time.

text.title: 竞技场的召唤
text.objectives: 在竞技场练习赛中获得10场胜利。
text.description: 星辰的排列显示出了可怕的预兆，刺激着人们心中嗜血的渴望，呼唤着战士到战场上与敌人短兵相接。在这样的日子里，竞技场高手们总是获利颇丰，他们可能也不明白为什么竞技场比赛总是场场爆满。在这激动人心的时间里，竞技场中会有丰厚的奖励等待着那些勇敢的，或者说莽撞的人……

english.title: The Arena Calls
english.objectives: Win 10 Arena Skirmish battles.
english.description: This alignment of the stars is a dire sign, stirring bloodlust and calling warriors to battle to the death in close quarters. Arena masters turn a tidy profit during these days, likely not understanding why their stands are overflowing. Amidst the excitement, great rewards do await those brave, or foolhardy, enough to venture into the arena....

objectiveDetails.description: 获得竞技场练习赛胜利

text.title: The Very Best
text.objectives: Defeat 5 players through Find Battle with a team of level 25 pets.
text.description: This alignment of the stars is truly a strange one, causing the tiniest of creatures to gain unnatural aptitude. None of our sages can explain the phenomenon, but cunning tamers have much to gain, especially by testing their skills against those of their peers.

english.title: The Very Best
english.objectives: Defeat 5 players through Find Battle with a team of level 25 pets.
english.description: This alignment of the stars is truly a strange one, causing the tiniest of creatures to gain unnatural aptitude. None of our sages can explain the phenomenon, but cunning tamers have much to gain, especially by testing their skills against those of their peers.

text.title: 啮岩孤地
text.objectives: 在啮岩孤地消灭卓格巴尔。
text.description: 这是一片古老的卓格巴尔领地，也是我们以前的交易场所，不过现在已经成为他们开展侵略行动的基地。$b$b我需要更多时间整顿残存的武士。去吧，进去消灭你遇到的任何卓格巴尔。$b$b为我们争取集结力量的时间。
text.completion: Thank you for clearing us a path. We should have a straight shot at Dargrul now.

english.title: Bitestone Enclave
english.objectives: Slay drogbar in the Bitestone Enclave.
english.description: This is an old drogbar enclave that we used to trade with. Now it is a base of operations for their raids.$b$bI need more time to gather what is left of our warbraves. Go, enter the enclave, and slay any you find in there.$b$bBuy us the time we need to gather our strength.
english.completion: Thank you for clearing us a path. We should have a straight shot at Dargrul now.

text.title: 伊利达雷的召唤
text.objectives: 在克拉苏斯平台与受难者奥图里斯谈一谈。
text.description: $n，奥图里斯请求你立刻到克拉苏斯平台跟他碰头。$B$B<考瓦斯凑了过来，急切地低语。>$B$B你必须抓紧时间。到处都有燃烧军团的耳目。

english.title: Call of the Illidari
english.objectives: Speak to Altruis the Sufferer at Krasus' Landing.
english.description: $n, Altruis requests that you meet him at Krasus' Landing at once.$B$B<Kor'vas leans in close, her voice an urgent whisper.>$B$BYou must hurry. The Legion has eyes everywhere.

text.title: 盯紧目标
text.objectives: 消灭审判官贝弗尔并吸取他的力量。
text.description:
这个恶魔毫无用处。我用夺魂之镰不断对他严刑拷问，可他一直守口如瓶。我们看看他还能撑多久。

不过，我还有个主意……

前面有一个恶魔审判官。他可以施展恐怖的邪能魔法，通过漂浮之眼来窥探世界，并且擅于使用黑暗契约。如果你能夺取他的力量，就可以让杰斯·织暗运用在仪式之中，用来监视燃烧军团。
text.giverWindow: 夺取他的精华并让自己变得更加强大。

english.title: Eye On the Prize
english.objectives: Kill Inquisitor Baleful and take his power.
english.description:
This demon has proved less than useful. I have been using the Scythe of Souls on it, but so far, it has resisted my inquiries. We will see how long that lasts.

I have a different idea...

There is a fresh inquisitor demon ahead. They are horrific fel casters who see through their floating eyes and specialize in dark pacts. If you steal its power, Jace Darkweaver could use some of it in his ritual to spy on the Legion.

Better yet, you will gain its power by ripping it from its smoking corpse.
english.giverWindow: Steal his essence and become more powerful.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭审判官贝弗尔并获取力量

text.title: 恶魔蛛后
text.objectives: 完成仪式以侦查燃烧军团首领。
text.description:
我们可以使用一些精华来完成仪式，然后你就能侦查燃烧军团的首领，看看他们有什么企图。

使用虚空坩埚完成仪式。

english.title: Meeting With the Queen
english.objectives: Complete the ritual to spy upon the Legion leaders.
english.description:
We can use some of that essence to complete my ritual. You'll be able to spy upon the Legion leaders and see what they're planning.

Use the nether crucible and complete the ritual.

text.title: 不择手段
text.objectives: 进入紫罗兰监狱，拷问毁灭者塔尔达斯以找出叛徒瓦雷迪斯的位置。
text.description: 我们必须把瓦雷迪斯给找出来——想要达到目的，我们的唯一办法就是进入这个监狱。$B$B要不择手段确保成功。

english.title: By Any Means
english.objectives: Gain entrance to the Violet Hold and interrogate Taldath the Destroyer to find out the location of the traitor Varedis.
english.description: We need to figure out what rock Varedis is hiding under - the only way we're going to do that is by getting inside this prison.$B$BDo what you must.

text.title: 造船
text.objectives: 记住图纸上的内容，然后销毁证据。
text.description: 要想制造舰船，我们需要做的第一件事是找到蓝图。在你的帮助下，我们得以在离开钢铁码头之前抢出了一批最好的图纸。$b$b我们最好保证这些图纸不至于落回到钢铁部落的手里。记住这些图纸，$c，然后销毁证据。等完成这项工作之后再告诉我。

english.title: Shipbuilding
english.objectives: Learn the blueprints and destroy the evidence.
english.description: The first thing we need to start building ships is a blueprint. With your help, I grabbed some of the best ones from the Iron Docks before we broke out of there.$b$bLet's make sure these don't fall back into the hands of the Iron Horde. Memorize these blueprints, $c, and then destroy the evidence. Let me know when you are done.

text.title: 造船进行时
text.objectives: 和亚纳斯交谈，开始建造一艘运输船。建造完成后，将它加入到你的船只收藏中。
text.description: 图纸已经拿到了，我们去造第一艘船吧，一艘运输船！准备好开工之后就过来和我谈谈吧。

english.title: Ship Shape
english.objectives: Speak with Yanas to begin construction on a transport ship.  Once complete, add it to your collection of ships.
english.description: Now that we have the blueprints, let's get started on our first ship, a transport!  Speak to me when you are ready to begin construction.

objectiveDetails.description: 等运输舰建造完成后举行下水仪式

text.title: 海军指挥官
text.objectives: 在你的船坞里找到梅里克·冯德，并完成一项海军行动。
text.description: 在这座船坞的建造过程中，我们在很短的时间里就完成了大量的工作，$n。现在该执行我们第一项海军行动，控制德拉诺的海上局面了！$b$b我得找个制高点设立事务所，并规划远洋任务。到船坞入口来见我吧。

english.title: Naval Commander
english.objectives: Find Merreck Vonder in your Shipyard and complete a Naval Mission.
english.description: We have come a long way in a short time on this shipyard, $n.  Now it's time to run our first naval mission and control the seas of Draenor!$b$bI will need to setup shop from a high vantage point to plan out these seafaring missions.  Meet me near the shipyard entrance and we can get started.

objectiveDetails.description: 在舰队指挥台旁找到梅里克·冯德
通过海军舰队控制台开始一次海军行动

text.title: Command of the Seas
text.objectives: Upgrade to a Level 2 shipyard.
text.description: Gul'dan wasted no time integrating his Shadow Council minions into every rank of the Iron Horde. The naval fleet that once owed loyalty only to Grommash is now his to command. If we want to fight back, we're going to need more than just a couple of transport ships. We must build an arsenal.$b$bWe need your expertise, commander. Upgrade your dockyards and create a fleet capable of dominating the seas!

english.title: Command of the Seas
english.objectives: Upgrade to a Level 2 shipyard.
english.description: Gul'dan wasted no time integrating his Shadow Council minions into every rank of the Iron Horde. The naval fleet that once owed loyalty only to Grommash is now his to command. If we want to fight back, we're going to need more than just a couple of transport ships. We must build an arsenal.$b$bWe need your expertise, commander. Upgrade your dockyards and create a fleet capable of dominating the seas!

text.title: Critters of Draenor
text.objectives: Defeat Erris the Collector in a pet battle.
text.description: I love collecting pets, and I've picked up a few unusual pets here in Draenor.  What would you say to a battle?  If you can defeat my humble team, I think we'll both learn a few new tricks.

english.title: Critters of Draenor
english.objectives: Defeat Erris the Collector in a pet battle.
english.description: I love collecting pets, and I've picked up a few unusual pets here in Draenor.  What would you say to a battle?  If you can defeat my humble team, I think we'll both learn a few new tricks.

text.title: 除妖
text.objectives: 在灰色哨所与吉恩·格雷迈恩见面。
text.description:
那个说着奇怪的话的维库人说我也许能在这里遇到你。我带来了格雷迈恩的命令。他可能掌握了关于希尔瓦娜斯下落的线索。

他在山脚附近搭建了营地。但我们遇到了一些麻烦。部落似乎已经盯上了我们的地盘。

我们需要你的帮助。你可以乘坐我的狮鹫，准备好就告诉我。
text.completion: It is good you arrived when you did, $n.

english.title: To Catch a Banshee
english.objectives: Meet with Genn Greymane in Greywatch.
english.description:
The strange-talking vrykul said I might be able to meet you here. I have orders from Greymane.  It seems he may have a lead on Sylvanas' location.

He's set up a camp near the base of the mountain. We've run into some troubles, though. It looks like the Horde may have homed in on our position.

We could use your help. You can take my gryphon. Just speak to me when you're ready to leave.
english.completion: It is good you arrived when you did, $n.

text.title: 烧尽瘟疫
text.objectives: 烧掉灰色哨所周围的被遗忘者瘟疫箱子。
text.description:
我们的确发现了希尔瓦娜斯的线索。虽然我也想尽快解决掉女妖之王，但灰色哨所的危机才是当务之急。

昨天，一队守卫在树林中发现了被遗忘者的踪迹。其中几个人回来后出现了染上瘟疫的迹象，就和吉尔尼斯爆发的一样。看来这些被遗忘者想要在灰色哨所里释放瘟疫。

在疫病爆发之前找出他们的瘟疫箱子，然后摧毁掉！
text.completion: The deed is done. $B$BYou have done a great service to the worgen of Greywatch, $n.

english.title: Combustible Contagion
english.objectives: Burn the Forsaken Blight Caches near Greywatch.
english.description:
It is true that we may have a lead on Sylvanas. Though I want nothing more than to get my hands on the Banshee Queen, the situation here at Greywatch requires immediate attention.

Yesterday, a regiment of guards returned with word of Forsaken forces in the woods. Several of them bore signs of a blight, similar to the one we endured in Gilneas. It would appear these Forsaken seek to unleash this blight upon Greywatch.

Seek out their caches and destroy them, before the blight overtakes us!
english.completion: The deed is done. $B$BYou have done a great service to the worgen of Greywatch, $n.

text.title: 荫蔽密语
text.objectives: 从灰色哨所周围的亡灵骑兵追猎者和亡灵骑兵疫病使者身上收集被遗忘者侦察指令。
text.description:
我们对部落在这个地区的活动仍然知之甚少，希望你能改变这个情况。

最近，林地里到处都是希尔瓦娜斯的密探。我们捉到的几个人身上都携带着黑暗游侠的指令。希尔瓦娜斯在这个地区的部队想必就是由他们指挥。

你在行动的时候要多注意那些侦察指令，它们有助于我们找出希尔瓦娜斯在这里的目标。
text.completion: Excellent. The puzzle is finally coming together. $B$BWe may not know why Sylvanas' forces are here, but I think we know where they are.

english.title: Whispers from the Dark
english.objectives: Collect the Forsaken Scouting Orders from Dread-Rider Stalkers and Dread-Rider Plaguebringers near Greywatch.
english.description:
We still have little knowledge of the Horde's activities in the region, but I'm hoping you can help change that.

Lately the woods have been crawling with Sylvanas' agents. The few we have taken out carried orders from her Dark Rangers, who are no doubt in command of her forces here.

While you're on the hunt, keep an eye out for any scouting orders. They may help us pinpoint Sylvanas' objective in the area.
english.completion: Excellent. The puzzle is finally coming together. $B$BWe may not know why Sylvanas' forces are here, but I think we know where they are.

text.title: 前往斯考德-艾希尔
text.objectives: 到克罗雷的瞭望所去见指挥官罗娜·克罗雷。
text.description:
有她的线索了！这些报告里提到，希尔瓦娜斯的部队正在斯考德-艾希尔寻找什么。那是一个离这不远的维库城镇，我们应该前去追查她的下落。

我之前已经派出了指挥官罗娜·克罗雷和吉尔尼斯旅的一个分遣队到那里进行侦察。去跟她汇合，并查明希尔瓦娜斯到底有什么企图。

与此同时，我会召集舰队突袭他们的岗哨。如果非得把他们的营地拆成一堆瓦砾才能伸张正义，我也绝对不会手软！
text.completion: So the cavalry has arrived? $B$BGood, we must make haste if we wish to uncover Sylvanas' plot before it comes to bear.

english.title: To Skold-Ashil
english.objectives: Meet with Commander Lorna Crowley in Crowley's Overlook.
english.description:
We have her now! According to these reports, Sylvanas' forces are after something in Skold-Ashil - a vrykul town not far from here. We must make our way there and track her down.

I had previously dispatched Commander Lorna Crowley and a detachment of Gilneas Brigade to scout the position. Meet up with her there and find out what Sylvanas is after.

Meanwhile, I will muster the fleet to assault their outpost. We will have justice if I have to reduce their camp to rubble!
english.completion: So the cavalry has arrived? $B$BGood, we must make haste if we wish to uncover Sylvanas' plot before it comes to bear.

text.title: 盾牌的秘密
text.objectives: 在斯考德-艾希尔检查6面雕饰维库盾牌。
text.description:
现在已经很明显了，斯考德-艾希尔有部落想要的东西。不幸的是，我们还不知道他们到底想要什么。

我们认为这个秘密跟女武神有关，所以我们必须进一步了解她们。之前的侦察结果显示，她们有一种传统是将她们的故事铭刻在盾牌上。

进入城市，尽你所能寻找这些盾牌。如果运气够好，我们就能查明希尔瓦娜斯想要的是什么了。
text.completion: Val'kyr, you say? This is worse that I had imagined. If Sylvanas is able to create more Val'kyr, there will be no limit to her armies!$B$BIt seems the vault is her goal. We must stop her!

english.title: Shielded Secrets
english.objectives: Examine 6 Engraved Vrykul Shields in Skold-Ashil.
english.description:
It's obvious at this point that the Horde wants something in Skold-Ashil. Unfortunately we still don't know what they're after.

We think the secret lies with the shieldmaidens here, so we need to find out more about them. Some early scouting revealed that they have a method of carving their shields to tell their stories. 

Go into the city and find as many of these shields as you can. With luck, we will find what Sylvanas seeks.
english.completion: Val'kyr, you say? This is worse that I had imagined. If Sylvanas is able to create more Val'kyr, there will be no limit to her armies!$B$BIt seems the vault is her goal. We must stop her!

text.title: 升级舰队
text.objectives: 收集1000份要塞资源，1000金币，并完成15次海军行动。
text.description: 干得漂亮，指挥官。然而，我们还需要更多的经验和资源才能升级这座船坞。等我们达到目标之后，我们就能提升船坞的容量，拥有更多舰船了！

english.title: Upgrading The Fleet
english.objectives: Collect 1000 garrison resources, 1000 gold and complete 15 naval missions.
english.description: You have been doing a great job out there commander.  However, we are going to need more experience and resources to upgrade this shipyard.  Once we reach our goals, we can upgrade the capacity of the shipyard to hold more ships!

text.title: 制海权
text.objectives: 收集2500份要塞资源，2500金币，并完成25次海军寻宝行动。
text.description: 制海权仍在我们的掌握之中！$b$b然而，我们需要更多的经验和资源才能继续提升这座船坞的等级。达到目标之后，我们就能提升船坞的容量，拥有更多舰船了！

english.title: Naval Domination
english.objectives: Collect 2500 garrison resources, 2500 gold and complete 25 naval treasure missions.
english.description: Our naval domination continues!$b$bHowever, we are going to need even more experience and resources to take this shipyard to the next level.  Once we reach our goals, we can upgrade the capacity of the shipyard to hold even more ships!

text.title: 7.0 Val'sharah - Treasure 025 - The Archdruid's Den - twh

english.title: 7.0 Val'sharah - Treasure 025 - The Archdruid's Den - twh

text.title: 7.0 Val'sharah - Treasure 027 - Temple of Elune - twh

english.title: 7.0 Val'sharah - Treasure 027 - Temple of Elune - twh

text.title: 开始干活
text.objectives: 在干船坞与索洛格碰头。
text.description: 现在有了这座船坞，就该忙着造船了！索洛格已经去了干船坞，你要不要去那里见见他？他说他已经有主意了。
text.giverWindow: 在干船坞与索洛格碰头。

english.title: Let's Get To Work
english.objectives: Meet Solog at the dry docks.
english.description: Now that the shipyard is complete, we need to get busy making ships!  Solog ran off to the dry docks, why don't you meet him down there?  He said he had a plan.
english.giverWindow: Find Solog Roark at the dry docks.

text.title: 7.0 Val'sharah - Bonemelt Grotto - Large Treasure 040 - zto

english.title: 7.0 Val'sharah - Bonemelt Grotto - Large Treasure 040 - zto

text.title: 杀光他们！
text.objectives: 杀死200名敌对玩家。
text.description: 找到他们，追猎他们，杀死他们。给我们的敌人上一堂永生难忘的课！

english.title: Slay Them All!
english.objectives: Slay 200 enemy players.
english.description: Find them, hunt them, kill them. Teach our enemies a lesson they'll never forget.

text.title: 成为晋升者
text.objectives: 在斯考德-艾希尔神殿的四座祭坛获得祝福，然后与雕像沟通。
text.description:
现在我们的目标很明确了。我们必须进入宝库，阻止希尔瓦娜斯获得创造更多瓦格里的力量。 

入口处有屏障，难怪她在这里耗了这么久，不过你似乎已经找到了破除屏障的关键。

你必须成为下一位晋升者。

完成盾牌上面描述的仪式，并打开宝库入口的屏障。我会把我们所知的情况转告给格雷迈恩——他一定希望亲自面对希尔瓦娜斯。
text.completion: It is good to see you, $n. $B$BThe assault on Dreadwake's Landing fared poorly, and I had thought our cause lost until Crowley informed me of your success.$B$BNow, let's finish this!

english.title: Becoming the Ascendant
english.objectives: Seek the blessings at the four shrines in the temple at Skold-Ashil, then commune with the statue.
english.description:
Our course is now clear. We must enter the vault and prevent Sylvanas from obtaining the power to create more Val'kyr. 

The entrance is barred, which is likely what has kept her out so far, but you may have already uncovered the key to this barrier.

You must become the next ascendant.

Complete the rites as depicted on the shields and take down the barrier to the vault. I will send word to Greymane of our findings - he will wish to confront Sylvanas himself.
english.completion: It is good to see you, $n. $B$BThe assault on Dreadwake's Landing fared poorly, and I had thought our cause lost until Crowley informed me of your success.$B$BNow, let's finish this!

text.title: 杀光他们！
text.objectives: 击杀200名部落成员。
text.description: 绝不能容忍部落的入侵。把他们都干掉！

english.title: Slay Them All!
english.objectives: Slay 200 enemy players.
english.description: The Horde encroachment cannot be tolerated. Dwindle their numbers to the ground!

text.title: 7.0 Val'sharah - Grove of Cenarius - Medium Treasure 044 - ZTO

english.title: 7.0 Val'sharah - Grove of Cenarius - Medium Treasure 044 - ZTO

text.title: 更高的分数
text.objectives: 收集肮脏的铁币并把它们交给格里伏塔。
text.description: 那些塔纳安的蠢货，他们身上带着各种各样的财富。情况还很复杂，但我现在已经有很多东西可以给你了！

english.title: An Even Bigga Score
english.objectives: Obtain Dingy Iron Coins for Griftah.
english.description: So these mooks in Tanaan, they be carryin' all manner of valuable treasures. It still be complicated, but I can give ya a lot more now!

text.title: 猎隼止声
text.objectives: 沿着鲑鱼溪找到烂喙，然后砍下它的脑袋。
text.description: 老爸热爱这个村庄。就算在如此恐怖的时刻，他也听不进任何要离开的建议。$B$B他离世之前告诉我，攻击他的是一只被我们称为烂喙的可怕猎隼。$B$B你正在对付这些亡灵，对吗？你可以帮我的父亲报仇吗？如果可以的话，往西北方向走就能找到那只禽兽，它正在通往海边的路上徘徊。
text.completion: Thank you. Grisly, eh? I think I'll mount it over the door.$B$BI want you to have this, too. Fresh-caught mossgill was Papa's favorite.

english.title: Shriek No More
english.objectives: Find Rotbeak along the Bradensbrook, and collect the beast's head.
english.description: Papa loved this village. He'd never hear of leaving, even in these dread times.$B$BBefore he died, he told me what attacked him: a monstrous falcon we call Rotbeak.$B$BYou're fighting these undead, aren't you? Will you avenge my father? If so, you can find the beast northwest of here, patrolling our western route to the sea.
english.completion: Thank you. Grisly, eh? I think I'll mount it over the door.$B$BI want you to have this, too. Fresh-caught mossgill was Papa's favorite.

text.title: 突袭斯考德-艾希尔
text.objectives: <放入>
text.description: <放入>

english.title: Assault on Skold-Ashil
english.objectives: <insert>
english.description: <insert>

text.title: 扼杀在摇篮
text.objectives: 在艾尔的宝库对战希尔瓦娜斯。
text.description:
女妖之王就在这里！不论在什么地方，我都能认出她那污秽的箭矢。

我们所有的奋斗都是为了这一刻。希尔瓦娜斯必须为她对瓦里安·乌瑞恩和整个联盟犯下的罪行付出代价！

拿起武器！
text.completion: You're awake! We nearly lost you there... $B$BIt's a good thing we managed to get you and Greymane out of there in time, otherwise we wouldn't have been able to reverse Sylvanas's poison. It's a shame she got away, but her plans in Skold-Ashil failed and we have you to thank for it. $B$BI'm sure Greymane will order a commendation for you once he is fully recovered. You did a great thing here, $n. $B$BGilneas is in your debt.

english.title: Ending the New Beginning
english.objectives: Confront Sylvanas in the Vault of Eyir.
english.description:
The Banshee Queen is here! I'd recognize those tainted arrows anywhere.

This is the moment we have been fighting for. Sylvanas will answer for her crimes against Varian Wrynn and the Alliance!

To arms!
english.completion: You're awake! We nearly lost you there... $B$BIt's a good thing we managed to get you and Greymane out of there in time, otherwise we wouldn't have been able to reverse Sylvanas's poison. It's a shame she got away, but her plans in Skold-Ashil failed and we have you to thank for it. $B$BI'm sure Greymane will order a commendation for you once he is fully recovered. You did a great thing here, $n. $B$BGilneas is in your debt.

text.title: 追猎雄狮
text.objectives: 在松岩盆地猎杀松岩追猎者和松岩徘徊者。
text.description:
这片山岭里的狮子擅于从远处伏击猎物。这些野兽会攻击任何进入它们视野的猎物，包括$r。

虽然大部分的猎物都无法抵挡如此可怕的掠食者，但是在我的狩猎队伍中，每个人都能够打败这些野兽。

去干掉几只追猎者，证明你的狩猎能力。
text.completion: Not a scratch on ya that I can see. I bet those lions never saw ya comin'!

english.title: Lion Stalkin'
english.objectives: Hunt Pinerock Stalkers and Prowlers in Pinerock Basin.
english.description:
The hills are crawlin' with lions that stalk their prey from afar. These big cats will pounce at anything that catches their eye, including |5$r. 

While most would fall to such a formidable predator, anyone in my huntin' party would be able to best those beasts.

Prove you've got what it takes by taking down a few of those stalkers.
english.completion: Not a scratch on ya that I can see. I bet those lions never saw ya comin'!

objectiveDetails.description: 猎杀松岩追猎者和松岩徘徊者

text.title: 猎杀大角鹿
text.objectives: 在松岩盆地猎杀松岩大角鹿。
text.description:
至高岭是野生动物的乐园，这里的生物独一无二、别无可寻。告诉我，$n，你仔细观察过驼鹿没有？

四处闲逛的大角鹿看起来可能只是温顺的大个儿，但只有傻瓜才会低估它们的实力。

即使对你这种老练的猎手来说，猎杀它们也会是一项艰巨的挑战。
text.completion: You've hunted the Highmountain Elderhorn and lived to tell about it. That's not a feat that most can say they've accomplished. Color me impressed.

english.title: Moose Shootin'
english.objectives: Hunt Pinerock Elderhorn in Pinerock Basin.
english.description:
Highmountain is home to wildlife that can't be hunted anywhere else in the world. Tell me, $n, have you ever laid eyes on a moose before? 

The roaming Elderhorn may look like gentle giants, but only a fool would underestimate their strength. 

They should prove to be a good challenge, even for someone as experienced as you.
english.completion: You've hunted the Highmountain Elderhorn and lived to tell about it. That's not a feat that most can say they've accomplished. Color me impressed.

text.title: Demon Destroyer
text.objectives: Slay Doomcaller, Sneermaw, and Grinchain
text.description:
The demons spreading this corruption must be dealt with. Kill their generals and their plans will unravel.

I have a gift for you. This horn was given to me by Odyn himself, use it to strike down all that stand in your way.

The gods will surely smile upon you if you thwart the advances of Legion.

english.title: Demon Destroyer
english.objectives: Slay Doomcaller, Sneermaw, and Grinchain
english.description:
The demons spreading this corruption must be dealt with. Kill their generals and their plans will unravel.

I have a gift for you. This horn was given to me by Odyn himself, use it to strike down all that stand in your way.

The gods will surely smile upon you if you thwart the advances of Legion.

text.title: 城墙之外
text.objectives: 去螳螂高原的龙影岗哨和祝踏岚谈一谈。
text.description: 我们收到消息说影踪派已经开始对螳螂高原进行反击了，他们好像正沿着野牛人入侵的方向行进。$b$b熊猫人已经有数千年之久没踏足过螳螂高原了。影踪派的弟子虽然勇猛顽强，但同样也刚愎自用，他们需要像你这样的英雄帮助。你能前往西北方的冬花关吗？找到影踪派的首领并提供你的经验和帮助？
text.completed: 去螳螂高原的龙影岗哨和祝踏岚谈一谈。

english.title: Beyond the Wall
english.objectives: Speak with Taran Zhu at the Longying Outpost in Townlong Steppes.
english.description: We received word the Shado-Pan have begun a counter attack in to Townlong Steppes. It sounds like they are going after the root of the yaungol invasion.$b$bThe pandaren have not traveled in force in to Townlong for thousands of years. The Shado-Pan are strong and brave, but they are also proud and few. They will need help from heroes like yourself. Can you travel through the Gate of Winter's Blossom in the northwest? Find the Shado-Pan leaders and lend your help and experience?
english.completed: Speak with Taran Zhu at the Longying Outpost in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 7.0 Val'sharah - River: Vignette: Purging the River - TRACKING - twh

english.title: 7.0 Val'sharah - River: Vignette: Purging the River - TRACKING - twh

text.title: Possessions of Power
text.objectives: Seek those who may offer insight into the origins of the shard.
text.description: Echoes of a thousand worlds swirl in the palm of your hand. Its true value lies in the eye of the beholder.

english.title: Possessions of Power
english.objectives: Seek those who may offer insight into the origins of the shard.
english.description: Echoes of a thousand worlds swirl in the palm of your hand. Its true value lies in the eye of the beholder.

text.title: 无暇谈话
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个暴怒的琥珀碎片。
text.description: 达古尔派出了他的走狗来对付我们。$b$b我们必须把这些元素统统消灭，以免它们去祸害雷霆图腾。
text.completion: It has been a long time since the earth itself has moved against us like this.

english.title: No Time to Talk
english.objectives: Destroy $1oa Enraged Ambershard.
english.description: Dargrul has sent his pets to do battle with us.$b$bWe need to crush these elementals before their rage swarms into Thunder Totem.
english.completion: It has been a long time since the earth itself has moved against us like this.

text.title: 怒裂
text.objectives: 消灭怒裂。
text.description: 地底之王用卡兹格罗斯之锤把山岭变成了我们的敌人。圣锤是创世的工具，可不能被他如此玷污！$b$b此时此刻，他的水晶仆从怒裂正在驱使元素从山岭中倾泻而出，伤害我的人民。$b$b我们必须守住大桥，抵御他们的攻击。$b$b进入洞穴找到怒裂，然后把它的碎块还给他的主人。
text.completion: I suspect this is not the last of Dargrul's assaults. He is still learning the powers of the Hammer like a child with a new toy.
text.giverWindow: 受卓格巴尔召唤前来摧毁雷霆图腾。

english.title: Wrathshard
english.objectives: Slay Wrathshard.
english.description: The Underking has used the Hammer of Khaz'goroth to render the mountainside into a weapon against us. The hammer is a tool for creation, not a weapon for his amusement!$b$bEven now, his crystal servant, Wrathshard, is driving these elementals out of the mountain down upon my people.$b$bWe must hold the bridge against this onslaught.$b$bEnter the cave, find Wrathshard, and send him back to his master in pieces.
english.completion: I suspect this is not the last of Dargrul's assaults. He is still learning the powers of the Hammer like a child with a new toy.
english.giverWindow: Summoned by the drogbar to destroy Thunder Totem.

text.title: Unused
text.objectives: Defeat Kiranys Duskwhisper at the haunted manor in Bradensbrook.
text.description: You've charged up the gun. Now it's time to use it. Go and confront the ghostly wizard Kiranys Duskwhisper, and drive him out of Bradensbrook.

english.title: Unused
english.objectives: Defeat Kiranys Duskwhisper at the haunted manor in Bradensbrook.
english.description: You've charged up the gun. Now it's time to use it. Go and confront the ghostly wizard Kiranys Duskwhisper, and drive him out of Bradensbrook.

text.title: 理论测试
text.objectives: 对被禁锢的小鬼使用血石。
text.description:
现在血石已经吃饱了，我希望利用它的力量来控制恶魔的意志，不然可没那么容易让他们乖乖听话。

当然，这一切只是理论。我从没见过血石的力量对恶魔会有什么直接影响。所以我需要你的帮助。

我捉了一些小鬼，它们应该很适合当我们的测试对象。对它们使用血石，然后告诉我效果如何。

english.title: Testing a Theory
english.objectives: Use the Bloodstone on an Imprisoned Imp.
english.description:
Now that the Bloodstone has fed, I hope to use its power to bend the will of demons that would otherwise not be so easily controlled.

Of course, this is all theory. I have never witnessed the direct effect of the Bloodstone's power on a demon. This is where you come in.

I have procured a few imps that should make suitable test subjects. Use the Bloodstone on them and report back to me with your findings.

text.title: 村庄危机
text.objectives: 在鲑鱼溪与希斯罗镇长谈一谈。
text.description: 又是一个外来者？刚有个叫杰罗德的小子跑过这条路，进到我们的村子里，号称他也许可以帮我们解决问题。$b$b如果你也是来帮忙的，那你最好和我们的镇长谈谈。$b$b不过提醒你，现在的时机可不好，而且他的脾气也很差。

english.title: A Village in Peril
english.objectives: Speak to Mayor Heathrow at Bradensbrook.
english.description: Another outsider? Some bloke named Jarod just went off to our village down the road claiming he might be able to help us with our problem.$b$bIf you're here to help as well, then you best speak to the Mayor.$b$bJust know this is a bad time, and he's got an itchy trigger finger.

text.title: 惊魂港危机
text.objectives: 在格雷迈恩先遣营地消灭10名灰色哨所破坏者或者渗透者。
text.description:
现在局势正朝着可怕的方向发展，$n。惊魂港只有象征性的少数兵力留守，格雷迈恩的突袭让我们措手不及，伤亡人数正在不断增加。

海滩上全是狼人渗透者，如果火炮攻破了我们的防线，他们很可能会将我们一举歼灭。我们的兵力太过分散，无法抵抗他们的攻势，但是你可以改变这一劣势。

把他们清掉！

english.title: Dreadwake's Dilemma
english.objectives: Kill 10 Greywatch Saboteurs or Infiltrators in Greymane's Offensive.
english.description:
The situation has taken a dire turn, $n. We were unprepared for Greymane's sudden assault, with only a token force left behind at Dreadwake's Landing, and we are paying the toll.

The beach is now swarming with worgen infiltrators, and if the cannons breach our defenses, they will likely swarm in on us. We're spread too thin here to take the fight to them, but you could change that.

Wipe them out.

text.title: 前往斯考德-艾希尔
text.objectives: 到斯考德-艾希尔外面的游侠据点去找黑暗游侠。
text.description:
感谢你的主动出击，$c，惊魂港的情况总算得到了控制。不过，我们没有时间庆祝胜利，我们必须完成希尔瓦娜斯的任务。

黑暗游侠们正在河流交汇处的高塔部署斯考德-艾希尔的行动。到那里去找他们，看看你能帮上什么忙。

english.title: To Skold-Ashil
english.objectives: Meet with the dark rangers in Ranger's Foothold, outside of Skold-Ashil.
english.description:
Thanks to your initiative, $c, the situation at Dreadwake's Landing is under control. We have no time to rest on our laurels, however - Sylvanas's mission must still be carried out.

The dark rangers are heading up operations in Skold-Ashil from the tower overlooking the river junction. Seek them out there, and see if you can aid in completing this task.

text.title: 成为晋升者
text.objectives: 在斯考德-艾希尔神殿的四座祭坛获得祝福，然后与雕像沟通。
text.description:
雕刻的内容似乎是一种升格仪式，让女武神可以进入宝库。我觉得我们可以好好利用这一点。

你必须成为下一位晋升者。

到神殿去完成仪式。如果非得踏过女武神的尸体才能办到，那就不要心慈手软。 

完成任务之后回来找我，然后我们就为部落攻下这座宝库！

english.title: Becoming the Ascendant
english.objectives: Seek the blessings at the four shrines in the temple at Skold-Ashil, then commune with the statue.
english.description:
It would seem that the engravings depict a rite of ascension, which allows the shieldmaidens to enter the vault. I believe we can use this to our advantage.

You must become the next ascendant.

Go to the temple and perform the rites. Should you need to wade through the corpses of the shieldmaidens to do so, then so be it. 

Find me when you have completed this task, and we will take the vault for the Horde!

text.title: 埃比希斯宝石
text.objectives: 去塔纳安丛林找太阳贤者查基斯。
text.description: 听着，头儿，我知道你是个珠宝匠。这没问题，我完全能理解——我也喜欢钱！$b$b我听到一些鸟人说他们在塔纳安弄到了某种新的宝石切割工具。我很想去看看，不过我得先解决了这座船坞里的麻烦再说。

english.title: Gems of the Apexis
english.objectives: Find Sun-Sage Chakkis in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: Listen, boss. I know you're a jewelcrafter. It's OK, I totally understand - I like money, too!$b$bI heard some of them bird fellas talking about some new gem-cuttin' device they got up in Tanaan. I'd be interested in checkin' it out myself, but I've got this whole shipyard mess to deal with right now.

text.title: 掌握塔迪拉特
text.objectives: 找到埃匹希斯宝石切割机构装体
text.description: 你——你是个珠宝匠，不是吗？你指节的动作和专注的眼神都是珠宝匠才有的。$b$b我正在塔纳安找一样东西。我们在阿兰卡的挖掘场并没有找到它……不过埃比希斯并不止在阿兰卡存在。$b$b我在找的是一台有背景的埃匹希斯构装体，专门用来切割宝石。沿途留意一下吧，珠宝匠。这样一台杰作可以让你我都受益非浅。

english.title: Mastery Of Taladite
english.objectives: Find the Apexis Gemcutting Construct.
english.description: You - you are a gemcutter, no? You have the look of it in the twitch of your knuckles, in the focus of your eyes.$b$bI've been looking for something specific out here in Tanaan. We did not find it in our excavations in Arak... but the Apexis did not only dwell in Arak.$b$bWhat I am looking for is a storied Apexis construct that specialized in cutting gems. Be on the lookout, jewelcrafter. Such a marvel could benefit the both of us.

text.title: 毁坏的构装体
text.objectives: 放入1000块埃匹希斯水晶，修复埃匹希斯宝石切割机。
text.description: <这台构装体年久失修，不过还没有损坏。最重要的是，它看上去似乎需要补充能量。>$b$b<机器背后有一个开放的插槽，等待着接受……埃比希斯用来当作能量源的东西。>

english.title: Ruined Construct
english.objectives: Repair the Apexis Gemcutter Construct by inserting 1000 Apexis Crystals.
english.description: <It is in disrepair, but it is not broken. More than anything, the construct appears to be in need of re-energizing.>$b$b<A slot on the backside of the machine lies open, waiting to accept... whatever the Apexis used as a source of energy.>

objectiveDetails.description: 修复埃匹希斯宝石切割机

text.title: 发狂驼鹿
text.objectives: 取得受诅咒的古代灵兽莫拉舒的犄角。
text.description:
猎人小屋里总有人提到盆地有一头发狂的驼鹿，说它正在制造恐怖。 

我还没亲眼见过那头野兽，他们说它的犄角会发出魔法的光芒。 

那些菜鸟猎人全都出手失败，你一定可以成功，然后把独一无二的战利品带回来给我！
text.completion: These antlers are going to look quite impressive hanging from the walls of the hunters' lodge.

english.title: Moose on the Loose
english.objectives: Collect the antlers of the cursed ancient spirit, Morashu.
english.description:
There's been chatter around the hunters' lodge about a crazed moose that is terrorizing the basin. 

I've never laid eyes on the beast myself, but they say its antlers are illuminated with magic. 

Where other lesser hunters have tried and failed, you will prevail, and collect me a one-of-a-kind trophy!
english.completion: These antlers are going to look quite impressive hanging from the walls of the hunters' lodge.

text.title: 血石大盗
text.objectives: 从纳拉什怨鳞女妖手里取得奇拉的血石。
text.description:
有一样对我很有价值的东西被抢走了，除非把它拿回来，否则我这边的工作就无法继续。

在大多数人眼中，它只是一块普通的石头。但是那块石头很不一般——它有生命，而且会呼吸！

任何东西，只要是带有魔法，总会被附近的纳迦抢走，我的石头也包括在内。幸好他们不知道怎么运用它的力量。

拿回我的石头，我就会考虑帮你。

english.title: Bloodstone Bandit
english.objectives: Recover Kira's Bloodstone from Narashi Spitescale.
english.description:
Something of personal value has been taken from me, and my work here cannot continue until I get it back.

To most it would appear to be an ordinary stone, but it is so much more than a simple rock - it lives and breathes!

The nearby naga have been snatching anything with any sort of magical significance, my stone included. Fortunately, they do not know how to access its power.

Return my stone to me, and I will consider your request for help.

text.title: 酋长的命令：赞加沼泽
text.objectives: 前往赞加沼泽的塞纳里奥庇护所，与伊谢尔·风歌谈一谈。
text.description: 塞纳里奥议会派驻外域的主要远征军组织被称为塞纳里奥远征队。尽管它最早是由塞纳里奥议会直接领导的探险队，但现在已经发展成了一支人数众多、完全独立的军队。$B$B远征队的首领伊谢尔·风歌希望我们能派些自愿者去她的哨站。前往赞加沼泽东部的塞纳里奥庇护所向她报告。沿着西边的大道一直往前走就到了。

english.title: Warchief's Command: Zangarmarsh
english.objectives: Speak to Ysiel Windsinger at the Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.
english.description: The Cenarion Circle's main expeditionary force in Outland is known as the Cenarion Expedition.  Though it began as a small venture controlled directly by the Cenarion Circle, it's become a large and fairly autonomous body.$B$BThe expedition's leader, Ysiel Windsinger, has asked us to direct volunteers to her outpost.  Report to her at the Cenarion Refuge in eastern Zangarmarsh.  Take the main path to the west and it will lead you directly there.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：赞加沼泽
text.objectives: 前往赞加沼泽的塞纳里奥庇护所，与伊谢尔·风歌谈一谈。
text.description: 塞纳里奥议会派驻外域的主要远征军组织被称为塞纳里奥远征队。尽管它最早是由塞纳里奥议会直接领导的探险队，但现在已经发展成了一支人数众多、完全独立的军队。$B$B远征队的首领伊谢尔·风歌希望我们能派些自愿者去她的哨站。前往赞加沼泽东部的塞纳里奥庇护所向她报告。沿着西边的大道一直往前走就到了。

english.title: Hero's Call: Zangarmarsh
english.objectives: Speak to Ysiel Windsinger at the Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.
english.description: The Cenarion Circle's main expeditionary force in Outland is known as the Cenarion Expedition.  Though it began as a small venture controlled directly by the Cenarion Circle, it's become a large and fairly autonomous body.$B$BThe expedition's leader, Ysiel Windsinger, has asked us to direct volunteers to her outpost.  Report to her at the Cenarion Refuge in eastern Zangarmarsh.  Take the main path to the west and it will lead you directly there.

text.title: 酋长的命令：泰罗卡森林
text.objectives: 与泰罗卡森林地区的塞纳里奥树林中的某位德鲁伊谈一谈。
text.description: 我们与塞纳里奥树林里的德鲁伊失去了联络。$B$B大酋长命令所有身强力壮的部落成员进入泰罗卡森林查明真相。$b$b你只需从赞加沼泽往泰罗卡森林方向走，穿过西北方的森林就能找到那地方。

english.title: Warchief's Command: Terokkar Forest
english.objectives: Speak with one of the druids at the Cenarion Thicket in Terokkar Forest.
english.description: We have lost contact with the druids of the Cenarion Thicket$B$BThe Warchief has commanded any able bodies of the Horde to venture into Terokkar Forest and discover what has happened.$b$bThe thicket can be found by heading northwest through Terokkar Forest from Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：泰罗卡森林
text.objectives: 与泰罗卡森林地区的塞纳里奥树林中的某位德鲁伊谈一谈。
text.description: 我们与塞纳里奥树林里的德鲁伊失去了联络。$B$B国王命令所有身强力壮的联盟成员进入泰罗卡森林查明真相。$b$b你只需从赞加沼泽往泰罗卡森林方向走，穿过西北方的森林就能找到那地方。

english.title: Hero's Call: Terokkar Forest
english.objectives: Speak with one of the druids at the Cenarion Thicket in Terokkar Forest.
english.description: We have lost contact with the druids of the Cenarion Thicket$B$BThe King has commanded any able bodies of the Alliance to venture into Terokkar Forest and discover what has happened.$b$bThe thicket can be found by heading northwest through Terokkar Forest from Zangarmarsh.

text.title: Warchief's Command: Nagrand
text.objectives: Speak with one of the druids at the Cenarion Thicket in Terokkar Forest.
text.description: We have lost contact with the druids of the Cenarion Thicket$B$BThe Warchief has commanded any able bodies of the Horde to venture into Terokkar Forest and discover what has happened.$b$bThe thicket can be found by heading northwest through Terokkar Forest from Zangarmarsh.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Nagrand
english.objectives: Speak with one of the druids at the Cenarion Thicket in Terokkar Forest.
english.description: We have lost contact with the druids of the Cenarion Thicket$B$BThe Warchief has commanded any able bodies of the Horde to venture into Terokkar Forest and discover what has happened.$b$bThe thicket can be found by heading northwest through Terokkar Forest from Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 破冰者的遗产
text.objectives: 说服马格纳·破冰者。
text.description:
最伟大的战士理应拥有最强大的武器。很久以前有一位伟大的国王，马格纳·破冰者，他的武器是由这片土地上最强大的巨龙的鳞片锻造而成。他本应来到这里，而不是在墓穴中日益腐朽，真是事与愿违。

他的儿子胡尼尔就在这里。他会带你前往墓穴。如果可以的话，请尽力拯救马格纳。不然，就带着他的武器回来。

english.title: Legacy of the Icebreaker
english.objectives: Deal with Magnar Icebreaker.
english.description:
The greatest warrior should wield the greatest weapons. Long ago a great king, Magnar Icebreaker, wielded weapons crafted from a scale of the mightiest dragon in the land. He should be here, but he is not. Instead he languishes in his tomb.

His son, Hruthnir, is here. He will lead you to the tomb. If Magnar can be saved, do so. Either way, return with his weapons.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用奥丁的传送门返回苍穹要塞

text.title: 奥丁的熔炉
text.objectives: 使用奥丁的熔炉。
text.description:
这个熔炉投入使用的时间比你们种族出现的时间还要久远；我们可能对你的武器略知一二。你的武器非常强大，需要我的私人熔炉才可以进行锻造。

如果你使用这把神器的经验已经足够，我们就可以对它进行强化。我们来试试吧？

english.title: The Forge of Odyn
english.objectives: Use the Forge of Odyn.
english.description:
This Forge has been working for longer than your race has existed; we might know a few things. Your weapon is powerful, it will take my personal forge in order to work it.

We can work the artifact to provide various improvements, provided you have enough experience with it. Let's give it a try shall we?

objectiveDetails.description: 使用奥丁的熔炉为你的神器灌魔

text.title: Hellfire Assault
text.objectives: Defeat the Hellfire Assault in Hellfire Citadel.
text.description:
If you are to breach the walls of the citadel, you must first face siege equipment and forces led by Siegemaster Mar'tak.

I wish you luck in gaining entry to Hellfire Citadel with your limbs intact.
text.completed: Return to Rokhan in your garrison.

english.title: Hellfire Assault
english.objectives: Defeat the Hellfire Assault in Hellfire Citadel.
english.description:
If you are to breach the walls of the citadel, you must first face siege equipment and forces led by Siegemaster Mar'tak.

I wish you luck in gaining entry to Hellfire Citadel with your limbs intact.
english.completed: Return to Rokhan in your garrison.

text.title: 埃比希斯宝石
text.objectives: 去塔纳安丛林找太阳贤者查基斯。
text.description: 指挥官，我注意到你在四处征战之余，也没有忘了磨练你的珠宝加工技艺。这真的很令人敬佩。$b$b我无意间听到几个鸦人在谈论一种宝石切割装置，他们认为那东西就在塔纳安。据说这些情报都来自一个叫“查基斯”的家伙。$b$b我想你可能会感兴趣？

english.title: Gems of the Apexis
english.objectives: Find Sun-Sage Chakkis in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: Commander! I've noticed you have been keeping up with your jewelcrafting, despite all of this war going on. I find that to be most admirable.$b$bI overheard some of the arakkoa discussing a gemcutting device that they believe is located within Tanaan Jungle. They got their information from one named "Chakkis."$b$bJust thought you might be interested.

text.title: 酋长的命令：纳格兰
text.objectives: 前往纳格兰的加拉达尔，与克洛坎上尉谈一谈。
text.description: 大酋长要求所有身强力壮的部落勇士驰援玛格汉兽人的家园加拉达尔。$B$B加拉达尔位于南方的纳格兰。沿南部大道离开沼泽，在第一个岔路口东拐，看到湖畔的大型聚居点就是了。$B$B去找那里的克洛坎上尉，向他提供一切可能的协助。加拉达尔绝不能陷落！

english.title: Warchief's Command: Nagrand
english.objectives: Speak with Captain Kroghan at Garadar in Nagrand.
english.description: The Warchief has asked for any able bodied champions of the Horde to ride to the aid of Garadar.$B$BThe home of the Mag'har, lies to the south, in Nagrand. Take the southern road out of the marsh, then turn east at the first fork and look for a large settlement on the lake.$B$BReport to Captain Kroghan there and offer him what assistance you can. Garadar must not fall!

text.title: 英雄的召唤：纳格兰
text.objectives: 前往纳格兰，与塔拉的监护者莫布吉尔谈一谈。
text.description: 国王要你代表他前往纳格兰的库雷尼聚居点——塔拉。$b$b快去那里找监护者莫布吉尔接头吧。

english.title: Hero's Call: Nagrand
english.objectives: Speak with Warden Moi'bff Jill at Telaar in Nagrand.
english.description: The King has requested you represent him with the Kurunai settlement of Telaar in Nagrand.$b$bSeek out Warden Moi'bff Jill upon arrival.

text.title: 酋长的命令：刀锋山
text.objectives: 前往刀锋山的雷神要塞，与奈克塔尔谈一谈。
text.description: 大酋长正在召集勇士终结刀锋山的食人魔威胁。即刻前往北方的兽人要塞：雷神要塞，向奈克塔尔告知我们的境况。我们需要他所能提供的一切协助。

english.title: Warchief's Command: Blade's Edge Mountains
english.objectives: Travel to Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains and speak with Nekthar.
english.description: The Warchief is calling for champions to put an end to the ogre threat in Blade's Edge Mountains. Make your way north into the mountains, to the orcish stronghold of Thunderlord Stronghold and let Nekthar know of our plight. Any help he can spare would be most welcome.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：刀锋山
text.objectives: 前往刀锋山的希尔瓦纳与基亚隆谈一谈。
text.description: 驻扎在刀锋山的希尔瓦纳的联盟部队需要增援。$b$b国王已要求所有身强力壮的联盟成员前往赞加沼泽北缘的那座山脉。

english.title: Hero's Call: Blade's Edge Mountains
english.objectives: Speak with Kialon at Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
english.description: The Alliance forces of Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains require reinforcements.$b$bThe King has asked for any able bodied members of the Alliance to journey to the mountains along the northern border of Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 酋长的命令：虚空风暴
text.objectives: 向52区的火箭主管弗斯拉格报到。
text.description: 虚空风暴52区的地精正在征召有能力、有兴趣的勇士支援他们在该地区的行动。$b$b大酋长认为他们在该地区的位置以及所能提供的协助对于抵抗附近的凯尔萨斯部队将会大有帮助。$b$b你可以沿着刀锋山东北边的道路抵达52区，你只需要一路向前，就能看到那片逐渐破碎消散在扭曲虚空中的区域了。

english.title: Warchief's Command: Netherstorm
english.objectives: Report to Rocket-Chief Fuselage at Area 52.
english.description: The goblins of Area 52 in Netherstorm have called for assistance from any able bodied champions willing to provide them the support they need in their endevours.$b$bThe Warchief feels their position and aid in the region will provide a tactical advantage against the nearby forces of Kael'thas.$b$bArea 52 can be reached by following the northeastern road of Blade's Edge Mountains until you see the world crumbling away into the Twisting Nether.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：虚空风暴
text.objectives: 向52区的火箭主管弗斯拉格报到。
text.description: 虚空风暴52区的地精正在征召有能力、有兴趣的勇士支援他们在该地区的行动。$b$b国王认为他们在该地区的位置以及所能提供的协助对于抵抗附近的凯尔萨斯部队将会大有帮助。$b$b你可以沿着刀锋山东北边的道路抵达52区，你只需要一路向前，就能看到那片逐渐破碎消散在扭曲虚空中的区域了。

english.title: Hero's Call: Netherstorm
english.objectives: Report to Rocket-Chief Fuselage at Area 52.
english.description: The goblins of Area 52 in Netherstorm have called for assistance from any able bodied champions willing to provide them the support they need in their endevours.$b$bThe King feels their position and aid in the region will provide a tactical advantage against the nearby forces of Kael'thas.$b$bArea 52 can be reached by following the northeastern road of Blade's Edge Mountains until you see the world crumbling away into the Twisting Nether.

text.title: 酋长的命令：龙骨荒野
text.objectives: 前往阿格玛之锤，与大法师艾萨斯·夺日者的影像谈一谈。
text.description: 大酋长下令加强部落在龙骨荒野的阿格玛之锤的兵力。$b$b这座要塞不但是我们突袭冰冠的战略要地，还是遏制这片大地上肆虐的混乱魔法能量的关键。$b$b快去找大法师艾萨斯·夺日者报到吧。

english.title: Warchief's Command: Dragonblight
english.objectives: Speak with the Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer.
english.description: The Warchief wishes to reinforce the Horde's presence at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight.$b$bThe fortress is a vital staging point for our assault on Icecrown and pivotal to containing the chaotic magic energies being released throughout the land.$b$bReport to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver.

enders.name: 大法师艾萨斯·夺日者的影像

text.title: 英雄的召唤：龙骨荒野
text.objectives: 前往群星之墓，与大法师茉德拉的影像谈一谈。
text.description: 龙骨荒野的银色盟约部队需要冒险者协助他们阻止那里混乱的奥术力量撕裂这片土地。$b$b他们尤其欢迎擅长对抗亡灵和巨龙的志愿者。$b$b愿意协助他们的人可以去龙骨荒野的群星之墓找大法师茉德拉报到。

english.title: Hero's Call: Dragonblight
english.objectives: Speak with the Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest.
english.description: Volunteers are needed to aid the Silver Covenant forces in the Dragonblight as they attempt to counter the chaotic arcane energies that threaten to rip the land apart.$b$bThose skilled in fighting dragons and undead are greatly welcome.$b$BThose willing to answer the call should report to Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

text.title: 酋长的命令：灰熊丘陵
text.objectives: 前往灰熊丘陵的征服堡，向征服者克雷娜介绍你自己。
text.description: 我们收到了灰熊丘陵基地的求助信。快去找征服者克雷娜吧。$B$B她在努力保护那里的自然资源。但你到了那儿以后可要小心行事，传闻她比一般的兽人还要暴躁得多。$B$B从龙骨荒野一路向东就能找到她了。

english.title: Warchief's Command: Grizzly Hills
english.objectives: Present yourself to Conqueror Krenna at Conquest Hold in the Grizzly Hills.
english.description: We've received a request for help from our base in the Grizzly Hills. Go to see Conqueror Krenna.$B$BShe's attempting to secure all of the natural resources. Just watch your back around her. The word is that she's aggressive even for an orc.$B$BYou can reach her by traveling east from Dragonblight.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：灰熊丘陵
text.objectives: 去灰熊丘陵西部的琥珀松木营地找杜蒙特中尉。
text.description: 在我们把所有的注意力都放在坚守暮冬要塞、处理天谴之门一带的状况时，月溪旅正在努力穿越茂密的森林，与灰熊丘陵的那些不友好的居民进行战斗。他们希望能找到另一条通往冰冠冰川的道路。$B$B驻扎在琥珀松木营地的杜蒙特中尉正在征募无畏的强壮冒险者去探索未知的野外。你愿意去接受这份挑战吗？

english.title: Hero's Call: Grizzly Hills
english.objectives: Report to Lieutenant Dumont at Amberpine Lodge in western Grizzly Hills.
english.description: While we focus to hold our ground at Wintergarde and deal with the unfolding events of the Wrathgate, battalions from as far away as Westfall battle their way through the dense foliage and inhospitable denizens of Grizzly Hills. All in hopes of finding an alternate route into Icecrown.$B$BLieutenant Dumont, stationed at Amberpine Lodge, has enlisted the aid of able bodied citizens willing to risk life and limb in the uncharted wilds. Will you rise to meet this challenge?

text.title: 祖达克
text.objectives: 去祖达克找黑锋哨站的斯特凡·瓦杜。
text.description: 我们在祖达克的死亡骑士盟友急需英雄帮忙肃清巨魔领土上的天灾势力。$b$b有志于此的英雄可以前往西南方的黑锋哨站找斯特凡·瓦杜谈一谈。

english.title: Zul'Drak
english.objectives: Report to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.
english.description: Our death knight allies in Zul'Drak are in need of heroes to aid them in securing the troll lands from the scourge.$b$bThose willing to aid should travel to the southwestern camp of Ebon Watch and speak with Stefan Vadu there.

text.title: 索拉查盆地
text.objectives: 前往索拉查盆地的蛮藤谷与蒙特谈一谈。
text.description: 我们最后一次收到赫米特·奈辛瓦里的消息说，他组建了一支远征队深入索拉查盆地的丛林探险，但这支远征队此后就失去了联络。$b$b飞行员蒙特去给他们送补给的，结果也一去不回。$b$b我们需要征集志愿者组建一支远征队去寻找那支失踪的远征队。蒙特的飞行器最后一次出现是在索拉查盆地的日灼之柱南边的蛮藤谷。

english.title: Sholazar Basin
english.objectives: Speak with Monte Muzzleshot in the Wildgrowth Mangal of Sholazar Basin.
english.description: Hemet Nesingwary was last heard from leading an expedition into the jungle depths of Sholazar Basin. His expedition has not been heard from since.$b$bMonte Muzzleshot is a pilot who was dispatched to provide them supplies, but he hasn't returned, either.$b$bVolunteers are needed to mount an expedition to find the missing expedition. Monte's flying machine was last seen in the Wildgrowth Mangal south of the Suntouched Pillar in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 魔法王国达拉然
text.objectives: 前往达拉然的紫罗兰之门找大法师塞琳德拉。
text.description: 肯瑞托已经把他们的城市移动到了诺森德。$B$B达拉然城早已不在洛丹米尔湖畔的保护罩下了，这座城市如今靠魔法悬浮在了晶歌森林上空。$B$B他们认为你已经准备好往那里走一遭了，去找晶歌森林中的传送水晶吧。$B$B大法师塞琳德拉在那里等你。

english.title: The Magical Kingdom of Dalaran
english.objectives: Report to Archmage Celindra at The Violet Gate in Dalaran.
english.description: The Kirin Tor have moved their city here to Northrend.$B$BNo longer does Dalaran sit under its protective dome on the shores of Lordamere Lake. Now the city magically floats above the Crystalsong Forest.$B$BThey believe you to be ready for your journey to the city. Look for the teleportation crystal in Crystal Song Forest.$B$BWhen you arrive, seek out Archmage Celindra.

text.title: 索拉查盆地
text.objectives: 当你准备好动身前往索拉查盆地时，就与大法师伯塔鲁斯谈一谈。到达索拉查盆地之后，与蛮藤谷的蒙特谈一谈。
text.description: 我们最后一次收到赫米特·奈辛瓦里的消息说，他组建了一支远征队深入索拉查盆地的丛林探险，但这支远征队此后就失去了联络。$b$b飞行员蒙特去给他们送补给的，结果也一去不回。$b$b达拉然的大法师伯塔鲁斯为你准备了一架飞行器，可以带你去蒙特的飞行器最后一次出现的位置。

english.title: Sholazar Basin
english.objectives: Talk to Archmage Pentarus when you're ready to leave for Sholazar Basin. When you arrive, speak with Monte Muzzleshot in the Wildgrowth Mangal of Sholazar Basin.
english.description: Hemet Nesingwary was last heard from leading an expedition into the jungle depths of Sholazar Basin. His expedition has not been heard from since.$b$bMonte Muzzleshot is a pilot who was dispatched to provide them supplies, but he hasn't returned, either.$b$bArchmage Pentarus in Dalaran is standing by with a flying machine to take you to the last known location of Monte Muzzleshot.

text.title: 奥丁之眼
text.objectives: 前往奥丁之眼的位置。
text.description:
是时候打响艾泽拉斯保卫战了。我们为你准备了一个工具，帮助你在这里运筹帷幄。它叫做奥丁之眼。

请跟我来，我会带你到那里去。过去之后会有人教你怎么使用它。

english.title: The Eye of Odyn
english.objectives: Go to the Eye of Odyn.
english.description:
It is time to begin the war in Azeroth. We have prepared a tool for you to direct your warriors and your own operations from here. It is called the Eye of Odyn. 

If you will follow me, I will take you to it, and someone that will help you use it.

text.title: 别抱怨了，挖吧！
text.objectives: 阿什兰的哈里森·琼斯想让你调查阿什兰挖掘场的最深处：突破口。
text.description: 好吧，$n，好消息是我们的挖掘队在地下挖穿了某个秘库的外部房间。坏消息是，部落也在那儿。快去下面看看吧。

english.title: Don't Hate, Excavate!
english.objectives: Harrison Jones in Ashran wants you to investigate the deepest part of the Ashran Excavation, The Breach.
english.description: Well $n, the good news is that our excavation team breached a chamber below right outside some sort of vault. The bad news is that the Horde were there too. Go down there and take a look.

text.title: The Iron Bulwark
text.objectives: Defeat the Iron Reaver in Hellfire Citadel.
text.description:
The Siegemaster within Hellfire Citadel has been working on a special machine she calls the Iron Reaver.

With any luck, she has not yet completed its construction, but you know what happens when we rely on luck...
text.completed: Return to Rokhan in your garrison.

english.title: The Iron Bulwark
english.objectives: Defeat the Iron Reaver in Hellfire Citadel.
english.description:
The Siegemaster within Hellfire Citadel has been working on a special machine she calls the Iron Reaver.

With any luck, she has not yet completed its construction, but you know what happens when we rely on luck...
english.completed: Return to Rokhan in your garrison.

text.title: 玛诺洛斯熔池
text.objectives: 击败地狱火堡垒的考莫克。
text.description:
在地狱火堡垒中，他们正使用玛诺洛斯熔池的恶魔能量腐化一只玛戈隆。

你要是去那地方侦察的话，可要小心。

english.title: Pits of Mannoroth
english.objectives: Defeat Kormrok in Hellfire Citadel.
english.description:
In the Hellfire Citadel, they work to corrupt a magnaron with fel energy within the Pits of Mannoroth.

If you delve into the fel pools of that place, be on your guard.

text.title: Court of Blood
text.objectives: Defeat the Hellfire High Council in Hellfire Citadel.
text.description:
A council of orc clans has assembled and must be adjourned... permanently.

Gurtogg Bloodboil of the Bleeding Hollow, Jubei'thos of the Burning Blade, and Dia Darkwhisper of the Shadowmoon clan can all be found within the accursed walls of Hellfire Citadel.
text.completed: Return to Rokhan in your garrison.

english.title: Court of Blood
english.objectives: Defeat the Hellfire High Council in Hellfire Citadel.
english.description:
A council of orc clans has assembled and must be adjourned... permanently.

Gurtogg Bloodboil of the Bleeding Hollow, Jubei'thos of the Burning Blade, and Dia Darkwhisper of the Shadowmoon clan can all be found within the accursed walls of Hellfire Citadel.
english.completed: Return to Rokhan in your garrison.

text.title: Deadeye's Vision
text.objectives: Defeat Kilrogg Deadeye in Hellfire Citadel.
text.description:
Kilrogg Deadeye has led his clan down a dark path that he cannot return from.

Demon blood coursing through his veins, he awaits the moment of his death--or yours--in Hellfire Citadel.
text.completed: Return to Rokhan in your garrison.

english.title: Deadeye's Vision
english.objectives: Defeat Kilrogg Deadeye in Hellfire Citadel.
english.description:
Kilrogg Deadeye has led his clan down a dark path that he cannot return from.

Demon blood coursing through his veins, he awaits the moment of his death--or yours--in Hellfire Citadel.
english.completed: Return to Rokhan in your garrison.

text.title: 灵魂之喉
text.objectives: 击败地狱火堡垒的血魔。
text.description:
落入神圣陵墓奥金顿核心的塔隆戈尔吞噬了上百个德莱尼的灵魂，变成了一头臃肿的畸形怪物。

这个面目全非的兽人因此抛弃了旧名，给自己起了一个新名字：血魔。

english.title: Maw of Souls
english.objectives: Defeat Gorefiend in Hellfire Citadel.
english.description:
Falling into the heart of the mausoleum in Auchindoun, Teron'gor gorged upon hundreds of draenei souls, becoming a bloated abomination in the process. 

No longer recognizable as an orc, Teron'gor gave up his old name and has taken on the mantle of Gorefiend.

text.title: Iskar's Clutch
text.objectives: Defeat Shadow-Lord Iskar in Hellfire Citadel.
text.description:
I'm afraid I have bad news about someone we once trusted. The arakkoa known as Iskar has gone too far in his desire to regain flight, and has joined with Gul'dan to regain his highborn body.

With it came the price of fel corruption and being doomed to fall at your hands.
text.completed: Return to Rokhan in your garrison.

english.title: Iskar's Clutch
english.objectives: Defeat Shadow-Lord Iskar in Hellfire Citadel.
english.description:
I'm afraid I have bad news about someone we once trusted. The arakkoa known as Iskar has gone too far in his desire to regain flight, and has joined with Gul'dan to regain his highborn body.

With it came the price of fel corruption and being doomed to fall at your hands.
english.completed: Return to Rokhan in your garrison.

text.title: Amphitheater of the Eternal
text.objectives: Defeat the Soulbound Construct  in Hellfire Citadel.
text.description:
The Exarch betrayer, Socrethar, was defeated with the assistance of Lady Liadrin and Exarch Maladaar.

But, he has returned. His vile spirit  is now within the Soulbound Construct in Hellfire Citadel, and must be destroyed once again.
text.completed: Return to Rokhan in your garrison.

english.title: Amphitheater of the Eternal
english.objectives: Defeat the Soulbound Construct  in Hellfire Citadel.
english.description:
The Exarch betrayer, Socrethar, was defeated with the assistance of Lady Liadrin and Exarch Maladaar.

But, he has returned. His vile spirit  is now within the Soulbound Construct in Hellfire Citadel, and must be destroyed once again.
english.completed: Return to Rokhan in your garrison.

text.title: 暴君神殿
text.objectives: 击败地狱火堡垒的暴君维哈里。
text.description:
暴君维哈里曾是一名前途无量的守备官，结果却因不为人知的原因而投身黑暗。

去净化这名黑暗艾瑞达吧。

english.title: Temple of Tyranny
english.objectives: Defeat Tyrant Velhari in Hellfire Citadel.
english.description:
Tyrant Velhari was once a promising vindicator, but has turned to Shadow for reasons known only to her.

Purge this Eredar of darkness.

text.title: Grommash's Torment
text.objectives: Defeat Fel Lord Zakuun in Hellfire Citadel.
text.description:
We believe Grommash has not yet accepted Gul'dan's offer, and may even have avoided drinking the blood offered to him.

But Gul'dan has set Fel Lord Zakuun on Grommash. This demon is Gul'dan's best-known torturer.

I fear for Grommash. If he is turned, I fear for us all.
text.completed: Return to Rokhan in your garrison.

english.title: Grommash's Torment
english.objectives: Defeat Fel Lord Zakuun in Hellfire Citadel.
english.description:
We believe Grommash has not yet accepted Gul'dan's offer, and may even have avoided drinking the blood offered to him.

But Gul'dan has set Fel Lord Zakuun on Grommash. This demon is Gul'dan's best-known torturer.

I fear for Grommash. If he is turned, I fear for us all.
english.completed: Return to Rokhan in your garrison.

text.title: The Felborne Breach
text.objectives: Defeat Xhul'horac in Hellfire Citadel.
text.description:
Summoned by Gul'dan from the depths of the Twisting Nether, Xhul'horac is one of most powerful of the Void Revenants--a race of parasitic void-beings that tear holes through the planes of reality, consuming and absorbing the energies and beings within.

Gul'dan has twisted Xhul'horac, feeding him overwhelming fel energy, and using his powers to tear open the portals through which he plans to rally the forces of the Burning Legion.
text.completed: Return to Rokhan in your garrison.

english.title: The Felborne Breach
english.objectives: Defeat Xhul'horac in Hellfire Citadel.
english.description:
Summoned by Gul'dan from the depths of the Twisting Nether, Xhul'horac is one of most powerful of the Void Revenants--a race of parasitic void-beings that tear holes through the planes of reality, consuming and absorbing the energies and beings within.

english.completed: Return to Rokhan in your garrison.

text.title: 毁灭者高台
text.objectives: 击败地狱火堡垒的玛诺洛斯。
text.description:
我们还以为短时间内不用再担心玛诺洛斯了，可古尔丹比我们预计的还要强大。

玛诺洛斯即将回到这个世界。有人在地狱火堡垒中看到了他的骨架，我们必须在他恢复全部力量前干掉他。

english.title: Destructor's Rise
english.objectives: Defeat Mannoroth in Hellfire Citadel.
english.description:
We believed we were done with Mannoroth, at least for a time. But Gul'dan is more powerful than we had predicted.

Mannoroth is nearly back in this world. His bones have been seen within the citadel, and he must be destroyed before he can reach his full power.

text.title: 黑暗之门
text.objectives: 在地狱火堡垒击败阿克蒙德。
text.description:
我们听到流言说，艾瑞达中的某位顶尖强者即将通过黑暗之门降临这个世界。

假如这个传言是真的，那很有可能就是污染者阿克蒙德。要是让他毫无阻碍地进入这个世界，整个德拉诺恐怕都要完了。

english.title: The Black Gate
english.objectives: Defeat Archimonde in Hellfire Citadel.
english.description:
We have heard rumors that one of the strongest of the eredar could soon enter this world through the Black Gate.

If these rumors are to be believed, it could even be Archimonde the Defiler. Should he arrive uncontested, Draenor itself is likely to fall.

text.title: 别抱怨了，挖吧！
text.objectives: 阿什兰的贝洛克·辉刃想让你调查阿什兰挖掘场的最深处：突破口。
text.description: 啊，你来得真及时，$n。快，到矿井下面去看看我们发现了什么。你也许会在下面撞见联盟，但我相信那对你来说只是小菜一碟。

english.title: Don't Hate, Excavate!
english.objectives: Belloc Brightblade in Ashran wants you to investigate the deepest part of the Ashran Excavation, The Breach.
english.description: At last $n, you've arrived and not a moment too soon. Quick, go down into the mine and take a look at what we've discovered. You may run into some Alliance down there. It is a minor inconvenience that is easily remedied.

text.title: 十万火急
text.objectives: 在达拉然下水道与马迪亚斯·肖尔谈一谈。
text.description: $B$B军情七处的马迪亚斯·肖尔大师有要事相召，他在达拉然的地底等你。但要小心：据报道，下水道内常有人失踪。

english.title: Peak Urgency
english.objectives: Speak to Mathias Shaw in the sewers beneath Dalaran.
english.description: $B$BBYou've been summoned by Master Mathias Shaw of SI:7. He's waiting for you in the depths beneath Dalaran. Be wary - there have been reports of disappearances in those sewers.

text.title: 开始干活
text.objectives: 在干船坞与索洛格碰头。
text.description: 现在有了这座船坞，就该忙着造船了！索洛格已经去了干船坞，你要不要去那里见见他？他说他已经有主意了。
text.giverWindow: 在干船坞与索洛格碰头。

english.title: Let's Get To Work
english.objectives: Meet Solog at the dry docks.
english.description: Now that the shipyard is complete, we need to get busy making ships!  Solog ran off to the dry docks, why don't you meet him down there?  He said he had a plan.
english.giverWindow: Find Solog Roark at the dry docks.

text.title: 造船
text.objectives: 记住图纸上的内容，然后销毁证据。
text.description: 要想制造舰船，我们需要做的第一件事是找到图纸。在你的帮助下，我们得以在离开钢铁码头之前抢出了一批最好的图纸。$b$b我们最好保证这些图纸不至于落回到钢铁部落的手里。记住这些图纸，$c，然后销毁证据。等完成这项工作之后再告诉我。

english.title: Shipbuilding
english.objectives: Learn the blueprints and destroy the evidence.
english.description: The first thing we need to start building ships is a blueprint. With your help, I grabbed some of the best ones from the Iron Docks before we broke out of there.$b$bLet's make sure these don't fall back into the hands of the Iron Horde. Memorize these blueprints, $c, and then destroy the evidence. Let me know when you are done.

text.title: 造船进行时
text.objectives: 和索洛格交谈并开始建造一艘运输舰。建造完成后，将它加入到你的舰队。
text.description: 你想参加和古尔丹的战斗吗？那么就需要一艘运输船！等你准备好开始造船了再来和我说吧。

english.title: Ship Shape
english.objectives: Speak with Solog to begin construction on a transport ship. Once complete, add it to your collection of ships.
english.description: You want to take the fight to Gul'dan? You need a transport! Speak to me when you are ready to begin construction.

objectiveDetails.description: 等建造完成后操作运输舰

text.title: 海军指挥官
text.objectives: 在你的船坞找到若洛什·逐潮，完成一个海军行动。
text.description: 你天生就是干这个的，$n。你的血管里都流淌着海水。现在该执行我们第一项海军行动，控制德拉诺的海上局面了！$b$b你得找一个制高点来规划远洋任务。沿着我们身后这条路走过去，就有一个不错的地方。到船坞的入口附近和我碰头，开始我们的第一次行动吧。

english.title: Naval Commander
english.objectives: Find Rolash Wavechaser at your shipyard and complete a Naval Mission.
english.description: You're a natural at this, $n. You've got the salt in your veins. Now it's time to run our first naval mission and control the seas of Draenor!$b$bYou will want a high vantage point to plan out these seafaring missions.  I know a good spot just up the path behind us. Meet me near the shipyard entrance and we can get started on our first mission.

objectiveDetails.description: 在舰队指挥台旁找到若洛什·逐潮

text.title: 升级舰队
text.objectives: 收集1000份要塞资源，1000金币，并完成15次海军行动。
text.description: 干得漂亮，指挥官。然而，我们还需要更多的经验和资源才能升级这座船坞。等我们达到目标之后，我们就能提升船坞的容量，拥有更多舰船了！

english.title: Upgrading The Fleet
english.objectives: Collect 1000 garrison resources, 1000 gold and combat 15 naval missions.
english.description: You have been doing a great job out there commander.  However, we are going to need more experience and resources to upgrade this shipyard.  Once we reach our goals, we can upgrade the capacity of the shipyard to hold more ships!

text.title: 制海权
text.objectives: 收集2500份要塞资源，2500金币，并完成25次海军寻宝行动。
text.description: 制海权仍在我们的掌握之中！$b$b然而，我们需要更多的经验和资源才能继续提升这座船坞的等级。达到目标之后，我们就能提升船坞的容量，拥有更多舰船了！

english.title: Naval Domination
english.objectives: Collect 2500 garrison resources, 2500 gold and complete 25 naval treasure missions.
english.description: Our naval domination continues!$b$bHowever, we are going to need even more experience and resources to take this shipyard to the next level.  Once we reach our goals, we can upgrade the capacity of the shipyard to hold even more ships!

text.title: 猎杀行动
text.objectives: 从苏拉玛的瓦雷迪斯·邪魂手里取得欺诈者的双刃。
text.description: 这次的猎杀行动由你带队，$n——我们挑出了几名伊利达雷来配合你的行动，确保消灭瓦雷迪斯。$B$B因为小规模战队最有机会潜入他的地盘，所以其余人员会在后方留守。$B$B等你准备好以后就到克拉苏斯平台来跟我们碰头，我们会在那里送你出发。

english.title: The Hunt
english.objectives: Obtain the Twinblades of the Deceiver from Varedis Felsoul in Suramar.
english.description: This hunt is yours to lead, $n - a select few Illidari will join you to make sure Varedis meets his end.$B$BThe rest of us must stay behind; a small team will have the best chance of making it to his hold undetected.$B$BWe will meet you at Krasus' Landing to see you off when you are ready.

text.title: 玛诺洛斯熔池
text.objectives: 击败地狱火堡垒的考莫克。
text.description:
在地狱火堡垒中，他们正使用玛诺洛斯熔池的恶魔能量腐化一只玛戈隆。

你要是去那地方侦察的话，可要小心。

english.title: Pits of Mannoroth
english.objectives: Defeat Kormrok in Hellfire Citadel.
english.description:
In the Hellfire Citadel, they're corruptin' a magnaron with fel energy in the Pits o' Mannoroth.

If ye delve into the fel pools of that place, be on yer guard.

text.title: 灵魂之喉
text.objectives: 击败地狱火堡垒的血魔。
text.description:
落入神圣陵墓奥金顿核心的塔隆戈尔吞噬了上百个德莱尼的灵魂，变成了一头臃肿的畸形怪物。

这个面目全非的兽人因此抛弃了旧名，给自己起了一个新名字：血魔。

english.title: Maw of Souls
english.objectives: Defeat Gorefiend in Hellfire Citadel.
english.description:
Falling into the heart o' the mausoleum in Auchindoun, Teron'gor gorged upon hundreds o' draenei souls, becoming a bloated abomination in the process. 

No longer recognizable as an orc, Teron'gor gave up his old name and has taken on the mantle of Gorefiend.

text.title: 暴君神殿
text.objectives: 击败地狱火堡垒的暴君维哈里。
text.description:
暴君维哈里曾是一名前途无量的守备官，结果却因不为人知的原因而投身黑暗。

去净化这名黑暗艾瑞达吧。

english.title: Temple of Tyranny
english.objectives: Defeat Tyrant Velhari in Hellfire Citadel.
english.description:
Tyrant Velhari was once a promising vindicator, but has turned to Shadow for reasons known only to her.

Purge this Eredar of darkness.

text.objectives: 击败地狱火堡垒的玛诺洛斯。
text.description:
我们还以为短时间内不用再担心玛诺洛斯了，可古尔丹比我们想象的还要强大。

玛诺洛斯即将回到这个世界。有人在地狱火堡垒中看到了他的骨架，我们必须在他恢复全部力量前干掉他。

english.objectives: Defeat Mannoroth in Hellfire Citadel.
english.description:

Mannoroth is nearly back in this world. His bones have been seen within the citadel, and he must be destroyed before he can reach his full power.

text.objectives: 在地狱火堡垒击败阿克蒙德。
text.description:

假如这个传言是真的，那很有可能就是污染者阿克蒙德。要是让他毫无阻碍地进入这个世界，整个德拉诺恐怕都要完了。

english.title: The Black Gate
english.objectives: Defeat Archimonde in Hellfire Citadel.
english.description:
We've heard rumors that one o' the strongest eredar might enter this world through the Black Gate soon.

If these rumors are to be believed, it could even be Archimonde the Defiler. If he arrives unchallenged, Draenor itself is likely to fall.

text.title: 伊利达雷的召唤
text.objectives: 在克拉苏斯平台与凯恩·日怒谈一谈。
text.description: $n，凯恩请求你立刻到克拉苏斯平台跟他碰头。$B$B<考瓦斯凑了过来，急切地低语。>$B$B你必须抓紧时间。到处都有燃烧军团的耳目。

english.title: Call of the Illidari
english.objectives: Speak to Kayn Sunfury at Krasus' Landing.
english.description: $n, Kayn requests that you meet him at Krasus' Landing at once.$B$B<Kor'vas leans in close, her voice an urgent whisper.>$B$BYou must hurry. The Legion has eyes everywhere.

text.title: 视人所不能
text.objectives: 与杰斯·织暗谈一谈，然后使用幽灵视觉扫视洞穴以寻找隐藏的恶魔。
text.description:
杰斯·织暗信誓旦旦地说，他有一瞬间感觉到恶魔出现在我们的背后。所以，他带上了部分兵力到东南方的洞穴进行调查。

虽然他们没有任何发现，但是他相信这里面一定有问题。

你可以提点一下他吗？更关键的是，记得用上你的幽灵视觉。

english.title: Give Me Sight Beyond Sight
english.objectives: Speak with Jace Darkweaver and then use your Spectral Sight ability to scan the cave for hidden demons.
english.description:
Jace Darkweaver swears that for a split second he sensed a demonic presence up and behind us. He took some of our forces up to the cave just to the southeast to investigate.

They found nothing in the cave, but he is certain that something is amiss.

Would you lend him your guidance, and more importantly, your spectral sight?

objectiveDetails.description: 面对洞穴使用幽灵视觉

text.title: 中毒的庄稼
text.objectives: 摧毁卓格巴尔剧毒雕像。
text.description:
卓格巴尔把我们赶出了田地，和害虫一起糟蹋我们的庄稼，还安置了邪恶的图腾进一步毒害我们的农作物。

我只能希望在你摧毁图腾之后，我们可以运用洁儿的水魔法来治疗大地。

感谢你前来帮忙，$n。我们只不过是些老实的农民和渔夫，根本没有什么战斗的能力。
text.completion: Thank you, $r. Some of the crops still live. I believe with hard work and some of Jale's magical waters, we will not lose the entire harvest.

english.title: Poisoned Crops
english.objectives: Destroy the drogbar Poison Idols.
english.description:
After driving us from the farmland and infesting our crops with insects, the drogbar placed wicked totems that further poison our harvest.

I can only hope that if you destroy them, we'll be able to heal the land using Jale's water magic.

Thank you for coming to help us, $n. We are but simple farmers and fishermen, and have little prowess in combat.
english.completion: Thank you, $r. Some of the crops still live. I believe with hard work and some of Jale's magical waters, we will not lose the entire harvest.

text.title: 奇怪的工具
text.objectives: 在干船坞与亚纳斯·蹈海谈谈。
text.description: 第一艘船的建造非常顺利，不过可惜的是，我并不是最适合这项工作的兽人。我不知道怎么使用这些人类的工具。你的造船工亚纳斯·蹈海已经做好了准备，将要接替我的工作。$b$b如果你还需要我做什么的话，我就在这干船坞上等着你。
text.giverWindow: 在干船坞与亚纳斯·蹈海谈谈。他的造船功夫远近闻名。

english.title: Strange Tools
english.objectives: Speak with Yanas Seastrike at the dry docks.
english.description: We are well on our way to building our first ship, but unfortunately, I am not the orc for the job.  I have no idea how to work with these human tools.  Your shipwright, Yanas Seastrike, is going to take over from here on out.$b$bI will be here at the dry docks if you need anything from me.
english.giverWindow: Speak with Yanas Seastrike at the dry docks.  His shipbuilding work is renowned.

text.title: 诱虫剂？杀虫剂？
text.objectives: 在白水溪对卓格巴尔使用诱虫喷剂。
text.description:
你从致命的奥姆古尔身上搞到了诱虫喷剂，它似乎可以协助我们对付卓格巴尔和他们的害虫。

把卓格巴尔炼制的喷剂喷在他们身上，让害虫反噬他们。
text.completion: That worked quite well. I will hold on to this Bug Sprayer; it might be useful in the battles to come.

english.title: Spray and Prey
english.objectives: Use the Bug Sprayer on drogbar in Whitewater Wash.
english.description:
The Bug Sprayer you recovered from Ormgul the Pestilent seems like it could give us an advantage against the drogbar and their insects.

Spray the Drogbar with their own alchemy and watch their insects turn against them.
english.completion: That worked quite well. I will hold on to this Bug Sprayer; it might be useful in the battles to come.

text.title: 丢失的货单
text.objectives: 找到纳克尔先生丢失的货物。
text.description: 这张防水的货单上大部分内容都是用某种密码写成的，真正的货单内容就藏在其中。角落里是某个名叫纳克尔先生的家伙的潦草字迹：“货船被攻击了，我们逃了出来，不过船正在下沉。快抢在他们之前赶来这里。”$b$b这行字后面写着沉船的坐标。不用说，能让这个纳克尔先生欠你个人情肯定是好事，而你绝不会希望欠他什么的。

english.title: The Missing Manifest
english.objectives: Find Mr. Knuckles' missing shipment.
english.description: The water-proofed manifest contains some form of code for the most part, hiding the contents of the actual manifest. In the corner is a hastily scrawled note for a Mr. Knuckles. "Shipment attacked, got away but boat is sinking. Get here before they do."$b$bThere are coordinates after that which lead to the sunken boat. Mr. Knuckles is definitely the kind of person you want owing you a favor, not the other way around.

objectiveDetails.description: 摧毁第一个军团传送门
摧毁第一个邪能散播器
第三个军团联络器 - TH控制器
第二个军团联络器 - TH控制器
第一个军团联络器 - TH控制器
袭击低地里的燃烧军团

text.title: 惊悚任务
text.objectives: 在破碎海滩找回5个被砍下来的脑袋。
text.description: 独家消息，$n。密探发现了一个通往燃烧军团世界的入口，萨格拉斯在那个世界里豢养了一头地狱犬，还给它灌输了巨大的能量。我们虽然无法直接打击萨格拉斯，但是如果能杀死那头地狱犬，也可以削弱他的能量。$B以上是好消息。$B$B下面则是个恐怖的坏消息。萨格拉斯一直用我们的盟友的大脑来喂食那头地狱犬，而且它也只吃这个。令人惊悚的是，破碎海滩有一批新鲜的脑袋补给。快到那里去找回同胞们的残骸。

english.title: A Gruesome Task
english.objectives: Retrieve 5 Severed Heads from the Broken Shore.
english.description: So here's the scoop, $n. One of our agents has found an entrance to the portal world where Sargeras is keeping his personal felhound. We can't strike at him directly, but he's imbued a lot of power into this creature.$B That's the good news.$B$B The bad news, however, is outright gruesome. He's been feeding this monster on the brains of our allies, and that's all it will eat. As horrifying as it is, there's a fresh supply of corpses at the Broken Shore. Head down and get them.

text.title: Ashran Dominance
text.objectives: Defeat the Alliance at all event locations in Ashran and kill Grand Marshal Tremblade.
text.description: The Alliance refuse to back down in Ashran. Teach them that the Horde will not stand aside while they plunder the power of the ancient ogre empire to use for their own schemes.
text.completed: Return to Angry Zurge in the Horde base inside Ashran.
text.giverWindow: Grand Marshal Tremblade leads the Alliance forces in Ashran.

text.title: Ashran Dominance
text.objectives: Defeat the Horde at all event locations in Ashran and kill High Warlord Volrath.
text.description: As we feared the Horde are trying to consolidate their position here on the island by looting it, just like we feared. Get out there and show them the Alliance won't put up with their aggression.
text.completed: Return to Chris Clarkie in the Alliance base inside Ashran.
text.giverWindow: Volrath leads the Horde forces in Ashran.
