text.title: 黑市交易
text.objectives: 到你的要塞去和张瑶谈谈。
text.description: 你今天帮了我们一个大忙，$n。郭雅老大说你很有本事，我们应该多看着你点——呃，我是说应该多和你亲近亲近。她已经把一个代……代……呃，替……呃，一个黑市的人派到了你的要塞。$b$b去和他谈谈吧，记得以后打算做什么的话，要大声把你的计划说出来。

english.title: Black Marketeering
english.objectives: Speak with Zhang Yeoh in your garrison.
english.description: Ya did us a real solid today, $n. Boss Goya says you're big stuff in dese parts and we should keep an eye on --- uh, I mean we should be good buds. She's sent a repre... repre... del-e-g... um, a Black Market person to your garrison.$b$bGo say hi and stuff, and make sure to speak loudly when you plan what you're gonna do next.

text.title: 空荡荡的鹰巢
text.objectives: 把鹰蛋放到潜岩者裂谷东部入口上方空荡荡的巢穴里。
text.description:
我把你找回的鹰蛋暂时安置好了，其中的一些仍然有希望可以孵化。

得把它们放到空的鹰巢里，如果运气好的话，会有巨鹰收留并照顾它们。

入口外面就有一个鹰巢，就在洞穴上方的岩架上面。

小心点，$n。鹰蛋非常脆弱。

english.title: Empty Nest
english.objectives: Place the eagle eggs in the empty nest above the eastern entrance to Rockcrawler Chasm.
english.description:
I've taken an inventory of the eggs you recovered. Some among the bunch may still have a chance to hatch.

They will need to be returned to an empty nest, and with any luck, an eagle will claim the eggs as her own and watch over them once again.

There is a nest just outside the entrance, on a rocky ledge above the cave.

Be careful, $n. The eggs are very delicate.

text.title: 带领援军
text.objectives: 与安格尔·钢嚎交谈，并选择将哪支援军带往塔纳安。
text.description: 嘿，你好，指挥官。你知道，塔纳安的战事正紧，不过我们还是有余力将附近的岗哨的一部分资源转移过来，保证我们在这里的进展。$b$b等你决定了调用哪支援军，告诉我一声就可以了，我会尽快把他们派过来的！

english.title: Bring the Reinforcements
english.objectives: Talk to Angar Steelbellow and choose which reinforcements to bring to Tanaan.
english.description: Greetings, Commander! With all of the fighting concentrated here in Tanaan, we've got the breathing room to divert some of our resources from nearby outposts to help make headway.$B$BJust let me know which reinforcements to call, and I'll get them here on the double!

text.title: 带领援军
text.objectives: 与弗拉格斯交谈，并选择将哪支援军带往塔纳安。
text.description: 嘿，你好，指挥官。你知道，塔纳安的战事正紧，我们有很多额外的补给都堆积在了附近的岗哨。$b$b只要你一声令下，我就调一部分过来供我们使用！

english.title: Bring the Reinforcements
english.objectives: Talk to Fraggs and choose which reinforcements to bring to Tanaan.
english.description: Hey there, Commander. You know, with all of the fighting concentrated here in Tanaan, we've got plenty of extra supplies just sitting around in our nearby outposts.$B$BYou just give me the order and I'll make sure some of them get sent our way!

text.title: 遇险的牛头人
text.objectives: 营救被俘虏的河鬃牛头人。
text.description:
卓格巴尔对我们进行了全力围捕，然后把俘虏带到了附近的一个洞穴里。

如果你的动作够快，他们应该还有一线生机。我不知道他们抓捕我们族人到底有何居心。

我简直不敢去想……在那洞穴深处只有黑暗。
text.completion: They have returned relatively unharmed. Thank you, $n.

english.title: Trapped Tauren
english.objectives: Free the captured Rivermane tauren.
english.description:
The drogbar just rounded up those of us that they could and led them to a cave near here.

If you act quickly, I think they can still be saved. I know not what purpose they have for capturing our people.

I shudder to think of it... in the deep places, the darkness rules.
english.completion: They have returned relatively unharmed. Thank you, $n.

text.title: 紫喉围攻
text.description: 保卫悬崖！

english.title: Siege of Crawliac
english.description: [ph] Defend the bluffs!

objectiveDetails.description: 击退鹰身人对天角部族的攻击！

text.title: 抚平创伤
text.objectives: 寻找驭风大师加兰并熄灭苍穹之角的火焰。
text.description: 我知道梅拉为什么要派你来。但是你也看到了，至高岭的威胁不只有卓格巴尔。$b$b在我们处理好紫喉女王的爪牙之前，我没办法派出增援。$b$b你想帮忙的话，就去找我的萨满。他本该去熄灭在村庄里肆虐的火焰。$b$b最后有人看到他的时候是炎女巫入侵之前，他正在赶往自己位于南边的灵魂小屋。
text.completion: Julan is dead? He was a good shaman and full of life. Not as morbid as some of these spiritwalkers.$b$bI will miss his laughter tonight.

english.title: Nursing the Wounds
english.objectives: Find Windmaster Julan and help extinguish the fires on Skyhorn.
english.description: I know why Mayla sent you. But as you have seen, the drogbar are not the only threat to Highmountain.$b$bI will not send forces to support until we deal with the minions of High Crawliac.$b$bIf you want to help, find my shaman. He was supposed to be dispersing these fires that are ravaging my village.$b$bHe was last seen heading for his spirit lodge to the south just before these Cinderwitches descended on us.
english.completion: Julan is dead? He was a good shaman and full of life. Not as morbid as some of these spiritwalkers.$b$bI will miss his laughter tonight.

text.title: 三大女魔头
text.objectives: 消灭妖术师拉吉、阿佳拉·亡歌和女巫乌格拉。
text.description: 紫喉女王掌管鹰身人大权的时候，安插了三个强大又致命的女巫来控制整个女巫会。$b$b我们必须消灭这些女巫。你要接受这个挑战吗？$b$b进入我身后的女巫秘地，找到这三个邪恶的生物。$b$b我们会从空中提供支援，让你的猎物无处可逃。$b$b要是你福大命大，就上山去找我们吧。
text.completion: Well done. Now to cut the head off the snake, as it were.

english.title: The Three
english.objectives: Slay Ragi the Hexxer, Agara Deathsong, and Ugla the Hag.
english.description: When High Crawliac seized control of the harpies she placed 3 powerful and deadly witches in charge of the covens under her command.$b$bThese witches must die. Feel up for the challenge?$b$bHead into the Haglands behind me and find these three evil creatures.$b$bWe will cover you from the air and give your prey no sky to retreat.$b$bLook for us higher up the mountain, should you survive.
english.completion: Well done. Now to cut the head off the snake, as it were.

text.title: 巫后
text.objectives: 消灭巫后，紫喉女王。
text.description: 是时候去解决巫后，紫喉女王了。$b$B你应该知道，能够在鹰身人中称王的绝非善类。$b$b这个生物杀害、背叛、折磨了无数的牛头人、鹰身人、狗头人，为了坐稳王位，她什么事都干得出来。$b$b来吧，朋友，是时候了结了。
text.completion: You have our respect and honor, $p. I name you Skyfriend, and grant you free passage through our lands at your discretion.
text.giverWindow: 鹰身人女王。

english.title: The Witchqueen
english.objectives: Slay High Crawliac, the Witchqueen.
english.description: The time has come to assault High Crawliac, the Witchqueen.$b$BYou should know that one does not become queen of the harpies through kindness.$b$bThis creature has killed, betrayed, and tormented countless tauren, harpies, kobolds, and anything else she had to in order to secure her position as queen.$b$bCome, friend, let us finish this.
english.completion: You have our respect and honor, $p. I name you Skyfriend, and grant you free passage through our lands at your discretion.
english.giverWindow: Queen of the harpies.

text.title: 穆兹的逗留
text.objectives: 在白水溪下游寻找穆兹。
text.description:
我的儿子！他们把他抓走了！我和妻子一个往上游，一个往下游，分头找他。

不用管我，请你一定要找到穆兹……我应该不会有事的……如果你找到穆兹，请把他带到上游交给我妻子。
text.completion: <Moozy squeals in delight at your presence.>

english.title: Moozy's Sojourn
english.objectives: Find Moozy downriver in Whitewater Wash.
english.description:
My son! They took him! My wife and I split up to look for him. She went upriver and I went downriver.

Leave me, please, and find Moozy... I might be okay... If you find Moozy, please bring him to my wife upriver.
english.completion: <Moozy squeals in delight at your presence.>

text.title: 穿过传送门
text.objectives: 穿过恶魔传送门进入地狱犬所在的世界。
text.description: 好消息：你就快到达目的地了。很抱歉必须让你亲力亲为，但是实践出真知嘛。看到下边的传送门了吗？里面就是地狱犬的所在。进去一探究竟吧。

english.title: Through the Portal
english.objectives: Use the Demonic Gateway to enter the Hound's Portal World.
english.description: Here's the good news: you're halfway there. Sorry you had to do that, but necessity is the mother of invention. See that portal down there? That's where the Hound lives. Get through it and find out what's going on in there.

text.title: 调配药剂
text.objectives: 达拉然的德崔斯·瓦德拉要你制作一些新的药水。炼金店里的帕蒂卡·埃根可以帮助你学习制作方法。
text.description: 让我看看……衣服上有药水的痕迹，鞋子上有碾碎的草药……炼金师同行我一眼就能看出来！$b$b我们的合作一定会相当愉快，我们两个。相信你不会排斥学习新事物吧。$b$b你一定要用用我完美的炼金台，这可是我亲手打造的！

english.title: Get Your Mix On
english.objectives: Deucus Valdera in Dalaran wants you to craft some new potions. Merchant Patricia Egan in the alchemy shop can help you learn how.
english.description: Let's see... potion stains on your tabard, crushed herbs on your boots... I know a fellow alchemist when I see one!$b$bWe will do good work together, the two of us. I trust you're not averse to learning new tricks.$b$bBe sure to use my state-of-the-art alchemy table. I built her myself!

text.title: 丢失的货物
text.objectives: 达拉然的炼金师德崔斯·瓦德拉要你在阿苏纳的水域附近找到丢失的补给。
text.description: 既然我们都熟络了，或许你可以帮我一个忙。$b$b跟我长期合作的运货员——那个老伙计叫什么来着——在阿苏纳上空被击落了，我一周的补给就这么没了。像你这么厉害的人肯定可以找回我丢失的货物。

english.title: Missing Shipments
english.objectives: Alchemist Deucus Valdera in Dalaran wants you to locate supplies lost near the water in Azsuna.
english.description: Now that we've gotten to know each other, perhaps you can lend me a hand.$b$bMy weekly supply shipment was lost when my longtime courier--you know, old whatsername--was shot out of the sky over the shores of Azsuna. Surely a hardy sort like you could retrieve my lost goods.

text.title: 铭文师的活
text.objectives: 把符文之书带给达拉然的帕林教授看看。
text.description: 好吧！我承认，即便聪明如我也无法翻译你找到的这部怪书。都怪那些水把里面的字给弄糊掉了。$b$b这么说吧，下面街区有一个蠢蛋铭文师欠我一份人情，这种瞎忙活的事情适合给他做。

english.title: There's a Scribe for That
english.objectives: Bring the Runewritten Tome to Professor Pallin in Dalaran.
english.description: Fine! I admit, even my considerable intellect can't translate the strange tome you discovered. No doubt the water smears made it illegible.$b$bSay, one of those dimwitted scribes down the block owes me a favor. This sort of busywork is just his cup of tea.

text.title: 远古知识
text.objectives: 观察德崔斯·瓦德拉试用维库配方。
text.description: 整本书的维库古方！哎呀，我会成为多少年来成功使用维库古方的第一个炼金师！$n，你竟然能够见证我的伟大，简直太走运了，朋友！$b$b那个叫萨维娜的死得真巧，不然这本书怎么能到我们手上呢，是吧？愚蠢的维库人……

english.title: Ancient Knowledge
english.objectives: Observe Deucus Valdera as he attempts one of the vrykul recipes.
english.description: The tome contains a wealth of ancient vrykul recipes! Why, I could be the first alchemist in untold ages to craft one! How fortunate for you, friend $n, that you are here to bear witness to my greatness!$b$bAwful kind of that Svena person to die and leave her book for us, eh? Silly vrykul...

objectiveDetails.description: 尝试制作原始魔力饮剂

text.title: 闲置喷灯
text.objectives: 从霍巴特·钩锤处购买一个报废的魔火喷灯，并把它交给达拉然的德崔斯·瓦德拉。
text.description: 我听说工程学商店里有人在出售一个喷灯，可能会用得上。你或许能谈出一个比我买时更合算的价钱！$b$b那家店就在街对面，我可以帮你在地图上标记出来。

english.title: A Dormant Burner
english.objectives: Purchase a Depleted Leyflame Burner from Hobart Grapplehammer and bring it to Deucus Valdera in Dalaran.
english.description: I've heard that someone over in the engineering shop is selling a burner that might be usable. You could likely negotiate a fairer price than I could!$b$bThe shop is just across the street. I'll make a note on your map for you.

text.title: 能量搜寻
text.objectives: 到阿苏纳各个重要位置去，用报废的魔火喷灯收集魔网能量。
text.description: 你带给我的魔火喷灯用不了！你明白我为什么从不信任那些工程师了吧……$b$b你得把喷灯放在一个能够与魔网能量共振的地方进行充能，然后它才能用在我们新发现的炼金配方上。$b$b幸运的是，阿苏纳布满了这种能量。

english.title: Ley Hunting
english.objectives: Travel to key locations in Azsuna and use the Depleted Leyflame Burner to collect ley energy.
english.description: The leyflame burner you brought me is useless! This is why I never trust an engineer...$b$bThe burner needs to be charged in areas that resonate with ley energy before it can be used to craft our newfound alchemy recipes.$b$bLucky for us, Azsuna is rich with such power.

objectiveDetails.description: 收集巨龙法力池的能量

text.title: 艾萨拉之眼：实用木塞
text.objectives: 前往艾萨拉之眼，帮达拉然的德崔斯·瓦德拉取得高级木塞。
text.description: 最近我萌生了一个想法，$n。众所周知，纳迦喜欢收藏各种各样的药水。或许他们那里会有我们需要的木塞。$b$b以我的高见，搜寻的最佳起始点就在艾萨拉之眼附近！$b$b尽量不要把时间浪费在对付纳迦上面，专心寻找一些备用木塞。

english.title: Eye of Azshara: Put a Cork in It
english.objectives: Go to the Eye of Azshara and retrieve the Advanced Corks for Deucus Valdera in Dalaran.
english.description: A thought occurred to me recently, $n. The naga have been known to hoard all manner of potions, so they might have the sort of corks we need.$b$bIn my educated opinion, I believe the best place to start searching is around the Eye of Azshara!$b$bTry not to waste your time in there dealing with the naga's goings on, just look for some replacement corks.

text.title: 熊怪火酒
text.objectives: 从瓦尔莎拉的熊怪营地取得一些燃皮火酒瓶，然后交给达拉然的德崔斯·瓦德拉，好让他把瓶上的木塞拿来用。
text.description: 哦！我认出你拿来的那些木塞了，$n。我最近从瓦尔莎拉的一个熊怪部落里也拿到几个这种木塞。熊怪用这种结实的木塞来封存它们的强劲火酒。$b$b我们需要更多的火酒——它们所使用的木塞将在我们的炼金台上发挥出巨大的用处。

english.title: Furbolg Firewater
english.objectives: Acquire skins of Smolderhide Firewater from the furbolg camp in Val'sharah. Bring them back to Deucus Valdera in Dalaran so he can make use of the corks.
english.description: Oh! I recognize these corks you brought me, $n. I recently acquired several from a furbolg tribe in Val'sharah. They need sturdy corks to keep a tight seal on that potent firewater they brew.$b$bWe need more firewater potions--the corks would make an ideal addition to our alchemy table!

text.title: 不精准的滴定管
text.objectives: 把不准的玛洛瑞滴定管交给达拉然的德崔斯。
text.description: 这些是你要的滴定管。如果还有任何需要，你尽管告诉我。$b$b<秀兰女士托着头发，咯咯笑起来。>

english.title: An Imprecise Burette
english.objectives: Bring the Uncalibrated Malloric Burettes to Deucus in Dalaran.
english.description: Here are your burettes. Should you ever be in the need of anything else, don't hesitate to ask.$b$b<Ms. Xiulan holds up the hair and continues to chuckle to herself.>

text.title: 焕然一新
text.objectives: 把修好的双胆混合烧瓶交给达拉然的德崔斯·瓦德拉。
text.description: 这是你的烧瓶，就跟新的一样。拿这些药水来换实在是太划算了。$b$b下次使用易碎品的时候小心点！

english.title: Thanks for Flasking
english.objectives: Take the repaired Dual-Chambered Mixing Flask to Deucus Valdera in Dalaran.
english.description: Here is your flask, good as new. A fair trade for those potions.$b$bBe a little more careful with your breakables next time!

text.title: 奈萨里奥的巢穴：强效粉末
text.objectives: 在奈萨里奥的巢穴中取得沉淀粉末，然后交给达拉然的德崔斯·瓦德拉。
text.description: 我听说古代卓格巴尔会从龙息的残留物中收集粉末。如果奈萨里奥的巢穴真在我们下方的某处，或许可以在里面搞到材料。$b$b到那里去，看看有没有什么东西可以替代我的粉末。

english.title: Neltharion's Lair: Potent Powder
english.objectives: Acquire Precipitating Powder in Neltharion's Lair and bring it to Deucus Valdera in Dalaran.
english.description: I've heard rumors that the ancient drogbar collected powder from the residue of dragon's breath. If it's true that Neltharion's Lair lies somewhere below us, it seems a likely source.$b$bGo there and try to find a replacement for my powder.

text.title: 更多粉末！
text.objectives: 从风暴峡湾的起泡的凯瑟琳处获得凯瑟琳的炼金材料袋。
text.description: 你带给我的那种沉淀粉末似乎是维库配方中所使用的一种极不稳定的反应物。$b$b传言说有个叫凯瑟琳的维库长老囤有大量这种粉末。这么危险的物质不该落在她的手里，而应该由我们处置才对！

english.title: We Need More Powder!
english.objectives: Obtain Katterin's Alchemy Kit from Katterin the Blistered in Stormheim.
english.description: The substance you brought me appears to be precipitating powder, a highly volatile reagent used by the vrykul in their recipes.$b$bThere are rumors that a vrykul elder named Katterin has built up quite a store of this powder. A substance this dangerous needs to be in our hands, not hers!

text.title: 被遗弃的滤网
text.objectives: 在月神殿找一位神殿女祭司谈谈，看看能不能取得一些夏多雷丝绸。
text.description: 清单写的下一件替换物是滤网。现在你应该知道了，像我这种炼金高手，只会使用最优质的工具来调配药水。$b$b瓦尔莎拉月神殿里的精灵会用夏多雷丝绸来制作长袍。或许她们愿意给你一些，用来给我做滤网。

english.title: Forlorn Filter
english.objectives: Speak with a Temple Priestess at the Temple of Elune to see if you can acquire some Shaldorei Silk.
english.description: Next on the list of things to replace are my filters. Now I'm sure you've concluded that an alchemist of my caliber uses only the finest of tools when mixing my potions.$b$bThe elves at the Temple of Elune in Val'sharah use Shaldorei silk to craft their robes. Perhaps they'd be willing to part with some for my filters.

text.title: 交还滤网
text.objectives: 把补好的夏多雷丝绸交给达拉然的德崔斯·瓦德拉。
text.description: 撕碎的布料已经补好了。希望你好好利用这块夏多雷丝绸。$b$b现在走吧。

english.title: Return the Filter
english.objectives: Return the Mended Shaldorei Silk to Deucus Valdera in Dalaran.
english.description: What was torn has now been mended. I hope you put this Shaldorei silk to good use.$b$bNow, run along.

text.title: 脆弱的坩埚
text.objectives: 把脆弱的魔息坩埚交给达拉然的德崔斯·瓦德拉。
text.description: 有些顾客问我要炼金石，不过如果没有可以更换的坩埚，我就无法进行制作。$b$b我们需要一些材料来制作新的坩埚，不过首先我们需要一个合适的容器，它要能够在经过处理后承受恶魔吐息。$b$b苏拉玛有一个被燃烧军团占领的地方。我们肯定可以在那里找到合适的东西。

english.title: A Fragile Crucible
english.objectives: Bring the Fragile Demonsbreath Crucible to Deucus Valdera in Dalaran.
english.description: I have customers asking for alchemist stones, but I'm unable to make any until I replace my crucible.$b$bIn order to create a new one, we'll need a few things, but first we'll need a proper container. Something that can be augmented to withstand a demon's breath.$b$bThere's a place in Suramar which the Legion has occupied. There surely must be a device there we can take that will be suitable for our needs.

text.title: 修复内胆
text.objectives: 收集$1oa份萨格拉斯之血，$2oa张魔皮，$3oa个邪能球茎，以及$4oa颗伊瑟拉莱之种。
text.description: 想使用这个坩埚，要做的第一步就是修复它的内胆。这需要一些材料，你可以自己收集，也可以和其他冒险者交易。$b$b邪能球茎和伊瑟拉莱之种是药草学的常见材料。$b$b魔皮可以通过剥皮获得。$b$b萨格拉斯之血可以在破碎群岛的各处找到。

english.title: Lining the Crucible
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Blood of Sargeras, $2oa Felhide, $3oa Felwort, and $4oa Yseralline Seeds.
english.description: The first step in making this crucible useful is to restore the lining of its interior. That's going to require supplies you'll either gather yourself or obtain through trade with fellow adventurers.$b$bFelwort and yseralline seeds are familiar to herbalists.$b$bFelhide is obtained through skinning.$b$bBlood of Sargeras can be found all over the Broken Isles.

text.title: 守望者地窟：恶魔胆汁
text.objectives: 制作隐形饮剂，然后前往守望者地窟，将坩埚浸泡在格里茉拉的胆汁中。
text.description: 处理这种坩埚的关键，就是必须把它侵泡在最污秽的邪能当中。虽然我也觉得恶心，不过要完成这道工序，最有效的办法是使用恶魔的胆汁。$b$b没错，我说的是恶魔的胆汁。准备好开工了吗？$b$b守望者地窟里就有这样的恶魔——一个名为格里茉拉的鬼母。有一把隐形的锁封印了她的房间。$b$b你最好带上一些隐形饮剂，在她的房间门口使用。
text.giverWindow: 务必带上一些隐形饮剂，以便进入她的房间。

english.title: Vault of the Wardens: Demon's Bile
english.objectives: Craft a Skaggldrynk, then go to the Vault of the Wardens and bathe the crucible in the bile of Grimoira.
english.description: The key to a crucible like this is that it must be bathed in the foulest of fel energy. I hate to say it, but the most efficient method of accomplishing such a feat is to subject it to the bile of a demon.$b$bYes, I said the bile of a demon. Ready to get to work?$b$bIn the Vault of the Wardens, such a demon exists. An imp mother by the name of Grimoira.  The door to her room is sealed by an invisible lock.$b$bI'd suggest bringing some Skaggldrynk with you. Use it when you get to her door.
english.giverWindow: Make sure to bring some skaggldrynk to get into her room.

objectiveDetails.description: 将魔息坩埚浸泡在格里茉拉的胆汁中

text.title: 黑市价格
text.objectives: 取得卡德加的银发，1份萨格拉斯之血，$3oa份卡多雷姜酒，以及$4oa份阿苏纳湿乳酪。
text.description: 我或许有你要的东西，你说的是滴定管吧？确实很少见。$b$b所以，你得帮个忙才行。只是小事一桩，弄点东西而已。$b$b高阶大法师的银色头发……泰坦的血液，还有……一些酒和乳酪。$b$b什么？！我自然有自己的生活需求。

english.title: The Price of the Black Market
english.objectives: Collect a Silver Hair of Khadgar, a Blood of Sargeras, $3oa Kaldorei Ginger Wine and $4oa Moist Azsunian Feta.
english.description: I may have what you're looking for, burettes you say? Not a very common item.$b$bFor that, I require a moderate favor. Nothing too big, just a few things really.$b$bA silver hair from a high-ranking archmage... the blood of a titan, and, oh... some wine and cheese.$b$bWhat?! I have appetites that need satiating.

text.title: 柔韧玻璃软管
text.objectives: 把柔韧玻璃软管交给达拉然的德崔斯·瓦德拉。
text.description: 你找到一种由柔韧玻璃制成的管子。看来格里茉拉就是用它来吮吸受害者的内脏。$b$b它拥有魔法般的特质，非常适合用于高级炼金台的工作。

english.title: Bendy Glass Tubes
english.objectives: Bring the Bendy Glass Tubes to Deucus Valdera in Dalaran.
english.description: You find tubing formed from a bendable sort of glass. It appears as though Grimoira was using it to suck out the insides of her victims.$b$bIts magical properties, however, would seem ideal for use on an advanced alchemy table.

text.title: 秘密行动
text.objectives: 找秀兰女士，为德崔斯取得一些新滴定管。
text.description: 我的器材就快换完了，$n。要再度制作合剂的话，我们就需要精确地测量每种原料。$b$b所以，我们需要更换滴定管套装。问题是，滴定管非常不容易弄到手。不过，我们或许可以通过其他渠道搞到一些……$b$b<德崔斯四下看了看，然后示意你靠近点。>$b$b秘密渠道，可以这么说。到黑市里搞。$b$b去找秀兰女士。记得保密。

english.title: Going Underground
english.objectives: See Ms. Xiulan about acquiring some new burettes for Deucus.
english.description: We're so close to replacing all my equipment, $n. In order to make flasks again, we need to be able to precisely measure each ingredient.$b$bFor that, we need to replace my burette assembly. Unfortunately, burettes aren't easy to come by. We may be able to procure some though through other means by...$b$b<Deucus looks around and beckons you closer.>$b$bGoing underground, so to say. As in, the Black Market.$b$bGo see Ms. Xiulan. Mum's the word.

text.title: 校准专家
text.objectives: 把不准的玛洛瑞滴定管交给技术高超的炼金师校准。
text.description: 要对滴定管的各项指标进行校准，需要多位技术高超的专家共同努力。$b$b化学家艾玛拉是我在幽暗城的老朋友，她帮我处理过类似的问题。$b$b虽然对我来说雷霆崖闻起来和畜生棚没什么两样，不过那里却有个标准严苛的炼金师，佳娜·冰蹄。$b$b另外，如果钱包没锁好的话，我绝不会踏上藏宝海湾半步，不过那里有个叫泰克斯·普图尔的倒是公认的公正可靠。

english.title: Calibration Experts
english.objectives: Take the Uncalibrated Malloric Burettes to skilled alchemists for calibration.
english.description: It will take the cooperation of several highly skilled sorts to calibrate these burettes for a variety of substances.$b$bChemist Emmara is an old friend from the Undercity who has helped me with similar endeavors.$b$bThunder Bluff smells like a barn to me, but Jana Winterhoof is an alchemist with exacting standards.$b$bAnd while I'd never travel to Booty Bay without a lock on my wallet, Tryks Pourtrue has proven reliable and fair.

text.title: 检测精确度
text.objectives: 制作多种药水，检测玛洛瑞滴定管的精确度。
text.description: 滴定管已经完成校准，是时候试用一下了！确定其精确度的唯一办法，就是制作大量药水。$b$b这项工作有趣吗？并不是，不过炼金术最重要的“成分”就是——勤勉！

english.title: Testing the Calibration
english.objectives: Test the Malloric Burettes' calibration by crafting a variety of potions.
english.description: Now that you have the burettes calibrated, it's time to test them out! The only way to be sure is by crafting a sufficient quantity of a variety of potions.$b$bGlamorous work? No, but the most important reagent in alchemy is a bit of elbow grease!

text.title: 分工明确
text.objectives: 跟奥拉尔德·施米尔谈谈你需要订制的东西。
text.description: 众所周知，我的时间比……嗯，任何人的都更宝贵，恐怕我必须开始着手更换我的药剂器皿。$b$b在这件事上，你的工作也相当重要，$n。你得帮我跟铁匠打交道。一想到我的长袍沾上煤灰，我就头皮发麻。$b$b这是我们需要的物品清单。而我会出门寻找我们需要的其他东西。

english.title: Channeling Our Efforts
english.objectives: Talk to Alard Schmied about the list of things you need done.
english.description: While it's no secret my time is more valuable than... well, anyone's, I fear I must step in and help to replace my decoction conduit.$b$bYou will also play a crucial part in this, $n, as my liaison with the blacksmiths. The thought of getting soot on my robes curls my toes.$b$bHere's a list of what we'll need done. Meanwhile I'll be out gathering the rest of what's needed.

text.title: 英灵殿：首要材料
text.objectives: 从英灵殿（英雄难度）取得永恒之沙，并调配一份千万战痕合剂，然后把它们交给达拉然的奥拉尔德。
text.description: 第一种材料只能去另一个世界寻找。幸运的是，风暴峡湾有一扇通往那里的大门。$b$b英灵殿里有一种用来打磨建筑物的沙砾，叫做永恒之沙。我需要大量的这种沙砾来制作新玻璃。$b$b这种材料使用起来很有难度，所以我需要一些助力。你知道的，某种可以让我提升耐力的东西。

english.title: Halls of Valor: The Prime Ingredient
english.objectives: Retrieve the Eternity Sand from Heroic: Halls of Valor, craft a Flask of Ten Thousand Scars and return both items to Alard in Dalaran.
english.description: This first ingredient can only be obtained by visiting the next realm. Fortunately for us, there's a gate in Stormheim that can take you there.$b$bIn the Halls of Valor, there is a sand that's used for polishing their architecture. Eternity Sand, it's called. I'll need an ample amount of it as the base for the new glass.$b$bThis ingredient won't be easy to work with either. I'll need something to keep me going, you know, keep my stamina up.

text.title: 黑鸦堡垒：重型材料
text.objectives: 从黑鸦堡垒（英雄难度）取得黑色硫磺岩，并调配一份无尽大军合剂，然后把它们交给达拉然的奥拉尔德。
text.description: 德崔斯认为清单里的下一种材料可以增强混合物的力量。我以前也听说过这种事，不过从未进行尝试。$b$b它叫做黑色硫磺岩，据说黑鸦堡垒的精灵在锻造时会使用这种材料。$b$b这种东西很难弄到，你可能需要深入堡垒进行搜寻。$b$b此外，因为它的质量很重，所以我可能需要你的合剂为我助力，我需要某种可以让我提升力量的东西。

english.title: Black Rook Hold: Heavy, But Helpful
english.objectives: Retrieve some Sabelite Sulfate from Heroic: Black Rook Hold, craft a Flask of the Countless Armies and return both items to Alard in Dalaran.
english.description: The next ingredient on the list will supposedly add strength to the mix, according to Deucus. I've heard of it before, but haven't really used it.$b$bIt's called Sabelite Sulfate, and it's said the elves of Black Rook Hold use it in their blacksmithing.$b$bSomething like that won't just be lying around. You may have to delve deep into the hold to find it.$b$bAnd due to its weight, I may need a concoction of yours to compensate, something to give me a bit more strength.

text.title: 噬魂之喉：取材冥狱深渊
text.objectives: 从噬魂之喉（英雄难度）取得龙骨粉，并调配一份第七恶魔合剂，然后把它们交给达拉然的奥拉尔德。
text.description: 最后一种材料，呃……$b$b<奥拉尔德沉思了一会，然后点点头。>$b$b是的，这是唯一的办法。最后的材料需要到亡者之地冥狱深渊去找。$b$b其实你不用进入冥狱深渊，只需要前往噬魂之喉，登上摆渡亡灵的船只就行。那艘船上有我们的最终材料。$b$b它叫做龙骨粉。找仔细点。$b$b此外，添加这种材料时必须动作迅速。所以，我需要某种可以让我反应更迅捷的东西。

english.title: Maw of Souls: A Hope in Helheim
english.objectives: Retrieve a crate of Dragur Dust from Heroic: Maw of Souls, craft a Flask of the Seventh Demon and return both items to Alard in Dalaran.
english.description: For this last ingredient, well...$b$b<Alard begins pondering for a moment, then nods his head.>$b$bYes, that's the only way. For this last one, you'll need to go to the land of the damned, Helheim.$b$bWell, not there exactly, but aboard the boat that ferries the dead across the Maw of Souls. Upon that boat may be the final ingredient we need.$b$bIt's called Dragur Dust. Keep an eye out for it.$b$bAlso, one needs to be quick when adding this ingredient. I'll need something to heighten my reflexes.

text.title: 翡翠梦魇：盛怒之火
text.objectives: 前往翡翠梦魇，取得尼珊德拉的心脏，然后把它交给达拉然的奥拉尔德。
text.description: 材料都找齐了，现在我们就差最后一步了。$b$b我的熔炉虽然已经烧得滚烫，但是不足以把这些材料烧成玻璃。所以，我们需要更高的温度。确切来说，是巨龙喷出的高温。$b$b我知道翡翠梦境里出现了一条被腐化的巨龙。不管有没有遭到腐化，巨龙炽热的心脏都足以熔化最坚韧的材料。$b$b把它的心脏带回来给我，你就能得到想要的导管了。

english.title: The Emerald Nightmare: Rage Fire
english.objectives: Travel to the Emerald Nightmare and acquire Nythendra's Heart. Bring it to Alard in Dalaran.
english.description: Now that we have all the ingredients assembled, we need one last thing.$b$bThe fire of my forges burn hot, but not hot enough to work these ingredients into glass. For that, we need more heat. The heat of a dragon, to be exact.$b$bI'm aware of one that has emerged from the Emerald Dream in a corrupted state. Corrupted or not, a dragon's heart burns with enough heat to melt the strongest of materials.$b$bBring me its heart and you'll have your conduit.

text.title: 消灭哨卫
text.objectives: 消灭三个哨卫。
text.description: 你成功了。看到那边的营地了吗？那里有些燃烧军团的哨卫，如果萨格拉斯的恶犬饿了或是需要关心，他们就会立刻向主人禀报。去把他们干掉。

english.title: Extinguishing the Sentinels
english.objectives: Extinguish the three Sentinels.
english.description: You've made it. See that camp there? They've got some Legion Sentinels hiding in there, set to notify Sargeras any time his pet pooch gets hungry or craves attention. Shut them down.

text.title: Test - New
text.description: 測試

english.title: Test - New
english.description: Test

text.title: 柳林小精灵
text.objectives: 引导小精灵穿过隐秘之池并种下$2oa棵树木。
text.description: 暗夜精灵与森林融为一体后，他们的灵魂就会变成小精灵。但小精灵的思维及感知方式却和生前极为不同。$b$b你可以跟这个小家伙建立联系。透过它的眼睛，观察它前往隐秘之池并种植树木的过程。

english.title: Wisp in the Willows
english.objectives: Guide the Wisp through the Hidden Pools to grow $2oa trees.
english.description: Wisps are the spirits of our night elven brethren who have become one with the forest. But their minds and the way they perceive things are very different than in life.$b$bYou should bond with this little one. See through its eyes as it travels to the hidden pools and grows some trees.

objectiveDetails.description: 与失落小精灵建立连接

text.objectives: 把图纸交给你要塞船坞中的海军装备专家。
text.description: 这些图纸上画的似乎是某种海军装备。我们应该把它带回到船坞去，看有没有人能够读懂。

english.objectives: Return the blueprints to a Naval Equipment Specialist at your garrison shipyard.
english.description: This appears to be a blueprint for some sort of naval equipment.  We should take it back to our Shipyard and see if someone can decipher it.

text.title: 森林女巫
text.objectives: 消灭森林女巫。
text.description:
你不久前在河湾救了我一命，正因如此，我才出面担保你以使者的身份进入这个部族，这也是你能活到现在的唯一理由。我认为我们之间已经两不相欠。

你必须向鲜血图腾证明自己，才有机会和酋长交谈。

有一个鹰身人主母最近侵入了这片森林。如果你能消灭这个森林女巫并让鲜血图腾看到她的尸体，那么他们可能会让你觐见图鲁克。
text.completion: The Bloodtotem don't often allow outsiders into their midst. Even asking them to give you an audience is a danger.

english.title: Witch of the Wood
english.objectives: Defeat the Witch of the Wood.
english.description:
You saved me at Riverbend not long ago. It is the reason I vouched for you as emissary to this tribe, and the only reason you're alive here now. I consider my debt to you paid.

You must prove yourself to the Bloodtotem chieftain before he will speak with you.

Within the forest is the Witch of the Wood, a harpy mother who recently descended into this territory. If you are able to defeat her and show her carcass to the Bloodtotem, they might allow you an audience with Torok.
english.completion: The Bloodtotem don't often allow outsiders into their midst. Even asking them to give you an audience is a danger.

text.title: 女巫之羽
text.objectives: 从巫林女巫身上收集$1oa片女巫之羽。
text.description:
抓了我的那些卓格巴尔有着非同寻常的侵略性。但附近洞穴里的部族似乎和他们并无干系，然而鲜血图腾还是采取了先发制人的策略，他们已经抓到了一些俘虏。

不过这一举动无疑让森林暴露在了鹰身人的魔爪之下。如果你能解决这些女巫，肯定就能让图鲁克另眼相看。记得带回她们的羽毛作为她们死亡的证据。
text.completion: I could hear them screeching from here. With this victory and the defeat of the Witch of the Wood, Torok will surely be willing to see you.

english.title: Hags of a Feather
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Hag Feathers from Witchwood Hags in the Witchwood.
english.description:
The drogbar you freed me from were unusually aggressive. The tribe in the nearby caves seems to be apart from the rest of them, but that didn't stop the Bloodtotem from going on the offensive just in case, capturing some of their number.

That move left the woods exposed to the harpies, however. Your help dealing with these witches would not go unnoticed by Torok. Bring back their feathers as proof of death.
english.completion: I could hear them screeching from here. With this victory and the defeat of the Witch of the Wood, Torok will surely be willing to see you.

text.title: 觐见图鲁克
text.objectives: 与图鲁克·鲜血图腾谈一谈。
text.description:
我应该警告你一下，图鲁克喜怒无常，还特别讨厌外来者。你一定要谨慎。

我们会在末路崖的帐篷里与他会面。我是河鬃使者，在这里是受到保护的，但是他们可没有对你做出任何许诺。
text.completion: Strange that he would be in the cavern at this time... perhaps this is a good sign?

english.title: An Audience with Torok
english.objectives: Speak with Torok Bloodtotem.
english.description:
I should warn you that Torok is easily displeased and is hateful of outsiders. Be on your guard.

We will seek an audience with him at his tent at the Cliff's Edge. As the Rivermane Emissary here, I am afforded some protection against aggression, but they have made no such promises about you.
english.completion: Strange that he would be in the cavern at this time... perhaps this is a good sign?

objectiveDetails.description: 与图鲁克·鲜血图腾见面

text.title: 石巨魔的困境
text.objectives: 与纳瓦罗格谈一谈，然后与他在安全的地方碰头。
text.description:
我们应该趁现在还有机会，赶快离开这个地方。鲜血图腾正在北边的村子集结，我觉得他们打算杀害我的人民。

准备好动身的时候就告诉我，我可以马上把我们带到安全的地方。
text.completion: You have little reason to trust me, but we have a common enemy in the Bloodtotem and I could use your help.

english.title: Rock Troll in a Hard Place
english.objectives: Speak with Navarrogg to meet him at a safe location.
english.description:
We should leave this place while we have a chance. The Bloodtotem are amassing at their village to the north, and I believe they intend to kill my people.

Let me know when you are ready to go, and I can take us to a safe place quickly.
english.completion: You have little reason to trust me, but we have a common enemy in the Bloodtotem and I could use your help.

text.title: 腐蚀者皮里克斯
text.objectives: 在月爪谷消灭腐蚀者皮里克斯。
text.description: 环视四周，$c。我的山谷充满了腐化。如果玛法里奥需要我召唤觉醒者伊瑟拉，那我肯定会帮他的忙。但是，我得先把恶魔从这片土地驱逐。$B$B腐蚀者皮利克斯就在前面，请助我消灭这个魔王。$B$B只要我们齐心协力，必能击溃萨特和他们的邪恶族群。

english.title: Perrexx the Corruptor
english.objectives: Kill Perrexx the Corruptor in the Moonclaw Vale.
english.description: Look around you, $c. Corruption has befouled my valley. If Malfurion requires my presence to summon Ysera the Awakened, then I will surely aid him, but not until I have purged these demons from my lands.$B$BPerrexx the Corruptor is just ahead. Help me slay this fiend.$B$BStand by my side, and together we can rout these satyrs and their brethren.

text.title: 耻辱者的制裁
text.objectives: 消灭可耻的萨德里斯。
text.description: 可耻的萨德里斯是最先背叛同胞，接受萨维斯诅咒的人之一。$B$B大战时，就是他带头杀害了我的许多亲朋好友。$b$b我最后一次在战场上和他对峙时，让他给逃走了。你要帮我制裁这个邪恶的东西。
text.completion: Xandris has finally paid for his crimes, but his blood will not bring back the innocents he has slain.

english.title: Dishonored
english.objectives: Slay Xandris the Dishonored.
english.description: Xandris the Dishonored was among the first to betray his brethren and accept the curse of Xavius.$B$BDuring the great war, it was he who led the slaughter of many of my dearest friends.$b$bThe last time I met him on the battlefield he fled. Help me to finally dispense justice on this foul being.
english.completion: Xandris has finally paid for his crimes, but his blood will not bring back the innocents he has slain.

text.title: 腐蚀者
text.objectives: 消灭腐蚀者康格拉克斯。
text.description: 虽然除掉了萨德里斯，但是我们仍需清除更多的威胁才能拯救我的林地。$b$b大战时，康格拉克斯在对自己家乡的腐化中获得了极大的快感。$b$b要不是因为德鲁伊同胞们泛滥的怜悯心，我早就亲手杀了他。$b$b请你去找到这个恶魔并且把他就地正法。$b$b之所以把这个任务托付给你，是因为我在这里感受到了更加黑暗的力量……我必须谨慎处理。
text.completion: You have my thanks, $c.$b$bIf not for your arrival I would have surely perished here.

english.title: The Corruptor
english.objectives: Slay Kagraxxis the Corruptor.
english.description: Xandris has been slain, but there are others that must be dealt with if my grove is to be saved.$b$bDuring the great war, Kagraxxis took great pleasure in corrupting the lands he once called home.$b$bWere it not for the foolish mercy of my fellow druids, I would have slain him myself.$b$bFind the demon and bring justice upon him.$b$bI must entrust this task to you alone, for I sense an even darker presence here... one that requires my personal attention.
english.completion: You have my thanks, $c.$b$bIf not for your arrival I would have surely perished here.

text.title: 给格雷迈恩的大礼
text.objectives: 在格雷迈恩的军舰上安置3个吉尔尼斯重磅炸药，然后在安全距离外引爆。
text.description:
吉尔尼斯渗透者似乎带来了许多重型军械，他们可能打算炮轰惊魂港的城墙。

如果我们能让这些东西转头对付格雷迈恩的军舰，肯定可以彻底终结他对岗哨的袭击。

english.title: A Gift for Greymane
english.objectives: Plant 3 Gilnean Heavy Explosives onto the hull of Greymane's ship and detonate them at a safe distance.
english.description:
It looks like the Gilnean infiltrators brought some heavy ordnance to the fight. It's likely they intend to use them on the walls of Dreadwake's Landing.

If these could be rigged to Greymane's ship, it could make for a decisive end to his assault on the outpost.

text.title: 制作原型
text.objectives: 到冰松岗哨寻找拉兹克·盖兹波特。
text.description:
如果艾迪想成为狩猎队的固定成员，那就需要针对她的体型而特别设计的装备。

我的器械专家应该知道什么样的武器最适合侏儒。

到他的帐篷去传个话，说我要尽快看到武器原型。
text.completion: A gnome hunter, huh? Is that a joke?$b$bFine, fine. What the boss wants, the boss gets. I'll start working on a prototype as soon as I finish up my latest project.

english.title: Procuring a Prototype
english.objectives: Find Razik Gazbolt at Icepine Point.
english.description:
If Addie's going to be a more permanent member of the huntin' party, then she'll need some specialty gear for someone her size.

My munitions expert should have some ideas about what kind of weapon would best suit a gnome.

Stop by his camp and let him know that I'll be needin' a prototype soon.
english.completion: A gnome hunter, huh? Is that a joke?$b$bFine, fine. What the boss wants, the boss gets. I'll start working on a prototype as soon as I finish up my latest project.

text.title: 至高岭的天空
text.objectives: 在雷霆图腾底部与拉善·天角谈一谈。
text.description: 等你准备好以后，就到雷霆图腾的底部跟我会合。$b$b在我的部族再次向年轻的梅拉宣誓忠诚时，能够有你在我身边，这是我的莫大荣幸。$b$b我们是团结一致的高岭部族！
text.completion: The Skyhorn are with us? This day just got much better.

english.title: The Skies of Highmountain
english.objectives: Speak with Lasan Skyhorn at the base of Thunder Totem.
english.description: When you are ready, join me at the base of Thunder Totem.$b$bI would be honored to have you at my side as my tribe once again swears its allegiance to the young Mayla.$b$bTogether, we are Highmountain!
english.completion: The Skyhorn are with us? This day just got much better.

objectiveDetails.description: 在雷霆图腾与拉善见面

text.title: Moonclaw's Wisdom
text.objectives: Meet Thaon Moonclaw in his den.
text.description: Our quick action today has stopped this aggression and saved my valley. As you requested, I will join Malfurion in the Grove of Cenarius.$B$BStill, there is much about these satyrs that I wish to tell you. This information would be most valuable to you.$B$BPlease meet me in my den before departing.

english.objectives: Meet Thaon Moonclaw in his den.
english.description: Our quick action today has stopped this aggression and saved my valley. As you requested, I will join Malfurion in the Grove of Cenarius.$B$BStill, there is much about these satyrs that I wish to tell you. This information would be most valuable to you.$B$BPlease meet me in my den before departing.

text.title: 嗜血之石
text.objectives: 用恶魔的鲜血来喂食血石。
text.description:
血石蕴含着庞大的能量，需要喂食才能唤醒。

不过这种石头不吃鱼类和蛋糕。它们渴望鲜血，而且是越强大的血液越好。

东边的地区受到了恶魔的侵扰。我要你用他们的鲜血来滋养我的石头，好让我释放它的力量。

english.title: It Hungers for Blood
english.objectives: Let the Bloodstone feed on the blood of demons.
english.description:
Bloodstones contain a great deal of power that can only be awakened once they are fed. 

Yet this stone does not feast on fish and cakes. It hungers for blood; the more powerful, the better.

There's an infestation of demons just east of here. I need you to nourish my stone with their blood, so that I may unlock its power.

text.title: 神秘文字
text.objectives: 把符文之书带到达拉然，给德崔斯·瓦德拉看看。
text.description: 你在一个巨型生物的骸骨旁找到了一部浸水的书册。书里的语言十分陌生，还装饰着符文和炼金符号。或许其他的炼金师可以告诉你更多信息。

english.title: A Mysterious Text
english.objectives: Bring the Runewritten Tome to Deucus Valdera in Dalaran.
english.description: You found a water-logged tome near the bones of a massive creature. Written in an unfamiliar language, the book is adorned with runes and alchemical symbols. Perhaps another alchemist would be able to tell you more.

text.title: 忠诚的宠物
text.objectives: 寻找纳瓦罗格的宠物。
text.description:
我唤醒大地的生物，用以保卫我和我的人民。我在被抓的时候命令它们留在家里，但是它们经常鲁莽行事，所以它们可能会试图跟随我。

如果它们真的这样做，恐怕就已经被鲜血图腾抓住了，甚至可能更糟。以我目前的状况，我根本现在没有力气去寻找它们。如果你能找到它们，我将感激不尽。
text.completion: Frag has fallen? The youngest of my pets was perhaps my most dear... curse the Bloodtotem and their cruelty!

english.title: Pet Rocks
english.objectives: Find Navarrogg's pets.
english.description:
I raise creatures born of the earth to help defend myself and my people. When I was captured, I ordered them to stay behind at our home, but they are often disobedient and likely tried to follow me.

If they did, I fear the Bloodtotem may have captured them, or worse. In my current state, I can't muster the strength to find them. If you find them, it would be much appreciated.
english.completion: Frag has fallen? The youngest of my pets was perhaps my most dear... curse the Bloodtotem and their cruelty!

text.title: 狩猎巨熊
text.objectives: 在安瑟平原收集$1oa块蓟鬃熊皮。
text.description:
据说蓟鬃巨熊背上的一根毛刺就足以割断矮人的胡须。而且就算你能躲过锐利的皮毛，还是容易命丧巨熊的重殴之下。

有些平庸的猎人已经成了那些巨熊的腹中餐了。

给我带回一些蓟鬃熊皮，证明你不会成为巨熊的点心。
text.completion: These pelts are even sharper than I imagined. Well done, $n.

english.title: Bear Huntin'
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Bristlefur Pelts within the Fields of An'she.
english.description:
They say a single hair from the back of a bristlefur bear is sharp enough to cut a dwarf's beard. But if the fur doesn't kill ya, the maul will.

Some lesser hunters have been a meal for those bears. 

Show me you're more than a snack and bring me back a few of those bristlefur pelts.
english.completion: These pelts are even sharper than I imagined. Well done, $n.

text.title: 诅咒密码
text.objectives: 让欧鲁诺克和你的盟友摧毁屏障，然后阻止古尔丹。
text.description:
你的盟友和我马上就会清除这些障碍，不过这会消耗我们很大一部分力量。不管前面是什么，都不是那么容易对付的。

古尔丹利用密码强化了一个元素领主，让它变得疯狂了。他想要用它来破坏元素与德拉诺之间的联系。如果你能摧毁那个元素，我们就能收回密码了。

english.title: The Cipher of Damnation
english.objectives: Get Oronok and your ally to destroy the barrier, then stop Gul'dan.
english.description:
Your ally and I will remove this barrier now, though it will take a greater part of our strength. What lies beyond will not be easy.

Gul'dan will have empowered an elemental lord with the Cipher, driving it insane. He will use it to destroy the link between the elements and Draenor. If you destroy that elemental, we could recover the Cipher.

objectiveDetails.description: 与你的盟友交谈并打破屏障

text.title: 军备竞赛
text.objectives: 在你的船坞建造一艘驱逐舰，并派它去执行海军行动。
text.description:
一场战斗无法决定整场战争，指挥官。

那艘运输舰抵挡不了钢铁部落的海军多久。我们还需要一艘舰船。幸运的是，一个本地的走私贩子向我们提供了建造驱逐舰所需的图纸。我们得立即建造一艘驱逐舰！

english.title: Destroying the Competition
english.objectives: Construct a Destroyer in your Shipyard and send it on a naval mission.
english.description:
One battle does not win the war, Commander.

That Transport isn't gonna hold up long against this Iron Horde navy.  We are going to need another ship.  Lucky for us, a local smuggler has supplied us with the plans we need to build Destroyers.  We should construct one of these ships immediately!

objectiveDetails.description: 完成海军行动：小打小闹

text.title: 军备竞赛
text.objectives: 在你的船坞建造一艘驱逐舰，并派它去执行海军行动。
text.description:
一场战斗无法决定整场战争，指挥官。

那艘运输舰抵挡不了钢铁部落的海军多久。我们还需要一艘舰船。幸运的是，一个本地的走私贩子向我们提供了建造驱逐舰所需的图纸。我们得立即建造一艘驱逐舰！

english.objectives: Construct a Destroyer in your Shipyard and send it on a naval mission.
english.description:
One battle does not win the war, Commander.

That Transport isn't gonna hold up long against this Iron Horde navy.  We are going to need another ship.  Lucky for us, a local smuggler has supplied us with the plans we need to build Destroyers.  We should construct one of these ships immediately!

objectiveDetails.description: 在你的船坞建造一艘驱逐舰
完成海军行动：小打小闹

text.title: 战斗史诗
text.objectives: 从斯考德-艾希尔的艾尔女祭司身上收集8节艾希瓦拉之歌的手稿。
text.description:
女祭司携带的手稿似乎是一篇史诗的第一部分，诗歌记录着古代瓦尔基拉女王，艾希迪尔的故事。 

如果艾希迪尔和这里的女武神有关联，那么你也许能够加以利用。 

这种关联的答案应该就在剩余的手稿之中。
text.completion: The verses of the poem unfold the tale of Ashildir founding the shieldmaidens and bringing them to Skold-Ashil.$B$BIf these shieldmaidens revere the Valkyra queen as this would suggest, your dealings with her in Helheim may prove advantageous.

english.title: Stories of Battle
english.objectives: Collect 8 verses of Ashilvara from Priestesses of Eyir in Skold-Ashil.
english.description:
The writings carried by the priestess appear to be the first part of an epic poem describing the history of Ashildir, the ancient queen of the Valkyra. 

If Ashildir has a connection to the shieldmaidens here, you may be able to use that to your advantage. 

The answer to her involvement likely lies within the remaining text.
english.completion: The verses of the poem unfold the tale of Ashildir founding the shieldmaidens and bringing them to Skold-Ashil.$B$BIf these shieldmaidens revere the Valkyra queen as this would suggest, your dealings with her in Helheim may prove advantageous.

text.title: 评价拉兹克
text.objectives: 到赫米特·奈辛瓦里在至高岭的住所去找他。
text.description:
赫米特想了解一下我的军火研发进度。

那么你肯定会很乐意去向我的老板汇报，说我的最新发明效果完美！

你可以在猎人小屋附近找到他的帐篷。

english.title: Rating Razik
english.objectives: Find Hemet Nesingwary at his Highmountain retreat.
english.description:
Hemet is expecting an update on how my munitions research and development is going.

I'm sure you'll be happy to tell my boss that my latest creation worked flawlessly!

You can find him at his camp near the hunters' lodge.

text.title: 降妖除魔
text.objectives: 消灭妖术师阿卡拉。
text.description:
鹰身人无休无止地试图控制盆地。她们制造那些邪恶妖术包的速度和我们清理的动作一样快。

只要她们的妖术师还活着，天角部族就无法占领上风。必须除掉她。

english.title: Hex-a-Gone
english.objectives: Slay Hexweaver Akara.
english.description:
The harpies are relentless in their pursuit to control the basin. They are able to craft bags of foul magic as quickly as we can destroy them.

The Skyhorn cannot gain the upper hand as long as their hexweaver lives. She must be stopped.

text.title: Xavius Event TRACKING
text.objectives: Defeat Botanist Darkgrove
text.description:
(PH)
Darkgrove has run out of places to hide. Now it is time to finish him off.$B$BIf we stop him now, there may be hope for this valley yet.
text.completed: Return to Ysera

english.title: Xavius Event TRACKING
english.objectives: Defeat Botanist Darkgrove
english.description:
(PH)
Darkgrove has run out of places to hide. Now it is time to finish him off.$B$BIf we stop him now, there may be hope for this valley yet.
english.completed: Return to Ysera

text.title: 船坞汇报
text.objectives: 返回你在坠落之月的船坞。
text.description: 指挥官！我们接到了船坞的报告，情况越来越紧急了。你能回到坠落之月去和梅里克确认一下情况吗？我们每建一艘船，在对抗古尔丹的新部落时就可以多占一分优势。
text.giverWindow: 返回你的船坞，并与梅里克会面。

english.title: Shipyard Report
english.objectives: Return to your shipyard in Lunarfall.
english.description: Commander!  We have received reports from the shipyard that things are getting serious.  Can you head back to Lunarfall and check in with Merreck?  Every ship we build gives us another advantage over Gul'dan's new Horde.
english.giverWindow: Return to your shipyard and meet with Merreck.

text.title: 船坞汇报
text.objectives: 返回你在霜寒晶壁的船坞。
text.description: 指挥官！我们接到了船坞的报告，情况越来越紧急了。你能回到霜寒晶壁去和若洛什确认一下情况吗？我们每建一艘船，在对抗古尔丹的新部落时就可以多占一分优势。
text.giverWindow: 返回你的船坞，并与若洛什会面。

english.title: Shipyard Report
english.objectives: Return to your shipyard in Frostwall.
english.description: Commander!  We have received reports from the shipyard that things are getting serious.  Can you head back to Frostwall and check in with Rolosh?  Every ship we build gives us another advantage over Gul'dan's new Horde.
english.giverWindow: Return to your shipyard and meet with Rolash.

text.title: 黯石水晶
text.objectives: 寻找纳瓦罗格的黯石焦镜。
text.description:
没有了水晶焦镜，我的力量非常薄弱。它被俘虏我的人拿走了，不知道现在何处。

我很确定它在邪能图腾的某个人手里。如果你找到它的话，请带回来给我。
text.completion: This will help me repair my broken body.

english.title: Stonedark Crystal
english.objectives: Find Navarrogg's Stonedark Focus.
english.description:
Without my crystalline focus, my powers are weak. Those who captured me took it, and I know not where it is now.

I'm sure one of the Feltotem has it. If you find it, please return it to me.
english.completion: This will help me repair my broken body.

text.title: 血债
text.objectives: 在图鲁克断崖打败图鲁克·鲜血图腾。
text.description:
你证明了自己是一个比鲜血图腾更好的盟友。有了聚焦水晶，我的伤势得以痊愈，只可惜弗拉格已经无力回天。

图鲁克和鲜血图腾必将为此付出代价。我们要赶在他们对洞穴里的人民发起攻击之前，把他们打个措手不及。
text.completion: You have earned my trust. The Stonedark are not yet safe from our brothers led by Dargrul the Underking. We would willingly join Mayla Highmountain and her tauren against them.

english.title: Blood Debt
english.objectives: Defeat Torok Bloodtotem at Torok's Bluff.
english.description:
You have proven a much greater ally than the Bloodtotem ever were. With my focus crystal, my wounds are healed. I fear Frag was too far gone to revive.

Torok and his Bloodtotem will suffer for what they have done to us. Let's pay them a visit before they can mount an attack against the cave of my people.
english.completion: You have earned my trust. The Stonedark are not yet safe from our brothers led by Dargrul the Underking. We would willingly join Mayla Highmountain and her tauren against them.

text.title: 雄鹰之魂的祝福
text.objectives: 在至高岭的护灵岗哨接受雄鹰之魂的祝福。
text.description:
长矛与欧恩哈拉的灵魂相连。按照传统，我们需要与它进行交流，并在接受祝福之后再去寻找长矛。它或许会给我们一些启示。

如果你陪我前往护灵岗哨，我会召唤出雄鹰之魂，祈求它在战斗中保佑我们。

english.title: The Eagle Spirit's Blessing
english.objectives: Receive the Eagle Spirit's blessing at Spiritwatch Point in Highmountain.
english.description:
The spear is linked to a spirit called Ohn'ahra. It has been tradition for us to speak with her and receive her blessing before going after the spear. She may also impart some knowledge.

If you would accompany me to Spiritwatch Point, I will summon the Eagle Spirit and ask for its blessing in the coming fight.

text.title: Satyr Line TRACKING
text.objectives: Defeat Botanist Darkgrove
text.description:
(PH)
Darkgrove has run out of places to hide. Now it is time to finish him off.$B$BIf we stop him now, there may be hope for this valley yet.
text.completed: Return to Ysera

english.description:
(PH)
Darkgrove has run out of places to hide. Now it is time to finish him off.$B$BIf we stop him now, there may be hope for this valley yet.
english.completed: Return to Ysera

text.title: 攻击女巫秘地
text.objectives: 在女巫秘地消灭$1oa个紫喉鹰身人和$2oa个天须死忠者。
text.description: 步行进入女巫秘地，消灭你能找到的所有鹰身人。$b$b削减她们的数量！$b$b我们会从空中协助你，把她们都逼到地面，任你处置。$b$b让这些女巫尝尝你的……那个东西……的厉害。
text.completion: Haha! You are covered in the feathers of your enemies.

english.title: Assaulting the Haglands
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Crawliac Harpies and $2oa Skywhisker Loyalists in the Haglands.
english.description: Proceed on foot into the Haglands and slay any harpies you find.$b$bQuell their numbers!$b$bWe will provide air support and force your prey to the ground where you can deal with them.$b$bShow these witches the fury of your... well... your "you."
english.completion: Haha! You are covered in the feathers of your enemies.

objectiveDetails.description: 击杀紫喉巫羽法师或召亡战士

text.title: 互惠互利
text.objectives: 在至高岭的铁角飞地找巴姆·碎石。
text.description: 你也知道，这个混合烧瓶并没有遭到严重的损坏。我很确定它修复一下就能使用。$b$b我不擅长修复玻璃，不过我知道一个名叫巴姆·碎石的牛头人，他是这方面的专家。他虽然做着铁匠生意，但是认识的人都说他很会处理玻璃。$b$b那些牛头人可不会白白给你干活，你得好好表现。

english.title: Flasking for a Favor
english.objectives: Seek out Barm Stonebreaker at the Ironhorn Enclave in Highmountain.
english.description: You know, this mixing flask didn't suffer terrible damage. I'm positive it can just be repaired.$b$bI'm no expert in glass repair, but I've heard of someone who is--a tauren by the name of Barm Stonebreaker. He's a smith by trade, but those who know him say he was born to work glass.$b$bThose tauren don't work for free, so you may be in for some work yourself.

objectiveDetails.description: 在至高岭寻找巴姆·碎石

text.title: 修补滤网
text.objectives: 在瓦尔莎拉寻找一位可以帮你缝补丝绸的裁缝。
text.description: 这样的布料带回去对德崔斯一点用也没有。$b$b瓦尔莎拉也许会有裁缝愿意帮你缝补一下。$b$b之前帮助你的女祭司或许知道谁可以帮你。

english.title: Mending the Filter
english.objectives: Try to find the whereabouts of a tailor in Val'sharah who can help you mend the silk.
english.description: Bringing back the cloth in such a manner would not be beneficial to Deucus.$b$bPerhaps there's a tailor here in Val'sharah who'd be willing to mend it for you.$b$bThe priestess who helped you earlier may know of such a person.

text.title: 未知的力量
text.objectives: 从塔纳安丛林的任意宝藏，稀有或稀有精英生物身上收集一枚被邪能腐蚀的埃匹希斯碎片。
text.description: 那个被叫做古尔丹的兽人已经毁灭了他自己的人民，现在又想要毁灭我们余下的人。卡纳克那些堕落的流亡者们已经因为那个虚无飘渺的重返天空的许诺而投靠古尔丹了。他将埃匹希斯的力量赐予了他最强大的爪牙，但以一种我无法理解的方法扭曲了它们。给我带一块这种碎片来吧。

english.title: Unknowable Power
english.objectives: Collect a Fel-Corrupted Apexis Fragment from any Treasure or from any Rare or Rare Elite creature in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: The one they call Gul'dan has ruined his own people, and now seeks to ruin what remains of mine as well. The fallen outcasts at Kra'nak have already pledged themselves to Gul'dan in a false promise of a return to the skies. He has given the most powerful of his minions the power of the Apexis, but twisted in a way that I cannot explain. Bring one of these fragments to me.

text.title: 无法看到的影响
text.objectives: 从塔纳安丛林的任意宝藏、稀有生物或稀有精英生物身上收集$oa枚被邪能腐蚀的埃匹希斯碎片。
text.description: 埃匹希斯碎片中的腐蚀已经开始影响我的许多同胞了。我们已经完全习惯了它赋予我们的力量，每天都有越来越多的人臣服于那黑暗的低语。你得再给我多找些样本来，我才能将族人从新的诅咒中解放出来。

english.title: Unseen Influence
english.objectives: Collect $oa Fel-Corrupted Apexis Fragments from any Treasure or from any Rare or Rare Elite creature in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: The corruption in the Apexis has begun to affect many of my people. We are so accustomed to the power it grants us that more succumb to the whispers every day. You must bring me more samples so I can free my people from yet another curse.

text.title: 深入洞穴
text.objectives: 在黯石洞穴消灭$1oa个鱼人。
text.description:
我们受够那些鱼人了。他们在洞穴里窜来窜去，就像自己家一样。他们偷走了我们最珍贵的圣物，还弄得到处都是鱼鳍的痕迹。

消灭一些鱼人，让他们知道这里不是他们的地盘。
text.completion: I could hear their murlurulurls echoing in the cavern. Maybe they'll think twice before taking our stuff next time.

english.title: Deep in the Cavern
english.objectives: Slay $1oa murlocs in Stonedark Cavern.
english.description:
We're getting tired of those murlocs. They skitter around the cavern like they own it. They stole some of our most precious relics and got their fishy fins all over them. 

Kill a few of them so they know they don't run things around here.
english.completion: I could hear their murlurulurls echoing in the cavern. Maybe they'll think twice before taking our stuff next time.

text.title: 咕噜咕噜
text.objectives: 消灭咕噜咕噜。
text.description:
鱼人平时很怕我们，但有些体型较大的鱼人带头闯入我们的洞穴，现在他们的胆子也越来越大。

消灭他们的首领。他的名字好像叫“咕噜咕噜”。
text.completion: That ought to send some of the murlocs packing.
text.giverWindow: 咕咕噜咕噜噜咕噜！噜咕咕咕！

english.title: Guhruhlruhlruh
english.objectives: Defeat Guhruhlruhlruh.
english.description:
The murlocs are usually pretty scared of us, but some bigger one led them into our cavern and they're getting too brave.

Kill their leader. I think its name is something like "Guhruhlruhlruh."
english.completion: That ought to send some of the murlocs packing.
english.giverWindow: Ruhrul gulul gruhhln! Lulhulghnnn!

text.title: 黯石圣物
text.objectives: 找回反抗之链、坚韧之轮以及忍耐之杖。
text.description:
鱼人偷走了我们的一些圣物，带到了底层洞穴里。

在我们准备的时候，你可以去找回圣物吗？
text.completion: You found them! Not sure how you carried them all at one time...

english.title: Stonedark Relics
english.objectives: Recover the Chain of Resistance, Wheel of Fortitude, and Rod of Bearing.
english.description:
The murlocs managed to steal some of our sacred relics and carry them down into the lower cavern.

While we warm up, do you think you could go find them?
english.completion: You found them! Not sure how you carried them all at one time...

text.title: 举起来了？
text.objectives: 把重物扛到利夫布鲁的雕像处，然后再扛回去找强壮的丹鲁尔。
text.description: 你能举起来？如果你可以把这些东西扛到利夫布鲁的雕像那里再抗回来，或许我们可以聊聊。
text.completion: Stronger than you look, little one.

english.title: You Lift, Brul?
english.objectives: Carry the weights to the statue of Liftbrul and return to Damrul the Stronk.
english.description: Do you even lift? If you can carry these weights to the statue of Liftbrul and back, maybe we can talk.
english.completion: Stronger than you look, little one.

objectiveDetails.description: 扛着重物回去找丹鲁尔

text.title: 突袭邪能熔炉
text.objectives: 突袭塔纳安丛林铁城港的钢铁部落援军。
text.description:
钢铁部落仍在从德拉诺各地调派援军以增援地狱火堡垒的防御力量。假如无法切断他们的补给线，我们在塔纳安的计划就会失去控制。

对铁城港的补给线进行一次战略打击应能使钢铁部落疲于防守，让我们能够维持住目前的成果。

english.title: Assault on the Fel Forge
english.objectives: Assault the Iron Horde reinforcements at Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description:
The Iron Horde continue to bring in reinforcements from all over Draenor to reinforce their position at Hellfire Citadel. If we don't cut off the flow of supplies then we risk losing control of our plans in Tanaan.

A strategic attack to the supply lines at Ironhold Harbor is just the thing to keep the Iron Horde on the defensive and maintain our momentum.

text.title: 突袭邪能熔炉
text.objectives: 突袭塔纳安丛林铁城港的钢铁部落援军。
text.description:
钢铁部落仍在从德拉诺各地调派援军以增援地狱火堡垒的防御力量。假如无法切断他们的补给线，我们在塔纳安的计划就会失去控制。

对铁城港的补给线进行一次战略打击应能使钢铁部落疲于防守，让我们能够维持住目前的成果。

english.title: Assault on the Fel Forge
english.objectives: Assault the Iron Horde reinforcements at Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description:
The Iron Horde continue to bring in reinforcements from all over Draenor to reinforce their position at Hellfire Citadel. If we don't cut off the flow of supplies then we risk losing control of our plans in Tanaan.

A strategic attack to the supply lines at Ironhold Harbor is just the thing to keep the Iron Horde on the defensive and maintain our momentum.

english.title: Assault on the Ruins of Kra'nak
Assault on the Ruins of Kra'nak
Assault on the Temple of Sha'naar
Assault on the Temple of Sha'naar

text.title: 突袭基尔加丹王座
text.objectives: 突袭塔纳安丛林基尔加丹王座的暗影议会军队。
text.description:
暗影议会正在被他们称为基尔加丹王座的高山顶上召唤他们的恶魔主子。我们都知道燃烧军团有多么危险，不要忘记第一次大战的教训。

前往基尔加丹王座，让我们阻止燃烧军团的入侵。

english.title: Assault on the Throne of Kil'jaeden
english.objectives: Assault the Shadow Council forces at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description:
The Shadow Council are summoning their demonic masters upon a mountain they are calling the Throne of Kil'jaeden. Remember the first war, we know the destruction the legion can cause if they are unchecked.

Head to the Throne of Kil'jaeden and let's put an end to this invasion before it can begin.

text.title: 突袭基尔加丹王座
text.objectives: 突袭塔纳安丛林基尔加丹王座的暗影议会军队。
text.description:
暗影议会正在被他们称为基尔加丹王座的高山顶上召唤他们的恶魔主子。别大意，那里可是整个塔纳安最危险的地方。

快去召集一支战斗小队突袭基尔加丹王座吧，别让燃烧军团在这里站稳了脚跟！

english.title: Assault on the Throne of Kil'jaeden
english.objectives: Assault the Shadow Council forces at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description:
The Shadow Council are summoning their demonic masters upon a mountain they are calling the Throne of Kil'jaeden. We know the destruction the legion can cause if they are left unchecked.

Head to the Throne of Kil'jaeden and let's put an end to this invasion before it can begin.

text.title: 血炼洞穴
text.objectives: 把森林女巫放到祭坛上，并在决斗中打败好战者。
text.description:
鲜血图腾的所有族人以及尊贵的客人都必须在岗哨下方的洞穴中通过鲜血试炼。

他们让你参加这个仪式，我希望这是一个好兆头。你必须证明自己的能力，在决斗中打败好战者，而且还要到洞穴深处的祭坛去献祭。
text.completion: They said an outsider would wield the Hammer of Khaz'goroth. I doubt you could even lift it.

english.title: Cave of the Blood Trial
english.objectives: Place the Witch of the Wood's carcass on the altar and defeat a Warmonger in single combat.
english.description:
All Bloodtotem and distinguished guests must go through a trial of blood in the cavern beneath this outpost.

I hope it's a good sign that they wish you to participate in this rite of passage. You will need to show proof of your deeds, defeat a Warmonger in single combat, then perform sacrifice at an altar deep in the cavern.
english.completion: They said an outsider would wield the Hammer of Khaz'goroth. I doubt you could even lift it.

text.title: 意外之盟
text.objectives: 在雷霆图腾与梅拉·高岭谈一谈。
text.description:
你赢得了我的信任。并非所有的卓格巴尔都像地底之王达古尔的手下那么狂暴，也并非所有的牛头人都像鲜血图腾那么嗜血。

你可以告诉梅拉·高岭她有我们的支持。你也可以自由探索我们的洞窟家园，$n。
text.completion:
Torok is dead? By... your hand? He must have truly given in to his thirst for blood if that came to pass.

The Stonedark on our side, though... That is an advantage I had not expected. Navarrogg has always been much more agreeable than Dargrul and his brood. Thank you for striking this rare alliance, $n.

english.title: Unexpected Allies
english.objectives: Speak with Mayla Highmountain at Thunder Totem.
english.description:
You have gained my trust. Not all drogbar are as violent as the savages led by Dargrul the Underking, nor are all tauren as bloodthirsty as the Bloodtotem.

You may tell Mayla Highmountain that she has our support. The cavern we call home is yours to explore freely as well, $n.
english.completion:
Torok is dead? By... your hand? He must have truly given in to his thirst for blood if that came to pass.

The Stonedark on our side, though... That is an advantage I had not expected. Navarrogg has always been much more agreeable than Dargrul and his brood. Thank you for striking this rare alliance, $n.

objectiveDetails.description: 等待纳瓦罗格完成仪式
在雷霆图腾与纳瓦罗格见面

text.title: Vale POI Event TRACKING
text.objectives: Defeat Botanist Darkgrove
text.description:
(PH)
Darkgrove has run out of places to hide. Now it is time to finish him off.$B$BIf we stop him now, there may be hope for this valley yet.
text.completed: Return to Ysera

english.title: Vale POI Event TRACKING
english.objectives: Defeat Botanist Darkgrove
english.description:
(PH)
Darkgrove has run out of places to hide. Now it is time to finish him off.$B$BIf we stop him now, there may be hope for this valley yet.
english.completed: Return to Ysera

text.title: 切除病源
text.objectives: 在亡灵骑兵入侵地消灭药剂师克斯哈特。
text.description:
这张地图指出了被遗忘者在灰色哨所周围的战略部署。东部的标记处是一个药剂师营地，那里就是亡灵骑兵的补给地点。

如果除掉负责制造瘟疫的药剂师，也许就能阻止这场入侵，防止亡灵骑兵进一步扩散瘟疫。
text.completion: To think that the Forsaken were brash enough to brew their blight in our own backyard. With the loss of their apothecary, their invasion force is left without teeth. $B$BYou have done well, $n.

english.title: Cut Out the Heart
english.objectives: Kill Apothecary Curseheart in the Dread-Rider Incursion.
english.description:
This map points out the strategic locations of the Forsaken forces around Greywatch. A marker to the east indicates an apothecary camp where Dread-Riders are being supplied from.

If you were to take out the apothecary in charge of creating this plague, it could stem the invasion and prevent the Dread-Riders from spreading the plague any further.
english.completion: To think that the Forsaken were brash enough to brew their blight in our own backyard. With the loss of their apothecary, their invasion force is left without teeth. $B$BYou have done well, $n.

text.title: 水晶之怒
text.objectives: 消灭戈尔莫格。
text.description:
一个叫戈尔莫格的卓格巴尔砾岩术士进入了我们圣水洞穴，并想吸取洞穴的能量为他所用。

我们必须赶在他变得过于强大之前，将他拿下。

他就在上层洞穴。
text.completion: I have never seen a drogbar transform like that. The Hammer of Khaz'goroth is indeed powerful.

english.title: Crystal Fury
english.objectives: Slay Gelmogg.
english.description:
A drogbar stonecaster known as Gelmogg entered our sacred water caverns and aims to draw its power into himself.

We must destroy him before he gets too powerful.

He is in the upper caverns.
english.completion: I have never seen a drogbar transform like that. The Hammer of Khaz'goroth is indeed powerful.

text.title: 元素的平衡
text.objectives: 找回$1oa个强能水晶。
text.description:
卓格巴尔把他们的邪恶水晶放在我们的洞穴里吸收里面的魔力，等到蓄满之后便取走它们。

我们必须取回水晶，让魔力重新消散回水中，否则卓格巴尔肯定会把魔力用作邪恶的企图。
text.completion: With the magic now spreading back into the cave, the balance of elements will be restored and the drogbar will not last long here.

english.title: Balance of Elements
english.objectives: Recover $1oa Empowered Crystals.
english.description:
The drogbar place their foul crystals in our cave to absorb the magic within, and then they collect them when they are saturated with power.

We must recover the crystals so the magic might dissipate and be suffused back into the waters, or else the drogbar will find ways to corrupt the magic to their own purposes.
english.completion: With the magic now spreading back into the cave, the balance of elements will be restored and the drogbar will not last long here.

text.title: 洞穴入侵者
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个卓格巴尔嗜魔者或凶猛的食岩元素。
text.description:
卓格巴尔和他们的大地之怒霸占了洞穴。他们污染了里面的魔力，并摧毁了久居此处的元素。

让我们联手把他们赶出这个神圣的洞穴。
text.completion: The cave is nearly restored...

english.title: Invading Spelunkers
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Drogbar Manathirsters or Violent Crageaters.
english.description:
The drogbar and their earthen furies have overrun the cavern. They're perverting the magic within and destroying the elementals that have forever dwelled in this place.

Let's work together to remove them from this sacred cave.
english.completion: The cave is nearly restored...

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭卓格巴尔或大地之怒

text.title: 虫害
text.objectives: 在大地母亲之赐杀掉$1oa条生病的幼虫和$2oa条过度生长的幼虫。
text.description:
那些害虫正在残害我们的庄稼，还会伤害任何靠近它们的人。

你可以去消灭那些邪恶的生物吗？
text.completion: With fewer of those insects out there, I can tend to some of the crops.

english.title: Infestation
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Diseased Grubs and $2oa Overgrown Larva at Earthmother's Bounty.
english.description:
Those bugs are destroying our crops and attack any of us who get near them.

Would you exterminate some of those vile creatures?
english.completion: With fewer of those insects out there, I can tend to some of the crops.

text.title: 致命的奥姆古尔
text.objectives: 消灭致命的奥姆古尔，并取得他的诱虫喷剂。
text.description:
至高岭的居民，尤其是我们部族，与卓格巴尔和平共处了许多年。然而上一次在河湾的交易中，我们遭到了背叛。

他们常会为我们提供强效制剂，用以预防农地的虫害。但这次，奥姆古尔率领卓格巴尔破坏了我们赖以为生的庄稼。

致命的奥姆古尔就是虫害的罪魁祸首。消灭他，然后把他用来吸引害虫的东西交给我。
text.completion: Now we have what they used to spray our fields. I wonder what use we could put this to...

english.title: Ormgul the Pestilent
english.objectives: Slay Ormgul the Pestilent and acquire his Bug Sprayer.
english.description:
We've lived at peace with the drogbar for years--our tribe even more than the others. But we were betrayed in our last trade with them at Riverbend.

They usually supply us with potent alchemy to prevent insects from infesting our fields. This time, led by Ormgul, they have attacked the crops that sustain us all.

Ormgul the Pestilent is the one who brought the infection to our farmland. Destroy him, and bring me whatever he uses to attract the bugs to our land.
english.completion: Now we have what they used to spray our fields. I wonder what use we could put this to...

text.title: 无所遁形
text.objectives: 消灭邪能领主卡扎并获取他的邪能之力。
text.description:
你揭露了隐藏的恶魔，我现在也能感受到他们的存在，尤其是洞穴深处有一个强大的邪能领主。你必须抓住机会去夺取他的力量。

如果你可以应付他们的领主，洞穴里的小兵就交给我们解决。
text.giverWindow: 获取他的力量，避免伊利达雷据点的部队遭受伏击。

english.title: Hidden No More
english.objectives: Kill Fel Lord Caza and take his fel power.
english.description:
Now that you've uncovered the demons, I can sense them, too. Specifically, I sense a very powerful fel lord deeper in the cave. You need to grab his power while you still can.

If you can deal with their leader, we will take care of the rest of his forces in that cave.
english.giverWindow: Take his power and keep your army at the Illidari Foothold from being ambushed.

text.title: 河流之危
text.objectives: 到白水溪去找渔夫克里尔。
text.description:
现在最大的威胁已经解决了，我们可以把农地交给农妇玛娅负责。

但是危机还没有完全解除，$n。渔场和农地一样重要，如果渔夫克里尔说的是真的，那么渔场的情况可能比农地更加糟糕。
text.completion: I'm glad you arrived when you did. The drogbar are increasing their aggression as we speak.

english.title: The Flow of the River
english.objectives: Meet with Angler Creel in Whitewater Wash.
english.description:
We can leave Farmer Maya in charge of the farmland now that the greatest threat has been reduced.

But we aren't out of hot water just yet, $n. The fisheries are just as important as our fields, and they are in even greater danger than the farm if what Angler Creel says is true.
english.completion: I'm glad you arrived when you did. The drogbar are increasing their aggression as we speak.

text.title: 河湾之危
text.objectives: 在河湾与洁儿·河鬃谈一谈。
text.description: 河湾！地底之王是这么说的吧？$b$b那里是我的家园，也是我们储存过冬补给的地方。我们必须火速赶去警告他们。$b$b我们到那里碰头。
text.completion: It would seem we beat the Underking here.
text.completed: 回河湾找洁儿·河鬃。

english.title: High Water
english.objectives: Speak with Jale Rivermane at Riverbend.
english.description: Riverbend! Is that what the Underking said?$b$bThat is my home and the place where we store our winter supplies. We must make it there at all speed and warn them.$b$bMeet me there.
english.completion: It would seem we beat the Underking here.
english.completed: Return to Jale Rivermane at Riverbend.

text.title: 灵魂之井
text.objectives: 在普通难度地狱火堡垒中的血魔身上收集4块灵魂残片。
text.description: 你打败了古尔丹的手下，他对这座邪能堡垒的控制被削弱了，我可以将你和你的盟军们一起传送到这座黑暗大厅的更深处。如果你能给我一些灵魂残片——比如说，就四块吧——就没有必要进行这些繁琐的步骤了，我可以掌控残片中的力量，将你们直接送到堡垒的上层。

english.title: Well of Souls
english.objectives: Collect 4 Soul Remnants from Gorefiend in Hellfire Citadel on Normal difficulty.
english.description: As you defeat Gul'dan's minions, his hold over this fel citadel weakens, allowing me to teleport you and your allies deeper into the dark halls. If I only I had some Soul Remnants - four of them, let's say - none of this would be necessary, and I could harness that power to send you directly into the upper reaches of the Citadel.

text.title: 灵魂之井
text.objectives: 在英雄难度地狱火堡垒中的血魔身上收集4块灵魂残片。
text.description: 你打败了古尔丹的手下，他对这座邪能堡垒的控制被削弱了，我可以将你和你的盟军们一起传送到这座黑暗大厅的更深处。如果你能给我一些灵魂残片——比如说，就四块吧——就没有必要进行这些繁琐的步骤了，我可以掌控残片中的力量，将你们直接送到堡垒的上层。

If I only I had some Soul Remnants - four of them, let's say - none of this would be necessary, and I could harness that power to send you directly into the upper reaches of the Citadel.

text.title: 邪能尖塔
text.objectives: 在普通难度地狱火堡垒中的玛诺洛斯身上收集4块邪能精华。
text.description: 如果我们能够直接传送到堡垒的顶端，到达古尔丹研习黑暗魔法的地方，事情就会变得简单很多了，不是吗？但这些大厅中仍然充斥着恶魔的力量，我的魔法无法穿透它们，达到那样的高度。$b$b如果能够利用强大的邪能精华，我就可以让我的魔法和他们的防御力量相容，绕过他们的防线。但只有在堡垒顶部才能够找到高度浓缩的邪能能量。这还真是个难题……

english.title: The Fel Spire
english.objectives: Collect 4 Fel Essences from Mannoroth in Hellfire Citadel on Normal difficulty.
english.description: This would all be so much simpler if we could just teleport directly to the top of the Citadel, where Gul'dan works his dark magic, wouldn't it? But while demonic power fills the halls, my magic cannot penetrate to such heights.$B$BIf only I had powerful Fel Essences to work with, I could attune my magic to their defenses and bypass them. But the only place you might find such concentrated fel energy would be atop the Citadel itself. What a conundrum....

text.title: 邪能尖塔
text.objectives: 在英雄难度地狱火堡垒中的玛诺洛斯身上收集4块邪能精华。

But the only place you might find such concentrated fel energy would be atop the Citadel itself. What a conundrum....

text.title: 泽斯高的血腥刀刃
text.objectives: 从泽斯高的血环氏族兽人身上收集$oa柄血环仪祭之刃。
text.description: 血环氏族的兽人们在使用血魔法——和巫毒魔法类似，但会造成更多的损害。他们会切割自己的血肉。很多血环氏族的人都会随身携带锯齿状的仪祭之刃，用来在自己身上划口子。$b$b把他们的刀刃带回来，指挥官。我们可以用他们的力量来对付他们。

english.title: Bloodied Blades of Zeth'Gol
english.objectives: Collect $oa Bleeding Hollow Ritual Blades from Bleeding Hollow orcs in Zeth'Gol.
english.description: Them Bleeding Hollow orcs do blood magic - like voodoo but it hurt more. They cut their own flesh. Most of 'em carry curved ritual blades for carvin' themselves up.$b$bBring me them blades, commander. We can turn their power against 'em.

text.title: 水上作业
text.objectives: 在铁城港的士兵身上收集$oa张钢铁部落海军机要。
text.description: 钢铁部落的残余部队正通过铁城港朝塔纳安这边转移。如果我们知道要来的是谁，在什么时候到来，就可以利用我们的船坞给他们添些乱了。$b$b到铁城港去搞些情报来吧！

english.title: A Little Wetwork
english.objectives: Collect $oa Iron Horde Naval Manifests from forces in Ironhold Harbor.
english.description: What be left of the Iron Horde is comin' to Tanaan through Ironhold Harbor. If we knew who was comin' and when, we could use our shipyard to cause some chaos.$b$bGo to Ironhold Harbor and fish up some intelligence!

text.title: 堕落兄弟之血
text.objectives: 在塔纳安丛林的邪兽人身上收集$oa个魔血之瓶。
text.description: 喝下了古尔丹的毒药的兽人们已经变成了被邪能控制的、没有灵魂的野兽。$b$b女伯爵莉亚德琳和血骑士们认为他们或许还有救。他们希望能够从刚被转化的兽人身上获取血液样本。去把他们的血带回来，$n！$b$b在塔纳安各地都可以看到邪兽人，不过钢铁前线、邪能熔炉和基尔加丹王座是他们最集中的地方。

english.title: Blood of Fallen Brothers
english.objectives: Collect $oa Vials of Fel Blood from fel orcs throughout Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: Orcs that drink Gul'dan's poison turn into fel beasts. Soulless savages.$b$bLady Liadrin an' the Blood Knights think maybe there be a way back. They be wantin' samples of blood from freshly turned orcs. Get their blood, $n!$b$bYou be findin' fel orcs all over Tanaan, but the Iron Front, the Fel Forge, and the Throne of Kil'jaeden is where you find the most.

text.title: 暗影议会的秘密
text.objectives: 从卡纳克废墟或基尔加丹王座的暗影议会代表身上搜集$oa封暗影议会密函。
text.description: 古尔丹正像结网的蜘蛛一样发展他的暗影议会。不过他的部分新爪牙并不那么聪明。他们把暗影议会的机密写了下来，而没有烧掉。$b$b快去外头捕捉他的手下，把他们身上的机密带回来交给我！他们中有些人在卡纳克废墟和鸦人合作，有些则在基尔加丹王座的顶部出没。

english.title: Secrets of the Shadow Council
english.objectives: Collect $oa Shadow Council Missives from shadow council representatives in the Ruins of Kra'nak or the Throne of Kil'jaeden.
english.description: Gul'dan be growin' his Shadow Council like a spider spin a web. But some of this new blood, they not so smart. They write down the secrets but don't burn 'em.$b$bCatch his minions out in the open and bring their secrets back to me! You find them workin' with the arakkoa in da Ruins of Kra'nak or atop the Throne of Kil'jaeden.

text.title: 解除沙纳尔的武装
text.objectives: 从塔纳安丛林的沙纳尔神殿后面的矿井中收集$oa块德拉诺水晶原石。
text.description: 为了得到引导魔法的完美水晶，沙纳尔神殿的德莱尼人不惜挖穿整座山脉。现在恶魔占领了那里。我们不能让恶魔染指那些水晶，指挥官！$b$b攻击神殿后面的矿井，把水晶从它们手中抢过来。

english.title: Disarming Sha'naar
english.objectives: Collect $oa Unrefined Draenic Crystals from the mines located within the Temple of Sha'naar in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: Draenei at the Temple of Sha'naar would mine these mountains for perfect crystals used to channel their magics. Now demons be lootin' the place. We gotta keep those crystals out of demonic hands, commander!$b$bAttack the mines behind the temple and grab them crystals.

text.title: 掌控它们的力量
text.objectives: 在塔纳安丛林的钢铁前线击败一只钢铁战争戈隆，并收集战争戈隆挽具。
text.description: 格罗玛什·地狱咆哮那个老家伙设法把戈隆变成了兵器。沃金想知道他是如何做到的。$b$b到钢铁前线去，杀死一只那种巨大的野兽，然后把它身上的战争挽具带回来。但在执行这个任务时，你可能会需要帮助。

english.title: Harnessing Their Power
english.objectives: Collect a Wargronn Harness from an Iron Wargronn at the Iron Front in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: Ol' Grommash Hellscream found a way to weaponize the gronn. Vol'jin wants to know how.$b$bTravel to the Iron Front and kill one of them big beasties, then bring back its war harness. You might be needin' help.

text.title: 复仇之力
text.objectives: 向你召集的恶魔猎手传授复仇专精。
text.description:
这就是燃烧军团惧怕我们的原因。我们能够利用恶魔的秘密来反制他们，同时还能变得比他们更加强大。

快点，$n，把你学到的东西传授给我们吧。

english.title: Vengeance Will Be Mine!
english.objectives: Teach the Vengeance specialization to your assembled demon hunters.
english.description:
This is why the Legion fears us. We have the ability to turn their secrets against them and in so doing become stronger than they ever can be.

Quickly, $n, teach us what you have learned.

text.title: 传授浩劫专精

text.title: 塔纳安屠魔者
text.objectives: 在塔纳安丛林击杀$oa个恶魔。
text.description: 看看北方，$c。天空正变成病态的绿色。古尔丹的召唤传送门还没有获得全部的力量，但风中已经混杂进了恶魔的臭味。$b$b干掉它们，$n。尽你的所能摧毁那些恶魔，不要让它们抵达艾泽拉斯。沙纳尔神殿已经成为恶魔的老巢，基尔加丹王座也是一样。此外，你也可以在丛林中的任何地方找到游荡的恶魔。

english.title: Demonslayer of Tanaan
english.objectives: Slay $oa demons in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: Look to the north, $c. The sky is turning a sickly green. Gul'dan's summoning portals are not yet at full strength, but already the stench of demon is on the wind.$b$bSlay them, $n. Destroy as many beasts as you can before they find a way to Azeroth. The Temple of Sha'naar is infested, as is the Throne of Kil'jaeden, although you may find others wandering about the jungle.

text.title: Ashran Dominance
text.objectives: Defeat the Alliance at the event locations in Ashran and kill Grand Marshal Tremblade.
text.description: The Alliance refuse to back down in Ashran. Teach them that the Horde will not stand aside while they plunder the power of the ancient ogre empire to use for their own schemes.
text.giverWindow: Grand Marshal Tremblade leads the Alliance forces in Ashran.

text.objectives: Defeat the Horde at the event locations in Ashran and kill High Warlord Volrath.
text.description: As we feared the Horde are trying to consolidate their position here on the island by looting it, just like we feared. Get out there and show them the Alliance won't put up with their aggression.
text.giverWindow: Volrath leads the Horde forces in Ashran.

text.title: 加强攻势
text.objectives: 在塔纳安丛林完成2项区域奖励目标。
text.description: 我们把古尔丹的仆从赶跑了，指挥官！如果你愿意的话，我们应该向他的其他要塞也施加一些压力。

english.title: Pressing the Attack
english.objectives: Complete 2 bonus objective areas within Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: We got Gul'dan's minions on the run, commander! If you be feelin' it, we should put some pressure on some of his other strongholds as well.

text.title: Wrath of Azshara Heroic Reward Quest

english.title: Wrath of Azshara Heroic Reward Quest

text.title: 尖牙与利爪
text.objectives: 从塔纳安丛林的各种野生动物身上搜集$oa枚塔纳安丛林利齿。
text.description: 在要塞这些单薄的墙壁之外，丛林正在渐渐包围我们。你能感觉到吗？那是无法驯服的野性，$c，它正在呼唤着我们原始的本能。要想了解生命的真义，最好的方法就是直面死亡。$b$b和我一起去狩猎吧，$n！从那些野兽身上收集牙齿。荆棘沼泽的掠食者，佐拉姆沼泽的迅猛龙，甚至海边的海洋生物和食肉植物都长着牙齿。把它们带回来给我！

english.title: Tooth and Claw
english.objectives: Collect $oa Tanaan Jungle Teeth from the various wildlife within Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: Beyond the meager shelter of these fortress walls, the jungle closes in. Can you feel it? That is the untamed wilderness, $c, calling forth our primal instincts. There is no better way to feel alive than to court death.$b$bJoin me in the hunt, $n! Collect teeth from the wild beasts. The ravagers in Thornmire, the raptors in Zorammarsh - even the sea creatures along the strand and the little podling plants themselves all have teeth. Bring them to me!

text.title: 锻造
text.objectives: 在英灵殿的熔炉处与锻造大师海尔加谈一谈。
text.description: 你的新武器十分强大，不过我的铁匠们拥有数千载的锻造经验，他们肯定能为你的武器增色不少。去找锻造大师海尔加谈谈，看看他会如何强化你的武器。

english.title: The Forgening
english.objectives: Speak with Master Smith Helgar in the Forge in Valhallas.
english.description: Your new weapon is very powerful, but my smiths have mastered crafting over thousands of years. Speak to Master Smith Helgar and see what improvements can be made.

text.title: 打击钢铁部落
text.objectives: 在塔纳安丛林击杀$oa名钢铁部落兽人。
text.description: 黑石铸造厂陷落之后，古尔丹将钢铁部落变成了……更糟糕的东西。曾经聚集在格罗玛什旗帜之下的兽人们，要么是由于恐惧，要么是由于对复仇的渴望，开始接受邪能的腐化。$b$b到塔纳安的战场上去，将古尔丹的部落扫荡干净。不管是兽人还是邪兽人都是钢铁部落的余孽，一律格杀勿论！

english.title: Bringing Down the Iron Horde
english.objectives: Slay $oa Iron Horde orcs in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: Ever since the fall of Blackrock Foundry, Gul'dan has been turning the Iron Horde into... something worse. The orcs who once flocked to Grommash's banner, through either fear or thirst for revenge, are now embracing the fel.$b$bWade into the battlefields of Tanaan and lay waste to Gul'dan's forces. Orc or fel orc makes no difference. Gut what remains of the Iron Horde!
